ɓa gna , ma gna fye dna yesu eye n bulus zhin wo waʼazi nyi fye kun . aza deye ɓei zhin sisiva aɓi nu ngun-tnaba wohin ɓei zhin a yahudiyi prist nu .
shi ɓa ɓei tumwi lonu , aljanu da wa gna , mi kpe yesu yelo , n bulus yi , amma nyikanu n fyei ya ?
aljanu da wa she pui ɓa ngun-aba wa lu ɓa , ɓa sakun n nyakun ntna wando fi yi n ɓahin wuwuyi .
nabari ye kwa gnami fi afisus vinya , a yahudiyi na helleniyi ɓawo , aza ɓa wo edna n mwa ɓa la yesu eye tu .
aza n ɓa ɓei ga gaiciya nyi ɓa ɓe , ɓai da ɓa laifi duk na zoku shei .
ɓa ɓe nɓa azoku zhe nya yi , na laya yi , ɓa kpe ɓa ena .
atakarda azoku nya nɓa ɓo kpe na nyi oɓa gyewye ɓei ɓa sun ngye , .
deye ɓo wu ge ɓa la shekwoyi ɓedo gwo n gaiciya yi dna .
avun zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa wu bulus ge , wo lo akaya kafin wo lo urushelima , wa gna dole ma lo roma .
amma wa tnu timatawus ɓedo arastis na bye ɓa lo akaya , amma wohin wa ce dna n turki .
aza n wo ɓo tnu nyi ɓa ɓei zhin owo abmazhin yi nu .
n sayi wahala kwa laka na kristi yi n afisus .
pyada ho ai yi wo dimitiriyus wo nu ɓei la wahala ka , wa gna apyada je ge ɓa zhin ashan azurfa nya a helleniyi shekwoyi diyana nya .
wa yi apyada je wa gna , tnu-tnu nkwo nyi , yi bwa nyagyi nkwonu n agyiwyei .
n sayi fye kpe lo ge bulus ku aza bugba wan , har eyi ashan n yi zhin nyi , ato gye ɓalo ngye a shekwoyi nu m , ntu lonu eyi abwaze , ta gyi abye m , kwoi ta to yi nu bwa ya gmanyi m , amma du akni do yi .
n yi to zhin nyaho n za ye yin , yi ta bwi agyiwye nu nuwan gmanyin , amma du n yi diyana yi , okwo nu aza ga kwo mwa-mwa nyi vinya , anyi ɓa ku zamwi , fye ɓa ye lo nu ?
shi ɓa ɓei wo lonu oɓa minagyi kwa laka , n sai-sayi ɓa ya aku fi ɓa gna , diyana afisus nya zhin nya dnagmayi nu . nsai-sayi yi aza yezhi ezhi kwa totu n sunu yi .
ɓa wan gayus ɓedo aristakus yi ɓa lo ɓai n kwotu , nge ada ɓa wa .
ɓa gna aza deye zhin , bulus atnu-tnu kun-zhin-yi nu .
bulus ɓo ye wa lo wo gye ɓa , amma a kristi yi n afisus to ɓa yem .
a romayi dan sanda tukwoda ɓa gna bulus ge wo to lo m , kada ɓa wu wo .
a dan-sanda tukwoda ye ɓei zhin bulus anugun-do nu .
aza ɓai ɓowyi fi n kwotu , ngye anyasin yi , aɓo ɓa ku gmaje har azaho ma to ɓa kpe dalili nkwo zhin ɓa lo ɓo m .
a yahudiyi ɓa wan alikzanda ɓa gni wo lo cei na bye .
wa ku abwa wu n she woi ye wa da ɓo .
amma shi aza ɓei kpe ge wo zhin yahudiyayi zanu ɓa gna aku fi-fi har awa n gun aba .
ɓai ci ge , diyana afisus nya , ko zhin nya dnagmayi nu . ezhi sakatare wa ɓe wa gna aza ge , fye ku ce pi , fye kpe lo ge afisus nu zhin adini diyana nya tukwo , okwo nu nkwo degbe ɓei kaya ɓe da yi n she , mi gyi fye wye shi fye ku kpe ge ko nu zhin gaiciya n afisus .
afisus nu zhin adini tukwo njesun ntu diye ɓo fye to gyi minagyi nɓei na da nkwo tukwo m , fye to zhin nyaho dna n pye-pye m .
gaiciya nu oza n fya ɓe cei nyi , wo to wyi diyana nyahom , woi to ka kwo mwa-mwa ya m , nyaho to lo nkwo ka diyana mwa-mwa ya m , ko cewyi .
ndei dimitiriyus nɓo yi lo n ɓai , sai wa ɓe n kala yi n kwotu , alkali ɓa zo ɓa ɓeda vinya .
amma kwo bmiya fya vi owa .
njesun nfye aɓo do yi lo n ɓai aɓa mi a da fi n esu bokun .
yi wo dna lo ntu ge a romayi gmamnati ɓa yi yi ɓa nya yi dalili wahal a nya .
deye to kunce lo , mi ta mi ma ga ɓa dalili m . shi wo ɓo zo da lonu , wa ku aza gnami vinya .
shi aɓei ku aɓo wan zhi bulus wa zhin waʼazi amigna nya wa kpe akaya lo .
bulus ɓei zhin waʼazi lo cei na zhi yakwo woi lo akaya .
wo ɓei dna akaya har apya atnu , woi zhin shiri ge wa lo suriya , a gna wo ge a yahudiyi ye lo ɓa wu wo .
ntu ce nu wa lo makidoniya .
sopata , pihas nugun biriya yi za , aristakus n sekundus a tasalunikayi gayus n wo gmi n darba nyi .
timatawus n tikikus yi ɓedo n tirofimus yi aza ye vinya ɓa gni lo n bulus yi ɓa lo turki .
aza deye ɓo ku lo ɓa pmi yi zhi n turowas .
shi paska ɓo ku zo , ya lo eya n filibi ya bwa anyi-pyei ngun atnu , ya kpe turowas si .
ya fi ɓo har mako gmanyi .
ɓinuyi la kaya woi la fi n lahadi wyi a kristiyi ɓa ye zhi ɓa gyi dagayi tebur .
bulus wa zhin waʼazi n mwa kpa har sadu ntu ge efye ɓa gyi wa laka .
ena ɓei nyi n buzangna yi dai-dai n nyakun she n yi ɓei fi nyi .
shi bulus ɓo gni woi daɓo utikus woi tu woi wan gye , wa kaya n nyakun she tahi wa fi .
bulus wa shin lo wa la wo shi , wa gna aza ge fye to damun wo wye-wyei lo , a da aza .
ɓa jeze lo ɓa gyi abye n dagayi tebur gyi yi .
bulus wa gyi abye n ɓedai har nya knaya .
n labmi yi ɓa gna aje ammi .
sa fyewyi ɓa ɓe n samariyi nwye-wyei , a da aza n mwa .
bulus wa zan-zan wa lo asos , ama yi da ya lo eya ya ku si nwa bye .
shi yi ɓo sun na jei ɓo , ya knu eya lo ya lo mitilini .
shi efye ɓo gyi ya si kos , nyipyeyi do ya si samos ya ɓe har melitus .
bulus ɓeda amigna nya nafisus nsa deye bulus to ɓo ye ge wa kpe gni afisus m , wa lo urushelima cewo ntu paska ɓo .
shi yi ɓo si melitus , bulus wa tnu afisus atukwoda ɓo , ɓa she gun yi n nuwan gbe .
shi ɓa ɓei ɓe wa gna ɓage , fye kpe lo ge tunyi nyipyei kmisunyi n mi ɓei ɓe turki har sayi .
mi ku dagayi tnu-tnu zhin ntukwo gba yi , saho ma ci bwi , mi-i sun wahala .
a yahudiyi ye cici ge ɓa wu mi .
amma mi to fa fye gaiciya gna ɓo m .
mi ku gaiciya gna fye naza bye har ma dna n fye a puwa .
nabari gmanyi nu n mi cei ntu a yahudiyi ɓo ɓedo abye do yi , nabari ho ko nu nyi ge aza ɓa fa laifi ɓa ɓe shekwoyi aba .
tile zaho-zahoi wa ga yesu gaiciya .
n sayi mi lo urushelima nu , ntu ge zafun gyi-gyi-yi na gna mi ge mi lo .
amma mita kpe nya ye lo nkwo ɓo zhin mi ɓo m .
amma zafun gyi-gyi-yi ku gna mi ge wahala lo na bye .
omi wye-wyei zhin gbeloyi nu sai dai ma zhin a pma n kwoi , ma zhin tnu-tnu n shekwoyi ga mi nyi .
emi tnu-tnu nu ge ma gna azaje shekwoyi yeye ɓo , nwo alheri yi .
mi kpe lo ge zaho-zahoi nfye mi , ta je mi wye gye m .
gaiciya nu n mi da zaho-zahoi ami ta tu n min .
ntu ge mi to so shekwoyi ɓeda m , mi-i ku kwo gna zaho-zahoyi .
suku-suku , fye kpa akni shekwoyi nya wato owo ikklisiya nwa si n wo ami yi nyi , zafun gyi-gyi-yi na kni fye fya ze aɓo wyednayi .
mi kpe lo ge shi mi fa fye a malami a nukwoyi ɓa gna fye gna-gna , ɓa zhin a cam-cam nu .
azaho ma nfye mi ɓa ɓa shan gaiciya do , ntu ge ɓa gni aza ga ɓahin .
fye dnawye fya pa ngye shi ma gye ma nuwan n fyei esa nu ma sase n fya ba , har aye ngun ata .
saho ma cibwi ntu fye ɓo .
n sayi ma fa fye n shekwoyi akun n wo ɓeda yi , n kwo iko yi kwa mi fye gaiciya ga , wa ga fye gado anabarka nwo cei zhin shiri a owo aza nyi .
mi to shin agyiwye san gyi ko aje manayi m .
fye kpe lo n gye shi ma zhin tnu-tnu n ma bwai , ntu mi bukata ɓo ɓedo n ma tnu-tnu kun-zhin-yi yi .
mi la ze gurbi nfye aba ntu ge ma ku bma awyekwoi zhin .
ma zhin lonu ntu ge mi pa yesu kristi ɓeda ɓo n wa da ge , ʼnyaga du gwo-gwo n anabarka . ʼ shi wo ɓei ku ɓeda zo wa ca-kwo-kwo wa zhin aduwa n ɓai .
ɓa cibwi n kala yi ɓa gna je ami .
ɓa ɓo zhin bugba zhi-zhiyi , ntu ge wo ɓei gna ge ɓa ta je wo wye gye m .
ɓa kun lo n woi har eya aba .
shi aɓei ku aɓo wan zhi bulus wa zhin waʼazi amigna nya wa kpe akaya lo .

ya kun ya lo ya sun a kristi yi ya fi n ɓai har mako gmanyi .
shekwoyi wa daɓo n bulus yi n ɓa gbe ge wo to lo urushelima m .
shi lahadi ɓei wu vi ya jeze lo eya aba n gnisun a kristi yi nɓa anyikwo yi n ɓa aɓi yi .
n nuwan gbe eyi vinya ya kniakwokwo ya zhin aduwa .
yaku ka , ɓahin ɓa jeze lo api .
shi yi ɓo ku a kristi yi ɓi gna n tayar , ya lo pitolemi , ya kpe zhi ɓo n nyipyei yi gmanyi , ya ɓi a kristi yi gna .
ya ku ka ɓo , ya lo kaisariya , ya lo filibbus puwa waʼazi zhinyi nu n woi , wo zhin gmanyi nu dna aza , tnaba aɓei kni ntu nyagyi gna ɓo nyi .
wo ɓei anyigun yi ngun-anyi ɓa ɓei zhin anabi nu .
sa yi ɓo fi ɓo , agabus wa gmi n yahudiya wa ɓe , wo ɓei n nyaga anabci nya yi .
shi wo ɓei ɓe yi amisa , wa ku bulus belti , wa pa wohin apita na bwa yi , wa gna , zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa gna ge elo nu aɓa zhin n belti dagayi yi a yahudiyi ɓa pa wo n urushelima ɓa ga wo dna a romayi akun . shi yi ɓo wo lonu a kristi yi n kaisariya n yi gnisun n woi nyi , ya gna wo ge wo to lo urushelima m .
amma wagna ge , kni nu zhin fyei ci bwi a ?
fye bma mi bugba ya nu .
mi n shiri zhin lo to ge ma lo kurkuku n urushelima gmanyi m , amma ma fi ntu dagayi yesu kristi ɓo . shi yi to ɓo mi n wo ɓo m , ya ku yi nya fa wa gna , shekwoyi ɓeye kwo ze lo nu . ya kuka ya ku eyi a kaya ya lo urushelima .
a kristi yi n kaisariya fyewyi ɓa kun lo n yi har urushelima , shi yi ɓo si ya lo manason puwa saipuriyi za , kristi yi kmisunyi nu ɓei n woi .
a yesu viyi vinya ɓa gwo yi na gmada yi .
efya gyi bulus wa ku yi wa lo cei n yakubu aba ɓedo ikklisiya ; atukwoda yi n urushelima , ya yezhi n ɓai .
shi yi ɓo ku aje ɓi gna bulus wa gna ɓa anya vinya n shekwoyi ku zhin n ya ba n abye do a tantasin .
a da ɓa vinya ɓai ci shekwoyi , ɓa gna omazado a yahudiyi lo n mwa nɓa ku gaiciya ga , amma ɓa zhi ge har sayi a shi owa bwa na kunnu yi .
a yahudiyi a kristi yi n ya ɓa ku wo ge ho zhin gaba lo n musa owa yi na yahudiyi kunnu yi , hoi gna ge a to zhin aɓi kaciya m .
yi ɓa zhin wunna ?
ntu ge ɓa ɓa wo ge ho dna lo n ya .
yi ku kpe nya yi ɓa zhin , aza lo n ya ngun-anyi nɓa ku shiri zhin ɓa wun tukwo ɓa zhin alkawali .
kun lo n ɓai a wun fye tukwo aduwa nyakun .
nha zhin lonu zaho-zahoi ɓa kpe ge ho ye lo na yahudiyi kun-nu yi .
amma yi ta gna abye do lo , n ɓa vi yesu nyi ge ɓa zhin kunnu ye m .
yi gna ge ɓa vi aɓo n yi ɓei ka fi ɓa n wasika nyi nu .
to ɓa zhin anagbayin .
shi wo ɓei wo lonu , wa ye wa vi ɓa shaula wa lo aduwa nyakun wa ku kunnu .
ɓa ga sakirifais har anyipyei tnaba , nyipyei tnaba yi a yahudiyi ho a .
turkiyi , ɓa ɓe urushelima ɓa gye wo dna aduwa nyakun .
ɓa zhin aza ɓa la rigima ka n bulus yi .
ɓa wan wo ɓai ɓo wyi ɓai gna a israilayi fye yewu .
oza i nyi n wo zhin waʼazi gaba n yi , woi gna aza ge ɓa to shi a yahudiyi owa n .
har ma woi tu aduwa nyakun cegye , woi lo ɓe abyedo yi .
ɓa ɓo da lonu ntu ge , ɓa ɓo ku gye bulus n kunsun n tirafimus yi .
wo ɓo zhin ebyedo nu , woi gmi afisus n turki ʼkni .
ɓa gye ngye bulus la lo ɓe n woi nu na duwa nyakun .
ezhi vinya kwa ku wo ɓo na da tu bulus tukwo .
ɓa gmi wo ya na duwa nyakun ɓa ku aba gu .
ɓai ye ɓa wu wo , amma a soja tukwoda wa wo sunu n zhi mi .
n sai-sai yi wa tnu a soja yi ɓa lo rigima aba .
shi a yahudiyi ɓo gye asoja ɓai ɓe ɓa ku fa bulus lu ɓo .
soja tukwoda wa bulus wan , wa wo pa agmayi , wa nya a yahudiyi ɓo enya n bulus zhin .
ɓa je kala ku na ɓeda yi ngye azhi n gnikwo .
amma to wa bwa ɓo kpalayi m , wa gna a soja ge ɓa lo n bulus yi nɓa barki .
a yahudiyi ɓa vi lo ɓa zhin atna ge ba wu bulus , amma a soja ɓa wo la tu agbe-gbegye ntu ge ɓa gni wo .
ɓai ɓowyi , ɓai gna a lo woi , a lo woi .
ai ye a lo dna n bulus yi n nyakun , wa gna soja tukwoda ge , suku mi ye ma daɓo .
soja tukwoda wa nya wo ge , wo wo helleni lo ? oho nu to zhin masar za n wo ɓo la wahala ka aye fyewyi n ɓa duya nyi har haku aza wuyi , ha lo ɓai n zhabui m .
bulus wa gna awo .
mi zhin yahudiyayi nu mi gmi n tarusus nu , n silisiya kni .
mi ɓa ho ha ye ge ma daɓo na za deye yi .
bulus kna aza wyeya tu nwo tnu-tnu ɓo soja tukwoda wa esa ga wo , bulus wa tu n nyakun she bayi , wa gna za ɓa ce pi wa da aɓeda ye n ibrahim bye yi .
shi yi ɓei ku aje gna mi , na afisus yi a tukwoda yi , ya lo eya ya lo kos efya gyi ya si roda ya du ya lo patara .

shi yi ɓo ku a kristi yi ɓi gna n tayar , ya lo pitolemi , ya kpe zhi ɓo n nyipyei yi gmanyi , ya ɓi a kristi yi gna .
ya ku ka ɓo , ya lo kaisariya , ya lo filibbus puwa waʼazi zhinyi nu n woi , wo zhin gmanyi nu dna aza , tnaba aɓei kni ntu nyagyi gna ɓo nyi .
wo ɓei anyigun yi ngun-anyi ɓa ɓei zhin anabi nu .
sa yi ɓo fi ɓo , agabus wa gmi n yahudiya wa ɓe , wo ɓei n nyaga anabci nya yi .
shi wo ɓei ɓe yi amisa , wa ku bulus belti , wa pa wohin apita na bwa yi , wa gna , zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa gna ge elo nu aɓa zhin n belti dagayi yi a yahudiyi ɓa pa wo n urushelima ɓa ga wo dna a romayi akun . shi yi ɓo wo lonu a kristi yi n kaisariya n yi gnisun n woi nyi , ya gna wo ge wo to lo urushelima m .
amma wagna ge , kni nu zhin fyei ci bwi a ?
fye bma mi bugba ya nu .
mi n shiri zhin lo to ge ma lo kurkuku n urushelima gmanyi m , amma ma fi ntu dagayi yesu kristi ɓo . shi yi to ɓo mi n wo ɓo m , ya ku yi nya fa wa gna , shekwoyi ɓeye kwo ze lo nu . ya kuka ya ku eyi a kaya ya lo urushelima .
a kristi yi n kaisariya fyewyi ɓa kun lo n yi har urushelima , shi yi ɓo si ya lo manason puwa saipuriyi za , kristi yi kmisunyi nu ɓei n woi .
a yesu viyi vinya ɓa gwo yi na gmada yi .
efya gyi bulus wa ku yi wa lo cei n yakubu aba ɓedo ikklisiya ; atukwoda yi n urushelima , ya yezhi n ɓai .
shi yi ɓo ku aje ɓi gna bulus wa gna ɓa anya vinya n shekwoyi ku zhin n ya ba n abye do a tantasin .
a da ɓa vinya ɓai ci shekwoyi , ɓa gna omazado a yahudiyi lo n mwa nɓa ku gaiciya ga , amma ɓa zhi ge har sayi a shi owa bwa na kunnu yi .
a yahudiyi a kristi yi n ya ɓa ku wo ge ho zhin gaba lo n musa owa yi na yahudiyi kunnu yi , hoi gna ge a to zhin aɓi kaciya m .
yi ɓa zhin wunna ?
ntu ge ɓa ɓa wo ge ho dna lo n ya .
yi ku kpe nya yi ɓa zhin , aza lo n ya ngun-anyi nɓa ku shiri zhin ɓa wun tukwo ɓa zhin alkawali .
kun lo n ɓai a wun fye tukwo aduwa nyakun .
nha zhin lonu zaho-zahoi ɓa kpe ge ho ye lo na yahudiyi kun-nu yi .
amma yi ta gna abye do lo , n ɓa vi yesu nyi ge ɓa zhin kunnu ye m .
yi gna ge ɓa vi aɓo n yi ɓei ka fi ɓa n wasika nyi nu .
to ɓa zhin anagbayin .
shi wo ɓei wo lonu , wa ye wa vi ɓa shaula wa lo aduwa nyakun wa ku kunnu .
ɓa ga sakirifais har anyipyei tnaba , nyipyei tnaba yi a yahudiyi ho a .
turkiyi , ɓa ɓe urushelima ɓa gye wo dna aduwa nyakun .
ɓa zhin aza ɓa la rigima ka n bulus yi .
ɓa wan wo ɓai ɓo wyi ɓai gna a israilayi fye yewu .
oza i nyi n wo zhin waʼazi gaba n yi , woi gna aza ge ɓa to shi a yahudiyi owa n .
har ma woi tu aduwa nyakun cegye , woi lo ɓe abyedo yi .
ɓa ɓo da lonu ntu ge , ɓa ɓo ku gye bulus n kunsun n tirafimus yi .
wo ɓo zhin ebyedo nu , woi gmi afisus n turki ʼkni .
ɓa gye ngye bulus la lo ɓe n woi nu na duwa nyakun .
ezhi vinya kwa ku wo ɓo na da tu bulus tukwo .
ɓa gmi wo ya na duwa nyakun ɓa ku aba gu .
ɓai ye ɓa wu wo , amma a soja tukwoda wa wo sunu n zhi mi .
n sai-sai yi wa tnu a soja yi ɓa lo rigima aba .
shi a yahudiyi ɓo gye asoja ɓai ɓe ɓa ku fa bulus lu ɓo .
soja tukwoda wa bulus wan , wa wo pa agmayi , wa nya a yahudiyi ɓo enya n bulus zhin .
ɓa je kala ku na ɓeda yi ngye azhi n gnikwo .
amma to wa bwa ɓo kpalayi m , wa gna a soja ge ɓa lo n bulus yi nɓa barki .
a yahudiyi ɓa vi lo ɓa zhin atna ge ba wu bulus , amma a soja ɓa wo la tu agbe-gbegye ntu ge ɓa gni wo .
ɓai ɓowyi , ɓai gna a lo woi , a lo woi .
ai ye a lo dna n bulus yi n nyakun , wa gna soja tukwoda ge , suku mi ye ma daɓo .
soja tukwoda wa nya wo ge , wo wo helleni lo ? oho nu to zhin masar za n wo ɓo la wahala ka aye fyewyi n ɓa duya nyi har haku aza wuyi , ha lo ɓai n zhabui m .
bulus wa gna awo .
mi zhin yahudiyayi nu mi gmi n tarusus nu , n silisiya kni .
mi ɓa ho ha ye ge ma daɓo na za deye yi .
soja tukwoda wa esa ga wo , bulus wa tu n nyakun she bayi , wa gna za ɓa ce pi wa da aɓeda ye n ibrahim bye yi .

shi bulus ɓo gni a shaula zhinyi abye wa gna , omi azaje , mi ku zan-zan n shekwoyi abye cici n bugba manayi yi .
nwo ɓeda zun-zunyai hannaniya prist dnagmayi wa gna zaho ge wo lu bulus ngbe .
bulus wa gna ge shekwoyi ɓa ce hohim pmi , oho nyakunpa bui-bui , kni alkali yi pya nu tu , to woi vi owan woi gna za ge wo ce mi pmi a ?
aza nɓa ɓei zhi vivi n bulus yi ɓa gna wo ge , ɓedanu n ho da n shekwoyi piristi dnagmayi ?
bulus wa gna , mi ta kpe lo ge wo nu zhin pirist dnagmayi m , ntu ge shekwoyi ɓeda gna ge to da ɓeda nukwoyi tu n fye abegyiyi tukwo m .
amma shi bulus ɓo kpe ge a sadukiyi ɓei fi ɓo ɓedo afarisiyi wa gna , omi azaje mi zhin farisiyi nu emi azakwoi vinya ɓei zhin afarisiyi nu mihin kwa a da mi owa ntu ge mi gaiciya ga ge efi kalaku lo nu .
shi wo ɓei da lonu aza yezhi , ɓa gnaj e ngun aba a sadukiyi na farisiyi .
ntu ge a sadukiyi gna ge efi kalaku to nyi m , amalaika to nyi m , zafun nyalo-nyalo nya to nyi m , amma a farisiyi n gaiciya ga na ɓeye vinya .
aɓo ɓa ku gmaje na shaula zhin ba .
a yahudiyi abye da ɓai gna ɓa to gye bulus laifi m , ɓa naɓo najei .
ɓa gna kpesun zafun ko malaika nu ɓei daɓo n bulus yi n dimashika zokwo .
ɓai ɓowyi n kala yi , aza ku she bulus gnu ɓai gni wo laɓa .
safyewyi a soja tukwoda wa gna asoja ge ɓa la bulus lo cei n ɓa barki woi gye ngye a yahudiyi ɓa wu wo .
nsukwoyi dagayi wa daɓo n bulus yi wa gna wo ge to damun , ngye shi ho ku mi seda zhin n urushelima aza abye nyi elonu ho ɓa zhin n roma .
n labmi yi aza ɓei du shinyi ( ) nɓa ɓei la nyasi si ge ɓa ta gyi nyagyi kwo ɓa sin nuwan , sai ɓa la bulus wu .
ɓa lo ɓa ku gna a pristi dnagmayi na byeda yi enya ɓa ye ɓa zhin .
fye lo fye gna asoja tukwoda nji a prist ɓedo abye da yi wa ɓe n bulus yi njesun a shaula zhin ba , shi a ɓe n woi , ya wu wo n zokwo . amma bulus zhalu wa ku wo , wa lo wa ku gna bulus na soja barki .
bulus wa yi soja dnagmayi ho wa gna wo ge , lo n ɓi ye yi nfye tukwoda aba wo ɓo kpakala yi lo wa gna wo . soja yi wa lo woi wa gna , bulus na gna ge mi ɓe nɓi ye yi nho aba , nge wo nɓei lo wa gna ho .
a soja tukwoda wa la ɓihi wa gni n woi n gna-gna wa nya wo ge , ho ye ha gna mi kni ɓo yi nu a ?
ɓihin wa gna nsu a yahudiyi ɓei gna ho ge ho ɓe n bulus yi na shaula zhin ba njesun .
amma to ɓei ye m .
aza lo n du shinyi n bwi fi n gbe-gbe ge , shi aɓe nwoi ɓa wu wo n zokwo .
ɓa ta sin nuwan kwo ɓa gyi nyagyi m , sai ɓa la bulus wu .
ɓa cei kma lo ɓa ɓe ɓa nya ho .
a soja tukwoda wa gna oɓihi n ge to gna zaho-zahoi ge ho ku ɓeye gna mi m .
sai a soja tukwoda wa yi asoja dnagmayi aje wa gna ɓa ge , ifye zhin shiri na soja yi ɓa lo kaisariya nsukwoyi naiye .
fye ku amashi da a dokwo da yi .
fya ga bulus dokwo wa tu fya lo woi n gwmna fileks aba .
wa ku wasika ka ga feliks wa gna .
wasikaye gmi n klaudiyus lisiyas aba nu kwoi ɓe gwamna feliks aba shekwo mwasa hoi , gnaɓi ɓe ho aba .
oza deye a yahudiyi na wan wo ɓai ye ɓa wu wo , amma ma tnu na soja yi ɓa gwo wo nɓa kun ntu ge nɓo ku wo ge wo zhin roma yi nu .
ma la wo ma lo cei nɓa shaula zhinba , ntu ge ma wo laifi n wa zhin .
ma gye ko zhin oɓa a yahudiyi adini ɓo nu n na kunnu yi .
ɓehin-hin ɓe ho to lo nkwo ɓa zhin adna wo n kurkuku m .
amma shi ma wo ge ɓa ku shiri zhin ɓa wu wo , ce na zhin mi tnu n woi n ho aba .
mi ku gna owo akala zhinyi ge ɓa ɓe n wo alaifi yi nho abye .
aku zo .
a soja ɓa la bulus n sukwoyi ɓa lo woi n antipata .
n labmi yi a soja ɓa jeze ɓe ɓa barki ɓa fa bulus na dokwo da yi , ɓa lo woi n kaisariya .
shi ɓa ɓei si kaisariya ɓa wasika ga gwamna , ɓa wu wo bulus njesun .
shi wo ɓo la wasika ba wa nya bulus aba n wo gmi , bulus wa gna mi gmi n silisiya nu .
gwamna wa gna wo ge n ɓei wo ho ɓeda , esa nho akala gayi ɓei ku ɓe .
gwamna wa gna asoja ge ɓa la wo dna n kurkuku n hirudus galukwo .

bulus gni nna romayi ikoda abye a bwa anyipyei ngun-atnu hananiya ɓedo a yahudiyi abyeda yi n tetullus yi ɓa lo i kaisariya .
ɓa ɓe ntu ge ɓa da bulus alaifi .
hananiya nu ɓei zhin prist dnagmayi , tetullus bei zhin loya nu .
shi gwamna ɓo yi tetullus ge wa da bulus alaifi wa gna , shekwo mwasa , eyi a yahudiyi yi kpe lo ge ho la salama , n loloya yi ga yi n ho kni .
ntu deye ɓo a da yi lo n mwa .
yi ta ye ya wun ho sa ya m , amma yi ɓa ye ha wo yi , nɓa da anya n ɓa gna yi gna-gna n bulus yi .
wahala gayi nu n woi , wo ku zhin a yahudiyi vinya ɓai la gyikici ka , ɓai zhin gaba na romayi gwamnati yi .
wo nu zhin a kristi yi tukwoda .
wo ɓo zhin atna wa tu aduwa nyakun cegye ya wan wo .
yi ɓo ye ya da wo owa bisa ga eyi adini .
amma lisiyas asoja tukwoda wa wo gwo n ya kun na kala yi .
wa gna aɓa da bulus owa bisa ga a romayi wyidna ho ɓa wo gaiciya n wohin aba . a yahudiyi vinya ɓa fi aku , ɓa gna , enya n tetullus ku da nyi gaiciya nu .
kwa si bulus sa , gwamna wa gna wo ge wo laka wa daɓo .
bulus wa gna , shekwo mwasa hoi mi kpe lo ge ho la mwasa hoi da a yahudiyi owa aye yi mwa begye , ada mi lo .
nya mi ye ma da nyi kwo ɓa wu ho ge , ma lo urushelima ntu mwa-mwa ga ɓo nu , anyipyei awo-cei-aba nɓa duya nyi .
ho ɓa gye njesun ge , mi to shin gyikici kala la ko aduwa nyakun , ko ezhi doho-dohoyi m .
aza deye ta mi ɓa ga seda , ntu anya ɓo n ɓa da ge ma zhin nyi m .
enya mi zhin waʼazi tu ko cici okwonu zhin gni gni zokwo .
okwo nu n ɓa gna wuwu nukwoyi .
mi zhin ma zhin shekwoyi bauta shi eyi a zakwoyi zhin .
mi gaiciya yi ga a yahudiyi owa , na nyai vinya n ɓa kafi anabi a littafi nyi .
mi gaiciya yi ga n efi kalaku n vingwo , a ɓefye-cei ɓedo aza nukwoyi , ɓahin lo nu ce .
ntu aɓo deye ɓo mi zhin atna n mi akala yi vinya , ma zhin ɓo ko bmiya n shekwoyi abye , na za yi .
mi ɓo la gmiya na ye yi mwa begye , ma je ze ɓe urushelima na gyiwyei shi ma bma a yahudiyi zhin , ma zhin sakirifais ga shekwoyi .
aza deye ɓo gye ml na sakirifais zhin ba nu .
mi la tukwo wun shi owa da .
zaho-zahoi to ɓei gni n ma ba m gyikici to ɓo nyi m , amma a yahudiyi ho a turki ɓei zhi ɓo .
a yahudiyi ye , ɓei gna ɓa zhi lo n ya , ɓo da laifi n ma zhin .
aza deye ɓo sun mi , mi yi zhin kni ɓe nukwoyi nuʼa ?
enya pi gmanyi nu n mikpe lo , n mi ɓei da na wada ba ge , ʼmi gni ai da mi owa ntu efi kalaku ɓo nu n vingwo . ʼ fileks kpe lo ge a kristi yi ta la gyikici ka m , ntu ce nu wa gna yahudiyi ge ɓa ku pmi sai lisiyas la e kafin wo zo ɓeda .
wa gna a je ze lo n bulus yi n kurkuku , amma a gye ɓa nuwan n woi daidai , a fa owo anugundo ɓa ɓe wo aba ɓa gye wo , ɓa ga wo anya ntu ge wa bwa agmada .
anyipyei fyewyi avun feliks wa ɓe n dirasilayi owo nyikwo , wo ɓei zhin yahudiyi za nu .
ɓa tnu bulus ɓo ntu ge wa gna ɓa yesu ɓeda .
wa daɓo nɓai tu efyece ɓo , n ɓemanayi zhin yi , n wa da yi nkwo ɓo lo nyi .
feliks wa wo dna shi wo ɓo wo aɓeye .
wa gna bulus ge , lo kpa nɓa je ho yi mi la esa bwa . wa gye ngye bulus ɓa ga wo toshi , ntu ce nu wa tnu wo ɓo cici woi daɓo n woi .
wa gyi abye woi yi bulus nasasayi , har aye ngun-aba .
amma bulus to ɓei gawo toshi m , avun a shan feliks do , abe n posho festus yi .
feliks woi ye ge a yahudiyi ɓa bwa agmada n woi , wa bulus fa dna n kurkuku .
a bwa anyipyei ngun-atnu hananiya ɓedo a yahudiyi abyeda yi n tetullus yi ɓa lo i kaisariya .
ɓa ɓe ntu ge ɓa da bulus alaifi .

kwa si bulus sa , gwamna wa gna wo ge wo laka wa daɓo .
bulus wa gna , shekwo mwasa hoi mi kpe lo ge ho la mwasa hoi da a yahudiyi owa aye yi mwa begye , ada mi lo .
nya mi ye ma da nyi kwo ɓa wu ho ge , ma lo urushelima ntu mwa-mwa ga ɓo nu , anyipyei awo-cei-aba nɓa duya nyi .
ho ɓa gye njesun ge , mi to shin gyikici kala la ko aduwa nyakun , ko ezhi doho-dohoyi m .
aza deye ta mi ɓa ga seda , ntu anya ɓo n ɓa da ge ma zhin nyi m .
enya mi zhin waʼazi tu ko cici okwonu zhin gni gni zokwo .
okwo nu n ɓa gna wuwu nukwoyi .
mi zhin ma zhin shekwoyi bauta shi eyi a zakwoyi zhin .
mi gaiciya yi ga a yahudiyi owa , na nyai vinya n ɓa kafi anabi a littafi nyi .
mi gaiciya yi ga n efi kalaku n vingwo , a ɓefye-cei ɓedo aza nukwoyi , ɓahin lo nu ce .
ntu aɓo deye ɓo mi zhin atna n mi akala yi vinya , ma zhin ɓo ko bmiya n shekwoyi abye , na za yi .
mi ɓo la gmiya na ye yi mwa begye , ma je ze ɓe urushelima na gyiwyei shi ma bma a yahudiyi zhin , ma zhin sakirifais ga shekwoyi .
aza deye ɓo gye ml na sakirifais zhin ba nu .
mi la tukwo wun shi owa da .
zaho-zahoi to ɓei gni n ma ba m gyikici to ɓo nyi m , amma a yahudiyi ho a turki ɓei zhi ɓo .
a yahudiyi ye , ɓei gna ɓa zhi lo n ya , ɓo da laifi n ma zhin .
aza deye ɓo sun mi , mi yi zhin kni ɓe nukwoyi nuʼa ?
enya pi gmanyi nu n mikpe lo , n mi ɓei da na wada ba ge , ʼmi gni ai da mi owa ntu efi kalaku ɓo nu n vingwo . ʼ fileks kpe lo ge a kristi yi ta la gyikici ka m , ntu ce nu wa gna yahudiyi ge ɓa ku pmi sai lisiyas la e kafin wo zo ɓeda .
wa gna a je ze lo n bulus yi n kurkuku , amma a gye ɓa nuwan n woi daidai , a fa owo anugundo ɓa ɓe wo aba ɓa gye wo , ɓa ga wo anya ntu ge wa bwa agmada .
anyipyei fyewyi avun feliks wa ɓe n dirasilayi owo nyikwo , wo ɓei zhin yahudiyi za nu .
ɓa tnu bulus ɓo ntu ge wa gna ɓa yesu ɓeda .
wa daɓo nɓai tu efyece ɓo , n ɓemanayi zhin yi , n wa da yi nkwo ɓo lo nyi .
feliks wa wo dna shi wo ɓo wo aɓeye .
wa gna bulus ge , lo kpa nɓa je ho yi mi la esa bwa . wa gye ngye bulus ɓa ga wo toshi , ntu ce nu wa tnu wo ɓo cici woi daɓo n woi .
wa gyi abye woi yi bulus nasasayi , har aye ngun-aba .
amma bulus to ɓei gawo toshi m , avun a shan feliks do , abe n posho festus yi .
feliks woi ye ge a yahudiyi ɓa bwa agmada n woi , wa bulus fa dna n kurkuku .
a nyipyei ngu ata shi festos ɓei ɓe kaisariya wa lo urushelima .
wo ɓei ɓe kaisariya ntu ge wa la feliks tnu-tnu nu wato gwamna eknihi nya nu .
a urushelima yi atukwoda ɓa gye wo nɓo , ɓa gna wo bulus ɓeda vinya .
ʼba gyiwo wye ntuge wa ɓe n bulus yi n urushelima , ɓa ɓei ye ɓa wu wo nu .
amma festos wa ci ɓa ge , bulus lu kaisariya du woi ɓei gni woi lo ɓo nu nwohin ntu cenu aza n ɓa kpe ɓeye ye lo ɓa ɓe kaisariya n ɓahin nabai a dawa nbwai . a ya bulus wada shi anyipyei ngu awo ɓei ku si , wa jeze lo kaisariya .
efya gyi wa ya bulus wa da .
shi bulus ɓei lo dna n kotu a yahudiyi nɓa ɓei kun n urushelima nyi , ɓa ku yezhi , ɓai da owo alaifi ɓo n tna asaida .
bulus wa na aɓo , wa gna , mi to n laifi yi lo m , ntu ge mi to zun ayahudiyi awyidna gna m , ko ma da ɓenukwoyi tu aduwanyakun tukwo m , ko ma zhin gaba n roma yi gwanmati yi m . festus woi ye owo ɓo kwa da ayahudiyi wa nya wo ge , ho ɓa ye halo urushelima , mi da ho owa n bwai ? ama bulus wa ye wa gna , awo , miɓa ye esu roma nya wa wo mi .
ho kpe lo ge mi to n laifi yi lo m .
ndei mi ku laifi zhin nkwo kunce lo n fi yi , mi ta naɓo lo ge ma fi m , ama ndei mi zhin oza kni-kniyi nu , ozaho to iko yi lo wa dna mi n aza deye akun ntu ge ɓa wu min .
nɓa ye ma lo kaisar aba . festus wa zhin shaula nwo shaula gayi , wa gna , abmiya lo la ye ge ha lo kaisar aba , kaisar aba nu n ho ɓa lo !
anyipyei ho fyewyi ɓa duya , esu agarippa n banis yi ɓa ɓe festus gnaɓi .
dna anyipyei n ɓa ɓei fi ɓo nyi , festus wa zhin shaula tu n bulus tukwo n ʼsu yi wa gna wo ge , za-wan-wan ho dna lo n ya n feliks ɓei ya wo ɓeda shi ge ma da .
esa nu mi ɓei dna n urushelima a malami adnagmayi ɓedo ayadudiyi abyeda yi , ɓa ku ɓa lafiya wu mi har ɓa gna mi ge mi la wo wu .
ma ku wu ɓa ge a romayi owa ta zun oza kni to ai da wo owan , a zhin a esa ga wo ɓa da ɓo n za yi nɓo nɓai dna a je yi .
shi ɓa ɓo ɓe ya , efye kwa gyi , a ɓeda kun zhi , ma ɓe n bulus yi .
ama ma wo aɓeda n ɓa ɓo da tu nwo tukwo nyi , to ma gye aɓo nu n mi ɓei cei mwi m .
oɓo nyi tu nɓa kunnu tukwo nu , oza ho ge a yi wo ge yesu , wa fi , amma bulus wa gyi tu ge wo n wye-wyei lo .
ma ku jeje ngye shi mi ɓa zun ɓeda ye ya , ma nya wo kwo wo ɓa ye a da wo owa tu aɓeye tukwo n urushelima .
ama bulus wa gna ge , wo ɓa ye wa lo n ɓeda yi n kaisar aba .
shi wo ɓo da lonu , ma gna ge a lo n woi , o la wo je gu , har ma zhin shiri ma tnu n woi n esu dnagmayi aba . agaribas wa gna ge , nɓa ye ma wo wo ɓeda n mihin .
festus wa gna wo ge , ho ɓei wo wo nsu .
shi efye ɓo gyi , esu ɓedo n barniki yi ɓa ɓe kwotu nɓa mwa-mwa ɓedo asoja atukwo da yi , n aza adnagmayi ezhi hi festus wa gna ge a ɓe n bulus yi .
festus wa da ɓo na za yi wa gna , esu agaribas ɓedo aza yi vinya , ayahudiyi n ɓa ʼya ɓedo aza yi n ɓa lo n urushelima , ɓa ce pma ge awu oza deye .
amma n mi wyegye , wo to zhin nyaho nkwo kunce awu wom .
dudu lonu wo ku na ge wo ɓa lo nɓeda yi n kaisar aba , omihin mi to nɓodo yi lo nmi ɓa zhin m , sai ma tnu woi .
ama mɓa ka kniɓeyi ma ga esu dnagmayi hi a ?
ntu ge mi to gye wo laifi , na gna ge wa zhin m , cenu a zhin mi ɓe nwo yi n fye abye vinya , oho esu agaribas ha mwi wo , ha wu mi nya mi ɓa ka .
ntu ge kwo ta wu mi lo dei-dei ma tnu n za wan-wan yi n esu dnagmayi aba ntna ɓo tukwo m . a nyipyei ngu ata shi festos ɓei ɓe kaisariya wa lo urushelima .
wo ɓei ɓe kaisariya ntu ge wa la feliks tnu-tnu nu wato gwamna eknihi nya nu .
a urushelima yi atukwoda ɓa gye wo nɓo , ɓa gna wo bulus ɓeda vinya .
ʼba gyiwo wye ntuge wa ɓe n bulus yi n urushelima , ɓa ɓei ye ɓa wu wo nu .
amma festos wa ci ɓa ge , bulus lu kaisariya du woi ɓei gni woi lo ɓo nu nwohin ntu cenu aza n ɓa kpe ɓeye ye lo ɓa ɓe kaisariya n ɓahin nabai a dawa nbwai . shi anyipyei ngu awo ɓei ku si , wa jeze lo kaisariya .
efya gyi wa ya bulus wa da .
shi bulus ɓei lo dna n kotu a yahudiyi nɓa ɓei kun n urushelima nyi , ɓa ku yezhi , ɓai da owo alaifi ɓo n tna asaida .

nɓa ye ma lo kaisar aba . festus wa zhin shaula nwo shaula gayi , wa gna , abmiya lo la ye ge ha lo kaisar aba , kaisar aba nu n ho ɓa lo !
anyipyei ho fyewyi ɓa duya , esu agarippa n banis yi ɓa ɓe festus gnaɓi .

esa nu mi ɓei dna n urushelima a malami adnagmayi ɓedo ayadudiyi abyeda yi , ɓa ku ɓa lafiya wu mi har ɓa gna mi ge mi la wo wu .
ma ku wu ɓa ge a romayi owa ta zun oza kni to ai da wo owan , a zhin a esa ga wo ɓa da ɓo n za yi nɓo nɓai dna a je yi .
shi ɓa ɓo ɓe ya , efye kwa gyi , a ɓeda kun zhi , ma ɓe n bulus yi .
ama ma wo aɓeda n ɓa ɓo da tu nwo tukwo nyi , to ma gye aɓo nu n mi ɓei cei mwi m .
oɓo nyi tu nɓa kunnu tukwo nu , oza ho ge a yi wo ge yesu , wa fi , amma bulus wa gyi tu ge wo n wye-wyei lo .
ma ku jeje ngye shi mi ɓa zun ɓeda ye ya , ma nya wo kwo wo ɓa ye a da wo owa tu aɓeye tukwo n urushelima .
ama bulus wa gna ge , wo ɓa ye wa lo n ɓeda yi n kaisar aba .
shi wo ɓo da lonu , ma gna ge a lo n woi , o la wo je gu , har ma zhin shiri ma tnu n woi n esu dnagmayi aba . agaribas wa gna ge , nɓa ye ma wo wo ɓeda n mihin .
festus wa gna wo ge , ho ɓei wo wo nsu .
shi efye ɓo gyi , esu ɓedo n barniki yi ɓa ɓe kwotu nɓa mwa-mwa ɓedo asoja atukwo da yi , n aza adnagmayi ezhi hi festus wa gna ge a ɓe n bulus yi .

ama mɓa ka kniɓeyi ma ga esu dnagmayi hi a ?
ntu ge mi to gye wo laifi , na gna ge wa zhin m , cenu a zhin mi ɓe nwo yi n fye abye vinya , oho esu agaribas ha mwi wo , ha wu mi nya mi ɓa ka .
ntu ge kwo ta wu mi lo dei-dei ma tnu n za wan-wan yi n esu dnagmayi aba ntna ɓo tukwo m .
bulus wa kna wohin agaribas wa gna bulus ge , gya bye ha gna yi ho ɓeda . bulus wa wu obwa , wa ya ɓeda da .
wa gna , mi gye mihin tukwo esu agaribas nzhin arzikida nu , shi mi ye ma da mihin ɓeda nho abye .
ntu gemi kpe lo ge , ho zhin oza nu , n wo kpe ayahudiyi owa ye ɓedo n ɓa akunnu yi .
nsayi mi gyi ho wye ha kna tnubua .
ayahudiyi kpe lo sarai ge ma ku makaranta ayahudiyi nya zhin dna tarsus , avun ma ɓe urushelima ma ku aɓo zhin dei-dei .
ɓa ɓei ɓa ye ɓa da , ɓa kpe lo ge mi zhin farisiyi nu nwo ta ye ge afua wye n ayahudiyi owa yi ɓedo nɓa akunnu yi m .
ama dalili nkwo zhin ɓai ga mi laifi nyi kwo lo gbo , ɓa ga mi laifi ge mi na wyetu yi ntu alkawali nu ɓo n shekwoyi ɓo zhin ga eyi azakwoyi nyi .
a israilayi abye ngun awo-cei-aba , ɓa zhin atna nyipyei n sukwoyi ge ɓa gye alkawali ye nunu nɓa ʼsa , ama nsayi ɓa la mi ze laifi da .
kwo zhin laifi nu ge oza wa ga gaiciya ge efi kala ku lo ?
kwo to zhin gaiciya nu ge shekwoyi n iko yi lo wa je za wye-wyei gan ?
n ɓei zhin mi gye ngye kwo bmiya lo ma ga aza wahala n ɓa vi yesu nyi .
nɓo ku aza fi n kurkuku n mwa begye n urushelima , n iko amalami dnagmayi nya yi , esa nɓa da aza owa ofi nya , kwa da mi har ma ye nɓei nɓa zhin nyi . mi ɓei zhin ma ga a yesu viyi wahala abaho-baho yi , mi ye ge ɓa na yesu aɓo .
mi ɓei pyena nɓayi , mi zan ɓa shin azhi yakwo , akniyi gbo-gbo .
n wyihoi mi lo ɓa zanshi n dimashika , mi la izni gwo n malami , dnagmayi , n nyipyei na tukwo , buzangna dnagmayi ndu nyipyei nya , kwa bmiya fi yi ɓedo aza yi nɓa ɓo gnisun n mi yi .
eyi vinya ya miya zhi nkni , ma wo begye kwoi daɓo n mi yi n ibraniyi bye yi , kwoi gna shawulu , shawulu kniyi nu zhin hoi ga mi wahala ?
ho ga hohin nu wahala .
ma nya ge , ʼnkanu hoi ya ? ʼ dagayi wa ye ga gna , ʼomi nu yesu n ho ga wo wahala nyi .
ntu ge mi la ho kni ha ze mi fyenu n mi saida da yi , ce na zhin mi wu mihin tukwo n ho aba .
ho ɓa gna anyi aɓo ho ku gye , n aɓo n ho ɓa gye , esa n ma wu mihin tukwo n ho aba .
nɓa kna ho n ho azaje aba ɓedo abyedo yi .
nɓa tnu ho n abye do aba , ha kpe ɓa awye ya , ɓa gye gaiciya ɓa ye abui , ɓa zan-zan dna buzangna shekwoyi nya , maimakon shetan wyegma , ntu ge ɓa bwa gafara oɓa alaifi nya , ɓa ze gado shekwoyi nya , ɓedo aza yi abaho-bahoi vinya , oɓa nu a la oɓa alaifi zhan ya ntu ɓa gaiciya ga ɓo omi aba . ʼ ntu deye ɓo , o esu agaribas , mi to ɓei na ɓo n ɓewyegye eshe nya yi m .
ma ya waʼazi zhin ga aza n dimashika mi , n urushelima yi ɓedo n yahudiya ekni yi , n jesun n abyedo aba , mi-i gna ɓa ge ɓa fwa alaifi ɓa pmibma ɓe shekwoyi aba , ɓa wu oɓa bmapmi a tnu-tnu manayi .
a yahudiyi ɓa wan mi dna aduwa nyakun ntu waʼazi zhin ɓo , ɓai ye ɓa wu mi .
ama shekwoyi wa mi gni , cenu zhin mi gni n wye-wyei n naiye , ma gna aza dnagmayi n aza anawyi yi gaiciya ye .
mi ta wu nyaho lo gbo n nya yi annabi edo n musa yi ɓei da m .
nge masihu ɓa sin wahala , wa ze oza kmisunyi n wo ɓo laka la evingwo , wa ɓe n buzangna yi na yahudiyi aba ɓedo n abye do yi . festus wa da ɓo nkalayi ngye wa kaya nshe , wa ci ge , bulus ho la cenya .
oho nyaba nmwa la tukwo pmi ho ya ! ama bulus wa gna , mi ta cenya nu m , festus duduyi , ama mi da gaiciya nu behinhin .
esu agaribas kpe aɓeye lo , mi da ɓeda ye n bugba kala yi , ntu ge aɓeye to zhin aɓo woi-woi nu nwo aba m , ntu ge ato zhin ɓa n vi nu m .
esu agaribas ha ga annabi gaiciya !
mi kpe lo ha ga gaiciya . agaribas wa gna wo ge , n aɓedeye yi ho ye ma ze yesu viyi-i ?
bulus wa ye wa gna , mi gyi shekwoyi wye lo omi ɓeda kwa zhin ho ɓedo aza yi vinya nɓa zhi lo ya , ɓa ku ze ngye mi , sai dai to ngye agma n ɓa fi n mi nyi m .
sai esu , n gwamna yi , barniki aza yi vinya ɓa kukala ɓa kunya .
shi ɓa ɓo zhin shaula ɓa gna , oza deye to zhin laifi n wo ɓa fi ko a dna wo n kurkuku m . agaribas wa gna festus ge , wo to ɓei ku gna ge , wo ɓa lo n ɓeda yi n kaisar aban , o la wo loya .
agaribas wa gna bulus ge , gya bye ha gna yi ho ɓeda . bulus wa wu obwa , wa ya ɓeda da .
wa gna , mi gye mihin tukwo esu agaribas nzhin arzikida nu , shi mi ye ma da mihin ɓeda nho abye .

oho nyaba nmwa la tukwo pmi ho ya ! ama bulus wa gna , mi ta cenya nu m , festus duduyi , ama mi da gaiciya nu behinhin .
esu agaribas kpe aɓeye lo , mi da ɓeda ye n bugba kala yi , ntu ge aɓeye to zhin aɓo woi-woi nu nwo aba m , ntu ge ato zhin ɓa n vi nu m .
esu agaribas ha ga annabi gaiciya !
mi kpe lo ha ga gaiciya . agaribas wa gna wo ge , n aɓedeye yi ho ye ma ze yesu viyi-i ?
bulus wa ye wa gna , mi gyi shekwoyi wye lo omi ɓeda kwa zhin ho ɓedo aza yi vinya nɓa zhi lo ya , ɓa ku ze ngye mi , sai dai to ngye agma n ɓa fi n mi nyi m .
sai esu , n gwamna yi , barniki aza yi vinya ɓa kukala ɓa kunya .
shi ɓa ɓo zhin shaula ɓa gna , oza deye to zhin laifi n wo ɓa fi ko a dna wo n kurkuku m . agaribas wa gna festus ge , wo to ɓei ku gna ge , wo ɓa lo n ɓeda yi n kaisar aban , o la wo loya .
ozan kwoi lo roma shi a ɓo ku shiri zo zhin , ntu geakuyialonyin roman eya nuwan nya yi , a ku a bulus ɓedo aza wan-wan ajei , fi n akurkuku guyi tukwoda ho akun , ai yi wo eye ge jiliyos , esu gu yi nu ɓei n woi .
ya kuka n ʼya yi , nkwo ɓa lo kwoi kpegni aba yi mwabegye lo ce yi n turki edna gbe .
aristakus ɓei gnisun n yi .
shi efye ɓei gyi ya si sida , jiliyos wa ye ge bulus wo la gmi gni wa ɓi anugundo gna , ɓa gwo wo agmadayi .
shi yi ɓo je lo fi eya , ese dnagmayi kwa ci , to ya mi ya dna eya n zokwo m , har kwa zhin ya duya saiprus sunbwa .
ya duya vivi n silisiya yi , n panfiliya yi , ya ɓe ya kpezhi n mira n lisiya ekni .
nɓo nu eyi tukwoda wato jiliyos , wa gye eya a masariyi nya , kwoi gmi alekzanderiya , kwoi lo italiya wa ku yi fi nkwo .
yi ɓo ku anyipyei bwa n mwa , yi sun wahala n eya dna yi , ya si kimdus deca , ese kwoi gna kala bwa-bwa , ya duya vivi n karita , ya lo salmoni .
n wahala yi , ya lo peceye peceye , yi lo edna ʼgbe yi har ya ɓe aba ho a yi kwo ge akpezhiba manayi , vivi ezhi hoi a yi kwo laisiya .
ya ku kpe zhi ɓo anyipyei n mwa begye .
ntu ge wahala ɓo nyi n aɓa zan-zan n kpai nyi , ntu ge vinyikwo ɓo la shi , bulus wa gna a kurkuku gu yi tukwoda ge .
ofye , mi gye lo wahala lo abye , kpekni yi ɓa sin asala eya kwa ɓaya , akaya ɓa bwi , aza ɓa bwa nyasan har efi . ama akurkuku guyi tukwoda to wa wo bulus ɓe da m , sai aya dna yi tukwoda ɓeda .
shi kwo nyi akpezhiba manayi to ɓei bmiya n ɓa ɓa zhi n vinyikwo yi m , ayadna yi ɓa gna ge a zhin atna a lo finiksa ɓo fi ɓo n vinyikwo yi .
finiksa ɓei zhin ayakpezhi ba manayi nu .
esa fyewyi ese kwa ya ci peceye ɓa gye ngye kwo bmiya lo ɓa kuka , ɓa lo eya ya , ɓa ya lo vivi edna ʼgbe yi .
esa sun fyewyi ese nyakwo kwa ya ci n kala yi , kwa ce eya abwaya lo cei nla .
ɓa zhin atna ge ɓa jeze ɓe n eya yi la gbe , to ɓa mi m , ɓa fa kwo kwa ce kwa vi ese lo .
ya duya n muse ɓiyi ho avun , a yi muse yi ge kalauda , nɓo nu n yi ɓo wankma deca , n aya ɓiyi-ɓiyi bmazhin yi , ya mi ya gyi eya nawyi .
ayadnayi ɓai wo dna ge kpesun ese ɓa ce eya abwaya har kwa lo afrika , kni , ntu deye ɓo , ɓa aje loya nɓa gyi eya she nyi .
shi efye ɓo gyi , ɓa gye ese kwoi gna cici , eya atnu-tnu yi ɓa ya akaya kunya fi n nuwan .
dna nyipyei tahi , ɓa kun eya atnu-tnu kaya anya yi vinya ɓa she ɓa ya .
ese yakwo kwa ci nkala yi to kwoi shan fa m har anyipyei mwa begye , ngmayi , har ɓa bugba gmiya n pwo-pwo ɓo yi .
to aza yi gyi nyagyi m , ama bulus wa yi aya tnu-tnu-zhin yi wa gna ɓa ge , ofye , fye ɓo gna fya wo mi ɓeda nkmisunyi , to ye kuka n akpezhiba manayi m , to yo sin asara ye m .
ama agu tu yi ngye apma , zaho-zahoi ta bwi wo wye-wyei nuwan , eya ɓa ɓaya .
ntu ge nsukwoyi naiye , malaika omi shekwoyi nya , n mi zhin wo bauta nyi , wa ɓe mi aba .
woi gna mi ge , ʼbulus to wo edna m , ntu ge shekwoyi ku howyegyi wo , sai ha gni agni n kaisar abye , woi ɓa aza gni , nɓa gnifi n ya n hoi nyiʼ .
ntu cenu fye ku mi zhi , ntu ge mi la gaiciya ga shekwoyi , kwo ɓa ze lo nu ngye shi wa da .
ama eya ɓa ɓaya ya wankma kpe n muse ho . dna nyipyei awo-cei-nyihi , ogma ɓedo n ʼse yi n sadu sa , yi kpe n nuwan adriya nya , yi lo nawyei , na vuyi ese yi ce yi abwa ya , aya dnayi ɓa gye ngye yi ku wu vivi nkma yi .
ɓa mwi nuwa lolo ɓa gye kafa .
esa fyewyi ɓa je mwi , ɓa gye kafa .
shi ɓa ɓo gye lonu , ɓa kpe ge yi ku ga okma si , ama ntu edna ɓo ge kpekni agye akuta nyi ndna gbe , ɓa ya eya akpegninya fi nuwan ngun-anyi , ɓai shin-shin ge efye kwo gyi .
aya dnayi ho , ɓai ye ge ɓa busi ɓa fwa eya , ɓai la ya ɓai lo eya ɓiɓiyi ɓai zhin ngye ɓa ye ɓa ya eya kpegninya fi n nuwan nabye bwa .
ama bulus wa gna asoja ɓedo nɓa tukwoda yi ge , fye ɓa ku fi vinya sai dai ozaho-zaho yi wa kpe dna n ya .
asoja ɓa zun owun ya , ɓa fwa eya ɓiɓiyi kwa kaya . shi efye ɓo la gyi , bulus wa gyi aza wye ge ɓa ku nyagyi gyi wa ci ge , fye ku sun nu , a mako ngun aba to fyei to nyagyi wo m .
mi gyi fye wye fye ku nyagyi ntu fye lafiya ɓo !
ntu ge kwo tukwoyi gmanyi oza ho nya , kwo ta bwi m . shi wo ɓo zo da lonu , wa la bredi wa zhin shekwoyi godiya nɓa abye vinya , wa sa wa gyi .
nsayi-sayi oɓa vinya ɓa bwa sauki ɓa ya nyagyi gyi .
aza vinya tagyi aba , ncei shi tnaba cei tnanyi ( ) eyi yewa nu n yi ɓei fi n eya yi vinya .
shi aɓo ku nyagyi gyi aya atnu-tnu yi ɓa kun alkama ɓa she ya fi n nuwan eya shanwo kwa ce gmiya .
eya la aya shi efye ɓo la gyi , to ɓa kpe aba nɓa zhi-n ama ɓa ta wye ɓa gye okma n amwi yi , ɓa zhin shaula ge kwo ese ɓa ce ɓa bwaya fi akuta , kwa kun ɓa va kpe na mwi .
ɓa gna ɓa ɓa zhin atna ɓa gbe awun ya ɓa fwa eya akpezhi nya ya fi n nuwan , ɓa ya eya avun , ɓa ku eje wu abye ɓa lo edna gbe .
ama eya tukwo kwa lo kwa bi dna n amwi .
eya tukwo kwa bi dna dei-dei , eya avun kwa la wu , nuwan dokwo kwoi ɓe kwoi lu kwo nkalayi har eya kwa ya ɓaya .
asoja ɓa gna oɓa tukwoda ge , ɓa ku aza wan-wan wu vinya kada oza ho nɓa mi wa she nuwan wa piya wa busi .
ama jiliyos to ɓei ye ge awu bulus m , wa gna ɓa ge a to zhin lo nu m .
wa gna ɓa ge oza n wo ɓa mi wa she nuwan wo she wa piya tu nkma .
aza nɓa ce nyi , ɓa zhin atna ɓa wan eya apisayi ɓa wan kma .
elonu aza vinya ɓa ku wan kma n lafiya yi .
shi a ɓo ku shiri zo zhin , ntu geakuyialonyin roman eya nuwan nya yi , a ku a bulus ɓedo aza wan-wan ajei , fi n akurkuku guyi tukwoda ho akun , ai yi wo eye ge jiliyos , esu gu yi nu ɓei n woi .

shi efye ɓo la gyi , to ɓa kpe aba nɓa zhi-n ama ɓa ta wye ɓa gye okma n amwi yi , ɓa zhin shaula ge kwo ese ɓa ce ɓa bwaya fi akuta , kwa kun ɓa va kpe na mwi .
ɓa gna ɓa ɓa zhin atna ɓa gbe awun ya ɓa fwa eya akpezhi nya ya fi n nuwan , ɓa ya eya avun , ɓa ku eje wu abye ɓa lo edna gbe .

eya tukwo kwa bi dna dei-dei , eya avun kwa la wu , nuwan dokwo kwoi ɓe kwoi lu kwo nkalayi har eya kwa ya ɓaya .
asoja ɓa gna oɓa tukwoda ge , ɓa ku aza wan-wan wu vinya kada oza ho nɓa mi wa she nuwan wa piya wa busi .
ama jiliyos to ɓei ye ge awu bulus m , wa gna ɓa ge a to zhin lo nu m .
wa gna ɓa ge oza n wo ɓa mi wa she nuwan wo she wa piya tu nkma .
aza nɓa ce nyi , ɓa zhin atna ɓa wan eya apisayi ɓa wan kma .
elonu aza vinya ɓa ku wan kma n lafiya yi .
esa fyewyi ya kpe ge muse n ya wankma kpe nyi , a yi kwo ge malita nu .
aza nɓa ɓei fi ɓo nyi ɓa wu yi yeye , ɓa ku ena fin yi ya wye ntu ogma ɓo nkwo ɓo lu yi , ese yi fu yi nyi .
ngye shi bulus ɓo ku ashinwan wa ya kpe nna , gbezhi kwa kun ntu gugurgu ɓo , kwa knanyi bulus nbwa .
shi a malitayi ɓei gye kwo shegyi n bulus bwa , ɓa gna aje ge , ozaye zhin zawuyi nu ɓehinhin !
wo la pwo n nuwan , ama ɓenukwoyi kwo nu ta ye ge wo pwo m . ama bulus wa mi kwo ya fi n na , wa ce wo nya gni ntna ɓoho .
aza yi bwa zhi ɓai gye ge , esa fyewyi wo ɓa ya sun , wa miyashi wa fi , amma shi ɓa ɓo gye esa la mwa to ɓoho kwoi zhin wo m , ɓa ɓeda shando ɓa gna ge , wo zhin shekwoyi ho nu .
vivi aba yi n yi ɓo wankma nyi , oza ho ɓei nyi ɓo a yi ge bubliyus , wo nu ɓo zhin gwamna muse yi nya .
wa gwo yi n bugba bui-bui yi , wa ga yi nyagyi har anyipyei ngun-ata .
bubliyus dada wo ɓo n nyasan yi , nayi nagun ɓedo n goro-san yi .
bulus wa lo wa zhin aduwa , wa to wo bwa wa wo kagna .
azaje vinya , nɓa to ɓei n lafiya yi m n muse yi , ɓa ɓe a ɓa kagna .
ntu deye ɓo aza ɓa ɓe yi n kyauta yi n mwa , esa nu yi ɓo ye ya kuka , aza ɓa ɓe yi na nya yi gbo-gbo n yi ɓa zhin akma n cei n zokwo .
apya ɓo ku sun ngun-ata , ngye shi eya ɓei ɓaya , ya kuka njesun , nsa deye yi ɓo zan-zan n eya alekzandariya nya yi nkwo zhin vinyikwo shi n muse hi , ai yi kwo ge aza aba . eyi akpezhiba kmisunyi sai sirakusa , ya bwa anyipyei ɓo ngun-ata .
ya kuka ɓo ya pmi lo rigiyum , ya bwa nyipyei gmanyi ese kudu nya kwa ya ci , nyipyei bahi yisi butiyoli , nɓo ya sun a yesu viyi hoi , ɓa gyi yi wye ge yi ku fi nɓa yi har anyipyei tnaba .
ya kpe kala ku ya lo roma .
eyi azaje nɓa ɓei fi n roma nyi , ɓa ku wo ge yi ɓe lo , ɓa ɓe shegun yi n abiyu gnikwo .
azado ɓa shegun yi n ashiragyi ngun-ata .
shi bulus ɓo gye ɓa , wa zhin shekwoyi godiya , wa bwa bugba kala .
shi yi ɓo si roma , a ye bulus ge wo dna wo nya abaho-baho n wo ɓa dna , sai dai soja ɓei zhin woi gu wo .
shi wo ɓo si wa bwa anyipyei ngun ata , wa yi a yahudiyi atukwoda wa da ɓo nɓai wa gna , omi azaje , a yahudiyi nɓa fi n urushelima nyi , ɓa na wan mi ɓai dna mi a romayi akun , ko shi ko nyi mi to zhin nyaho-nyaho yi m , ko ma zhi za wuya kwo ɓo n kwo zhin kunnu eyi azakwoyi nya m .
a romayi ɓa ku owa da mi , ɓai ye ɓa ya mi , ntu ge ɓa to sun nyaho n mi aba nkwo kunce lo nfi yi , ngye shi a yahudiyi atukwoda ɓei gna ge awu mi nyi m .
shi a yahudiyi atukwoda to ɓo ye a shaula yi m , to a wun aje bugba m , ma gye ko la mi ze tile ma gyi abye n ɓeda yi kwa lo kaisar aba .
ma yi fye ge fye ɓe n naiye ge ya kpe ajeye , magna fye ge , mi dna n agma ye ge , mi n gaiciya ga yi lo ge masihu wa ɓe nu . ʼba ye ɓa gna wo ge , yi to wo ɓoho tu nho tukwo m !
yi to bwa wasika n yahudiya , ko naza nɓa kun lo n urushelima , ɓai ɓe iya nyi m .
ama yi ce pma ya wo enya ho gaiciya yi ga , enya dei n yi kpe lo , okwo nu ge abaho-bahoi vinya , aza ta ye a yesu viyi lo m . ɓa esa shi , nwyihi aza nmwa begye ɓa yezhi n wo puwa .
wa daɓo n ɓai tu shekwoyi ebemi ɓo , woi wu ɓa aɓo ntu yesu ɓo ngye shi aka fi n littafi gyi-gyi-yi , wa ya ɓa wu n attaura musa nya ɓedo anabi yi , wa ya ɓa wu n labmi yi har wyeshe !
azaho ɓa ku gaiciya ga , ama azaho to ɓa gaiciya m .
ɓa na bo aje yi n mwa , ɓa kuka n ɓeda gmanyi shi n bulus ɓo da ge , zafun gyi-gyiyi ɓo ku ɓeda da cewo n anabi ishaya gbe ge , wa gna a yahudiyi ge , ʼfye ɓa wo fyei gye ama fye ta bwa awyega m , ntu ge ofye abugba shin-shin lo , ofye atnubua ta ye lo ɓa wo m , fyei ku fye awye kpe to fya bwa awye gam , ntu ge fye ta ye lo fya gye , fya wo , fya bwa awye ga , fya ɓe ma ka fye gna m . ʼ mi ye fya kpe ge , gni-gni shekwoyi nya ye , kwo nyi ntu abyedo ɓo nu ce , ɓai ɓa gwo kwo . bulus wa wo nya dna n wohin haya nyakun har aye ngun aba , woi gwo azhiɓeyi doho-doho nɓa ɓei ɓe wo wyegye .
woi gna ɓa shekwoyi ebe mi ɓo , n dagayi yesu kristi yi , zaho-zaho yi to ɓo wo wo ɓi m .
esa fyewyi ya kpe ge muse n ya wankma kpe nyi , a yi kwo ge malita nu .
aza nɓa ɓei fi ɓo nyi ɓa wu yi yeye , ɓa ku ena fin yi ya wye ntu ogma ɓo nkwo ɓo lu yi , ese yi fu yi nyi .
ngye shi bulus ɓo ku ashinwan wa ya kpe nna , gbezhi kwa kun ntu gugurgu ɓo , kwa knanyi bulus nbwa .
shi a malitayi ɓei gye kwo shegyi n bulus bwa , ɓa gna aje ge , ozaye zhin zawuyi nu ɓehinhin !
wo la pwo n nuwan , ama ɓenukwoyi kwo nu ta ye ge wo pwo m . ama bulus wa mi kwo ya fi n na , wa ce wo nya gni ntna ɓoho .
aza yi bwa zhi ɓai gye ge , esa fyewyi wo ɓa ya sun , wa miyashi wa fi , amma shi ɓa ɓo gye esa la mwa to ɓoho kwoi zhin wo m , ɓa ɓeda shando ɓa gna ge , wo zhin shekwoyi ho nu .
vivi aba yi n yi ɓo wankma nyi , oza ho ɓei nyi ɓo a yi ge bubliyus , wo nu ɓo zhin gwamna muse yi nya .
wa gwo yi n bugba bui-bui yi , wa ga yi nyagyi har anyipyei ngun-ata .
bubliyus dada wo ɓo n nyasan yi , nayi nagun ɓedo n goro-san yi .
bulus wa lo wa zhin aduwa , wa to wo bwa wa wo kagna .
azaje vinya , nɓa to ɓei n lafiya yi m n muse yi , ɓa ɓe a ɓa kagna .
ntu deye ɓo aza ɓa ɓe yi n kyauta yi n mwa , esa nu yi ɓo ye ya kuka , aza ɓa ɓe yi na nya yi gbo-gbo n yi ɓa zhin akma n cei n zokwo .
apya ɓo ku sun ngun-ata , ngye shi eya ɓei ɓaya , ya kuka njesun , nsa deye yi ɓo zan-zan n eya alekzandariya nya yi nkwo zhin vinyikwo shi n muse hi , ai yi kwo ge aza aba . eyi akpezhiba kmisunyi sai sirakusa , ya bwa anyipyei ɓo ngun-ata .
ya kuka ɓo ya pmi lo rigiyum , ya bwa nyipyei gmanyi ese kudu nya kwa ya ci , nyipyei bahi yisi butiyoli , nɓo ya sun a yesu viyi hoi , ɓa gyi yi wye ge yi ku fi nɓa yi har anyipyei tnaba .
ya kpe kala ku ya lo roma .
eyi azaje nɓa ɓei fi n roma nyi , ɓa ku wo ge yi ɓe lo , ɓa ɓe shegun yi n abiyu gnikwo .
azado ɓa shegun yi n ashiragyi ngun-ata .
shi bulus ɓo gye ɓa , wa zhin shekwoyi godiya , wa bwa bugba kala .
shi yi ɓo si roma , a ye bulus ge wo dna wo nya abaho-baho n wo ɓa dna , sai dai soja ɓei zhin woi gu wo .
shi wo ɓo si wa bwa anyipyei ngun ata , wa yi a yahudiyi atukwoda wa da ɓo nɓai wa gna , omi azaje , a yahudiyi nɓa fi n urushelima nyi , ɓa na wan mi ɓai dna mi a romayi akun , ko shi ko nyi mi to zhin nyaho-nyaho yi m , ko ma zhi za wuya kwo ɓo n kwo zhin kunnu eyi azakwoyi nya m .
a romayi ɓa ku owa da mi , ɓai ye ɓa ya mi , ntu ge ɓa to sun nyaho n mi aba nkwo kunce lo nfi yi , ngye shi a yahudiyi atukwoda ɓei gna ge awu mi nyi m .
shi a yahudiyi atukwoda to ɓo ye a shaula yi m , to a wun aje bugba m , ma gye ko la mi ze tile ma gyi abye n ɓeda yi kwa lo kaisar aba .
ma yi fye ge fye ɓe n naiye ge ya kpe ajeye , magna fye ge , mi dna n agma ye ge , mi n gaiciya ga yi lo ge masihu wa ɓe nu . ʼba ye ɓa gna wo ge , yi to wo ɓoho tu nho tukwo m !
yi to bwa wasika n yahudiya , ko naza nɓa kun lo n urushelima , ɓai ɓe iya nyi m .
ama yi ce pma ya wo enya ho gaiciya yi ga , enya dei n yi kpe lo , okwo nu ge abaho-bahoi vinya , aza ta ye a yesu viyi lo m . ɓa esa shi , nwyihi aza nmwa begye ɓa yezhi n wo puwa .
wa daɓo n ɓai tu shekwoyi ebemi ɓo , woi wu ɓa aɓo ntu yesu ɓo ngye shi aka fi n littafi gyi-gyi-yi , wa ya ɓa wu n attaura musa nya ɓedo anabi yi , wa ya ɓa wu n labmi yi har wyeshe !
azaho ɓa ku gaiciya ga , ama azaho to ɓa gaiciya m .
ɓa na bo aje yi n mwa , ɓa kuka n ɓeda gmanyi shi n bulus ɓo da ge , zafun gyi-gyiyi ɓo ku ɓeda da cewo n anabi ishaya gbe ge , wa gna a yahudiyi ge , ʼfye ɓa wo fyei gye ama fye ta bwa awyega m , ntu ge ofye abugba shin-shin lo , ofye atnubua ta ye lo ɓa wo m , fyei ku fye awye kpe to fya bwa awye gam , ntu ge fye ta ye lo fya gye , fya wo , fya bwa awye ga , fya ɓe ma ka fye gna m . ʼ mi ye fya kpe ge , gni-gni shekwoyi nya ye , kwo nyi ntu abyedo ɓo nu ce , ɓai ɓa gwo kwo . bulus wa wo nya dna n wohin haya nyakun har aye ngun aba , woi gwo azhiɓeyi doho-doho nɓa ɓei ɓe wo wyegye .
woi gna ɓa shekwoyi ebe mi ɓo , n dagayi yesu kristi yi , zaho-zaho yi to ɓo wo wo ɓi m .
anugundo ye-yeyi n fye fi n roma nyi , wasikaye gmi n bulus akun nu , yesu kristi bara kni-kniyi ntuge wa zhi waʼazi , shekwoyi nabari manayi nya .
shekwoyi ɓei zhin nabari manayi ye alkawali tunyi nsapai , nwo anabi akun dna alkawali kwo-kwoyi .
kwo zhin nabari manayi nwo nugun tukwonu , yesu kristi eyi dagayi n wo ɓei ɓe ngye oɓi a mawo dna dawuda esu abe ɓi fye .
owo kalala n efi kwo wu ge wo zhin shekwoyi ikoda nugun nu , n shekwoyi nayi gyi-gyi-yi .
nsayi ye dna n kristi , ala shekwoyi alheri zeya pu eyi alaifi da n yi to kunce lo yagwo kwo gmanyi n amin .
nsayi ye wo tnuyi nge yi lo anyi , yi gna aza vinya n na bai vinya , aɓo ayakwo n shekwoyi ku zhin ɓa nabai ɓa ga gaiciya ɓa vi wo ɓo .
ofye , anugundo ye-yeyi nfye fi n roma nyi , fye filo n na aza n wo ye , yesu kristi n la fye yi fya ze shekwoyi anya , owo aza gyi-gyi-yi .
shekwoyi sun-sun-gye n bugba fuyi vinya n ɓakun n shekwoyi eyi dada n yesu kristi , eyi dagayi yi aba ɓa ze fye nya .
kpema shekwoyi kwo nu zhin wye-wyeyi ma gna fye kmisunyi aba vinya n ma lo , mawo ai dafye gaiciya ga ɓo .
ntuge akpe fye gaiciya ga dna n shekwoyi yelo n anyi vinya .
misa shekwoyi ami dna n yesu kristi n tu nabari manayi ye ɓo , n zaho-zahoi n fye mi .
shekwoyi kpelo shi mi zhin ma zhin aduwa , ntu fye ɓo cici .
nyipyeyi n sukwoyi mi-i ɓe nfyei n fya bukatai , n za aba n mi zhin wo tnu-tnu n mi kalayi vinya , miyi gna aza nabari manayi owo nugun nya .
mi zhin aduwa ma bwa esa n shekwoyi ɓeye nu , ma gye fye njesun , nkwa yezhin omi zan kwa ze lafiya nya .
ntuge a wo mi pwa ma ɓe fya ba n nabai ma ɓe fye gaiciya ga , n ko ɓa zhi ofye ikklisiya kwa mwa dna n dagayi .
miye fye bmazhin lo ce , ntuge mita ye ma ɓe fye gaiciya ga nu gmanyin , amma ofye nya kwa ɓe mi kala .
zaho-i zahoi n yi mi wa bwa anabarka n na aje aba .
mi n cei pmalo fya kpe omi azaje , nge mi ɓei ku shiri zhin n na bwai mwa-begye ma ɓe fye aba , ( ama to ayen ) n na abai ma zhin tnu-tnu n fye aba omi bwa apma , shi mi zhin n ikklisiya aje .
ntuge mi n ta yakwoyi shi fye lo n azayi vinya , n na zayi n ɓala awye kna n na zayi n awye to kna ɓan , eh , n na ɓeyekpe yi n na azayi n ɓa ta kpe ɓeho yen .
ntu lonu shi mi ɓa mi n sun , mi n mihin yeye yilo ma ɓe f a ba n roma , ma zhin shekwoyi nabari manayi waʼazi .
nabari manayi kristi nya vinyiko ta wo milon , shekwoyi ikoda zokwonu n wo ɓe n na zayi ri shemi n ɓa gwo ko .
aɓei zhin nabari ye waʼazi n kmisun na yahudiyi aba nu , amma n sayiye ala aza vinya yi ɓa ɓe shekwoyi aba n zokwo yeyi .
nabari manayi ye gna yi ge , shekwoyi zhin yi shiri ntu she ɓo , woi zeyi aza manayi n shekwoyi awyeba .
esa n ya ga gaiciya ya kpema yesu wa gniyi , nkwo ya-yai har okwo zo-zo , gaiciya ga nu gakwo .
shi a cei kafi dna n littafi oza n wa bwa wye-wyeyi woɓa bwa kwo dna n gaiciya ga n shekwoyi aba nu . efi ntna ɓo vi aba amma shekwoyi wu wo minagyi , n kwo gmi n she n na a laifida , n na ɓenukwoyi zhiyi tukwo , aza nukwoyi nɓa ce gaiciya abwa ya , gama ɓa kpe shekwoyi gaiciya ga ye lo kwo to ai wu ɓam , shekwoyi la ɓeyekpeye dna ɓa n ɓa bugba mi .
tunyi sapa , aza ɓei ku eshe gye n kniyi n shekwoyi ɓei zhin , ɓai kpege wo lo n iko nyalo-nyalo nyayi .
ntu cenu ɓato naɓezeyi lo lon sanu ɓa ɓei gni agni zhi n shekwoyi abye n wada wyi yin .
e , ɓa kpe owo ɓe yelo , amma ɓato yen , ko ɓa gawo mwa-mwan , ko ɓa zhin wo godiya n tu nwo bmazhin ɓo fyegyi-fyegyin .
safyewyi , ɓaya a nubwozhin abanza nya shi shekwoyi wu , n nyayi nwo ye ɓa zhin .
oɓa bugba tnaceyi kwa ze wyegma kwa ku jeje .
ɓai gyege ɓa ce-cei lo n tna shekwoyi , ɓaku ze aza mama .
nnavun , maimako ɓa ga shekwoyi ikoda nyalo-nyalo mwa-mwa , ɓaku ashinwa , na kutayi ɓa zela ashan ɓa gyiɓa wye , alu , anya fanya , awa n na gbayizanyi-kwo-ciyi .
ntuce nu shekwoyi wa faɓa ɓa zhin anagbayi doho-dohoi nɓa ceyi pma , e , awye bwo ɓo n naɓo nukwoyi ɓai zhin nnajeyi nanyi .
maimakon ɓa ga enya gaiciya , n ɓa kpe ge ko zhin gaiciya nu n shekwoyi tukwo , ɓa kni a nya ɓai gwo kpe , ɓa ga akata gaiciya .
ntu lonu ɓa zhin aduwa ga anya n shekwoyi azhin , amma to ɓa vi n shekwoyi anabarkada ɓo , n wonu na zhin anya vinya nyin .
cenu ɓei zhin shekwoyi wa yaɓa bwa , ɓa zhin aɓo nukwoyi ye vinya .
har oɓa nyikwo ɓa fa zokwo n shekwoyi wa zhin gaɓa , ɓa ce ɓai zhin a nagbayi n na jeyi .
aza nugbayi , maimako ɓa zhin ɓo n kwo kunce n na nyikwozayi , shakpe kwa ɓa duwyi ɓahin-ɓahin , azanugbayi wangye n na jeyi , ntuce nu ɓa gwo ɓa lada dna n ɓa wye-wyeyi , tata n kwo kunce ɓa gwo .
ntu lonu sanu n ɓa ɓei ya shekwoyi bwa to ɓaye a kpewoyen , shekwoyi wa ya ɓa bwa ɓa zhin aɓe awyebwo nya , n ɓa bugba nukwoyi zhin nubwo n cei .
oɓa wye-wyeyi ɓa ku nu n na ɓe nukwoyi n laifiyi , shakpe , n na je bmiyi , eshe , zawu , gusun , akatace , bugba nukwoyi , n na aje ɓedayi .
ɓa ɓei zhin aza ɓetuyi nu , ɓai wun shekwoyi nu , awyegba-ciyi , a tukwo-mwayi , cici ɓai zhin azokwo woi-woyi nubwo shi ɓa ɓa zhin ɓenukwoyi , to ɓai vi oɓa zakwoyi ɓom .
ɓa ta ye awyegan , to ɓai nu alkawali n , n tna ye-ye , n tna sun-sun gye .
ɓa ɓei kpe shekwoyi tata , tu aɓeye tukwo ofi nu , amma ɓa gyi abye n zhin yi har , ɓai dna aza kwoce nge ɓa zhin lonu ce .
anugundo ye-yeyi n fye fi n roma nyi , wasikaye gmi n bulus akun nu , yesu kristi bara kni-kniyi ntuge wa zhi waʼazi , shekwoyi nabari manayi nya .

tata lo nabye to , kpesun , ho cilo ge , ʼaza , ukwoyi nu n na daɓo n ya .
amma lapmi , ho zhin oza laifi da nuce .
sanu n ha ci n cei ge ɓa zhin aza nukwoyi nu , kwoi bmiya lo a gaba tata , ho da hohin tukwo ɓo nu ce , ntuge ho zhin aɓeye lo ce .
yi kpelo ge , shekwoyi ɓei da wa woi zun aza kni n ɓa zhin aɓeye pya .
ho gye ngye shekwoyi ɓei da aza owa , wo la hoi da fwa , hoi zhin aɓoho lo n hohin ?
hota gye lo shi shekwoyi zhin hakuri n hoi m ?
ko ho ta kula lo ma ?
hota gye lon , esaye vinya woi pmi ho to woi tahon , woi gaho sa ha pmi avun wu ho a laifin .
wo wuho alheri deye ntu ge haye abui nu .
amma , fyeta kna tnubua lo n , fye ye minagyi nukwoyi zhi fyehin ntu fye abugba kala kpe ɓo , n ge fyeta pmi avun wu of ye alaifin .
minagyi nyipyei ɓelo n shekwoyi ɓei da anyi vinya wa .
wo ɓei ga oza shi owa tnu-tnu a mu gawo n sun .
wo ɓei ga aza n ɓa zhin shekwoyi ɓeye n hakuri yi , wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya , ɓai zan mwa-mwa n latu yi shin n wyewye yi nyalo-nyalo nyai nwo ganyi .
ama wo ɓei ga aza tata n ɓa gni a papa n shekwoyi gaiciya yi , ɓai zan-zan fi n na zokwo nukwoyi , aɓei ze shekwoyi minagyi ya kpe ɓa .
bugba wun , n na zhingye yi , ɓei bwa a yahudiyi .
na a zayi n ɓato zhin a yahudiyi m vinya , n ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi .
amma aza nɓa vi wo ɓo , ɓa ɓei bwa mwa-mwa n bugba fu yi , ko yahudiyi nu kwo aza nɓato zhin a yahudiyim .
ntuge shekwoyi zhin zaho-zahoyi ɓo n tna awyekwo .
wo ɓei ta laifi aba n kwo nyi vinya .
wo ɓei ta ashan-gbayi , koda-yake , ɓato n shekwoyi awyidna yi kashi lo n , gama nɓa bugba mi , ɓa kpe ɓe manayi yelo n nukwoyi .
shekwoyi awyidna kafi lo n ɓa bugba mi .
oɓa la-ami kwoi zunɓa kni .
ko kwoyi daɓa wa , shekwoyi ɓei ta a yahudiyi ntu ɓenukwoyi zhin ɓo , ntu ge ɓa n wo awyidna yi ka shi lo , ama to ɓai shi ɓa bwan .
ɓa kpe ɓe manayi ye , ama ɓata zhin kon .
ata ga aza gni-gni n ɓa kpeɓeye n naɓa zhin sai aza n ɓa zhin kwo .
nyipyei ɓelo n shekwoyi ɓei da aza nukwoyi wa , nɓa ɓemwi nukwoyi , dna n yesu kristi .
deye kwonu zhin shekwoyi shiri n mi zhin waʼazi .
ofye a yahudiyi fye zhin nubwo ge ɓeho to dnalo nfye a tasin n shekwoyi n , ntuge wo ɓei ga fye owo wyidna fyei zhin a ɓokwo , fyei gna n ge fye zhin owa nugundo manayi nu .
fye kpeɓeye lo nwo ye , fye kpe ɓe nukwoyi yelo n ɓe manayi fyei gna manayi ye , ntuge aɓe ku wyidna wufye , fyei n na ɓinayi .
fye kpe shekwoyi zokwo ye lo har nfye ɓawu wyebuayi ko n bwanyi yi .
fye gye fyehin nge a fitila nu fyei wu aza zokwo n ɓa fi n wyegma , n ɓata kpe shekwoyi ye n .
fye gye ge fye ɓa mi , fya wu aza n na ɓi yi shekwoyi zokwo , ntu ge fye kpe owo wyidna yelo n ɓa zhin ɓeyekpe n gaiciya yi nyi .
e , fyewu aza knunu zhin , kninu zhin to fyei wu fyehin ma ?
fye gla aza ge ɓato wyivi m , fyehin fyei wyivi ?
fye gna ko to bmiya aza zhin anagbayi n , fyei zhin n fyehin ?
fye gna ato gba ashan fyei ze agyiwye efye shekwoyi .
fye zhin aɓekwo n ge fyekpe shekwoyi awyidna ye , ama fyei dnawo vinyikwo to fyei shi ɓa bwan .
gaiciya nu n littafi a da , nge anyi da ɓeda nukwoyi n shekwoyi tukwo n tu n fye ɓo .
ayi oza ye yahudiyi nu kwo zhin ɓe manayi nu , n ho shi wo awyidna bwa .
ama n ho to shi ɓa bwan , ho to du aɓe nukwoyi zhinyi lo n .
( atna-kaciya zhinyi ) .
ndei a shangbayi shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa , shekwoyi ta gaɓa mwa-mwa n yanci yi , n wa zhin shiri ge wa ga a yahudiyi nyi n ?
ɓehin-hin ashan-gbayi ɓoku dufye a yahudiyi , n fye kpe shekwoyi ɓeye n mwanyi , n wo alkawali yi shinyi , to fyei shi owa wyidna bwanyin .
fye to zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin nu shifye azakwoyi zhin a yahudiyin , kwo kuwa shifye zhin kaciyan .
aʼa , oza n wo bugba wulo cewo n shekwoyi aba , wonu zhin yahudiyi hin-hin .
ntuge shewoyi ta dna aza wye nu n ɓa sa ɓa nayi yan n kaciya zokwon , ama wo dna ozanu wye n wo bugba manayi .
oza n wo bugba do shanye kpe n wo wye-wyei mi wo ɓa bwa latu n shekwoyi abanu , to ge n fye abam .
to , kpesun , ho cilo ge , ʼaza , ukwoyi nu n na daɓo n ya .
amma lapmi , ho zhin oza laifi da nuce .
sanu n ha ci n cei ge ɓa zhin aza nukwoyi nu , kwoi bmiya lo a gaba tata , ho da hohin tukwo ɓo nu ce , ntuge ho zhin aɓeye lo ce .
yi kpelo ge , shekwoyi ɓei da wa woi zun aza kni n ɓa zhin aɓeye pya .
ho gye ngye shekwoyi ɓei da aza owa , wo la hoi da fwa , hoi zhin aɓoho lo n hohin ?
hota gye lo shi shekwoyi zhin hakuri n hoi m ?
ko ho ta kula lo ma ?
hota gye lon , esaye vinya woi pmi ho to woi tahon , woi gaho sa ha pmi avun wu ho a laifin .
wo wuho alheri deye ntu ge haye abui nu .
amma , fyeta kna tnubua lo n , fye ye minagyi nukwoyi zhi fyehin ntu fye abugba kala kpe ɓo , n ge fyeta pmi avun wu of ye alaifin .
minagyi nyipyei ɓelo n shekwoyi ɓei da anyi vinya wa .
wo ɓei ga oza shi owa tnu-tnu a mu gawo n sun .
wo ɓei ga aza n ɓa zhin shekwoyi ɓeye n hakuri yi , wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya , ɓai zan mwa-mwa n latu yi shin n wyewye yi nyalo-nyalo nyai nwo ganyi .
ama wo ɓei ga aza tata n ɓa gni a papa n shekwoyi gaiciya yi , ɓai zan-zan fi n na zokwo nukwoyi , aɓei ze shekwoyi minagyi ya kpe ɓa .
bugba wun , n na zhingye yi , ɓei bwa a yahudiyi .
na a zayi n ɓato zhin a yahudiyi m vinya , n ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi .
amma aza nɓa vi wo ɓo , ɓa ɓei bwa mwa-mwa n bugba fu yi , ko yahudiyi nu kwo aza nɓato zhin a yahudiyim .
ntuge shekwoyi zhin zaho-zahoyi ɓo n tna awyekwo .
wo ɓei ta laifi aba n kwo nyi vinya .
wo ɓei ta ashan-gbayi , koda-yake , ɓato n shekwoyi awyidna yi kashi lo n , gama nɓa bugba mi , ɓa kpe ɓe manayi yelo n nukwoyi .
shekwoyi awyidna kafi lo n ɓa bugba mi .
oɓa la-ami kwoi zunɓa kni .

( atna-kaciya zhinyi ) .

anabarka yahudiyi-bye nya mi gye ampanyi nza zhin yahudiyi nyi ?
gyiba manayi ho lo n shekwoyi aba ?
ampanyi ho lo n na yahudiyi kaciya n ɓa zhin nyi ?
e , ampanyi lo n oza ɓa n wo zhin yahudiyi , kmisunyi shekwoyi ɓei gaɓa owo awyidna .
( n nabai ɓa kpe , ɓa zhin wo ɓeye ) .
gaiciya azaho n ɓa mi to ɓei n aminci yi n , ntuge ɓa ɓei bma alkawali ya n shekwoyi yi , kwa wu nu ge shekwoyi ɓa bma wo alkawaliya ?
aʼa , ko shi kwo nyi aza vinya n na anyi zhin aza kata nu , shekwoyi to zhin zakatan nun .
ho pa enya lo n litafi n zaburada n deye tukwo ?
shekwoyi ɓeda ta shan don , ci-ci kwo zhin gaiciya nu .
ko nyikadonu nu na nya ɓa ɓo .
ama , azaho ci ge , owo ɓeda n yi to shi bwa nyi n , kwo n na ampanyi yilo , eyi alaifi ku ampanyi zhin , ntu ge aza ɓa gye shi shekwoyi yeye nyi , esa ɓa gye shi yi zhin aɓe nukwoyi zan .
kwo bmiya lo n wo aba wa tayi , esa ya zhin ɓe nikwoyi , eyi alaifi yi bwa wo go bmazhin ?
shekwo sauka .
kni shekwoyi pya nu to woi ta laifin ma ?
wo ɓa zun oza kni n wu na ?
ntuge wota mi wa da mi owa , wa zunmi kni ngye laifi da n , ndei omi tna gaiciya ɓe wolo n mwa-mwayi koi wuge wo zhin gaiciya da nun .
n ha vi kwo lo nu , ha gye shi yi gna ɓenukwoyi zhin nu dudu .
shekwoyi wa gna kwo ye .
amma aza n ɓa da abeye pya knizun kunce lo n ɓa aba .
dudu lonu aza ho gye ge nya nu n mi zhin waʼazi .
to , eyi a yahudiyi du aza je lo ?
ko fyewyi , ntuge , yi ku luwu ge aza vinya zhin a laifi danu .
ko a yahudiyi ko aza nɓa to zhin a yahjudiyin .
she littafi a da , za manayi to lo n , zaknayi to lon nna nyimi n wo to zhin laifi danu n .
ozato lo n wo vi shekwoyi zokwo cewo ko n wo n cei pma wa vin .
zaho-zahoi la wonya pmiya , aza vinya nku ɓenukwoyi zhin , oza to lo n bwaho n wo zhin ɓe manayi ko zaknayin .
oɓa ɓeda tucegye , n ce asin ngye vingwo nkwo gu-guyi ya gni .
oɓa nyitala nu-nuyi n na katayi .
ɓeda doho-dohoyi nɓa da kwo n mwi nukwoyi fi , n kwo ɓa wu oza .
oɓa gbe , nu-nuyi n na aknikpe yi n minagyi yi .
ba pye-pyeyi n za wu , ɓai wun za nu n wo to gwo ɓa ɓedan .
abaho-bahoi n ɓa lo ɓa fa bugba wun n wahala yi n na azhingye yi .
ɓa ta kpe enya ye n na yi ge , bugba fun kwo shekwoyi anabarka m .
ɓa ta gye ɓa nuwan n shekwoyi , kwo enya n wo zhin nubo n ɓa tukwon .
ntucenu shekwoyi minagyi n wagyi tulo mwa n na yahudiyi , ntu ge oɓa tnu-tnu nu , ɓa shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa , ɓace ɓai zhin aɓo nukwoyi , zaknayi n ɓami to n na ɓenayi lo lon .
ɓehin-hin anyi vinya to n na gmiba yi lon n shekwoyi ikoda abyen .
nsayi ye , hoku gye ?
za to lo n naɓa zewo oza manayi n shekwoyi abam , ntuge wo zhin ɓo n na awyid-na da m .
ntuge yi kpe shekwoyi awyidnaye , ya gye to yi gna ɓa bwa shin , owo awyidna wu yi ge , yi zhin aɓe nukwoyi zhin yi nu .
amma nsayiye shekwoyi ku eshe zokwo do wuyi , gbo , n na wyidna bwashi yi , amma n zokwo woyi ( ko-daya-ke zokwo woyi nu to n , ntu ge shekwoyi ɓeda ku gna yi tunyi n sapa ) .
nsaiye shekwoyi wa gna ge woɓa gwo yi , wa zeyi a tna laifi da .
n ya kpema yesu kristi wa zo yi a laifi , wa zhin yi gafara .
aɓa gni yi n zokwo deye n ya ɓe kristi aba .
ko hoi zhin nyika donuʼa , ko hoya zhin kni laifi nuʼa .
aza vinya nku laifi zhin ɓai ku gba kpekpe-gye n shekwoyi mwa-mwa aba , ama nsayi yi ku ze aza akni-kni-yi , ntu wo alheli ɓo , nɓa ɓe dna n gni-gni n yesu kristi aba nyi .
shekwoyi wa tnu n yesu yi ntu ge , wa ze doshan nya nya ntu oyi alaifi ɓo , ozaho-zahoi nwa ga gaiciya aku gafara zhin wo .
shekwoyi wa shin deye ntu ge wa wu ge wo zhin ɓefyecei nu , nsa avun nya , wo ɓei la bugba bwa n laifi-i , to wa ga aza ta-ta m wa zhin deye nsayi ye ntu ge , wa wu ge wo zhin oza kni-kni-yi nu , woi ɓa mi wa gmi oza ya tu nwa ga yesu gaiciya , wohin ce wa ze oza kni-kni-yi .
nyaho lo n zanyikwoci ɓa mwa wohin nkwo ɓo ?
nge awo .
ntu kniɓehia ?
ntu ge yi shi awyidna bwa ?
awo , ama ntu gaiciya ga ɓo .
onya gmanyi nu n yi kpe lo , okwo nu ge a ta bwa gni-gni n awyidna bwashi ɓo nu m , ama n gaiciya ga aba .
mi nya ge , shekwoyi zhin ayahudiyi shekwoyi nu gmanyi , wo to zhin abyedo shekwoyi nu ce n ?
cewo wo zhin ɓa nya nu .
shekwoyi gmanyi nu , owo nu ɓa gni ayahudiyi ntu ɓa gaiciya ga ɓo , owo nu-i ɓa gni abyedo , ntu ba gaiciya ga ɓo .
shi kwo wu lo nu nyi , ta gye yi ɓa ku awyidna ze gboloyi n ?
nge awo , awyidna ze gboloyi n ?
nge awo , awyidna nɓa apmayi lo .

nge awo , awyidna nɓa apmayi lo .
besisi n ibrahim yi dna n nayi ibrahim nu zhin eyi a yahu-diyi dada .
ko ɓei wo n wuna dna nɓenya yemiʼa , gaiciya ga n gni-gni yiʼa ?
ntu nwo atnu-tnu manayi ɓo nu n shekwoyi ɓei gwo wo ?
ngye lonu nu , yi n nyai lo n yi ɓa gma .
ama n shekwoyi aba ibrahim to n na abayi lo n wo ɓa gma kwo wa zhin aɓekwo n .
ntuge , littafi ku gna yi ge ibrahim ɓei ga shekwoyi gaiciya , ntuce nu shekwoyi wa zo wo alaifi wa yi wo oza gyi-gyi-yi .
ama wo to ɓei lo eshe ntu n wa aɓo amanayi ɓo nu n wo ɓei zhin nyin ?
awo , gni-gni zhin shekwoyi cauta nu .
aga aza nu n ɓa to zhin tnu-tnu n tu nkwo ɓo n .
ntuge shekwoyi ze alaifi da a gyi-gyi-yi n wo awyeba , ɓai ya ga kristi gaiciya , wa gni ɓa n shekwoyi minagyi .
dawuda esuɓei ku oza agmada ɓeda wato laifida n shekwoyi la wo ze oza gyi-gyi-yi ntna laifi nwo abye .
anabarka da nu oza n shekwoyi ku gafara zhin wo , wo la oza laifi kuya n wo awye ba .
e , agmada yakwo nu n za aba n na aku abui zowo , to dagayi shan wo alaifi ba m .
nsaiye ɓonya nyi ge ; aga aza nu anabarka n ɓa ga kristi gaiciya ɓai shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa , ko aga aza nu anabarka n ɓata shi a yahudiyi awyi-dna bwan , amma ɓai kpe ma kristi a ?
ibrahim ma , n ya gna ge wo ɓei gwo anabarka ntu wo gaiciya gaɓonu .
gaiciya ga nu gmanyi ?
ko ntu ge wo ɓei shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa nuʼa ?
ntu ge aga ɓonya deye amsa , sai a ga deye amsa kpa .
shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim owo anabarka n kni sayiʼa ?
tun kafin wo ze yahudiyi , kalm wo zhin kaciya .
nna avun nu n shekwoyi ɓei zhin wo alkawali ntu n wo gaiciya ga ɓo , a zhin wo kaciya .
kaciya zhin ɓei wuge ibrahim n gaiciya ga yi lo , njesun ge shekwoyi ɓei lawo lu gwo wa zewo tna-laifi da , oza manayi nwo awyeba kafin a zhin wo kaciya .
ntu lo nu ibrahim nu zhin dada , zafun nya , n aza aba nɓa ku gaiciya ga , ai la ɓa gni to ɓai shi yahudiyi awyidna bwan .
yi ku gye nu aza nɓa ta shi awyidna bwan , shekwoyi nu gniɓa ntu ɓa gaiciya ɓo .
ibrahim nu zhin a yahudiyi dada dna n zafun n na ku kaciya zhin ɓa .
ɓa ɓa gye n wo ɓesisi nge kaciya zhin nu tagni ɓa m , ntu ge ibrahim ɓei bwa shekwoyi alheri ntu wo gaiciya ga ɓonu gmanyi , kafin azhin wo kaciya .
kwa wunu cewo ngye shekwoyi alkawali , nwo ɓei zhin ibrahim nwo byei nyi , nge wo ɓa gawo anyi vinya nyi .
woto ɓei zhin wo alkawali ye ntu ge wo ɓei shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa nun , ama ntuge wo ɓei ga wo gaiciya .
ntuce nu n dei hoye gnalo ge shekwoyi anabarka lo aza banu n ɓa zhin ɓemana , ho gna nu ge , shekwoyi alkawali n na a gaiciya gayi aba kwo zhin gbeloyi nu , gaiciya ga n la ze nyaze .
ama gaiciya ɓeda ye nya nu nyi .
sa nu n ya zhin atna ge ya bwa shekwoyi anabarka n gni-gni yi , n na ɓemanayi zhin ɓo , n wo awyidna bwa shi yi , yi zhin ya zo fi n wo minagyi nu , ntuge ci-ci yi ta mi nɓa bwa shin .
zokwo gmanyi n yi ɓa fa awyidna bmaya ɓo , yito bwa wyidna kwo gmanyin .
ntu lonu , agayi shekwoyi anabarka ntu gaiciya ga ɓo nu .
cauta nu yi ɓa gwo kwo to yi ya vi a yahudiyi kunun , n yi n gaiciya gayi lo ngye ibrahim .
ntuge ibrahim nu zhin yi dada sa n kwa ɓe gaiciya ga aba .
nya nu n littafi a da , sa n kwo ciyi ge shekwoyi ɓei la ibrahim ze oda aza begye nya .
shekwoyi ɓa gwo aza vinya n ɓa ga shekwoyi gaiciya shi ibrahim ɓei zhin nyi .
alkawali deye gmi n shekwoyi aba nu , n wo zhin a zafi ɓai bwa wye-wyeyi n jesun nyi , woi da aɓo ɓo n ɓa ɓei zhin n abye n gyeɓaku luzhin .
ntu lo nu , sa n shekwoyi ɓei gna ibrahim nge , wo ɓa gawo ɓi n wo ɓa bwa ebye gawo n mwa , waze ebye yakwo , ibrahim ʼbei la shekwoyi ga gaciya ko shi ko nyi kwo ɓei zhin ɓo ɓedna yi nu .
ntuge , owo gaiciya ga ɓei n kalayi , wo to ɓei damu ge wola kwo n , nna ɓa yi wo ge oda nyin .
woi aye yi tagyi , saratu owo nyikwo aye ce shi-ciwa-gmanyi , wo ɓei la du aɓima saya .
ama ibrahim to ɓei zhin shekwoyi shakan , wa ga shekwoyi gaiciya ntuge , owo gaiciya ga nwo awyetu yi ɓei n kalayi .
wa ci shekwoyi ntu anabarka ye ɓo , to woi lu ɓa bwan .
wo ɓei n gaiciyai ga ge shekwoyi ɓa mi wa nu ɓo n wa da .
ntu ibrahim gaiciya ga ɓo , shekwoyi wa zhin wo alaifi gafara , wa ze oza ntna laifi .
nsaiye , ɓeda wo-wo yi ye nge aɓei gwo wo ntu nwo gaiciya ga ɓo nu , ko to ɓei zhin ntu ibrahim gyi ba ɓo nu gmanyin .
kwo zhin eyi nyanu , kwo wuyi ge shekwoyi ɓa gwo yi n zokwo gmanyi , shi wo ɓei gwo ibrahim nyi sanu n ya ga shekwoyi alkawali gaiciya , n wo ɓei la yesu eyi dagayi kala n efi nyi .
wo ɓei fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo wa laka n vingwo ntu ge wa ze yi aza ye-ye yi n shekwoyi aba .
woi nu yi n shekwoyi ɓe manayi .
dna n nayi ibrahim nu zhin eyi a yahu-diyi dada .
ko ɓei wo n wuna dna nɓenya yemiʼa , gaiciya ga n gni-gni yiʼa ?
ntu nwo atnu-tnu manayi ɓo nu n shekwoyi ɓei gwo wo ?
ngye lonu nu , yi n nyai lo n yi ɓa gma .
ama n shekwoyi aba ibrahim to n na abayi lo n wo ɓa gma kwo wa zhin aɓekwo n .
ntuge , littafi ku gna yi ge ibrahim ɓei ga shekwoyi gaiciya , ntuce nu shekwoyi wa zo wo alaifi wa yi wo oza gyi-gyi-yi .
ama wo to ɓei lo eshe ntu n wa aɓo amanayi ɓo nu n wo ɓei zhin nyin ?
awo , gni-gni zhin shekwoyi cauta nu .
aga aza nu n ɓa to zhin tnu-tnu n tu nkwo ɓo n .
ntuge shekwoyi ze alaifi da a gyi-gyi-yi n wo awyeba , ɓai ya ga kristi gaiciya , wa gni ɓa n shekwoyi minagyi .
dawuda esuɓei ku oza agmada ɓeda wato laifida n shekwoyi la wo ze oza gyi-gyi-yi ntna laifi nwo abye .
anabarka da nu oza n shekwoyi ku gafara zhin wo , wo la oza laifi kuya n wo awye ba .
e , agmada yakwo nu n za aba n na aku abui zowo , to dagayi shan wo alaifi ba m .

kwa wunu cewo ngye shekwoyi alkawali , nwo ɓei zhin ibrahim nwo byei nyi , nge wo ɓa gawo anyi vinya nyi .
woto ɓei zhin wo alkawali ye ntu ge wo ɓei shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa nun , ama ntuge wo ɓei ga wo gaiciya .

ntu lonu , agayi shekwoyi anabarka ntu gaiciya ga ɓo nu .

alkawali deye gmi n shekwoyi aba nu , n wo zhin a zafi ɓai bwa wye-wyeyi n jesun nyi , woi da aɓo ɓo n ɓa ɓei zhin n abye n gyeɓaku luzhin .
ntu lo nu , sa n shekwoyi ɓei gna ibrahim nge , wo ɓa gawo ɓi n wo ɓa bwa ebye gawo n mwa , waze ebye yakwo , ibrahim ʼbei la shekwoyi ga gaciya ko shi ko nyi kwo ɓei zhin ɓo ɓedna yi nu .

wa ci shekwoyi ntu anabarka ye ɓo , to woi lu ɓa bwan .
wo ɓei n gaiciyai ga ge shekwoyi ɓa mi wa nu ɓo n wa da .
ntu ibrahim gaiciya ga ɓo , shekwoyi wa zhin wo alaifi gafara , wa ze oza ntna laifi .
nsaiye , ɓeda wo-wo yi ye nge aɓei gwo wo ntu nwo gaiciya ga ɓo nu , ko to ɓei zhin ntu ibrahim gyi ba ɓo nu gmanyin .
kwo zhin eyi nyanu , kwo wuyi ge shekwoyi ɓa gwo yi n zokwo gmanyi , shi wo ɓei gwo ibrahim nyi sanu n ya ga shekwoyi alkawali gaiciya , n wo ɓei la yesu eyi dagayi kala n efi nyi .
wo ɓei fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo wa laka n vingwo ntu ge wa ze yi aza ye-ye yi n shekwoyi aba .
woi nu yi n shekwoyi ɓe manayi .
bugbafu n shekwoyi yi ntu lonu , nsayi ye shi aku yi ze abefyecezhin yi n shekwoyi abye nyi , ntu yi gaiciya ga ɓo n wo alkawali .
yi ɓa bwa bugba fu hin-hin nsaiyi ntu n ɓo n yesu kristi eyi dagayi ku zhin ga yi nyi .
ntuge , ntu n yi gaiciya ga ɓo nu n wa ɓe n yi n aba n yi gni-agni zhin n saiye nyi .
yi n bugba kalayi n agmadayi , yi shiwye ya ze enya n shekwoyi n ceyi dna n bugba ntu yi ɓo ya ze .
yi ɓa dagma ce sanu n ya lo wahala ncei , ntu ge yi kpe ge ko n na pmayi lo-lo n yi aba , ɓa wu yi shi yi ɓa zhin hankuri .
hankuri zhin kwa ɓe n kala yi kwa bma yi zhin ya kpema shekwoyi esayi vinya , ya zhin apma n kwoi har esa n yi awyetu n gaiciya gai ɓa bwa kala n mi gni yi .
nnavun , sanu n kwo zhin lonu , yiɓa mi ya bwa bugba kala ko knidonu na zhin yiʼa , yi kpe ge nyaho ta zhin ntuge yi kpelo shi shekwoyi yeyi , yi wo ye-ye yi lo n yi abugba mi , ntuge shekwoyi zafun dnalo n yi mi , woi nuyi a bugba n wo yeye yi .
sanu n yi to ɓei n bmazhin yi , n tna gni-gni zokwo , yesu wa ɓedna n sai dai-dai wafi ntu n yi alaifi ɓo , eyi n yi to ɓei n na pmayin .
ko yi n na pmayi , yi to ɓei dnace nge ozaho ɓa fi n yi ɓon , ko shiko nyi kpekni ko ɓei ɓa yezhin lonu .
ama , shekwoyi wa wuyi owo yeye shiwa tnu n kristi yi , wa fi tu n yi ɓo , tunyi yi ye zhin a laifi da .
shi kwo nyi nwo ami yi nu , nwa zhin aɓedeye gayi , yi ye zhin alaifi da , ai , woɓa gna zhin-zhin gayi nu n sayi , shi wo layi gni nyi .
nsayi wo ɓa gni yi n shekwoyi minagyi vinya n kwo ɓelo nyi .
tunyi , yi ye zhin wo anuɓayi , a jeze ɓe n yi n shekwoyi aba , ntu n wo nugun efi ɓo .
anabarka yakwo nu , n yi ɓa gna bwa n sayi n yi ku zhin wo anugundo nyi , woi dna lo n yi mi .
nsayi ye , yi dagma ntu jedoɓe woi-woi ɓo n shekwoyi , ntu nya ɓo n yi dagayi yesu kristi wa zhin gayi , nwa fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo nyi , woi zeyi shekwoyi a nugundo .
kristi wu lo gbo n adamu yi sanu adamu ɓei zhin laifi , ɓenukwoyi zhin a lo anyi vinya .
owo laifi kwoi gna efi laɓa n na anyi vinya , ntucenu anya vinya ɓai kwo , ɓai fi , ntuge aza vinya n ku laifi zhin .
yi kpelo ge adamu laifi nu na ɓe nɓe deye yi , ntuge kodayake , aza ɓei zhin ɓai zhin benukwoyi tun adamu sa , har musasa , shekwoyi to ɓei zhin woi daɓa ofi wa ntuge ɓa bma wo a wyidna yan , gama woto ɓei gaɓa owo awyidnan , kwo wo gna ɓa enya n wo ye ɓa zhin .
ntu lonu sanu n ɓa nayi ɓei zhin kwoi fi , kwo to ɓei fi ntu n ɓa laifi ɓo nun , ntuge , ɓa to ɓei zun shekwoyi owa gna , shi adamu ɓei zhin nyi m .
dogbe lo n adamu a tasin n kristi yi n wo to ɓei lu ɓe nyin .
doshan lo dna oza laifi n shekwoyi gafara zhin yi .
ntuge zaknayi ye , adamu ɓei ɓe aza mwa begye n fiyi ntu nwo laifi ɓo , ama zaknayi ye , yesu kristi woi ɓe aza n mwa begye a gafara zhinyi dna n shekwoyi sun-sun-gye .
adamu laifi gmanyi ɓei ɓe aza nfi lada yin n mwa .
ama kristi woi ku alaifi n mwa woi ga wye-wyeyi manayi nfi aba .
zaknayi laifi adamu , kwo la zhin esu tu n na aza tukwo vinya , ama oza n wa gwo shekwoyi cauta , gafara zhin n lo-lo , ɓaku zhin wye-wyeyi asu ntu zaknanyi ɓo , yesu kristi .
e , adamu laifi ɓei ɓe n tata yi n na aza tukwo vinya , ama kristi ɓe manayi zhin kwa ze aza aɓe-fyece zhinyi n shekwoyi abye , n na bai ɓa pwo .
adamu wa zhin aza n mwa begye , ɓa ze alaifi da , ɓai zun shekwoyi ɓeda gna , ama kristi wa zhin shekwoyi woi gwo aza n mwa begye ntuge wo ɓei vi ɓo .
aɓei ga awyidna ngun awo , n nabai zahozahoi wa gye aba nwa kaya n shekwoyi awyidna bwashi .
ama , sanu ya gye eyi alaifi , ya gye shekwoyi alheri dna ngafara zhin mi n mwa .
nsapai , laifi ɓei gyi ʼbe tu n aza tukwo vinya kwoi ɓe n ɓai nfi , ama nsayi ye shekwoyi alheri nu gyi be , kwoi gayi a gni-gni manayi n shekwoyi abye , n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nyayi n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
ntu lonu , nsayi ye shi aku yi ze abefyecezhin yi n shekwoyi abye nyi , ntu yi gaiciya ga ɓo n wo alkawali .

nsapai , laifi ɓei gyi ʼbe tu n aza tukwo vinya kwoi ɓe n ɓai nfi , ama nsayi ye shekwoyi alheri nu gyi be , kwoi gayi a gni-gni manayi n shekwoyi abye , n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nyayi n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
ala iko laifi nya bmaya to , yi ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi , n nabai shekwoyi wa gyi abye n yi alheri wuyi n gafara zhin yi ?
awo , yiɓa gyi abye n laifi zhinyi to kwoi zhin dole nu ?
ntuge aɓei la laifi iko bmaya n yi tukwo , sanu n yi ɓe ze a yesu viyi nyi , a zhin yi baptisma ya ze gmanyi n yesu yi , ntu nwo efi ɓo , aɓei la ofye nanyi laifi zhin nya iko bmaya .
aɓei la of ye nayi laifi nya bi dna n baptisma sanu n woi ɓei fi , sanu dada shekwoyi n wo iko dnagmayi , ɓei jeze ɓe n yesu yi n wye-wyeyi n efi , aɓei la owo wye-wyeyi woi-woyi ga yi ya dagma .
ntuge fyeku ze nayi gmanyi n woi , ntu cenu fyeku fi n woi sanu n wo ɓei fi nyi , nsayi wo ga fye owo wye-wyei woi-woyi , fye ɓei kukala evingwo shi wo ɓei lakala .
aɓei la ofye a shakpe nukwoyi zundu n gnisun n woi , ofye nayi n kwo ye laifi nyi , aɓei lakwo gwoya a tu kwo eci nukwoyi n nabai ofye laifi nayi to kwo shan dna n laifi sirtan , to kwa ze laifi baran .
sanu , nfye ku fi n laifi aba fyeku pwo nkwo kwocedna n kwo ikoyi nfye tukwo .
tunda of ye nanyi kwo-kwoyi laifi ye nya ɓei lafi n yesu yi , yi kpelo ge wo ɓa gayi owo wyewyeyi .
kristi la laka n vingwo wo ta shan fi n jesun , efi to n iko dohoi shan sun lo n wo tukwon .
wo ɓei fi bwazun gmanyi wa zo laifi iko , ama n sayiye wo n vrye-wyei lo n sase n shekwoyi nyalo-nyalo .
ntu lonu fye ze of yehin aza fi-fiyi n laifi aba , to fya ye laifi ayin fya ku ze awye-wyei da n shekwoyi aba fyei wo-wo dna n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
fyeto ye laifi kwa bwa iko tu nfye nanyi tukwo n shan sun , fye to ye okwo ashakpe nukwoyi n .
fye to ye ega doho nfye nanyi kwa ze ɓenukwoyi zhin nyan , kwa ze laifi zhinya , ama fye ga fyehin tukwo vinya n shekwoyi akun nfye aga yi vinya , ntu ge fye la kun n efi , fye ku ze apmanya n shekwoyi akun , wa zhin apma n fyei n wo ɓeye gmanyi .
laifi to shan fye tukwo da zen , ntuge fye to ye filo n ewa suntan , aba n laifi ɓa zefye owo baran .
ai fye n yanci yi lo dna n shekwoyi alheri n sun-sun gyei .
kwo wunu ge yi ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi to ya gye yi anuwan n kwo ɓeyin ?
( ntuge eyi gni-gni to lo n ge sai ya shi awyidna bwanun , ama shekwoyi alheri nu ) , awo .
fye ta kpe lon nge fye ɓa mi fya kni fye dagayin ?
fye ɓa mi fya kni laifi ( n fiyi ) ko , ɓovi ( n gyi-gyi-yi ) oza nfya ga fyehin tukwo n wo a kun wonu ɓa lafye wa ze of ye dagayi fya zewo afyenu .
fye gode n shekwoyi , ntu ge fye ɓei zhin laifi abara nu , nsaiye fyeku ɓovi n fye abugbayi vinya , enya n shekwoyi wa wufye .
nsayi ye , fyela kun n ifye dagayi kwo-kwoyi akun , laifi , fyei ku ze ofye dagayi woi-woyi abara , ɓefyece .
mi daɓo n layi mi-i zhin apma n ɓesisi abara nya n na dagayi nyayi , ntuge fya bwa awyega n pye .
shi fye ɓei zhin abara laifi gbo-gbo nya nyi , ntu lonu , nsaiye fye fa fyehin fya ze abara aɓe manayi nya nɓeyi vinya n kwo gyi-gyi-yi .
nsapai n fye ɓei zhin laifi bara , fye to ɓei gye fye anuwan n ɓe manayi zhin yin .
fya bwa kni gyiba yiʼa ?
gyiba to ɓei bmiyam , tunda vinyikwo wo fyelo fyei ya zhin aɓo nubo n fyeɓei zhin fyei zhin nyi .
ntuge aɓeye zofi n anapi nu n shekwoyi minagyi yi .
ama n sayi ye fye la kun n laifi iko , fye ku zhin shekwoyi abara , owo gyiba nwo ga fye okwo nu gyi-gyi n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi .
gama laifi lada ofi nu , amma shekwoyi cauta wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya nu dna n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
to , yi ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi , n nabai shekwoyi wa gyi abye n yi alheri wuyi n gafara zhin yi ?
awo , yiɓa gyi abye n laifi zhinyi to kwoi zhin dole nu ?
ntuge aɓei la laifi iko bmaya n yi tukwo , sanu n yi ɓe ze a yesu viyi nyi , a zhin yi baptisma ya ze gmanyi n yesu yi , ntu nwo efi ɓo , aɓei la ofye nanyi laifi zhin nya iko bmaya .
aɓei la of ye nayi laifi nya bi dna n baptisma sanu n woi ɓei fi , sanu dada shekwoyi n wo iko dnagmayi , ɓei jeze ɓe n yesu yi n wye-wyeyi n efi , aɓei la owo wye-wyeyi woi-woyi ga yi ya dagma .
ntuge fyeku ze nayi gmanyi n woi , ntu cenu fyeku fi n woi sanu n wo ɓei fi nyi , nsayi wo ga fye owo wye-wyei woi-woyi , fye ɓei kukala evingwo shi wo ɓei lakala .
aɓei la ofye a shakpe nukwoyi zundu n gnisun n woi , ofye nayi n kwo ye laifi nyi , aɓei lakwo gwoya a tu kwo eci nukwoyi n nabai ofye laifi nayi to kwo shan dna n laifi sirtan , to kwa ze laifi baran .
sanu , nfye ku fi n laifi aba fyeku pwo nkwo kwocedna n kwo ikoyi nfye tukwo .
