ntu lonu fye ze of yehin aza fi-fiyi n laifi aba , to fya ye laifi ayin fya ku ze awye-wyei da n shekwoyi aba fyei wo-wo dna n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
fyeto ye laifi kwa bwa iko tu nfye nanyi tukwo n shan sun , fye to ye okwo ashakpe nukwoyi n .
fye to ye ega doho nfye nanyi kwa ze ɓenukwoyi zhin nyan , kwa ze laifi zhinya , ama fye ga fyehin tukwo vinya n shekwoyi akun nfye aga yi vinya , ntu ge fye la kun n efi , fye ku ze apmanya n shekwoyi akun , wa zhin apma n fyei n wo ɓeye gmanyi .
laifi to shan fye tukwo da zen , ntuge fye to ye filo n ewa suntan , aba n laifi ɓa zefye owo baran .
ai fye n yanci yi lo dna n shekwoyi alheri n sun-sun gyei .
kwo wunu ge yi ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi to ya gye yi anuwan n kwo ɓeyin ?
( ntuge eyi gni-gni to lo n ge sai ya shi awyidna bwanun , ama shekwoyi alheri nu ) , awo .
fye ta kpe lon nge fye ɓa mi fya kni fye dagayin ?
fye ɓa mi fya kni laifi ( n fiyi ) ko , ɓovi ( n gyi-gyi-yi ) oza nfya ga fyehin tukwo n wo a kun wonu ɓa lafye wa ze of ye dagayi fya zewo afyenu .
fye gode n shekwoyi , ntu ge fye ɓei zhin laifi abara nu , nsaiye fyeku ɓovi n fye abugbayi vinya , enya n shekwoyi wa wufye .
nsayi ye , fyela kun n ifye dagayi kwo-kwoyi akun , laifi , fyei ku ze ofye dagayi woi-woyi abara , ɓefyece .
mi daɓo n layi mi-i zhin apma n ɓesisi abara nya n na dagayi nyayi , ntuge fya bwa awyega n pye .
shi fye ɓei zhin abara laifi gbo-gbo nya nyi , ntu lonu , nsaiye fye fa fyehin fya ze abara aɓe manayi nya nɓeyi vinya n kwo gyi-gyi-yi .
nsapai n fye ɓei zhin laifi bara , fye to ɓei gye fye anuwan n ɓe manayi zhin yin .
fya bwa kni gyiba yiʼa ?
gyiba to ɓei bmiyam , tunda vinyikwo wo fyelo fyei ya zhin aɓo nubo n fyeɓei zhin fyei zhin nyi .
ntuge aɓeye zofi n anapi nu n shekwoyi minagyi yi .
ama n sayi ye fye la kun n laifi iko , fye ku zhin shekwoyi abara , owo gyiba nwo ga fye okwo nu gyi-gyi n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi .
gama laifi lada ofi nu , amma shekwoyi cauta wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya nu dna n yesu kristi eyi dagayi .
loloya n owa fye ta kpelon omi azaje aye-yei , a yahudiyi dna n kristi sanu n oza lafi owa to n iko yi shan sun lo n wo aban ?
ma ga ɓesisi ; sanu nyikoza pamula owa n lawo pa gyi nwo ɓa har ewyi n wa fi ncei .
ama n wa fi owa to n ikoyi shan sun lo n wo tukwon .
mula owa ta shan wo knizun .
nsayi , woɓa mi wa se enu do , n wa ye kwo ɓei ɓa zhin nukwoyi owo ɓa wo n wye-wyei , ama , kwo to zhin nukwoyi nu woi la fin .
ofye ɓa , ofye tukwo da kwo nu ɓei zhin owa a yahudiyi nya , ama , fya ku fi n kristi yi n zundu , tunda fye ku fi , fye to ye shan owa se lon , kohin to n ikoyi shan sun lo n fye tukwon .
fye a jeze ɓe wye-wyei sa n kristi a laka n vingwo fyei ku ze aza woi-woyi nsaiye , fye ku se oza nwa laka la n efi n nabai fya zhin a tnu-tnu a manayi , a tnu-tnu amanayi shekwoyi nya .
sanu , n oza kwo-kwoyi ɓei zhin woi ye lo tnu-tnu n fye mi aɓo nukwoyi zhin pwa ɓei zhin ɓai wo fye , fyei zhin oɓo n shekwoyi a gna nge fye to zhin , fyei zhin aɓo anukwoyi a tnu-tnu efi nya .
ama nsaiye fye to gye fye anuwan n na yahudiyi owa yin n ɓa knunu yin .
ntuge fyeɓo ku fi , fyei fi n ɓa bauta zhin , nsaiye , fye ɓa zhin shekwoyi bauta to ge dna n zokwo kwo-kwoyi , fyei shi awyidna bwan , ama n zokwo woyi , ( nfye abugbai vinya n fye awye-wyei vinya . ) to , mi wu nu nge shekwoyi owa zhin nukwoi nu ?
awo , owa to zhin nyanukwoyi nun , owa nu ɓei wumi omi laifi , mi to ɓei ɓa kpe laifi ye n kwo dna n mi bugban , aɓo pwa wo nukwoi n ɓa ɓe fi n mi bugba min , to owai a gna n ge , to wo aɓo nukwoi shakpe n ho bugba min . ama , laifi zhin a pma n owa yi , kwoi wumi nge shakpe deye pya to bmiyam , kwoi ku anya pwawo nukwoi kala n mi-mi .
to owa ɓei lo n na ɓa zun gnana , to ɓenukwoyi zhin yi yelon .
cenu ɓei zhin to ma gye mi anuwan sanu n mi to ɓei kpe nya ye n owa yen .
ama sa n mi ɓei kpe gaiciya ye , ma kpe ge mi la owa zungna , mi la ze laifi da n kunce n fiyi .
nmi aba , manayi n kwo ɓei kunce kwa wu mi wye-wyei zokwo , kwo nu a zhin a gami efi lada nu .
laifi ɓei dna mi kwoce kwoi la owa manayi shekwoyi nya kwoi zhin apma n kwoi , kwoi zemi oza n wo kunce n ofi yi .
ama owa n kwohin tukwo kwo zhin nya manayi nu n bmiya .
ama kwo ɓa ze nwuna ?
owa nu to bwi min ?
kwo ɓa ze manayi n wuna ?
awo , laifi nu .
nya kasa nu ɓei zhin apma n nyai n kwo bmiya , kwa zun mi kni ntu lonu fye gye , kwo zhin nya kasa nya nukwoyi .
ntu ge kwo zhin apma n shekwoyi owa manayi kwa nu kwo ɓeye .
ntu lonu owa bmiya , wahala to !
lo n kwoi nun , ama n mihin nu , ntuge mi kundna gni nu nbauta zhin , n laifi yi n ze omi tukwoda .
oɓo nkwo gna mi gna-gna mi ta kpe , omihin tukwo ɓe ganyi lon , ntuge , mi ye ma zhin oɓo n kwo bmiya , ama mi ta min .
mi zhin oɓo n mi to cei pman , enya n mi ta yen .
mi kpelo sarai enya n mi zhin nyi kwo to bmiya lon , emi nubo zhin wumi nge , mila ye n owa yei n mi zungna nyi .
ama mi ta mi ma bma mihin zhin , ntuge mi to ye zhin celon , laifi nu n kwo dna n mi , n du mi kala nyi , kwoi zhin mi mi-i zhin aɓo a nukwoyi .
mi kpelo nge mi la bwo n mi nai kwo-kwoyi , kwo n miya pmi lo n kni bwai nuʼa , mi ta mi ma zhin mihin ma zhin ɓe manan , mi n cei pmalo ama mita min .
sa n mi cei pma ma zhin ɓe manayi , mi ta min , n ma zhin atna to ma zhin ɓenukwoyin , ma zhin kwonu .
ama ngye mi zhin ɓo lo n mi to n cei pman , kwo wunu ge laifi ye n mii shilo n kwo akun .
kwa wunu ge owa ye zhin tnutnu lo n mi , sanu n mi cei pma ma zhin oɓo n kwo bmiya ma ze ma zhin nukwoyi nu .
miye ma zhin shekwoyi ɓeye , shi emi zawoi-woi ncei pma .
ama nyalo n dna n mi mi , n mi oza kninya kwoi sun kun lo nmi-i , kwoi gyi nasara n mi-i , kwoi zemi laifi bara n kwo ye dnalo n mi .
nmi mi , mi cei pma ma ze bara shekwoyi ɓeye zhin yi .
ama ma gye mi ye zhin laifi bauta .
omi za woi-woi gnami ge mi zhin ɓe manayi , ama oza kwo-kwoyi nkwo dna nmi mi n cei pmalo kwa zhin ɓenukwoyi .
ewuyi emi , mi la ze sun-sun nya .
nyi kadonu ɓa gni mi n nai efi nya yeʼa ?
ma gode n shekwoyi , yesu kristi eyi dagayi n lami gni woi la mi loya .
fye ta kpelon omi azaje aye-yei , a yahudiyi dna n kristi sanu n oza lafi owa to n iko yi shan sun lo n wo aban ?

nyi kadonu ɓa gni mi n nai efi nya yeʼa ?
ma gode n shekwoyi , yesu kristi eyi dagayi n lami gni woi la mi loya .
ntu cenu , knizun to lo nna aza ba , n ɓa zhin kristi yesu nya n .
ntuge iko zafun wye-wyei ga nyaiko ye zhin mi nya nu dna kristi yesu-kwo la mi loya n laifi awun n ofiyi .
ato gni yi , n laifi akun ntuge yi kpe shekwoyi awyidna ye lo nun , ntuge yita mi n ɓa kni ya shi bwan , ama shekwoyi wa zhin zokwo do wa gni yi , wa tnu n wo nugun yi dna n zanyikwoci nayi ngye eyi nya , ama eyi anya n laifi yi wa wun laifi iko ya n yi tukwo .
wa ga wohin tukwo hadaya ntu yi alaifi ɓo .
ntu cenu , nsaiye yi ɓa mi ya vi shekwoyi awyidna n ya vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi , to ya vi nayi kwo-kwoi n kwo dna n yi nyin .
aza nɓa fa oɓa nayi kwo-kwoi kwoi bwa iko tu n ɓa tukwo , ɓa vi ɓahin ɓeye nu .
ama aza n ɓa vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi , ɓa nu zhin oɓo n kwo da shekwoyi .
oza n wo vi zafun ɓeye wo ɓa bwa wye-wyeyi n bugba-fuyi .
ama oza nu wa vi nayi wo ɓa fi .
ntuge eyi oza kwo-kwoyi n kwo dna yi nyi kwo zhin nuɓayi nu n shekwoyi , kwo ta ye kwa shi shekwoyi awyidna bwan , kwoi ta min .
cenu zhin , aza n ɓa fi n ɓa nayi kwo-kwoyi iko sinta ɓai vi oɓa aɓo fawo n shakpe nukwoyi , ɓa ta mi ɓa zhin ɓo n kwo da shekwoyin .
oza woiwoyi nu gyi be ama fyeto wu lo nun oza woi-woi nu zhin iko n fyei , ngye fye , n shekwoyi zafun yi lo n dna n fye mi , ( fya pa oza n wo to n kristi zafun yi dnalo n wo min , wo to zhin kristi viyi nun kwo fyewyi . ) ko idayake kristi dnalo n mi ofya nayi ɓa fi ntu n laifi ɓo , ama of ya wyewyeyi ɓa pwo ntuge kristi nku gafara zhin fye .
ndei shekwoyi zafun nwa la yesu kala n efi nyi , n dnalo n fyemi wo ɓa zhin ofye a nayi fifiyi , ɓa bwa wye-wyei nfye efi avun , ntu n zafun ye ɓo n wo dna n fye nyi .
ntu cenu , omi azaje yeyeyi kwo to zhin tilas nu nge fya vi ofye za kwo-kwoi ɓo fya zhin ɓo nwa gna fyem .
ntuge n fya vi kwo fye ku bwi , aɓa ta fye , ama dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko fya ɓakwoya n kwa ɓenukwoi zhin yi fye ɓa pwo .
aza vinya n shekwoyi zafun wu ɓa zokwo ɓanu zhin shekwoyi aɓi .
nlonu yi to ze ngye afyenu , yi wo dna n , ama yi zhin aɓo n gye shekwoyi aɓi nwa gwo ɓa fi n wo iyali ɓai yiwo dada , dada .
ntuge owo zafun gyi-gyi-yi daɓo n yi n ya bugba mi n ge yi zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu .
shi yi zhin owo aɓi nu nyi , yi ɓei gyiwo gado ntuge nya n shekwoyi gawo nugun yesu kwo zhin eyi nyanu ce .
ama n yi ye owo mwa-mwa tilas ya gye azhin nkunsun nwoi .
wahala n yi sin n saiye nyi kwo to kunce lo a mwi kwo do n mwa-mwai n wo ɓei gayi nyin .
ntuge shekwoyi anya zhin-zhin vinya zhi ɓai pmi nu , n hakuriyi , n awyetu yi nyipyei n shekwoyi ɓei ku owo aɓi kala n fi .
ntuge dna nyipyei hi , akna wuyi atakanda , laifi , efi , nbwo-bwoyi anya vinya nɓa gyi nasara tu n na anyi tukwo to n kwo ɓeyei dna n shekwoyi gbe ga ɓa ɓei ku bwiwye- anyi vinya ɓei gwo mwa-mwa ɓai bwa loloya n laifi , n shekwoyi aɓi bwa kwo agmada nyi .
ntuge yi kpelo anya-zhin-zhin ngye anya-fanya n agbe-gbei na shinwa yi ɓa bwa nyasan ɓai fi nge ɓa pmi nyipyei ye .
eyihin a yesu viyi ko shiko nyi yi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi dna lo n yi mi ngye tuze eyi mwamwa nya , yi do dna n yi wye-wyei mi , a lo yi ya n na azhin-gye n wahala yi , yihin ce yi pmi nyipyei , wyi n shekwoyi ɓei gayi eyi loloya towo aɓi nya ɓedo n nayi woi-woyi n wa zhin yi alkawali nyi , anayi n nyasan ta shan ɓa san , ɓai ta shan fin .
a gniyi n gaiciya ga mi nu , gaiciya zhin awyetu nya n yi to ncei lo nsayi yen .
oza n wo n nyayi wota shan awye tun , waga gaiciya nge wo ɓa bwa kwon .
ama ndei yi ga shekwoyi gaiciya n nya tukwo n kwoto zhin , kwo wu yi nge yi pmi n hankuri yi n bugba kalai .
dna n zokwo gmanyi zafun gyi-gyi-yi bmayi zhin n yi aɓesa yi fyegyi-fyegyi dna n yi aduwa zhin mi .
ntuge yi ta kpe nya ye lo n yi ɓa zhin aduwa n kwo tukwon , kwo n yi ɓa zhin cewon .
ama zafun gyi-gyi-yi zhin aduwa n tu yiɓo n bugba shanwo yi n na ta mi ada n gbeyi m .
eyi dada , n wo kpe eyi abugba ye n yi , wo kpe nya ye n zafun da , sanu nwo gyiwye gayi dna n shekwoyi ɓeye nyi .
yi kpelo ge aɓo vinya nɓa bwayi ɓa lo tnu-tnu manayi n yi aba , ndei yi ye shekwoyi lo , yi-i kunce lo nwo shiri yi .
ntuge , tunyi n kmisunyi , shekwoyi ɓei ku da aza vinya n ɓa ɓe wo aba , wo ɓei n cei pma-kpe aza nɓa ɓa ɓe ɓa ze ngye owo nugun , n na bai owo nugun wa ze oza kmisunyi dna nwo azaje .
shi wa kni yi , wa yi yi nge yi ɓe dawo , sanu n ya ɓe ncei wa ze yi ge , tna laifi da , wa nuyi n kristi ɓemanayi wa gayi agni-gni manayi n wohin yi , wa zhin yi alkawali owo mwa-mwa nya .
shekwoyi ma lo n yi bwa yi ɓa da gena tu aɓe a wo-woi ye tukwoʼa ?
ndei shekwoyi malo n yi bwa , nyikado nu ɓa zhin gaba n yiya ?
tunda wo to kni wo nugun gnin , ama wa gawo ntu yi ɓo vinya , wota gayi anya vinya ngnisun nwoyin ?
nyikado ɓa da ɓeda nukwoyi tu n yi tukwo , aza n shekwoyi laɓa kni ɓa ze owo nya ?
awo , owo nu na zhin yi gafara wa gayi agni-gni manayi n wohin yi .
nyikado ɓa zunyi knia ?
kristi nu ɓa zun yi kni ?
awo , gama owo nu na fi n yi ɓo , wa la kala n efi ntu yi ɓo , woi sase tulo n shekwoyi aba , n latu dnagmayi aba , woi gyi wye gayi n eshemi .
nyikado nu ɓa gwo yi kristi yeye ya ?
sanu n ya sin wahala kwo a zhin , sanu n na zan yi shin kwo zawuyi , ntuge wota ye yi lonu ?
sanu mikun gunyi to yi ye n gyiwye yin , ko yi dna n na a-zhin-gye kwo aye awuyi , shekwoyi n ku yi ya n nu ?
awo , gama littafi a gnayi , ntu n wo ɓo tilas ya zhin shiri ya sin wahala n saho-sahoyi , yi wu ngye akni nu n ɓa pmi a wuɓa .
nna ɓeye vinya , nasara zhin yi nyanu dna kristi n wa ye yi wa fi ntu n yi ɓo nyi .
ntuge mila gaiciya ga nyaho tami kwa gnayi aje n shekwoyi yeye yi n .
efi ta min , wyewyei ta min , a malayika ta min , anapi kala vinya ta min kwa gwo yi shekwoyi yeye yan , eyi dnawo n naiye nya , n bugba wun yi nsu nya yi .
kwo aba n yi nyi , n eshe bmana , dna n nuwan yakwo min , nyaho ta mi kwa gnayi ajeya n shekwoyi yeye yin n wa wuyi dna n yesu kristi , sanu n wa fi n yi ɓo nyin .
ntu cenu , knizun to lo nna aza ba , n ɓa zhin kristi yesu nya n .
ntuge iko zafun wye-wyei ga nyaiko ye zhin mi nya nu dna kristi yesu-kwo la mi loya n laifi awun n ofiyi .
ato gni yi , n laifi akun ntuge yi kpe shekwoyi awyidna ye lo nun , ntuge yita mi n ɓa kni ya shi bwan , ama shekwoyi wa zhin zokwo do wa gni yi , wa tnu n wo nugun yi dna n zanyikwoci nayi ngye eyi nya , ama eyi anya n laifi yi wa wun laifi iko ya n yi tukwo .
wa ga wohin tukwo hadaya ntu yi alaifi ɓo .
ntu cenu , nsaiye yi ɓa mi ya vi shekwoyi awyidna n ya vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi , to ya vi nayi kwo-kwoi n kwo dna n yi nyin .
aza nɓa fa oɓa nayi kwo-kwoi kwoi bwa iko tu n ɓa tukwo , ɓa vi ɓahin ɓeye nu .
ama aza n ɓa vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi , ɓa nu zhin oɓo n kwo da shekwoyi .
oza n wo vi zafun ɓeye wo ɓa bwa wye-wyeyi n bugba-fuyi .
ama oza nu wa vi nayi wo ɓa fi .
ntuge eyi oza kwo-kwoyi n kwo dna yi nyi kwo zhin nuɓayi nu n shekwoyi , kwo ta ye kwa shi shekwoyi awyidna bwan , kwoi ta min .
cenu zhin , aza n ɓa fi n ɓa nayi kwo-kwoyi iko sinta ɓai vi oɓa aɓo fawo n shakpe nukwoyi , ɓa ta mi ɓa zhin ɓo n kwo da shekwoyin .
ama fyeto wu lo nun oza woi-woi nu zhin iko n fyei , ngye fye , n shekwoyi zafun yi lo n dna n fye mi , ( fya pa oza n wo to n kristi zafun yi dnalo n wo min , wo to zhin kristi viyi nun kwo fyewyi . ) ko idayake kristi dnalo n mi ofya nayi ɓa fi ntu n laifi ɓo , ama of ya wyewyeyi ɓa pwo ntuge kristi nku gafara zhin fye .

a israilayi gado o , omi aza a israila yi !
o , om azaje yahudiyi , shi mi n cei pma lo n mwa fya ɓe kristi aba .
omi bugba wo mi shan lo , bugba yi wun mi n nyipyei n sukwoyi ntu n fye ɓo .
kristi kpelo , zafun gyi-gyi-yi kpelo , nge mi ta da egbe ɓeda nun , sanu n ma cige mi yelo a mi gmiya n shekwoyi ebe mi , ngye deye ɓa zhin fye fya bwa gni-gni .
shekwoyi ku anya ga fye n mwa , ama fye ta wo wo lon .
wa kni fye n gye owo aza yeyeyi , wa kni fye wa gni fye busi n wo buzagna mwamwai , wa wufye shiwo n cei pma wa tu fye anabarka , wa ga fye owo awyidna ntu n fye a sese ɓo n na bai fya kpe enya n wo ye fya zhin .
wa fa fye fya zhin wo sujada wa ga fye alkawali a adnagmai .
aza dnagmayi shekwoyi anya efye zakwoyi nu kristi nwohin , ɓei gmi nfye nuwo zhin yahudiyi nu dna n nayi owo nwo gyibe tu n na anya she vinya nsaiye nyi .
mwa-mwa n shekwoyi aba nyalo-nyalo .
to , shekwoyi ta mi lo nu wa nuwo alkawali n na yahudiyi abarn ?
awo : ( ntuge alkawaliye zhin aza nya nu nɓa zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin nyi . ) aza vinya nu to n na maɓa fi n na yahudiyi fye , n ɓa zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin .
oɓa kun-kun n ibrahim , ta zhin ɓa ɓa ze ibrahim aɓin , shekwoyi ɓeda , nku da nge alkawali zhin ishaku , ibrahim nugun anyanu , n ishaku ayawyi yi .
koda yake ibrahim ɓei n na aɓi ajeyi .
kwa wu nu ge ibrahim aɓi vinya nu to zhin shekwoyi aɓin , ama aza nɓa ga alkawali gni-gni nya gaiciya n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim nyi .
shekwoyi ku alkawali zhin nge , ntna , oho n saratu yi n ɓei ga fye oɓi .
aye n mwa begye n navun sanu n wo nugun ishaku ɓei la wo nyikwo la , owo nyikwo rifkatu , woi la ga aɓi ma a-za-ba , shekwoyi wa gna wo isuwa oɓi n na ɓa ma kmisunyi nyi , wo ɓa zhin yakubu owo mado bara .
dna n shekwoyi ɓeda , mi la yakubu kni ma tuwo anabarka to ge isuwam .
shekwoyi ɓei dace to ai ma aɓi yen , to ɓai kpe ɓemanayi ye n ɓenukwoyi n sapa .
wo to ɓei zhin ce ntu n naɓo nu n na ɓi ɓei zhin m , ama nya n shekwoyi ɓei ye wa kni .
shekwoyi ɓei zhin ɓenukwoyi nu ?
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku gna musa ge , n ɓa wu oza alheri n ma ye , magye oza sun-sun n ma ye .
ntu lonu , shekwoyi ta ga anabarka ntu ge oza kun ce wa bwa kwo nun , kwo wa zhin tnu-tnu n kala yi wa bwan , wo bwa ntuge , shekwoyi gye oza sun-sun nu n wa ye ko n wa gye dama .
firauna , masar esu ɓei zhin ɓesisi nu gaiciya ye nya .
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku gnawo ge wo la masar ebe ga wo ntuge wa wuwo shekwoyi iko n wo tukwo .
n nabai anyi vinya ɓa wo shekwoyi eye mwa-mwa .
ntu lonu fye gye , shekwoyi wu azaho alheri ntu ge wo n cei pmanu , wa zhin azaho n na tukwoi kwa gnana to ɓa wo ɓon .
to , kni nu zhin shekwoyi woi gye ɓa laifi , nge ɓata wo lo n ma ?
ɓa to zhin oɓo n wa gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin ?
aʼa to dalo nun , ho zhin kni nua ha zan shekwoyi zanshin n laifi a ?
enya n na zhin ko , kwo ɓa mi kwa gna oza n wa zhin kwo nyi ge kni na zhin hoi zhin mi n layia ?
sanu n oza mi shakun , wo to n ikoyi lo wa zhin apma n ezun yi gmanyi wa mi shakun manayi ntu n zhedu ɓo wa mido ntu n pashe fi ɓon ?
shekwoyi to n ikoyi lo wa wu wo minagyi n na aza tukwo n ɓa kuncelo a wuɓan , aza n wa zhin hakuri nɓai n sai mwa n ?
wo n zokwo yi lo-lo , nge eyi n na akuyi ze aza n wa ze owo mwa-mwa ya kpe ɓa , ko yi zhin a yahudiyi nu , ko yi zhin abyedo nu , wa wuyi alheri n na bai aza vinya ɓa gye shi owo mwamwa nsun .
fye pa lo enya n hosia anabci a da ?
shekwoyi wa cige , wo ɓa bwa abye do ga wohin ( aza nɓa ta kun n na yahudiyi byen ) wa ye ɓa ko da yake oza to shin ɓa yen . aza n na ɓei zhin ai ciɓa ge , fye to zhin omi aza nun , aɓa yi ɓa nsai ge , shekwoyi wye-wyei da aɓi .
ishaya anabi ɓei da ɓo n na a yahudiyi tukwo wa cige , koda yake ɓa ɓa mwa begye ngye amwi n ela gbe , aza n bwasun ciwyi nu n ɓa ɓei pwo n ɓami .
ntuge dagayi ɓei dawa n na anyi tukwo wa zo owo atnu-tnu n ɓai wa zun ɓa ya kpekpegye . ishaya wa je gna n na abado nge nto n shekwoyi sun-sun gyei nun , aɓei wu a yahudiyi vinya , oɓa vinya shi aɓei wu aza vinya n ɓa ɓei fi n sodon n gomora zhimi nyi .
to , yi ɓa da ge nana n na ɓeye tukwoa ?
yiɓa cige shekwoyi la esa ga abye aje woi zhin ɓa gafara dna n gaiciya gami , ko da yake ɓa ta zan shekwoyi zanshin .
ama , a yahudiyi n ɓa zhin atna ɓa bwa agni-gni manayi ntu n na awyidna bwashi ɓo , ɓato gyi nasaran .
ntu n kniɓei nua ?
ntuge ɓa ɓei zhin atna ɓa bwa gni-gni ntu n na awyidna bwashi n atnazhinyi ɓaze aza manayi maimakon ɓaga gaiciya , ɓaku ce bonyi n kuta bonyicenya dnagmayi .
shekwoyi ɓo ku pma ɓa gna dna nwo ɓeda wa cige , mila apma shi na a yahudiyi zokwo , aza n mwa begye ɓa ce bonyi n wo ( yesu ) aza n ɓa gawo gaiciya vinyikwo ta wo ɓam . o , omi aza a israila yi !
o , om azaje yahudiyi , shi mi n cei pma lo n mwa fya ɓe kristi aba .
omi bugba wo mi shan lo , bugba yi wun mi n nyipyei n sukwoyi ntu n fye ɓo .
kristi kpelo , zafun gyi-gyi-yi kpelo , nge mi ta da egbe ɓeda nun , sanu n ma cige mi yelo a mi gmiya n shekwoyi ebe mi , ngye deye ɓa zhin fye fya bwa gni-gni .
shekwoyi ku anya ga fye n mwa , ama fye ta wo wo lon .
wa kni fye n gye owo aza yeyeyi , wa kni fye wa gni fye busi n wo buzagna mwamwai , wa wufye shiwo n cei pma wa tu fye anabarka , wa ga fye owo awyidna ntu n fye a sese ɓo n na bai fya kpe enya n wo ye fya zhin .
wa fa fye fya zhin wo sujada wa ga fye alkawali a adnagmai .
aza dnagmayi shekwoyi anya efye zakwoyi nu kristi nwohin , ɓei gmi nfye nuwo zhin yahudiyi nu dna n nayi owo nwo gyibe tu n na anya she vinya nsaiye nyi .
mwa-mwa n shekwoyi aba nyalo-nyalo .
to , shekwoyi ta mi lo nu wa nuwo alkawali n na yahudiyi abarn ?
awo : ( ntuge alkawaliye zhin aza nya nu nɓa zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin nyi . ) aza vinya nu to n na maɓa fi n na yahudiyi fye , n ɓa zhin a yahudiyi hin-hin .
oɓa kun-kun n ibrahim , ta zhin ɓa ɓa ze ibrahim aɓin , shekwoyi ɓeda , nku da nge alkawali zhin ishaku , ibrahim nugun anyanu , n ishaku ayawyi yi .
koda yake ibrahim ɓei n na aɓi ajeyi .
kwa wu nu ge ibrahim aɓi vinya nu to zhin shekwoyi aɓin , ama aza nɓa ga alkawali gni-gni nya gaiciya n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim nyi .
shekwoyi ku alkawali zhin nge , ntna , oho n saratu yi n ɓei ga fye oɓi .
aye n mwa begye n navun sanu n wo nugun ishaku ɓei la wo nyikwo la , owo nyikwo rifkatu , woi la ga aɓi ma a-za-ba , shekwoyi wa gna wo isuwa oɓi n na ɓa ma kmisunyi nyi , wo ɓa zhin yakubu owo mado bara .
dna n shekwoyi ɓeda , mi la yakubu kni ma tuwo anabarka to ge isuwam .
shekwoyi ɓei dace to ai ma aɓi yen , to ɓai kpe ɓemanayi ye n ɓenukwoyi n sapa .
wo to ɓei zhin ce ntu n naɓo nu n na ɓi ɓei zhin m , ama nya n shekwoyi ɓei ye wa kni .
shekwoyi ɓei zhin ɓenukwoyi nu ?
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku gna musa ge , n ɓa wu oza alheri n ma ye , magye oza sun-sun n ma ye .
ntu lonu , shekwoyi ta ga anabarka ntu ge oza kun ce wa bwa kwo nun , kwo wa zhin tnu-tnu n kala yi wa bwan , wo bwa ntuge , shekwoyi gye oza sun-sun nu n wa ye ko n wa gye dama .
firauna , masar esu ɓei zhin ɓesisi nu gaiciya ye nya .
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku gnawo ge wo la masar ebe ga wo ntuge wa wuwo shekwoyi iko n wo tukwo .
n nabai anyi vinya ɓa wo shekwoyi eye mwa-mwa .
ntu lonu fye gye , shekwoyi wu azaho alheri ntu ge wo n cei pmanu , wa zhin azaho n na tukwoi kwa gnana to ɓa wo ɓon .
to , kni nu zhin shekwoyi woi gye ɓa laifi , nge ɓata wo lo n ma ?
ɓa to zhin oɓo n wa gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin ?
aʼa to dalo nun , ho zhin kni nua ha zan shekwoyi zanshin n laifi a ?
enya n na zhin ko , kwo ɓa mi kwa gna oza n wa zhin kwo nyi ge kni na zhin hoi zhin mi n layia ?
sanu n oza mi shakun , wo to n ikoyi lo wa zhin apma n ezun yi gmanyi wa mi shakun manayi ntu n zhedu ɓo wa mido ntu n pashe fi ɓon ?
shekwoyi to n ikoyi lo wa wu wo minagyi n na aza tukwo n ɓa kuncelo a wuɓan , aza n wa zhin hakuri nɓai n sai mwa n ?
wo n zokwo yi lo-lo , nge eyi n na akuyi ze aza n wa ze owo mwa-mwa ya kpe ɓa , ko yi zhin a yahudiyi nu , ko yi zhin abyedo nu , wa wuyi alheri n na bai aza vinya ɓa gye shi owo mwamwa nsun .
fye pa lo enya n hosia anabci a da ?
shekwoyi wa cige , wo ɓa bwa abye do ga wohin ( aza nɓa ta kun n na yahudiyi byen ) wa ye ɓa ko da yake oza to shin ɓa yen . aza n na ɓei zhin ai ciɓa ge , fye to zhin omi aza nun , aɓa yi ɓa nsai ge , shekwoyi wye-wyei da aɓi .
ishaya anabi ɓei da ɓo n na a yahudiyi tukwo wa cige , koda yake ɓa ɓa mwa begye ngye amwi n ela gbe , aza n bwasun ciwyi nu n ɓa ɓei pwo n ɓami .
ntuge dagayi ɓei dawa n na anyi tukwo wa zo owo atnu-tnu n ɓai wa zun ɓa ya kpekpegye . ishaya wa je gna n na abado nge nto n shekwoyi sun-sun gyei nun , aɓei wu a yahudiyi vinya , oɓa vinya shi aɓei wu aza vinya n ɓa ɓei fi n sodon n gomora zhimi nyi .
to , yi ɓa da ge nana n na ɓeye tukwoa ?
yiɓa cige shekwoyi la esa ga abye aje woi zhin ɓa gafara dna n gaiciya gami , ko da yake ɓa ta zan shekwoyi zanshin .
ama , a yahudiyi n ɓa zhin atna ɓa bwa agni-gni manayi ntu n na awyidna bwashi ɓo , ɓato gyi nasaran .
ntu n kniɓei nua ?
ntuge ɓa ɓei zhin atna ɓa bwa gni-gni ntu n na awyidna bwashi n atnazhinyi ɓaze aza manayi maimakon ɓaga gaiciya , ɓaku ce bonyi n kuta bonyicenya dnagmayi .
shekwoyi ɓo ku pma ɓa gna dna nwo ɓeda wa cige , mila apma shi na a yahudiyi zokwo , aza n mwa begye ɓa ce bonyi n wo ( yesu ) aza n ɓa gawo gaiciya vinyikwo ta wo ɓam .
gaiciyaga n seida-zhin-yi omi azaje omi bugba ɓeye n mi aduwa yi nu nyi nge a yahudiyi ɓa bwa gni-gni .
mi kpe ɓa bugbadna ye lo n ɓa cei lo ntu shekwoyi latu ɓo , ama bugbadna deye zhin gbeloyi nu .
ntuge ɓata kpe genyi lo nge kristi la fi ntu ge wa zhin ɓa zhi n shekwoyi aba , ama ɓai zeze ɓai zhin atna ɓa zhin ɓemana n na bai ɓa bwa shekwoyi agmada dna n na yahudiyi a wyidna n na knunu yi , ama ɓa nu to zhin shekwoyi gni-gni zokwo m .
ɓata kpe genyi lo ge , kristi ga aza nu n ɓa ga gaiciya , anya vinya n ɓa zhin atna ɓa bwa , dna n na awyidna bwashin .
woɓo ku ce zo vinya .
ntuge musa ɓei ku ka , ge ngye oza ɓa mi wa zhin ɓemanayi , to wa zhin ɓenukwoyin , wa gyi nasara n jarabai dna n wo asese , n na ba yi nu , n naɓa zhin wo gafara wa pwo !
ama gni-gni n kwo ɓe ntu gaiciya ga ɓo kwo cige , koto n na apmai lo ba zan nshemi ntuge ha gmi kristi ɓe n cei n wa bma ho zhin .
koto n na apmai lo ha lo ho zan wo shin dna n na azafin aba ha jewo ze ɓe ncei n efin . ntuge gni-gni n kwo ɓe dna n gaiciya ga n kristi , ekwo nu zhin nya n yi zhin waʼazi , kwo to mwa kpa lon n zaho-zaho yin , ɓehin-hin kwo wo viviyi lo n yi ngye , eyi abugba n yi agbei .
ntuge n ha gna aza n ho gbeyi nge kristi yesu nu zhin ho dagayi ha ga gaiciya nho bugbami nge shekwoyi lawo laka n vingwo , ho ɓa pwo .
gama dna n gaiciya ga nu nbugba n oza bwa gnigni manayi n shekwoyi aba , n wo gbeyi nu njesun n wo gna aza owo gaiciya ga ɓo .
gama shekwoyi ɓeda gna yi ge , oza to lo n wo ga kristi gaiciya vinyikwo kwa wo won .
a yahudiyi n na tna kaciya zhinyi gmanyi nu , oɓa dagayi gmanyi nu n wo gaɓa anya vinya , n ɓa nya wo n bugbai gmanyi nyi .
oza n wa yi shekwoyi eye wo ɓa pwo .
ama ɓaɓa nya wo n wuna nge wo gniɓa a kpe baga gaiciya ?
ɓai ɓa gawo gaiciya n wuna to ɓai wo wo ɓon ma ?
ɓai ɓa wo wo ɓo n wuna to ozai gna ɓan ma ?
oza ɓa lo n wuna wo gna ɓa to ai tnu wo ma ?
nya nu n shekwoyi ɓeda da sanu n kwa ci n cei ge , gye shi oɓa apita bmiya oɓanu nɓa zhin bugba fun nabari manayi shekwoyi nya waʼazi , ɓai ɓe n nabari a gmada nyai .
aza a yeyeyi nu aza n ɓa zhin shekwoyi nabari manayi waʼazi nyi . ama aza vinya nu to n ɓa wo nabari manayi ɓa gwon .
ntuge anabi ishaya ɓei ku da dagayi nyikado la gaiciya ga ɓo n ma gna ɓa nyiʼa ? ama gaiciya ga ɓe n shekwoyi ɓeda wonu , nabari manayi kristi nya .
ama a yahudiyi ma ?
ɓaku shekwoyi ɓeda wo ?
e , gama kwola lo aba n ɓa nyi vinya .
aku nabari manayi zhin waʼazi har anyi ce zhi ba .
ama ɓa ɓei ku awyega bwa ( nge shekwoyi ɓa ga aza je gni-gni to ɓai ya gwon ? ) e , ntuge tunyi n musa sa , shekwoyi ɓei ku gna ge , wo ɓa zhin owo aza ɓa wo oshe , wa zhin atna wa kun ɓa agyewyi n wa gni-gni ga abyedo atna cei .
ishaya ɓei je da ntna edna ge , aza nɓa to zan shekwoyi shin ɓa ɓa bwa wo .
nsaiye , wo zhin atna lo wa si a yahudiyi kpe , ama ɓa gyi abye na ɓenayi , to ɓai ye ge ɓa ɓem .
omi azaje omi bugba ɓeye n mi aduwa yi nu nyi nge a yahudiyi ɓa bwa gni-gni .
mi kpe ɓa bugbadna ye lo n ɓa cei lo ntu shekwoyi latu ɓo , ama bugbadna deye zhin gbeloyi nu .
ntuge ɓata kpe genyi lo nge kristi la fi ntu ge wa zhin ɓa zhi n shekwoyi aba , ama ɓai zeze ɓai zhin atna ɓa zhin ɓemana n na bai ɓa bwa shekwoyi agmada dna n na yahudiyi a wyidna n na knunu yi , ama ɓa nu to zhin shekwoyi gni-gni zokwo m .
ɓata kpe genyi lo ge , kristi ga aza nu n ɓa ga gaiciya , anya vinya n ɓa zhin atna ɓa bwa , dna n na awyidna bwashin .
woɓo ku ce zo vinya .
ntuge musa ɓei ku ka , ge ngye oza ɓa mi wa zhin ɓemanayi , to wa zhin ɓenukwoyin , wa gyi nasara n jarabai dna n wo asese , n na ba yi nu , n naɓa zhin wo gafara wa pwo !

koto n na apmai lo ha lo ho zan wo shin dna n na azafin aba ha jewo ze ɓe ncei n efin . ntuge gni-gni n kwo ɓe dna n gaiciya ga n kristi , ekwo nu zhin nya n yi zhin waʼazi , kwo to mwa kpa lon n zaho-zaho yin , ɓehin-hin kwo wo viviyi lo n yi ngye , eyi abugba n yi agbei .

a yahudiyi n na tna kaciya zhinyi gmanyi nu , oɓa dagayi gmanyi nu n wo gaɓa anya vinya , n ɓa nya wo n bugbai gmanyi nyi .
oza n wa yi shekwoyi eye wo ɓa pwo .
ama ɓaɓa nya wo n wuna nge wo gniɓa a kpe baga gaiciya ?
ɓai ɓa gawo gaiciya n wuna to ɓai wo wo ɓon ma ?
ɓai ɓa wo wo ɓo n wuna to ozai gna ɓan ma ?
oza ɓa lo n wuna wo gna ɓa to ai tnu wo ma ?
nya nu n shekwoyi ɓeda da sanu n kwa ci n cei ge , gye shi oɓa apita bmiya oɓanu nɓa zhin bugba fun nabari manayi shekwoyi nya waʼazi , ɓai ɓe n nabari a gmada nyai .

ama a yahudiyi ma ?
ɓaku shekwoyi ɓeda wo ?
e , gama kwola lo aba n ɓa nyi vinya .
aku nabari manayi zhin waʼazi har anyi ce zhi ba .
ama ɓa ɓei ku awyega bwa ( nge shekwoyi ɓa ga aza je gni-gni to ɓai ya gwon ? ) e , ntuge tunyi n musa sa , shekwoyi ɓei ku gna ge , wo ɓa zhin owo aza ɓa wo oshe , wa zhin atna wa kun ɓa agyewyi n wa gni-gni ga abyedo atna cei .

nsaiye , wo zhin atna lo wa si a yahudiyi kpe , ama ɓa gyi abye na ɓenayi , to ɓai ye ge ɓa ɓem .
shekwoyi to na wo aza ɓom ma nya ɓo , shekwoyi ku owo aza a yahudiyi yanu ?
awo , ko fye wyi , fye pa ge mi zhin yahudiyi nu n mihin , ibrahim yawyi n banyami bye .
awo , shekwoyi to yawo aza n wakni tunyi n sapan , fye pa ɓolo n littafi a da tu ɓeye tukwo ?
anabi iliya ɓei cibwi kpe shekwoyi ntu n na yahudiyi tukwo , shi a ku shekwoyi anabi wu , ai la shekwoyi a bagadi ɓaya , iliya ɓei gye ge owo nu bwa cedna n knihin n wo gmanyi woi ye shekwoyi , ɓa zhin a tna ɓa wuwo n wohin .
fye pa amsa lo n shekwoyi ɓei gawo ?
shekwoyi ɓei ciwo ge , awo , oho nu to ce n ho gmanyi yin .
mi n na azayi lo lo dubu tnaba n ɓa yemi lo , bai to gba shan . kwo wu lo lo nu n naiye .
a yahudiyi vinya nu to pmi avun wu shekwoyin .
azalo fyewyi n na gniɓa ntu n shekwoyi alheri ɓo n wa kniɓa .
ngye shekwoyi alheri nu agye oɓa ɓemana zhin nu ton , nzokwoye cauta to shan kyauta nu zhin , kwo to zhin cauta nu , zai ya zhin tnu-tnu nu wa bwan .
kwo wulo n lonu , a yahudiyi n mwa to bwa shekwoyi alheri nɓa zanshin .
fyewyi n ku bwa aza n shekwoyi wa kni-ama aza nɓa ce nyi awye n ku ɓa bua .
nyanu n shekwoyi ɓeda da sanu n kwo ci n cei ge , shekwoyi laɓa shigye , woi guɓa awye n na tunbuayi n na bai to ɓa kpe oɓo ye n yi da , sa n ya gna ɓa kristi ɓo n cei .
kwo wulo n lonu nu har naiye .
dauda esu ɓei ku ce da sanu n wo ɓei ci n cei ge , fwa oɓa nyagyi manayi n anabarka do yi kwo pi ɓa agam ɓagye nge ɓeho to lo n ɓa ; tasin n shekwoyin .
fa anya a manayi ye ɓa je zekpe ɓa , ɓa wuɓa , ɓa ɓa ɓaya .
fa oɓa awye ɓa dna wyegma n na bai to ɓa gye wyeban , ɓa zan-zan n ya kpe ntu n na kaya shan wo ɓo . kwa wunu , nge shekwoyi ku owo aza ya har abada ?
awo , owo nufi n na bai abyedo ɓa bwa pwopwo .
n na bai ɓa yahudiyi ɓa wo she ɓa ya shekwoyi gni-gni zanshin ga ɓahin .
nsaiye , ndei anyi vinya ku nya bwa ntu shekwoyi gni-gni ɓo , sanu n na yahudiyi ɓa ce bonyi to ɓa ye kwom .
ai anyi ɓei gna anabarka bwa sanu n a yahudiyi ɓa gwo kristi .
shi fye kpelo ge , shekwoyi lami kni owo tnu-tnu yi nfye aba abyedo , mi gnafye , mi-i ce a yahudiyi ɓepa shi mi ɓa mi nsun .
nna bai n kwo yezhin ma zhin ɓa ɓa ye enya n fye abyedo n cei lo , n zokwoyi magni azaho nɓa mi .
kwo ɓei ze ɓe wowo ɓai ya ze a kristi viyi .
sa n shekwoyi ɓei pmiya n ɓa aba kwa wunu nge wo ɓei pmida anyi wa gaɓa gni-gni .
nsai ye kwo dulo n ɓewowoyi a yahudiyi ɓa ɓe da kristi .
kwo ɓei ze ngye aza fi nu na je kukala n efi .
shi ibrahim n na anabi yi zhin shekwoyi a zanu nyi , oɓa ɓi ɓa ze shekwoyi aza ce , ntuge n shinwan gbegye gyi-gyi-yi okwa bwala ɓa ze a gyi-gyi-yi nu ce .
ama a bwala ho n ibrahim shinwa , a yahudiyi ho , ala ɓa kaya , efye abyedo a bwala a bmana nya , ngye zaitun bmana nya bwala , a fyefyegyi .
nlonu n saiye fyei gwo anabarka n shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim n wo aɓiyi ɓai sin shinwa gma n shekwoyi wa nu n wohin tukwoyi .
fye zhin peceiye kada fya gma ntuge aku fye fi n ɓa apita nu .
fye pa nge a kpe fye ye ntuge fye filo n shekwoyi shinwa nu , fye zhin abwala nu fye to zhin a gbegye nun .
to ko yezhin lo ha cige aɓei ibma a bwalai ya ntuge a fyemi nu gyi , ntu cenu mi zhin ɓo lo n kwo kunce .
fye zhin peceiye .
pa ge a bwala ho , a yahudiyi a ɓei bma ɓa ya ntu ge ɓato ɓei ga shekwoyi gaiciya nun , fye zhi n ya ntuge fya gawo gaiciya nu .
fyeto zhin aɓo-kwon , gye gba fyehin tukwo fya zhin igodiya , fya zhin peceiye .
ntuge n shekwoyi to fa abwala nwafi ɓa tunyi n sapan , wo ta fa fyehin .
shekwoyi zhin wa nu wo alkawali shi awye hagye shi shekwoyi zhin alheri dna ɓo , wo gyiminagyi n na azai nɓa ta vi wo ɓon , ama wo zhin ɓemana ga fye fyei ya gyi abye fya yewo n gaiciya gayi , ama nfye to zhin lo nu m aɓa zun fye ya .
n zokwo do , nna yahudiyi fa ɓa tna gaiciya ga ɓa jeze ɓe da shekwoyi , shekwoyi ɓa je ɓa fyegyi n shinwa .
wo n ikoyi lo wa zhin lonu .
ntu ge n gye shi shekwoyi ɓei la ye wa gwo fye n fye ɓei mwa kpa n woi , n fye ɓei zhin zaitun bmana nya bwala , wa fye fyegyi n wo shinwa manayi onya nna ta shin zhin-fye gye ge woto gni n shiri yi nu zhin wa je a yahudiyi gwo n jesun n ɓa ɓei shin fi n kmisunyi nyin ?
mi n cei pma fya kpe gaiciya ye n shekwoyi aba , emi azaje yeyeyi n na bai nfye ta mwa fyehin tukwo fya ya abokwo zhin , e , kwo zhin gaiciya nu nge a yahudiyi ho zhin gaba lo n nabari manayi-nsaiye , ama kwo ɓa bwa esanu la n fye abyedo fya ku ɓe kristi aba vinya , efye n fya ye fya ɓe .
n navun israila vinya ɓapwo .
fye pa oɓo lo n anabi ɓo da n ɓeye tukwo ?
gniyi ɓa gmi n sihiyona , wa pmi a yahudiyi awye ya n ɓenukwoyi zhin .
nsayi mɓei kuɓa a laifi ya , she ma zhin ɓa alkawali .
nsaiye , a yahudiyi n mwa begye zhin anuwuyi nu nabari manayi nya .
degye n la ze gyiba nfye aba , ntuge kola ɓe efye abyedo n shekwoyi cauta yi , har nsaiye a yahudiyi zhin shekwoyi aza yeyeyi nu , ntu n wo alkawali ɓo n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim , ishaku n yakubu yi nyi .
gama shekwoyi cauta n wo yiyi-i kwo ta shan kman , wotajeze n na vunyi n wo alkawali n wa zhin nyin .
nsapai , fye ɓei zhin shekwoyi a nuɓai nu , ama sa n na yahudiyi ɓei na shekwoyi cauta aɓo wa gye fyenu sun-sun .
nsayi ye a yahudiyi nu zhin tawaye ama n wyihoi ɓa ɓei gni shekwoyi sun-sun gye bwa n fyei .
gama shekwoyi ku ɓa ya ga ɓenukwoi zhin n nabai wa gye aza sun-sun vinya .
o , shekwoyi , ɓo wo-woyi danu n yi n cei .
owo wyemwa , n wo ɓeyekpei n wo nyabwai kwo dna ɓo lo ya kpe owo shawara ye n wo azokwoi .
nyikadonu n yi mi kpe shekwoyi bugba yelo a ?
nyikadonu n ɓeyekpei lo wa ga shekwoyi shawara wa wu wo zokwo a ?
nyikado nu ɓa ga shekwoyi nya kunce kwa zhin wo wa zhin ɓo a ?
gama anya vinya kun n shekwoyi aba nu .
anya vinya bwa wye-wyei dna nwo ikonu .
anya vinya nyi ntu wo latu ɓo nu .
mwa-mwa nwo aba nyalo-nyalo amin .
ma nya ɓo , shekwoyi ku owo aza a yahudiyi yanu ?
awo , ko fye wyi , fye pa ge mi zhin yahudiyi nu n mihin , ibrahim yawyi n banyami bye .
awo , shekwoyi to yawo aza n wakni tunyi n sapan , fye pa ɓolo n littafi a da tu ɓeye tukwo ?

fye pa amsa lo n shekwoyi ɓei gawo ?
shekwoyi ɓei ciwo ge , awo , oho nu to ce n ho gmanyi yin .
mi n na azayi lo lo dubu tnaba n ɓa yemi lo , bai to gba shan . kwo wu lo lo nu n naiye .
a yahudiyi vinya nu to pmi avun wu shekwoyin .
azalo fyewyi n na gniɓa ntu n shekwoyi alheri ɓo n wa kniɓa .
ngye shekwoyi alheri nu agye oɓa ɓemana zhin nu ton , nzokwoye cauta to shan kyauta nu zhin , kwo to zhin cauta nu , zai ya zhin tnu-tnu nu wa bwan .
kwo wulo n lonu , a yahudiyi n mwa to bwa shekwoyi alheri nɓa zanshin .
fyewyi n ku bwa aza n shekwoyi wa kni-ama aza nɓa ce nyi awye n ku ɓa bua .
nyanu n shekwoyi ɓeda da sanu n kwo ci n cei ge , shekwoyi laɓa shigye , woi guɓa awye n na tunbuayi n na bai to ɓa kpe oɓo ye n yi da , sa n ya gna ɓa kristi ɓo n cei .
kwo wulo n lonu nu har naiye .
dauda esu ɓei ku ce da sanu n wo ɓei ci n cei ge , fwa oɓa nyagyi manayi n anabarka do yi kwo pi ɓa agam ɓagye nge ɓeho to lo n ɓa ; tasin n shekwoyin .
fa anya a manayi ye ɓa je zekpe ɓa , ɓa wuɓa , ɓa ɓa ɓaya .
fa oɓa awye ɓa dna wyegma n na bai to ɓa gye wyeban , ɓa zan-zan n ya kpe ntu n na kaya shan wo ɓo . kwa wunu , nge shekwoyi ku owo aza ya har abada ?
awo , owo nufi n na bai abyedo ɓa bwa pwopwo .
n na bai ɓa yahudiyi ɓa wo she ɓa ya shekwoyi gni-gni zanshin ga ɓahin .
nsaiye , ndei anyi vinya ku nya bwa ntu shekwoyi gni-gni ɓo , sanu n na yahudiyi ɓa ce bonyi to ɓa ye kwom .
ai anyi ɓei gna anabarka bwa sanu n a yahudiyi ɓa gwo kristi .
shi fye kpelo ge , shekwoyi lami kni owo tnu-tnu yi nfye aba abyedo , mi gnafye , mi-i ce a yahudiyi ɓepa shi mi ɓa mi nsun .
nna bai n kwo yezhin ma zhin ɓa ɓa ye enya n fye abyedo n cei lo , n zokwoyi magni azaho nɓa mi .
kwo ɓei ze ɓe wowo ɓai ya ze a kristi viyi .
sa n shekwoyi ɓei pmiya n ɓa aba kwa wunu nge wo ɓei pmida anyi wa gaɓa gni-gni .
nsai ye kwo dulo n ɓewowoyi a yahudiyi ɓa ɓe da kristi .
kwo ɓei ze ngye aza fi nu na je kukala n efi .
shi ibrahim n na anabi yi zhin shekwoyi a zanu nyi , oɓa ɓi ɓa ze shekwoyi aza ce , ntuge n shinwan gbegye gyi-gyi-yi okwa bwala ɓa ze a gyi-gyi-yi nu ce .
ama a bwala ho n ibrahim shinwa , a yahudiyi ho , ala ɓa kaya , efye abyedo a bwala a bmana nya , ngye zaitun bmana nya bwala , a fyefyegyi .
nlonu n saiye fyei gwo anabarka n shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim n wo aɓiyi ɓai sin shinwa gma n shekwoyi wa nu n wohin tukwoyi .
fye zhin peceiye kada fya gma ntuge aku fye fi n ɓa apita nu .
fye pa nge a kpe fye ye ntuge fye filo n shekwoyi shinwa nu , fye zhin abwala nu fye to zhin a gbegye nun .
to ko yezhin lo ha cige aɓei ibma a bwalai ya ntuge a fyemi nu gyi , ntu cenu mi zhin ɓo lo n kwo kunce .
fye zhin peceiye .
pa ge a bwala ho , a yahudiyi a ɓei bma ɓa ya ntu ge ɓato ɓei ga shekwoyi gaiciya nun , fye zhi n ya ntuge fya gawo gaiciya nu .
fyeto zhin aɓo-kwon , gye gba fyehin tukwo fya zhin igodiya , fya zhin peceiye .
ntuge n shekwoyi to fa abwala nwafi ɓa tunyi n sapan , wo ta fa fyehin .
shi awye hagye shi shekwoyi zhin alheri dna ɓo , wo gyiminagyi n na azai nɓa ta vi wo ɓon , ama wo zhin ɓemana ga fye fyei ya gyi abye fya yewo n gaiciya gayi , ama nfye to zhin lo nu m aɓa zun fye ya .
n zokwo do , nna yahudiyi fa ɓa tna gaiciya ga ɓa jeze ɓe da shekwoyi , shekwoyi ɓa je ɓa fyegyi n shinwa .
wo n ikoyi lo wa zhin lonu .
ntu ge n gye shi shekwoyi ɓei la ye wa gwo fye n fye ɓei mwa kpa n woi , n fye ɓei zhin zaitun bmana nya bwala , wa fye fyegyi n wo shinwa manayi onya nna ta shin zhin-fye gye ge woto gni n shiri yi nu zhin wa je a yahudiyi gwo n jesun n ɓa ɓei shin fi n kmisunyi nyin ?
mi n cei pma fya kpe gaiciya ye n shekwoyi aba , emi azaje yeyeyi n na bai nfye ta mwa fyehin tukwo fya ya abokwo zhin , e , kwo zhin gaiciya nu nge a yahudiyi ho zhin gaba lo n nabari manayi-nsaiye , ama kwo ɓa bwa esanu la n fye abyedo fya ku ɓe kristi aba vinya , efye n fya ye fya ɓe .
n navun israila vinya ɓapwo .
fye pa oɓo lo n anabi ɓo da n ɓeye tukwo ?
gniyi ɓa gmi n sihiyona , wa pmi a yahudiyi awye ya n ɓenukwoyi zhin .
nsayi mɓei kuɓa a laifi ya , she ma zhin ɓa alkawali .
nsaiye , a yahudiyi n mwa begye zhin anuwuyi nu nabari manayi nya .
degye n la ze gyiba nfye aba , ntuge kola ɓe efye abyedo n shekwoyi cauta yi , har nsaiye a yahudiyi zhin shekwoyi aza yeyeyi nu , ntu n wo alkawali ɓo n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim , ishaku n yakubu yi nyi .
gama shekwoyi cauta n wo yiyi-i kwo ta shan kman , wotajeze n na vunyi n wo alkawali n wa zhin nyin .
nsapai , fye ɓei zhin shekwoyi a nuɓai nu , ama sa n na yahudiyi ɓei na shekwoyi cauta aɓo wa gye fyenu sun-sun .
nsayi ye a yahudiyi nu zhin tawaye ama n wyihoi ɓa ɓei gni shekwoyi sun-sun gye bwa n fyei .
gama shekwoyi ku ɓa ya ga ɓenukwoi zhin n nabai wa gye aza sun-sun vinya .
o , shekwoyi , ɓo wo-woyi danu n yi n cei .
owo wyemwa , n wo ɓeyekpei n wo nyabwai kwo dna ɓo lo ya kpe owo shawara ye n wo azokwoi .
nyikadonu n yi mi kpe shekwoyi bugba yelo a ?
nyikadonu n ɓeyekpei lo wa ga shekwoyi shawara wa wu wo zokwo a ?
nyikado nu ɓa ga shekwoyi nya kunce kwa zhin wo wa zhin ɓo a ?
gama anya vinya kun n shekwoyi aba nu .
anya vinya bwa wye-wyei dna nwo ikonu .
anya vinya nyi ntu wo latu ɓo nu .
mwa-mwa nwo aba nyalo-nyalo amin .
apma zhin n shekwoyi anyaga yi ntu cenu mi gyi fye wye fya gafye anayi n shekwoyi akun , ɓa ze hadaya wye-wyei gyi-gyi-yi nya , odo pya n wo ɓa gwo .
nfya pa oɓo ɓo n wa zhin fye , deye duwyi lo wa nya fye ?
fye to shan hali n na kunnu anyi nya yi n , ama fye ku ze aza woi-woi n naɓo nfye ɓa n zhin , nfye nubo zhinyi .
nlonu fye ɓa kpe nfye aɓo-mutu shiwo zokwo ɓa fu fye nubo .
ngye shekwoyi tnu-tnuyi mi ga zaho-zahoi nfye mi shekwoyi pmagna : fye zhin gaiciya n fyehin tukwo ɓo , fyei mwi shi shekwoyi wa ga fye gaiciya-ga n sun .
shi agalo n mwa begye n fye nayi n lo nu kristi nayi .
yi zhin aga nu owo nayi nya , zaho-zahoi n yi mi woi nu kwo ntuge yi n na tnu-tnuyi lo gbo-gbo .
shekwoyi , n gbai ga zaho-zahoi n yi mi nwo ɓa zhin ɓa n bmiya n shekwoyi n la anabci zhin gba nu ga fye , zhin anabci nsai vinya n ho ɓa mi n sai vinya , n ho gaiciya ga n kalai lo n ho ɓa gwo tnu-tnu-tnu shekwoyi aba .
ngye ho nyaga zhin aza bmazhin nyanu , bma ɓa zhin cewo .
ngye ho zhin malami nu wu nya n bmiya .
ngye ho zhin waʼazi zhin yi nu kpe ge eho waʼazi n kalai lo n bmazhin yi dna .
n shekwoyi la gyiwye gaho , bma azaje zhin n cei .
n shekwoyi la aza bwashi tnu-tnu ga ho woi ku azafiho n nakun zhin tnu-tnu n ho kala yi .
aza n ba zhin abugba zhi-zhi da a tna ɓa zhin kwo n bugba a kristi yi nya yi .
to ye aza n gbeyin , yeɓa cewo .
to ye enya n kwo to bmiyan , ye ɓemana ha zhin kwo .
fye ye n na ajei ngye aya-ɓi , fya ga aje mwamwa n bugba buibui .
fye to wo bwato nfye tnu-tnu yin , ama fye zhin dagayi tnu-tnu n bugba bui , bui .
dagma n tu nyaɓo n shekwoyi z hin gaho , zhin hakuri n wahalai , ha zhin aduwa ci-ci .
sanu shekwoyi aɓi gyisan , bma ɓa zhin , zhin ha yi azhiɓei ɓa ɓe nyagyi nho puwa ko kwa nɓa ye agyewan aba n sukwoyi .
n oza zhin fye ɓenukwoyi ntuge fye zhin kristi nya nu , to tu wo eknin , zhin adduwa shekwoyi wa tuwo anabarka .
sa n na aza dagma ha dagma n ɓai , n ɓa wun bugba ha bma ɓa bugba wun .
fye zhin tnu-tnu n dagma ngnisun .
to zhin n gye ho zhin zadnagmayin .
to lodna n na aza yakwo aban , ama gnalo n ha sharayi .
to ha ci a ɓo n gye ho kpe ɓeho ye lon .
to gba ɓenukwoyi ta n ɓenukwoyin .
zhin ɓeho-ɓehoyi cewo , aza kpe ge hoto zhin zakata nun .
to wu anya n zaho-zahoi .
bwa bugba buyi n na azai vinya ngye shi ho ɓa mi .
emi anugundo ye-yeyi fyeto gba ɓe ta ga fyehin .
fa kwo ga shekwoyi ntuge wo ku gna ge wo ɓa gba aza n kwo kunce .
fye to la owa dna n fye akun .
( wato fye to zun owa gnan ) .
gaho nuwunyi nya gyi mikun ya gun wo , n nuwan mikun wo-wo gawo nuwan wa sin .
ho ye anakna nu kpe wo n tukwo , wato vinyikwo ɓa wo wo n ɓo woku zhin ho nyi .
to fya ye ɓenukwoyi kwa gyi ebe tu nfye tukwon , ama fye zun ɓenukwoyi kni dna a ɓemanayi izhin .

ntuge shekwoyi la ɓa gwo ɓa ze owo aɓi .
ɓa zhin shekwoyi a bara nu , ofye nyanu ton oɓa nuwan lo n wo abanu toge nfye aban , fye fa wa gna ɓa kwo kwo bmiya lo , kwo kwo to bmiya lon , shekwoyi ɓami wa zhin ɓa ɓa zhin shi kwo kunce .
azaho zhin nubo ge a yesu viyi ɓa shi a yahudiyi anyipyeyi asun-sun nya nu bwa , anyipyeyi n ɓa ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa n cei , ama aza ho ci ge kwo zhin gbelohi nu nya zenu za zhin aɓei pya , ntuge anyipyeyi vinya zhin shekwoyi anya nu .
nna beye pya ozaho-zahoi nu ɓa zhin oɓo n kwo kunce .
nho n na anyipyeyi kni hoi ga shekwoyi mwamwa , ho ye ha lawo tu ho zhin ɓe manayi nu .
nlo nunce oza n wo gyi abu n na zun sha ga eshan .
wo sa shekwoyi ami ntu nkwo ɓo , wo zhin ɓe manayi nu , oza ce n wo ta to abuyi bwan , wo zhin atna nu wa zhin oɓo n kwo da dagayi , woi zhin godiya .
yi to zhin eyihin tukwo adagayi nu n , n yi ɓami ya kni ge yi bwa wye-wyei ko ya fin .
kwo yi n wye-wyei , kwo yi fi yi zhin dagayi anya nu .
zokwo doho-dohoyi zhin wo anya nu .
kristi ɓei fi wa laka njesun ntu n na aɓeye ɓo nu .
n na bai wo ɓa zhin yi dagayi kwo yi nwye-wyei , kwo yi ku fi .
hoto n iko yi lo ha zun ho zado kni kwo ha ciwo wyegban .
pa ge , ozaho-zahoi n yi mi wo ɓei gni agni gni n shekwoyi wada a sese ɓa n wada wyi yi .
ntuge , a cei kafi shi mi nyi , nyikutukwo dohodohoi ɓei ce a kwo-kwo n mi abye , nyitala doho-dohoi ɓei ye abui n shekwoyi aba .
behin-hin , zahozahoi ɓei ga wohin tukwo nyadoku n shekwoyi aba .
ntu cenu , fye to zhin aje laifi zanshin .
fye zhin atna fya sase , n fye ta zhin ofye do wa ce bwoyin , n na ɓo n wo ɓa gye ho hoi zhin n wo zhin nubwo ge ɓato bmiya lon .
nmi aba , mi kpelo lalle dna n dagayi yesu iko , nyaho to wunya lon , n na abu gyi yi n na zun sha ga eshan .
ama , nza gna ge kwo zhin ɓenukwoyi nu , to , wo to zhin m , ntuge n wo aba kwoto bmiya lon .
ngye oho zaho damu lon nyayi n ho gyi , hota zhin yeye ɓe zhin nun , n ha gyi abye n gyi yin .
to fa oho nyagyi kwa zhin oza n kristi wa fi n wo ɓo wa bwin .
to zhin oɓo n kwo ɓa ɓe ho n wyegba-ciyi , kwo hoi kpelo ge kwo bmiya lon .
gama aɓo kpakaiayi n yi a yesu viyi aba , kwo nu to zhin nyagyi n nyasin yi , ama ɓemana , bugba fu , n na agmada yi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aba .
nfya fa kristi wa zhin dagayi dna n na ɓeye vinya , aɓa da shekwoyi .
n na azaje yi .
yi zhin atna ya zhin aɓo nɓa ɓa ɓe nbugbafuyi , ya mi aje zhi .
fye to wun shekwoyi tnu-tnu ya ntu na abu ɓon .
fye pa nge nyaho towun ya lon , n na bugyi yin , ama kwo wunya lo sa nu n kwa zhin ozado wa ce bwonyi .
oɓo n kwo bmiya okwo nu ha fa abugyi , ko jesin , kwo nya zhin n kwo ɓa zhin ohozado wa ce bonyi , wa zhin laifi .
ho ɓami ha kpe ge nyaho to wunya lo n nya yi n ho zhin , kwo n shekwoyi aba , ama kuce shin hohin , to wu ho gaiciya ga nza aba n kwo ɓa zhin wo wa ce bonyin .
n na ɓeye pya , bugba bui-bui da nu oza n wota zhin laifi nɓe yi n wo kpe ge kwo bmiya n .
ama nza kpe ge ɓo nwo ye wa zhin nyi kwoto bmiya lon , wo to zhin kwon wo zhin laifinu woi ya zhin , ntuge wo zhin nubo ge kwo zhin ɓenukwoi nu .
ntu cenu n wo aba kwo to bmiya lon .
nyaho-nyahoi nza zhin woi gye ge kwo to bmiya lon kwo zhin laifi nu .
a fye gwo oza n wo ye wa ɓe da fye kwo owo gaiciya ga kwoi gba kala .
to zunwo kni ntuge owo aɓonubozhin wulo gbo n ho nyai , tu aɓo tukwo n kwo bmiya n doi n kwo to bmiyan .
misali , to na aɓo n woi n na abugyi tukwo n na zun sha ga eshan .
ho ga gaiciya , nya ho to wunya lo nkwon , ama azaje gaiciyaga gba kala lo , ɓa gye kwo zhin nukwoyi nu , ɓata gyi abun sai dai ɓa gyi afintolo , cei ya cece ge ɓa gyi abuyi pya .
aza n ɓa gye kwo to wunya lo ɓa gyi abuyi pyan , ɓato ci aza wyegba n ɓata gyin .
nho ta gyin to gye ɓa laifi n ɓa gyi nyin .
ntuge shekwoyi la ɓa gwo ɓa ze owo aɓi .
ɓa zhin shekwoyi a bara nu , ofye nyanu ton oɓa nuwan lo n wo abanu toge nfye aban , fye fa wa gna ɓa kwo kwo bmiya lo , kwo kwo to bmiya lon , shekwoyi ɓami wa zhin ɓa ɓa zhin shi kwo kunce .

hoto n iko yi lo ha zun ho zado kni kwo ha ciwo wyegban .
pa ge , ozaho-zahoi n yi mi wo ɓei gni agni gni n shekwoyi wada a sese ɓa n wada wyi yi .
ntuge , a cei kafi shi mi nyi , nyikutukwo dohodohoi ɓei ce a kwo-kwo n mi abye , nyitala doho-dohoi ɓei ye abui n shekwoyi aba .

ntu cenu , fye to zhin aje laifi zanshin .

nmi aba , mi kpelo lalle dna n dagayi yesu iko , nyaho to wunya lon , n na abu gyi yi n na zun sha ga eshan .

n na ɓeye pya , bugba bui-bui da nu oza n wota zhin laifi nɓe yi n wo kpe ge kwo bmiya n .
ama nza kpe ge ɓo nwo ye wa zhin nyi kwoto bmiya lon , wo to zhin kwon wo zhin laifinu woi ya zhin , ntuge wo zhin nubo ge kwo zhin ɓenukwoi nu .
ntu cenu n wo aba kwo to bmiya lon .
nyaho-nyahoi nza zhin woi gye ge kwo to bmiya lon kwo zhin laifi nu .
kwo yi-i gye ge aɓeye to zhin nyaho nu n shekwoyi aba kwo yi ya zhin ɓan , yita mi ya gyi abye ya zhin ɓan , ntuge ya da yihin agman , tile ya pa azaje ɓo nɓa shakai n dna , nɓa gye ge aɓeye to bmiya lo nyin .
yi zhin ɓo n kwo ɓa da azaje to ge eyihin , ya zhin ɓo n kwo ɓa bma wo zhin kwa miwo gni dna n dagayi .
kristi to zhin ɓo n kwo dawo num , she , zabura ka yi wa da waɓe n tuge , wa sin wahala , n na za kun nɓa wun dagayi nu nyi . aɓeye n na cei kafi n litafi tunyi n sapa nyi , a kafi ntuge ɓa wuyi-atnazhin n bugba kala bwayi nu .
nnabayi ya pmi peceiye n hakuri yi har ewyi n shekwoyi ɓe zun laifi kni n efiyi .
shekwoyi n wo ga hakuri , n migniyi , n bugba kala yi , wo bma fye zhin fya sase n na jeyi n bugba dayi za-zai wuwo do kristi hali .
nsayi , eyi vinya yami ci dagayi n begye yi gmanyi , yi ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa , eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada .
abyedo ɓa dagma ntu lonu fye ye , n na jeyi n ikklisiya , shi kristi wa gwo fye n bugba bui-bui n na bai n shekwoyi eye ɓa latu .
fye pa ge , yesu kristi wa ɓe wa wu ge shekwoyi ta daɓo wa pman , njesun wa bma a yahudiyi zhin .
njesun fye pa ge waɓe n na bai abyedo ɓa bwa gnigni , ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa ntu wo sun-sun gye ɓo .
nyanu n zabura kayi wa da , sanu n wo ɓei ka n cei ge , mba ciho dna n abyedo , ma la oho ye tu . nna abado , fye dagma , ofye abyedo ngnisun nwo azayi a yahudiyi . njesun , fye ci dagayi , ofye abyedo , fa aza vinya ɓa ciwo . anabi ishaya wa cige gado gyiyi ɓa gmi n jese puwa , wa gyi be tu n abyedo tukwo , ɓa ɓei tu awye n wo nu vinya . nlonu mi zhin aduwa ga fye abyedo , n na bai shekwoyi n wo gafye awye tunyi , wa ga fye a gmada n bugbafu yi , shi fya gawo gaiciya .
mi zhin aduwa n shekwoyi ɓa nu fye n awyetu yi dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko n wo dna n fye nyi .
mi kpe lo fye zhin aza manayi nu n ceceyi , omi azaje , fye kpe aɓeye ye lo n fye ɓami fya wu azaje ɓa .
ama mi n bugba kalayi lo ma je fye aɓeye gna , mi kpe lo fye ye ma pa fye ɓanu kawai , ntuge n shekwoyi alheri yi , mi zhin tnutnuyi nu n yesu krisiti wa tnu fye n cei abyedo .
mi ɓefye n nabari manayi mi-i ga fye ngye hadaya n shekwoyi akun , ntuge ala fye zhanya , fyei zhin ɓo wo ye dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi .
ntu lonu mi gye kwo bmiya lo ma gma , ntu anya ɓo vinya n kristi yesu ku zhin dna n mi nyi .
mi ta ye ma daɓo shi wa zhin tnu-tnu n na azajeyi nun , ama n nya yi n mi kpelo , woku a pma zhin n miyi woi wan abyedo ɓe shekwoyi n cei .
ma wan ɓa n waʼazi yi nu , n mi zhin njesun n mi asese manayi nɓa abye , n na aɓo a wowoyi n wa zhin n mi abwai atuze n shekwoyi aba , vinya n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko yi nu .
dna n zokwo ye , miku waʼazi zhin nabari manayi krisiti nya tunyi urushelima har ilirukum .
ama omi ɓeye nu , miye lo abye mi zhin waʼazi aba n kristi ye to si kpan , afa aba zado la ikklisiya shi .
mi vi shiri nu , nna cei kafi n litafi , aba n ishaya cige , aza n ɓa to shin kristi ye won ɓaɓa gye ɓa bwa awye ga . behin-hin enyanu n kwo zhin mi n cei pma ma ɓe fya ba .
ama n na avun omi tnu-tnu ku zo n ya mi n shiri yi zhin lo ma ɓe n na aye awyekwo nya ye avun .
gama mi zhin shiri lo malo asbaniya n ma lo mi ɓei bma n roma , bayan yiku esa manayi bwa n na jeyi fye ɓei gnami ami .
bma a yesu-viyi asangyi-yi zhin ama kafin mi ɓe tilas malo urushelima malo a yesuviyi n cau-tai n ɓo .
gama fye gye , a yesuviyi n ɓa fi n makidoniya n akaya yi ɓaku enya ga ntu n na azaje ɓo n ɓa fi n urushelima ɓai sin wahala nyi .
ɓa ɓei zhin kwo n bugba bui-bui ntuge ɓa gyelo ɓa ntayi shi a yesuviyi lo nɓafi n urushelima .
ntu n kni ɓei ya ?
ntuge nabari manayi kristi nya kun n urushelima nu kwoi lo abyedo aba .
tunda ɓa ɓei gwo cauta zafun nya nabari manayi nya nɓenu ɓa gye ɓe n ɓa ɓa zhin ɓa , okwo nu ɓa gaɓa akaya nanyi nya .
sanu n ma gaɓa agyiwye ye , ma zo n ɓatnu-tnu manayi yei , mi ɓei ɓe ma gye fye wye mi-i lo asbaniya lo .
mi kpe lo sanu n mabe , dagayi ɓei gami anabarka ntu n fye ɓo , ma ɓefye n cei .
fye ɓa zhin aduwa ngnisun n miyi ?
ntu n dagayi yesu kristi ɓo , ntu nfye yeye ɓo nfye yemi nyi , n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ga fye-fye zhin aduwa n mwa n gnisun n miyi ntu mi tnu-tnu ɓo .
fye zhin aduwa n nyaho ta bwami n na aza kun n ɓa ta vi yesu kristi nyin , n ɓa fi n urushelima nyi .
fye zhin aduwa njesun n na yesu viyi ɓei gwo agyiwye n mi lo ɓa n cei nyi .
nnavun nmi ɓa mi ma ɓe of ye aba n bugba bui-bui dna n shekwoyi ɓeye , yi ɓa gaje kala .
nsayi ye , shekwoyi n wo ga bugba fu nyi , wo kun sun n fyei .

nsayi ye , shekwoyi n wo ga bugba fu nyi , wo kun sun n fyei .
gnaɓi vinya fibi nyikoza yesu viyi n kankriya zhimi ɓelo wa gye fye wye safyewyi .
woku tnu-tnu zhin n mwa n ikklisiya ye .
fye gwo wo n gye mapui dna n dagayi .
fyawu wo a yesu viyi yeye .
fye bma wo zhin n zokwo doho-dohoi n fye ɓami ntuge wo ku bma aza zhin n mwa dna n ɓa sangyi n mihin ɓe .
gna biriska n akilayi nge mi ɓiɓa gnaio , ɓa zhin omi atnu-tnu kun zhin yi nu dna kristi yesu .
ɓehin-hin , har oɓa wye-wyei ye kwa bwi n miɓo .
omi gmayin nu ta saɓa amin , har n abyedo n ikklisiya yi .
suku-suku fye ɓi aza gna n ɓa yezhi ɓa ci shekwoyi n ɓa puwa .
fye ɓi omi nugundo manayi gna abainatus .
owonu ɓei kmi yesu vi n asiya .
fye ɓi maryamu gna n wa zhin tnu-tnu n mwa n na bai wa bma yi zhin nyi .
fye ɓi andarinikus n yunuyas yi gna , omi bye n ɓa ɓei kunsun n miyi fi n kurkuku nyi .
amanzani gaɓa mwa-mwa .
ɓa ɓei ku vi yesu n mi abye .
fya ɓi ambiliyatus gna , oza n mi ye ngye shekwoyi ɓi .
n urbanus yi eyi tnutnu kunzhin yi , n istakiyi oza yeye yi .
fye ɓi abalis gna gami oza n dagayi ye , fya ɓi aza gna n ɓa fi ɓai zhin tnu-tnu n aristo bulus puwa nyi .
fye ɓi harodiyana omi bye gna , fya ɓi a yesuviyi gna n ɓa zhin afyenu fi n narkissus puwa nyi .
fye ɓi tarifaina gna n tarifusayi dagayi a tnu-tnuyi , n barsisa yi n wa zhin tnu-tnu mwa ga dagayi nyi .
fye ɓi rufus gna gami oza n dagayi a kni ga wohin , wa ze wonya , n wo iya yeyeyi , n wo la ze omi iya yeyeyi nyi .
suku-suku fya ɓi asinkiritus gna n filiguna , n harmisayi n batrubas yi n harmasayi n na aza jeyi n ɓa kusun n ɓayi .
fye ɓi flubugusa gna n juliya yi n niriyus yi , n wo mapuiyi n ulumbasayi , aza gyi-gyi-yi n ɓa kunsun n ɓai nyi .
fye dna aje abwado , ikklisiya n ya vinya tnu fye n ɓa gnaɓiyi .
nsaiye , ɓeda gmanyi n mi cei lo ma da kafin mi zo n wasika ye yi .
fye la pmiya n na aza n ɓaɓe n na ajegnayi ɓai shan aza gaiciya ga a shan .
ɓai ɓe n wuwuyi nkwo wu gbo , n doyi n aku wu fye .
a zayi pya ta zhin tnu-tnu ga eyi dagayi yesu nun , ama ɓaye gyiba ga ɓahin nu .
ɓa zhin a ɓeda kpedayi nu , aza nɓato ceceyin , ɓata wo ɓa kwoce dnan .
ama zaho-zahoi kpelo nge fye gni-a-gni lo cewo dna n gaiciya .
deye dami a gmalo .
miye fya sase cewo dna n nya n kwo bmiya , fya abwa kunya n nya n kwo to bmiyan .
safyewyi , shekwoyi bugbafu nya wo ɓa bma shaitan ya n fya pita sin ta .
anaɓarka nɓa kun n yi dagayi yesu kristi aba ɓa kun-sun n fyei .
timatawus omi tnu-tnu kun zhinyi , n lukiyus yi , n yasunayi , n susibatrus yi , omi ebye ɓa tnu fye n ɓa gna ɓiyi .
omi tartiyus n mi ka bulus wasikaye nyi , mi tnu fye n mi gnaɓiyi ce n gye yesu viyi do .
gayus wa gna nge mi ɓi fye gna ga wo , mi zhin wo zhiɓeyi nu , ikklisiya yezhi lo nwo puwa nu n ya .
arastus maʼaji , tnu fye n wo gnaɓiyi n lonu kawartus eyi zado .
sai n wyihoi , alheri dagayi yesu kristi nya kwo kunsun n fyei vinya .
mi fi fye n shekwoyi akun , n wo ɓa mi wa ga fye kala , fya mizhi n dagayi nyi shi nabari manayi da .
shi ma gna fye n wu nyi .
shekwoyi gni-gni shiri nyi ntu n fye ɓo abyedo n soshi tnuyi n sapa .
ama shi anabi ɓei ku pmada shi shekwoyi wa gbe , a zhin nabari ye waʼazi lo n na abaho-bahoi , n na bai aza vinya n na anyi , ɓa ga kristi gaiciya ɓa vi wo ɓo .
shekwoyi gmanyi n cece wum wo nu nyi , mwa-mwa kunsun n woi ntu n yesu kristi ɓo .
har nyalo-nyalo amin .
fibi nyikoza yesu viyi n kankriya zhimi ɓelo wa gye fye wye safyewyi .
woku tnu-tnu zhin n mwa n ikklisiya ye .
fye gwo wo n gye mapui dna n dagayi .
fyawu wo a yesu viyi yeye .
fye bma wo zhin n zokwo doho-dohoi n fye ɓami ntuge wo ku bma aza zhin n mwa dna n ɓa sangyi n mihin ɓe .
gna biriska n akilayi nge mi ɓiɓa gnaio , ɓa zhin omi atnu-tnu kun zhin yi nu dna kristi yesu .
ɓehin-hin , har oɓa wye-wyei ye kwa bwi n miɓo .

har nyalo-nyalo amin .
wasika ye gmi n bulus aba nu , n shekwoyi ɓei yiwo ntuge wa ze aza tnu-tnu yi yesu kristi nya , ɓedo n ʼyi zado yi na yiwo ge sastanisu nyi .
kwoi lo shekwoyi aza ʼba n korinto , n shekwoyi wa yiɓa ɓa ze wa za , woi la ɓa gwo dna n yesu kristi mi .
kwa lo aza ba vinya njesun nɓa yi yesu kristi , eyi dagayi nɓa nya yi .
shekwoyi eyi dada ɓedo n ʼyi dagayi yesu kristi yi , wo ga fye alheri n bugba fuyi .
shekwoyi anabarka , fye bwa jedoɓe mi zhin ma sa shekwoyi ami cici ntu alheri manayi ɓo n wa ga fye she fye ku ze yesu aza nyi .
wo ku fye ze anyabwayi n mwa .
wo ku bma fye zhin fyei da ɓo ga wo , woi la yekpe nunuyi ga fye dna gaiciya .
nya mi ɓei gna fye ge kristi ɓo mi wa zhin ga fye , kwo ku zhin .
fye la alheri doho-dohoi bwa nna anabarka yi n sayi ; zafun nyaga doho-dohoi n iko yi fya zhin wo ɓeye , ɓa zhin fye nya nu dna saye n na zhi ai pmi eyi dagayi yesu kristi jezeɓe nyi .
wo la ye har nyalonyalo ayi fye aza kni-kni-yi , tna laifi n ɓenukwoi yi dna wo nyipyei jezezhi nya .
shekwoyi ɓa zhin fye ɓeye ntna kma-kma , ntuge wo zhin wa zhin ɓo wa da cim-cim .
owoi nu na yi fye ge fya zhin nugundo nwo nugun yi yesu kristi .
ama , oma-zaje , mi gyi fye wye dna dagayi yesu kristi ʼye , fye ku ɓeda ajegna nya ya nfya tasin .
fye ku ze gmanyi , to ajegna lo aduwa nyakun m .
fye la ye ɓedo , efye ɓo nubo-zhin gmanyi , ɓemwi gmanyi njesun .
ntuge , omazaje , azaho n ɓa kun n kuluwi puwa ɓa ku gnami pei-pei nge fye wu anya lo n najeyi .
ntuge azaho cige , mi zhin bulus nya nu azaho cige , mi zhin bitrus nya nu . azaho cige , mi zhin bitrus nya nu . aza ho ge , mi zhin apollos nya nu . azaho kwa ɓai cige , mi zhin yesu nya nu . fyela yesu gnajeya wyiwo-wyiwo .
omi , bulus , nu ɓei fi ntu fya laifi ɓo ?
a ɓei zhin fye batisma dna n bulus eyenu ?
ma gode n shekwoyi ntuge mi to ɓei zhin zaho batisma n fye m akpege krisbus ɓedo n gayus ntuce nu zaho-zaho yi ta mi wa cige gye mi ya oɓo woyi mi-i shi bulus aduwa nyakun m . e , kuwa , mi ɓei ku batisma zhin istifanus a puwa da ama mi ta shan zaho ɓo palon n mi ɓei zhin wo batisma m .
yesu to ɓei tnumi ma zhin batisma num , ama ma zhin waʼazi nabari manayi nya .
mi to zhin waʼazi n na ɓeda ayakwoi fi aza ɓeyekpe nyam , kada ko wun iko ya n ko dna n waʼazi fa-fayi yesu zundu nya nyi .
gama yesu fi-fi ti zundu nabari ko zhin gbolo-yi nu n aza bwi-bwi-yi aba .
ama n eyi aza gni-gni-yi aba , ko zhin shekwoyi iko nu .
ntuge shekwoyi wa cige , miɓa ze aza zokwo gni-gni nya gboloyi , kwo ko ɓei bmiya n ɓa ba wuna , har ɓeda n na ɓo nubo-zhin a ɓeyekpei agbamgbam nya yi . to mi gye awyega da , aɓeyekpei n naza yi n ɓa mi n gbegyi tu na anyi nya tukwo nyi .
shekwoyi ku ɓa ze amama da , woi ku wu ge oɓa wyega zhin gboloyi nu .
gama shekwoyi dna n wa wyega , wa ku kpe ge anyi ta kpe wo ye dna naza wyegam .
amma wa zhin ntuge wa gni aza dna n waʼazi zhin mi , n nanyi gye ko ge gboloyi nyi .
ko ze gboloyi nu na yahudiyi aba ntuge ɓa ye tuze n ʼshe kwa wu ge oɓo na zhin ko waʼazi nyi , ko zhin gaiciya nu , kwoi ze gboloyi nu n na heleniyi aba , ntuge ɓa bwa nya gaiciya nu ga n ko lodo nɓa ɓonubo-zhin yi , nɓa wyega yi jesun .
ntu cenu sa ya zhin waʼazi ge yesu wa fi wa gni ɓa nu , ayahudiyi ta ye ɓedayem ko fyewyi .
n na heleniyi aba kwa , ko zhin gboloyi nu .
ama shekwoyi la awye gu aza ya , na yi ɓa ga gni-gni nyi , a yahudiyi dnado na heleniyi yi , ɓa gye she kristi nu zhin shekwoyi iko kala wa gni ɓa ; kristi n wohin tukwo wonu dna n shekwoyi shiri ceceyi nya atasin , ntu ɓa gni-gni ɓo .
gama shekwoyi shiri ye na gye ko ge gboloyi nyi , ko du zanyikoci awyega lo n ceceyi .
shekwoyi a-kala-gba kuwa kristi fi-fi tu n zundu ko du zanyikoci doho-dohoi lo n kala .
to ema zaje , fye dnawye n fya tasin fya gye , aza fyewyi nu bwasun nfye mi nfye vi kristi nyi n ʼnaye dnagmai yi , ko iko , ko kuwa n duciya yi .
gama shekwoyi ɓei kni aza gbolo n zanyikoci awye ntuge wa dna aza ce-ce vinyiko .
njesun wa kni aza gba-gba yi ntuge wa dna akalada vinyiko .
wa kni shiri n ʼnanyi ye ta gyeko ngye nya hom , ntuge wa ze anya gboloyi n nanyi ye gye ngye ɓa nu zhin anya dnagmayi .
n nabai ge ko knibwai na , to zaho-zahoyi wami wa gma gni n shekwoyi abyem .
ntuge n shekwoyi aba nu gmanyi nfye wye-wyei yi lo dna kristi yesu .
owo na wuyi shekwoyi shiri ntu gni-gni ɓo ; owo na zhin shekwoyi woi gwo yi : owo na ze yi aza gyi-gyi-yi , wona ga wohin tukwo wa gni yi .
ai littafi gyi-gyi-yi ku da ge , zaho-zaho yi wo cei pma wa gma , to wo gma dna n ʼnya dagayi ku zhin . wasika ye gmi n bulus aba nu , n shekwoyi ɓei yiwo ntuge wa ze aza tnu-tnu yi yesu kristi nya , ɓedo n ʼyi zado yi na yiwo ge sastanisu nyi .

ai littafi gyi-gyi-yi ku da ge , zaho-zaho yi wo cei pma wa gma , to wo gma dna n ʼnya dagayi ku zhin .
shekwoyi shiri mama nya ema zado , esanu mi ɓei ɓe fya aba ma gna fye shekwoyi nabari ceyi , mi to ɓei zhan pma na ɓeda dadai yi , ko ɓeyekpe dnagmaiyim .
gama mi ɓei la tu ge miɓa bwa ɓeda tu n yesu tukwo nu n wo fiyi tu n zundu .
ntucenu ma ɓe fya ba dna n kalagba , n dnawo yi , n vinvin yi .
mi to ɓei zhin waʼazi n ɓeda dadai yi zanyikoci ɓeyekpe nyam , ama zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓei dna n ma ɓeda woi wu aza nɓa ɓa wo nyi ge , tnutnu ɓo gmi n shekwoyi aba nu .
nɓei zhin lonu n nabai efye gaiciyaga kwa kpema shekwoyi nu , toge zanyikoci ho ɓeyekpem .
ama mi daɓo ɓeyekpe nya n nazayi n ɓaku mwa dna zafun .
ɓeyekpe ye ta gmi nanyi ye num , kwoi ta daɓo ga aza-yako anyi ye nya nu nɓa zhi ɓai miya nyim .
eyi aɓeda zhin ɓeyekpe nya nu , ntuge ɓa kun n shekwoyi aba nu , ɓai wu shekwoyi shiri ɓeyekpe nya kwa lo yi na gmada eshe nya .
shiri ye ɓei bwi shi n sapa , ko da shike aɓo zhin ko ntu ya pma bwa ɓo nu kafin ma a zhin anyi .
ama aza-yako anyi nya to ɓei kpe ce yem , ntuge ɓa ɓei gna ɓa kpe koye nu , ɓa to ɓei ɓa zun dagayi mwa-mwa nya du m .
nya nu n littafi gyi-gyi-yi kwa da cei ge zaho-zahoi to shin gye , ko wa wo , ko wa zhin ɓo nubo cei , enya shekwoyi ku zhin shiri ntu naza ɓo nɓa yewo nyi m .
ama yi kpe aɓeye yelo ntuge shekwoyi la tnu n wo zafun yi wa gna yi , owo zafun zhin wa bi aba ya vinya , wa wuyi asiri shin-shin-yi shekwoyi nya .
she zanyikoci zafun n ko dna womi nyi , oko gmanyi nu kpe wa ɓenubozhin ye , n lonu zaho-zahoi ta kpe shekwoyi aɓo nubozhin yem , sai owo zafun gmanyi .
yi to gwo zafun anyi ye nya num , ya gwo zafun n shekwoyi nu , wa wu yi anyaga amanai alheri nya n shekwoyi ku ga yi nyi .
ntu cenu aɓeda nʼya da vinya , zafun gyi-gyi-yi nu na gayi ɓa , aɓeda nu to n zanyikoca knim .
ntu cenu yi zhin apma n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aɓeda yi ɓa wu zafun gyi-gyi-yi aɓo n ɓahin yi .
ama oza n wo to n zafun yim , wo ta mi wa gwo anya n shekwoyi zafun gayim , ntuge wo ta kpe ɓa wyegam , ɓa zhin gboloyi nu n wa ba .
sai oza nwo zafun gyi-gyi-yi , wonu ɓa kpe zafun gyi-gyi-yi aɓo ye .
oza wo n zafun yi wo zhin wa mwi aɓo vinya , wa ku ɓa kpeye .
oɓo nu kuwa nko dami nanyi da yi , ntuge wota kpe zafun-da ʼɓoyem ko fyefye .
wo ɓa mi wuna ?
ntuge wo to zhin oza nu nwo shin dagayi aɓonubozhin ye kpem ko wa daɓo woyi , ko wa shin shekwoyi bwa ashanje nwa duwa zhin mim .
ama eyi a yesu viyi , yi n kristi bugba yi shi lo n wa ɓe nubo zhin yi .
ema zado , esanu mi ɓei ɓe fya aba ma gna fye shekwoyi nabari ceyi , mi to ɓei zhan pma na ɓeda dadai yi , ko ɓeyekpe dnagmaiyim .
gama mi ɓei la tu ge miɓa bwa ɓeda tu n yesu tukwo nu n wo fiyi tu n zundu .
ntucenu ma ɓe fya ba dna n kalagba , n dnawo yi , n vinvin yi .
mi to ɓei zhin waʼazi n ɓeda dadai yi zanyikoci ɓeyekpe nyam , ama zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓei dna n ma ɓeda woi wu aza nɓa ɓa wo nyi ge , tnutnu ɓo gmi n shekwoyi aba nu .
nɓei zhin lonu n nabai efye gaiciyaga kwa kpema shekwoyi nu , toge zanyikoci ho ɓeyekpem .
ama mi daɓo ɓeyekpe nya n nazayi n ɓaku mwa dna zafun .
ɓeyekpe ye ta gmi nanyi ye num , kwoi ta daɓo ga aza-yako anyi ye nya nu nɓa zhi ɓai miya nyim .
eyi aɓeda zhin ɓeyekpe nya nu , ntuge ɓa kun n shekwoyi aba nu , ɓai wu shekwoyi shiri ɓeyekpe nya kwa lo yi na gmada eshe nya .
shiri ye ɓei bwi shi n sapa , ko da shike aɓo zhin ko ntu ya pma bwa ɓo nu kafin ma a zhin anyi .
ama aza-yako anyi nya to ɓei kpe ce yem , ntuge ɓa ɓei gna ɓa kpe koye nu , ɓa to ɓei ɓa zun dagayi mwa-mwa nya du m .
nya nu n littafi gyi-gyi-yi kwa da cei ge zaho-zahoi to shin gye , ko wa wo , ko wa zhin ɓo nubo cei , enya shekwoyi ku zhin shiri ntu naza ɓo nɓa yewo nyi m .
ama yi kpe aɓeye yelo ntuge shekwoyi la tnu n wo zafun yi wa gna yi , owo zafun zhin wa bi aba ya vinya , wa wuyi asiri shin-shin-yi shekwoyi nya .
she zanyikoci zafun n ko dna womi nyi , oko gmanyi nu kpe wa ɓenubozhin ye , n lonu zaho-zahoi ta kpe shekwoyi aɓo nubozhin yem , sai owo zafun gmanyi .
yi to gwo zafun anyi ye nya num , ya gwo zafun n shekwoyi nu , wa wu yi anyaga amanai alheri nya n shekwoyi ku ga yi nyi .
ntu cenu aɓeda nʼya da vinya , zafun gyi-gyi-yi nu na gayi ɓa , aɓeda nu to n zanyikoca knim .
ntu cenu yi zhin apma n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aɓeda yi ɓa wu zafun gyi-gyi-yi aɓo n ɓahin yi .
ama oza n wo to n zafun yim , wo ta mi wa gwo anya n shekwoyi zafun gayim , ntuge wo ta kpe ɓa wyegam , ɓa zhin gboloyi nu n wa ba .
sai oza nwo zafun gyi-gyi-yi , wonu ɓa kpe zafun gyi-gyi-yi aɓo ye .
oza wo n zafun yi wo zhin wa mwi aɓo vinya , wa ku ɓa kpeye .
oɓo nu kuwa nko dami nanyi da yi , ntuge wota kpe zafun-da ʼɓoyem ko fyefye .
wo ɓa mi wuna ?
ntuge wo to zhin oza nu nwo shin dagayi aɓonubozhin ye kpem ko wa daɓo woyi , ko wa shin shekwoyi bwa ashanje nwa duwa zhin mim .
ama eyi a yesu viyi , yi n kristi bugba yi shi lo n wa ɓe nubo zhin yi .
aɓi nawyi tnu-tnu oma zaje , mi daɓo lo fyei ngye aɓi putu nu , dna yesu vi zokwo , to fyei vi dagayi m , sai ofya ɓeye , mi ta mi ma daɓo fyei ngye a yesu viyi kalada nɓa nunuyi lo n zafun yim .
kwa zemi dole ma gafye madara to ge nyagyi kpakala yi m , ntuge fye to ɓei yi kunce fya gyi nyagyi kpakala yi m .
har saiye ma fye to kunce m , fye ɓo sin madara nu kpa .
ntuge fyeye zhin a yesu viyi-putu nu , fyei vi fya ɓeye , toge shekwoyi nya m .
sanu fye wun aje nu fyei gnajeya ntu nanya wu ɓo , kwo ta wu nu ge fye zhin aɓi-putu nu fyei ye fyehin zokwo m ?
ɓehin-hin , fye zhan ɓo lo ngye aza nɓa to zhin dagayi nya num ko fye-fye .
fye ku gye , fye wu-anya najei ge ko omi nu du apollos lo , fyei gna aduwa nyakun aje .
kwo to wu nu she fye mwa-mwa ye gbagbai lo dna dagayi yekpe mim ?
nyikanu mi-i , ko apollos , nʼyi ɓa ku ze dalili ajegna nya ?
ntu ge na , yi zhin shekwoyi atnu-tnuyi nu kawai , zaho-zahoi nwo nyaga yi , nʼyi bmazhin yi nu , fyei ga gaiciya .
omi tnu-tnu nu ɓei ma bye anya n fya bugba mi , apollos kwa wa kpe nuwan , ama shekwoyi nu na zhin anyai pa nfya bugba mi , toge eyim .
eza n wa bye-bye nyi ɓedo n za yi nwa kpe nuwan kpe-kpe nyi , ɓa to zhin nyaho nu m , ama shekwoyi nu zhin tukoda gama owo nu zhin anya yi pa .
apollos nʼmi-i , yi zhin tnu-tnu n ngye bwadodna nya , n ɓomwi yrgmanyi , ko shi ko nyi a ɓei ga zaho-zahoi nʼyi mi lada she wa zhin tnu-tnu n wohin yekpe sun .
yi zhin shekwoyi atnu-tnu loyi nu ngnisun kawai .
fye zhin shekwoyi fwa nu , toge eyi nyam ; fye zhin shekwoyi nyakun nu , toge eyi nyam .
dna n shekwoyi alheri , wo ku wu mi she mi ɓa ze nya-miyi ʼgbada .
mi la nyakun shi , apollos la nya mi tu ko she .
ama zaho-zahoi wo ɓa mi nya tu ko , wo zhin peceiye .
ntu ge zaho to lo wa shan nyakun hin-hin shishi ndu do yi la lu bwanyim wato yesu kristi nu .
azaho ɓa mi tu nya shi-shiyi ye n zinariya yi , ko azurfa , ko a kuta a nabmiya yi .
azaho kwa ɓa mi na shinwan yi , ko agbe-gbe ko akpa-yi .
zaho-zahoi tnu-tnu dai aɓei pmi ko gye nʼna nu .
wada wyi nu n kristi ɓei pmi ko gye n wohin tukwo yi .
ena nu ɓei wu ko tnu-tnu yi bmiya lo , ko koto bmiya lo m .
oza wa mi tu nya shishiyi ye , kwa gmi gni to kwa gyinam , wo ɓei gwo lada .
ama n zaho-zahoi tnu-tnu ʼaku gyina , wa bwi nuwan .
ama wo ɓa pwo n wohin tukwo , sai dai ngye wa shegmi n ʼna nu .
fye ta kpe lo ge fye zhin shekwoyi nyakun nu , shekwoyi zafun yi sase lo dna fye mim ?
ntucenu zaho-zahoi nwa wun shekwoyi nyakun ya , to shekwoyi ɓa wun wo ya .
ntuge shekwoyi nyakun gyi-gyi-yi lo .
ofye nu zhin anyakun yi .
to zaho-zahoi wa dna wohin tukwo kwoce ge wo zhin za cece nu she anyi-da gye fyem .
ndei zaho gye wohin tukwo lo lonu , wo la ze mama ntuge wa bwa cece eshe nya .
ntuge nya n aʼnyi ye gye ge cece nu , ko zhin gboloyi nu n shekwoyi abye .
she ayuba littafi da , shekwoyi zhin wa wan aza-ce-ce dna ɓa ce-ce mi nu .
littafiʼa jeda dna zabura ge shekwoyi kpelo sarai shi zanyikoci zhin aɓo nubo wu , ɓai zhin a gboloyi nu .
ntucenu , zaho-zahoi to gyigbe ge wo vi aza cece anyi nyam .
ntuge shekwoyi la nyaho-nyahoi ga fye .
wo la bulus , n apollos yi , n bitrus yi ga fye ɓa bma fye zhin .
wo la anyi vinya ga fye fya zhan-pma ceyi , wye-wyei ɓedo nʼfi yi ofya afyenu nu .
wo ku anya vinya ga fye nɓa lo n sayi ye ɓedo na nya yi nɓa ye ɓeɓelo .
ɓa zhin fyanya nu vinya fyehin fye zhin kristi anya nu .
kristi kwa wo zhin shekwoyi nya nu .
oma zaje , mi daɓo lo fyei ngye aɓi putu nu , dna yesu vi zokwo , to fyei vi dagayi m , sai ofya ɓeye , mi ta mi ma daɓo fyei ngye a yesu viyi kalada nɓa nunuyi lo n zafun yim .

omi ma ?
mi zhin bara manayi nu ?
mi to damu lo nfya ɓo nubo zhin yi tu mi tukwo da cem , ko aɓo zaho-zahoi zhin nubo ce yim .
mi to n mihin tukwo yi ga gaiciya lo tu ce m .
omi bugba ta zun mi kni lom , dudu lo nu ko to wu nu ge mi knikniyi lom .
shekwoyi nu zhin mi mwi yi .
ntu cenu fye to zun-ɓo ya wolo wolo , to dagayi yi zhim , tu n zahozahoi tukwo ko wo zhin bara manayi nu ko nukwoyi m .
shi dagayi ɓei ɓe , wo ɓei kpe buzangna ya a gye shi zaho-zahoi wu lo har bugba mi .
zaho-zahoi ɓei kpe sayi nya ko zhin yi zhin dagayi tnu-tnu .
dna sayi nu n shekwoyi ɓei ga zahozahoi wo cici n ko zhin wo nya .
fye to kni aza kni-knin ma zhan-pma n apollos yi ɓedo mihin yi , ma si ɓo si n mi da nyi : nge fye to kni aza kni-knim .
fye to mwa fyehin tukwo n shekwoyi tnu-tnu yi hoi ngye wo du azaje lom .
ho zhin aɓoko kni ɓei na ?
ho kninyi lo n shekwoyi nu to ga ho ma ?
to kninu zhin hoi ci hohin ngye nya ho cei nyi ato gaho ga-ga nu ma ?
fye zhin aɓo lo ngye fye ku zafun nyagyi lu bwa vinya n fye cei pma .
nubo ku fye fu dna zafun har fye ku gyi abe n yi ceya .
a wo mi ngye fye ye ku abe yi nu gyi nu , ntuge sa nʼsa ɓei si , fye ɓei gye yi gni abe gyi nfyei ce .
nsa hoi kwa wumi ngye eyi n yi zhin shekwoyi atnutnu yi nyi , shekwoyi ku yi kma navun vinya .
yi wulo ngye aza nu nɓa zhin laifi dnagmai har aye awuɓa .
yi ku ze awye shi nya na za ba ɓedo na malaika yi .
yi ku ze a ma-ma ntu yesu ɓo , amma fye ku ze aza ce-ce ntu yesu ɓo .
yi ku ze akala gbai , ama fye na kalayi lo .
a kuyi ze aza gbolo , ama aku mwa-mwa gafye .
har n saiye , mikun gnuyi lo , yi wo nuwan mikun , yi kpe aje sakun , ai lu yi , yi zan-zan laɓa ngye aza ɓa to na pi yim .
yi zhin tnu-tnu nʼya bwa yi ntuge ya bwa nyagyi .
esa na za kpe ya gye , ya tuɓa anabarka , esanu ɓa ga yi wahala , ya bwami nɓai .
esa na dayi ɓo nukoyi , ya dnaɓo gbe na ɓeda manai yi ; yi ku ze findakulu , yi ku ze aza gbolo har naiye .
mi ta ka fye ɓedaye ge mi ye ma dnafye vinyiko nu m , ama mi kun fye nu ntuge fye zhin ma ɓi ye-ye yi nu .
ko fye bwa aza n lo dubu gun awo ɓa wu fye yesu ɓo , fye pa ge mi nu bwa fye dada zhin gmanyi .
ntuge omi nu na gni fye ɓe cei n yesu aba , esa n mi ɓo zhin fye waʼazi cei nyi .
ntuce nu mi gyi fye wye , fye tumwi n mi , fya zhin she mi zhin .
cenu zhin mi-i tnu n timatawus yi n fya ba wa bma fye zhin , wo zhin mi ɓi yeye yi nu dna dagayi , gbenuyi nu njesun .
wo ɓa pa fye aɓo mi wu dna ekklesiya dohodohoi nma lo .
azaho lo n fye mi ɓai mwa ɓahin tukwo , ɓa gye ge mi wo dna nu to mi-i ɓe fya bam .
n shekwoyi aye yi , mi ɓe lo safyewyi .
dna n sayi nu n mi ɓei kpe aɓokoda-yi ɓo ye , ngye ɓa to zhin aɓeda dayi nu kawai yim , ko ngye ɓa n shekwoyi iko yi kusun lo .
ntuge shekwoyi bemi to zhin aɓoda nya nu kawai yim , ama iko nya .
fye kni kni-dai na ?
miɓe fya ba n gnakni yi , n busi yi pma lawu ɓedo , ko mi ɓe dna yeye n buga yami ya ?
ntu cenu fye ku yi ze a tnu-tnu yi nu nɓa gna shekwoyi anabarka mi , ɓai wu shekwoyi asiri njesun .

mi ta ka fye ɓedaye ge mi ye ma dnafye vinyiko nu m , ama mi kun fye nu ntuge fye zhin ma ɓi ye-ye yi nu .
ko fye bwa aza n lo dubu gun awo ɓa wu fye yesu ɓo , fye pa ge mi nu bwa fye dada zhin gmanyi .
ntuge omi nu na gni fye ɓe cei n yesu aba , esa n mi ɓo zhin fye waʼazi cei nyi .
ntuce nu mi gyi fye wye , fye tumwi n mi , fya zhin she mi zhin .
cenu zhin mi-i tnu n timatawus yi n fya ba wa bma fye zhin , wo zhin mi ɓi yeye yi nu dna dagayi , gbenuyi nu njesun .
wo ɓa pa fye aɓo mi wu dna ekklesiya dohodohoi nma lo .
azaho lo n fye mi ɓai mwa ɓahin tukwo , ɓa gye ge mi wo dna nu to mi-i ɓe fya bam .
n shekwoyi aye yi , mi ɓe lo safyewyi .
dna n sayi nu n mi ɓei kpe aɓokoda-yi ɓo ye , ngye ɓa to zhin aɓeda dayi nu kawai yim , ko ngye ɓa n shekwoyi iko yi kusun lo .
ntuge shekwoyi bemi to zhin aɓoda nya nu kawai yim , ama iko nya .
fye kni kni-dai na ?
miɓe fya ba n gnakni yi , n busi yi pma lawu ɓedo , ko mi ɓe dna yeye n buga yami ya ?
bulus ge a to bwa jedoɓe nzahim zaho-zahoi da lo ge ɓenukwoi ku zhin nʼfya tasin , ɓenukwoi n na ɓenai ta zhin ce pyam .
oza lo n dna fya duwa nyakun n dna laifi nwo dadanyikwo yi .
to fya zhin aɓoko ge na , fye gye ge fye fi n zafun nu ?
ai ko kamata lo bugba wunfye ɓedo vinyiko yi , har fya gye fye la zayi pya biya n fya tasin .
ko da shike mi to gni lo nfya bam , mi zhin ɓeye nubo lo zin .
dna yi dagayi yesu ye , mi la ɓo zhin nubo n na ɓa zhin sai ho gna ngye mi gni lo ɓo .
fye yi yezhi aduwa nyakun nya-iko dagayi yesu nya ɓa kunsun fyei dna fye yezhi mi , omihin ce n kunsun lo nfyei dna zafun a la zayi pya biya n na duwa nyakun , a gawo n shetan akun wa wu wo nayi , nna wyetu-yi ge owo wye-wyei ɓei po dna nyipyei nʼyi dagayi yesu kristi ɓei jezeɓe ncei nyi .
ko zhin ɓo nukwoyi nu fyei gma ntu fye gyi-gyi ɓo , ama fyei fa ɓeye pya koi gyabye .
fye ta kpe lo ge n na fa zaknayi dna wo laifi , sa fyewyi aɓa wan wo zokwo m ?
fye la ʼza nukwoi ye gmiya n fye tasin , n na bai fya ze aza gyi-gyi-yi .
aɓei la kristi-shekwoyi kugya ɓiyi-wu ntu yi ɓo .
ntu cenu yi nya agmada tu wo , ya dna kala dna yesu-vi zokwo , ya zokwo kwokwoi ya nko nuwun yi viyan ɓedo n ko kpi zhin yi .
yi nya gmada tu bredi gyi-gyi yi , mwa-mwa nya , n gaiciya nya yi .
dna wasika n mi ɓei ka fye nyi , mʼɓei gna fye ge fye to ye ɓedo n na ɓenukwoi zhin-yi yim .
mi to ɓei da a shetan da nu ɓo n ɓa zhin anagbai nyi , ko aɓo wyedai , ko avi , ko ashan-gba yim .
ntuge fye ta kpefi n nanyi ye n tna aza deye pyam .
nya mi ɓei zhin nufi cei ko nu nyi ge , fye to ye ɓedo n zayi nwo yi wohin ge wo zhin yesu viyi , ama woi ce woi zhin anagbai , aɓowyeda , woi gba a shan , ko woi gyi azafi laɓa , ko woi wyi ʼvi , ko woi sin eje , ko woi kni aza akmi .
ko nyagyi , fye to gyi nʼza deye pya yim .
eyi tnu-tnu nu ya da yihin owa eyi tnu-tnu nu to ya da abmida wam .
ama ɓehin-hin eyi tnu-tnu nu ya da aza wa , ya zhin ɓa ɓo dai-dai in ɓa lo aduwa nyakun ge a yesu viyi , ɓai gwo alaifi ye pya zhin nyi .
shekwoyi nwo gmanyi yi , wo nu zhin abmida ʼwadayi .
ama ofye fyehin ce , fye zhin nʼzayi yi , fya gmi wo ya nfya duwa nyakun .
zaho-zahoi da lo ge ɓenukwoi ku zhin nʼfya tasin , ɓenukwoi n na ɓenai ta zhin ce pyam .
oza lo n dna fya duwa nyakun n dna laifi nwo dadanyikwo yi .

mi ye ma dna fye vinyiko nu .
ashe ɓeyekpei to lo ko gmanyi n na yesu-viyi nwo ɓa mi wa gna a ɓena ajeyam ?
ama maimako deye , sai yesu-viyi wa lo n wo yesu-viyi doyi n na tna-viyi wada ɓokun .
aje kara zhin , ko zhin knizun nu n fya ba a yesu-viyi .
fye ta mi fya bwa bugba n ɓenukwoi yi n naɓa zhin fyem ?
ko gna bmiya lo n dagayi aba fya fwa a gyi fye fi .
ama maimako deye , fye nu n laifi lo n fyehin tukwo , fyei gyi azaje fi , har ma nfya ʼjei ɓe .
azaho ta lo shekwoyi ebe min fye ta kpe lo ge aza n ɓa zhin aɓoi pya ɓa to n gado yi lo n shekwoyi bemi m ?
fye to dna fyehin tukwo wyi m , ntuge aza nɓa zhin anagbai , ko ɓai gba ashan , to ɓai zhin befyece m , ko kwa zanugbai woi wagye n zanugbai yi , nyikoza woi wagye n zanugbai yi , nyikoza woi wagye n nyikoza yi-ɓa ta lo woʼbe mim .
nlonu avi , ko afan-nada , a nyasin-yi , aza gyifi-yi , ko azaje-zaje-yi .
esa lo n na zaho ɓei bwa wu lonu n fye mi , ama n sayi ala fya laifi zhan ya , a la fye kni ntu shekwoyi ɓo .
wo la fye gwo ntu nya ɓo n dagayi yesu kristi n zafun shekwoyi nya yi wa zhin nfye ɓo .
miɓa mi ma zhin nyaho-nyahoi to yesu yi na tu mi ko gbem , ama aɓo vinya nu to bmiya lo ntu mi ɓom , ko ai ɓei la ye ge mi zhin aɓo vinya , mi ta ye ma zhin ɓo ko ɓa wan mi shi har to miyi mi ma fa ko zhin ɓo nʼsa mi ye ce yim .
shekwoyi la nubo gayi ntu nyagyi ɓo , ama tuge ya gyi ndu ya nubo-fu yam .
to zhin nubo ge nyagyi zhin ɓo yako num , ntuge shekwoyi ɓa du a nubo ya ɓedo n nyagyi yi n wyiho yi .
ama anagbai zhin to bmiya lom ko fyefye : a to zhin ya nayi ga ce num , ama ntu dagayi ɓo , woi cei pma lo wa nu ya nayi n wohin tukwo yi .
shi shekwoyi ɓei la yesu kala n vingwo , elo nu wo ɓei kuyi kala ce n wo iko yi .
fye ta kpelo ge efye nayi zhin gmanyi nu n yesu nya yim ?
to miɓa la kristi nayi ma ɓe ko do n karuwa nya yi ?
ko fye-fye !
ko fye ta kpe lo ge oza wo lo wa wangye n karuwa yi wo la ze gmanyi n woi ma ?
littafi ku da peipei , oɓa ngun-aba , ɓa ze gmanyi .
ama oza n wa wohin ga dagayi , wo la ɓedo n kristi yi , ɓa ku ze ngye oza gmanyi .
fye bui anagbai zhin si .
laifi daho-dohoi n za zhin , ko ta to nayi bwa m , oza wa zhin anagbai , wo zhin wo nayi nu laifi .
fye ta kpe ge ofya nayi zhin zafun gyi-gyi-yi asese ba nu , n shekwoyi ɓei ga fye nyi , woi sase lo dna fye mim ?
ofya nayi to zhin fya nya num .

ashan nyagyi oɓo ko jesun lo sai ɓenya n fye ɓo nya tu n nyagyi tukwo na ku ashan gba cei nyi .
tu ɓenya ye tukwo zaho-zahoi gyelo ngye owo ɓegbe-dna nu gna bmiya lo .
ɓeye-kpe bmiya ʼza shi , ama oɓo na gna yelo ntu ikklisiya mimi ɓo ko nu zhin yeye .
oza wo gye ge wo kpe aɓo ye lo vinya , to , wo bwa wo tnayekpe nu bmi zo wu .
ama oza wo ye shekwoyi ɓehin-hin nya , owo nu bmiya shi lo n shekwoyi ɓa kpe wo ye .
to , yi ɓa gyi nya na ku shan gba cei ?
yi kpelo ge oshan to ku shekwoyi nu zhin m , yi-i kpelo ge shekwoyi bwasun gmanyi nu .
azaho zhin ɓa da ge a shekwoyi lo mwa begye n ʼshe ɓedo n ʼkni yi .
ama yi kpelo ge shekwoyi bwasun lo gmanyi nu , owo nu zhin dada nwa zhin anya vinya , wa zhin yi ya ze wa nya .
njesun dagayi bwasun gmanyi nu yesu kristi wo nu na zhin anya vinya , woi ga yi-wyewyeyi njesun .
dudu lomu , a yesu-viyi ho ta kpe ɓeye ye lon .
ntu ɓa mida ɓo na shan yi , oɓa ɓenubo-zhin gna ɓa ge ashan zhin anya awye-wyeyi nu , har ɓa ku gaiciya ga ge nyagyi na la ko ga ʼshan , a la ku shekwoyi nu ga .
ntu cenu she ɓa gyi nyagyi-yipya , kwa lu ɓa n bugba .
pa ge shekwoyi to damu lo ko yi gyi , ko to yi gyim .
ko ta zhin ya gba-gba m , n yi to gyi m , kwoi ta ɓe yi mwa-mwa yi ya gyi m .
ama fye zhin peceiye n iko yi fye cei lo ntu ko gyi ɓo , sakun fya zhin yesu-viyi ho , nwo bugba to kalai lon , wa kaya dna laifi .
oɓo nyi ko ɓa zhin ; ngye zaho lo n wo to n bugba kalai lo dna na ɓeye pyam , hoi kpe honya lo ge nyagyi ye pya ta zhin ho nyahon , hoi gyi nyagyi na ʼshan nyakun , ai deye ɓa cewo bwa har wa lo o-shan nyakun ntuge wa gyi nyagyi , bugba yi gwo wo lu .
to , ntu ge ho kpe lo ge ko to zhin nyaho nun hoya gyi m , ho ɓa zhin yesu-viyi do n wo bugba to kalai lon wa bwi dna zafun , oho zado n yesu wa fi ntu wo ɓo .
ko zhin laifi nu n kristi abye ho ya ce ho zado bwa wa zhin ɓo n wo bugba zun wo kni da ce .
nuce nu , ndai ashan-bu gyi ɓa zhin mi zado wa zhin laifi , mi ta shan ɓa gyim har nyalo-nyalo , ntuge mi ta ye lo ma zhin mi zado , wa zhin laifi m .
