mi ye fya bwa omi n miyi shi mi daɓo n gye mama .
fye bwa emi n miyi ma daɓo n ko n mi yi fi n bugba .
mi n shewo yi lo nfyei , shewo shekwoyi nya pya , wato of ye ye-ye kwa ze krisiti nyanu gmanyi .
shi ɓinyinkwoyi gyi-gyi-yi zhin wa sewo ye-ye shi ntu n enu ɓo nu n woye nyi .
oza nwo ɓa zhin owo ɓa .
ama mi wo dna lo n vinvin yi , mi-i wodna sakun zaho wa pmi fye awyeya n fye gaiciya ga dna n dagayi , shi shetan ɓei dna hawawu kwoce dna n adini ofwa nyi .
fye wu lo ngye fye to mi zhi lon , fyei ga nyaho-nyahoi gaiciya n na gna fye , ko oza woi zhin fye kristi do n waʼazi gbo ndoyi n yi zhin nyi , ko zafun do ndu zafun gyi-gyi-yi nfye ɓei gwo nyi ko ai wu fye zokwo do n fye ɓa pwo , fya gwo ko lo abwa ʼba-ba .
aza gyifiyi ama mi tagye lo ngye aza nɓa yi ɓahin ge shekwoyi atnu-tnuyi nyi , ge ɓa du mi lon .
ngye mi ta kpe waʼazi zhin , amma mi kpeɓeye lo n mida , shi mi gye fye ku awyega bwa nsa yi ntuge yi ku wu fye pei-pei .
ma zhin ɓenukwoi nu , mi-i gba mihin nfye aba , shi ma zhin fye waʼazi shekwoyi nabari manayi nya , to ma gna fye ge fye gba nya hon ?
ama ma gwo a ikklisiya je cauta n ɓa tnu mi n cei , n nabai ma zhin fye tnu-tnu to fye yi gba nyahon .
sa deye ɓei ku zo mikun kwa yami gun , ama to ma nya fye ɓehon , gama a-yesu-viyi n makidoniya ɓei ku ɓemi n nyaga yi .
mi to nya fye gyiwye ɓon , mi-i ta shan fye nyan .
mi ku alkawali zhin , ngaiciya ga yi n mi ceilo dna n yesu nyi , nge mi ɓa ku gna aza vinya n helleni .
ntu kniɓehiʼa ?
ntu ge mi ta ye fye lon ?
shekwoyi kpe lo ge mi ye fye lo .
ama , mi ɓa zhin ma zun aza kni n ɓa gma ge ɓa zhin shekwoyi tnu-tnu nu shi yi zhin nyin .
shekwoyi nu to tnu n na aza ye pyayin .
kwo fyewyi , ɓa zhin akataceyi nu , ɓa dnafye kwoce n gye ɓa zhin kristi atnu-tnu yi .
ama ce ta wo mi lon !
shetan zhin wa pmi wohin bma ngye malaika buzangna nya .
ntuce nu kwo to zhin oɓe wo-woyi nu , owo abara ɓami ɓa zhin lo nu ce , ɓa ze n gye a tnu-tnuyi , manayi .
n navun ɓa ɓa gwo tata doho-dohoyi , nɓa atnu-tnu nukwoyi kunce lo n cei .
mi gyi fye wye n jesun , fye to gye ngye mi zhin mama num , ko fyei gye lo nu , fye wo mi ɓeda nabai ma mwa mihin tukwo ngye ɓa .
dagayi to ga mi iko ge mi mwa mihin tukwo lo num , ntu ge mi zhin aɓo lo ngye mama nwo ton na pwo yi m .
ama aza deye ɓai gyi abye , ɓai gna fye , shi ɓa kpe ɓeye lo nsun , omihin ɓa mwa mihin tukwo .
( fye gye ge fye cecei-lo , ama fyei kna a mamahi ɓeda tnubua n bugba buyi , fye ta damu lo , esa ɓa zefye oɓa fyenu , ɓai gwo anya vinya nfye n cei lon , ɓai gyi gyiba tu nfye tukwo , ɓai ci fye wyegba .
vinyiko wo mi lo maci ge mi to n kalayi lo n migni yi n lonun , ama enya n ɓa mwa ɓahin tukwo n cei mi ɓami ma mwa mihin tukwo ce . ) ɓa ta mwa ɓahin tukwo ge ɓa zhin ibraniyi nun ?
mi zhin kwo nu .
ɓa zhin a israilayi nu ?
mi zhin kwo nu .
ɓa zhin ibrahim ayawyi nu ?
mi zhin kwo nu .
ɓai gna ɓa zhin kristi nu bauta ?
ama miku bauta zhin wo ndu ɓa .
( mila zenya nu mi-i gma nsun layi ) .
miku tnu-tnu zhin n duɓa .
ayi dnami n kurkuku n na bwai mwabegye .
a zhin mi bulala n na abwayi mwa begye .
mi sun n fiyi ci-ci .
a yahudiyi zhin mi bulala n ɓa knalufin n nukwoyi , shita-cei ciwagmanyi har abwa ngun atnu .
abwa ta ai lumi n na abusiyi .
a knimi akuta bwa zungmanyi .
abwa ta eya kwoi ɓaya nmiyi , bwa zun gmanyi mi yi dna n ela nsukwoyi vinya n kwo nyipyeyi ɓe .
miku zan-zan n na abai mwa kpa , mi-i sin wahala anuwan yako nya .
n na a viyi , n ma za akun yahudiyi n naabyedo yi , miku wahala sin , n na azhi yakwo , n efiyi n bmana n na nuwan yi n na zakun nɓa yi ɓahin ge ɓa zhin kristi aza .
a ɓe mi n nayi san yi , n tnagye-wan yi n sukwoyi , nsayi mwa-begye mi lo n mikunyi , nunwa mikunyi , mi-i zan n tna nyagyi , eseyi fumi mi-i vin , n tna aje nɓa bwi miʼse .
ndeye avun mi n damuwa yi lolo shi ikklisiya zan-zan lo n wu .
nyikadonu bwi aba to mi-i wun bugba n wo ɓon ma ?
nkadonu miya to ai wo mi pwa n ge mi bmawo zhin ma ?
nkadonu la gbidokunnu n zafun to minagyi yi gyi mi n zayi n wa zhin woi gbidokunnu nyin ma ?
ama ndei n mi ɓa gma , ma gma n na anyayi nu n ɓa wu emi kalagba .
shekwoyi eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada n na ciwo nyalo-nyalo nyi , kpelo ge mi da gaiciya nu .
ngye , gwamna n dimaska , n esu aretas yi ɓa gu ezhi ntu ge ɓa wan mi .
ama a kamishi n na awunyi dna n katakpa n ebwo nkwoɓei ce n ganuwan nyakun pa , ma lo minya !
mi ye fya bwa omi n miyi shi mi daɓo n gye mama .
fye bwa emi n miyi ma daɓo n ko n mi yi fi n bugba .
mi n shewo yi lo nfyei , shewo shekwoyi nya pya , wato of ye ye-ye kwa ze krisiti nyanu gmanyi .
shi ɓinyinkwoyi gyi-gyi-yi zhin wa sewo ye-ye shi ntu n enu ɓo nu n woye nyi .
oza nwo ɓa zhin owo ɓa .
ama mi wo dna lo n vinvin yi , mi-i wodna sakun zaho wa pmi fye awyeya n fye gaiciya ga dna n dagayi , shi shetan ɓei dna hawawu kwoce dna n adini ofwa nyi .
fye wu lo ngye fye to mi zhi lon , fyei ga nyaho-nyahoi gaiciya n na gna fye , ko oza woi zhin fye kristi do n waʼazi gbo ndoyi n yi zhin nyi , ko zafun do ndu zafun gyi-gyi-yi nfye ɓei gwo nyi ko ai wu fye zokwo do n fye ɓa pwo , fya gwo ko lo abwa ʼba-ba .
ama mi tagye lo ngye aza nɓa yi ɓahin ge shekwoyi atnu-tnuyi nyi , ge ɓa du mi lon .
ngye mi ta kpe waʼazi zhin , amma mi kpeɓeye lo n mida , shi mi gye fye ku awyega bwa nsa yi ntuge yi ku wu fye pei-pei .
ma zhin ɓenukwoi nu , mi-i gba mihin nfye aba , shi ma zhin fye waʼazi shekwoyi nabari manayi nya , to ma gna fye ge fye gba nya hon ?
ama ma gwo a ikklisiya je cauta n ɓa tnu mi n cei , n nabai ma zhin fye tnu-tnu to fye yi gba nyahon .
sa deye ɓei ku zo mikun kwa yami gun , ama to ma nya fye ɓehon , gama a-yesu-viyi n makidoniya ɓei ku ɓemi n nyaga yi .
mi to nya fye gyiwye ɓon , mi-i ta shan fye nyan .
mi ku alkawali zhin , ngaiciya ga yi n mi ceilo dna n yesu nyi , nge mi ɓa ku gna aza vinya n helleni .
ntu kniɓehiʼa ?
ntu ge mi ta ye fye lon ?
shekwoyi kpe lo ge mi ye fye lo .
ama , mi ɓa zhin ma zun aza kni n ɓa gma ge ɓa zhin shekwoyi tnu-tnu nu shi yi zhin nyin .
shekwoyi nu to tnu n na aza ye pyayin .
kwo fyewyi , ɓa zhin akataceyi nu , ɓa dnafye kwoce n gye ɓa zhin kristi atnu-tnu yi .
ama ce ta wo mi lon !
shetan zhin wa pmi wohin bma ngye malaika buzangna nya .
ntuce nu kwo to zhin oɓe wo-woyi nu , owo abara ɓami ɓa zhin lo nu ce , ɓa ze n gye a tnu-tnuyi , manayi .
n navun ɓa ɓa gwo tata doho-dohoyi , nɓa atnu-tnu nukwoyi kunce lo n cei .
mi gyi fye wye n jesun , fye to gye ngye mi zhin mama num , ko fyei gye lo nu , fye wo mi ɓeda nabai ma mwa mihin tukwo ngye ɓa .
dagayi to ga mi iko ge mi mwa mihin tukwo lo num , ntu ge mi zhin aɓo lo ngye mama nwo ton na pwo yi m .
ama aza deye ɓai gyi abye , ɓai gna fye , shi ɓa kpe ɓeye lo nsun , omihin ɓa mwa mihin tukwo .
( fye gye ge fye cecei-lo , ama fyei kna a mamahi ɓeda tnubua n bugba buyi , fye ta damu lo , esa ɓa zefye oɓa fyenu , ɓai gwo anya vinya nfye n cei lon , ɓai gyi gyiba tu nfye tukwo , ɓai ci fye wyegba .
vinyiko wo mi lo maci ge mi to n kalayi lo n migni yi n lonun , ama enya n ɓa mwa ɓahin tukwo n cei mi ɓami ma mwa mihin tukwo ce . ) ɓa ta mwa ɓahin tukwo ge ɓa zhin ibraniyi nun ?
mi zhin kwo nu .
ɓa zhin a israilayi nu ?
mi zhin kwo nu .
ɓa zhin ibrahim ayawyi nu ?
mi zhin kwo nu .
ɓai gna ɓa zhin kristi nu bauta ?
ama miku bauta zhin wo ndu ɓa .
( mila zenya nu mi-i gma nsun layi ) .
miku tnu-tnu zhin n duɓa .
ayi dnami n kurkuku n na bwai mwabegye .
a zhin mi bulala n na abwayi mwa begye .
mi sun n fiyi ci-ci .
a yahudiyi zhin mi bulala n ɓa knalufin n nukwoyi , shita-cei ciwagmanyi har abwa ngun atnu .
abwa ta ai lumi n na abusiyi .
a knimi akuta bwa zungmanyi .
abwa ta eya kwoi ɓaya nmiyi , bwa zun gmanyi mi yi dna n ela nsukwoyi vinya n kwo nyipyeyi ɓe .
miku zan-zan n na abai mwa kpa , mi-i sin wahala anuwan yako nya .
n na a viyi , n ma za akun yahudiyi n naabyedo yi , miku wahala sin , n na azhi yakwo , n efiyi n bmana n na nuwan yi n na zakun nɓa yi ɓahin ge ɓa zhin kristi aza .
a ɓe mi n nayi san yi , n tnagye-wan yi n sukwoyi , nsayi mwa-begye mi lo n mikunyi , nunwa mikunyi , mi-i zan n tna nyagyi , eseyi fumi mi-i vin , n tna aje nɓa bwi miʼse .
ndeye avun mi n damuwa yi lolo shi ikklisiya zan-zan lo n wu .
nyikadonu bwi aba to mi-i wun bugba n wo ɓon ma ?
nkadonu miya to ai wo mi pwa n ge mi bmawo zhin ma ?
nkadonu la gbidokunnu n zafun to minagyi yi gyi mi n zayi n wa zhin woi gbidokunnu nyin ma ?
ama ndei n mi ɓa gma , ma gma n na anyayi nu n ɓa wu emi kalagba .
shekwoyi eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada n na ciwo nyalo-nyalo nyi , kpelo ge mi da gaiciya nu .
ngye , gwamna n dimaska , n esu aretas yi ɓa gu ezhi ntu ge ɓa wan mi .
ama a kamishi n na awunyi dna n katakpa n ebwo nkwoɓei ce n ganuwan nyakun pa , ma lo minya !
shekwoyi iko dna n kalagba gmagma yepya zhin acije nu , ama fye fa ma gyi abye , ma gnafye aɓewyegye ɓo , n na ɓei n dagayi ku wu mi .
aye ngunawo-cei anyi n ɓa duya nyi aɓei lami lo cei n ʼshe mazhin ziyara .
fye to nyami ko dna n mi nayi kwo dna n mi zafun .
ntuge mita kpe genyi lon .
shekwoyi gmanyinu kpe ce lo .
ama mi ɓei la lo ʼshe .
mawo aɓo wo-woyi n ɓa du zanyikwoci asan wa da ( ama ato ɓei ye nge mi gna aza aɓeyem ) .
beye-kpe ye pya kun ce lo oza gma , ama mita gman , miɓa bwa gma n mi kalagbai nu , njesun shi shekwoyi n ikoyi wa zhin apma n zakala-gbai n tu nwo mwa-mwa ɓo .
mi n na aɓeyi lo n mwa , n mi ɓa gma n ɓa ɓo , mi-i ta ze mama nge mi gma ntu nɓa ɓon , ama mito cei pmalo oza zhin nubo n mi tukwo ndu enya n wo gye n mi zan-zan , woi ce woi ce woi wo n mi waʼazin .
miɓa da ɓeye , gama eɓeye zhin aɓo adnagmayi nu , shekwoyi ɓei wodna sakun miɓa mwa mihin tukwo n ɓai nu , ntu cenu a gami kalagba dna n nayi , kola ze ekna dnami nayi , she tan tnu-tnuyi ko knimi kwoi gnami-gna-gna .
abwa ngun ata mi-i gyi shekwoyi wye , wa ga mi lafiya n jesun .
ama wa gnami ge , awo , mikunsun lo nhoi , nyanu n ho n cei pma lo .
omi iko wu kohin n du , n na aza kala gbayi abaʼa . nsayi ye a damailo mi-i gna shi mi to n kalayin , adamilo mi sase ngye oza n wo wu kristi iko maimakon mi wu emihin iko n ɓeye-kpeyi .
shi mi kpelo ge ntu n kristi ɓo nu nyi , bugba ta wun mi lo n ekna yi ɓon , n na agyeyi , n wahalayi , azhin n gmagma sin yi , gama esa n mi gba kala , n sahi nu n mi n kalayi .
fye zhin mi , mi-i zhin aɓo ngye mama , mi-i gma n lanyi , ko ɓei kunce efye nu fya ci mi , to ge ma ci mihin tukwom .
ntu ge nyaho to lo nna aza deye ncei lo , n mi to cei lon ko shi kwo nyi mi to zhin nyaho num .
esa nmi ɓei kunsun nfyei , mi ɓei ku wu fye pei-pei , nge mi zhin tnu-tnuyi nu , n shekwoyi wa tnu n miyi n wohin tukwoyi , gama mi ɓei ku aɓo awo-woyi n na atnu-tnu yakwoyi zhin nfye aba .
enya gmanyi n mito ɓei zhin fyen , n mi ɓei zhin n na a ikklisiya aje , ekwonu mi to ze akaya n fye aban .
mi to ɓei gnafye ge fye gami nyagyi magyi , n na abai n mi ɓa wangyen .
mi gyi fye wye fya zhin mi gafara , ntu laifi ye ɓo .
mi je fye aba ɓe lo nsaiye mi je fye aba ɓe lo , bwa tahi , mi-i ta nyafye nyaho ɓom , mi ta ye efye agyiwye lon , mi ye fyenu , nzokwo doho-dohoi fye zhin omi aɓinu , fye kpelo aɓi ta gba oɓa dada n oɓa ayayi nyagyi ɓa gyin .
aɓi danu ga aɓi nyagyi .
mi nbugba bui lo , ma ga fye omihin tukwo n nyayi vinya n mi n cei , ntu n fye ɓo dna n zafun .
ko shikwo-nyi , ʼfye yeye to mwa lo n mi aba , ngye shi mi ye fye nsun nyim .
azaho n fyemi ɓai gna ge ko zhin gaiciya nu yi ta wu nyaho n wo ɓeɓen , ama wo zhin oza ce-ceyi nu , woi dnayi kwoce , yi tabbata lo tilas wo ɓei la gyiwye go n yi n zokwo doho . ama n wuna ?
aza n mi ɓei tnu n cei nyi ɓa ɓei ku gyibaho gyi tu n fye tukwo ?
esa n mi ɓei gna titus nge wo ɓe n eyi zado yi n jesun , ɓa ɓei ku gyi baho gyi tu n fyenu ?
awo , gama yi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi gmanyi yi nu , yi zan-zan gmanyi , yi zhin ɓo n zokwoyi gmanyi .
mi zhin nubo fye gye ngye mi da aɓeye vinya , n nabai fya ye n mi-i nu , ko ngye ma bmiya mihin shi nfye aba .
ko to wu lo nu m .
mi da deye n shekwoyi abye , ngye aza nɓa dna n kristi , emi anugundo ye-ye-yi ntu ge ma mi fye zhi dna n zafun .
gama edna wo mi lo esa n ma ɓe n cei , anya n mi ɓo gye ta damin , enya n mi ɓa zhin ceta da fyen , edna wo mi lo mi bei gye fye fi fyei wu anya .
fye wo aje ʼshe , fyei gyi minagyi n na ajeyi fyei mwa fyehin tukwo , fyei da ɓo a nukwoyi n na aje tukwo n nunuyi n tukwomwayi n na ajegna yi .
e , edna womi lo ntu ge n ma ɓe fye aba shekwoyi ɓa gbami n fye abye , bugba wunmi ma ci bwi , ntuge n mwa-begye nfye , n ku laifi zhin ɓai ku ze alaifida to ɓai damu n ɓenukwoyi , aɓo cegye nya n fye ku zhin , n na aje anyikwo gwoyi .

ebwa tahi nyi n mi ɓe fye aba , littafi a gnayi nge n aza gun aba ko ngun ata nku ɓenukwoyi gye tilas atako , ( to emi gnakni bwa tahi nu nyin . ) mi ɓei la gnaknin aza n ɓa zhin laifi nyi , esa n mi ɓei ɓe fye aba cei nyi , nsayi mi gna kni ɓa njesun , shi mi ɓei shin gnaknin ɓa nyi , du n na azajeyi ɓe n ge n ma ɓe , miye ma ta ɓanu mi ta gye ɓa sun-sun m .
mi ɓa wu fye enya n fye ye vinya fya kpe n ge kristi daɓo n fyei dna nmi , kristi to gba kala lo n wo aɓo zhin n fye yin , ama wo zhin iko yakwo nu dna n fye .
ewo nayi kala gbayi ɓei lafi tu n zundu , ama nsayi ye wo n wye-wyeyi lo dna n shekwoyi iko .
eyi n yi cenyi yi gba kala gba-gbayi lo dna n nayi , shi wo ɓei gbakala , ama nsayiye yi sase n kalayi shi wo ncei nyi , n shekwoyi ikoyi vinya n wo aɓo zhin nfye yi .
fye mwi fyehin tukwo gye fye dna fyehin wye , fye zhin a yesu viyi nu ?
fye gyi nasara lo ?
fye wo kristi aese lo nwo ikoyi n fye a bugbami ?
ko fye dna fyehin kwoce nu ge fye zhin a yesu viyi to fye yi zhin ma ?
mi zhin nubo nge fye ɓa ye , fya zhin saida nge miku nasara ho gyi , mi zhin kristi nyanu .
mi zhin aduwa nge fya se ase manayi , to ge ya bwa enya n yi ɓa gma n cei n , koi wu nge enya n yi wunyi ko zhin gaiciya nu .
awo , gama yi n cei pmalo fya zhin ɓemana kwo ai ci yi wyegba .
eyi tnu-tnu nu ya ga ɓemana zhin bugba kala , to ge ya zhin nubo n ɓenukwoyin .
adayi lo shi yi to n kalayi lon ai ciyi wyegba , ama fye n kalayi lo .
eyi ɓemwi n yi aduwa zhin yi , okwo nu zhin fya ku ze a yesu vi yi kalada .
mi ka deye ga fye n na awyetuyi , mi ta shanɓe ma ta fye esa n ma ɓe n cei n , gama mi cei pma lo ma zhin a pma n dagayi ikoyi n wa gami nyi , to ge ma ta fyen , ama ma zhin fye fya ze a kalada .
mi zo emi wasika n na ɓe da ye yi .
fye da gma fye mwa fi n kristi fye kna aɓo tunbua n mi ku da nyi , fye sase n bugba-doloyi , n bugba fuyi .
shekwoyi ye-ye nya , n bugbafu nyayi wo kunsun n fyei .
fye ɓi aje gna dna n dagayi .
a yesu viyi n ya ɓa ɓi fye gna lo .
alheri eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya ko kunsun nfyei vinya .
shekwoyi ye-ye n zafun jedoɓe yi ko kunsun nfyei .
ebwa tahi nyi n mi ɓe fye aba , littafi a gnayi nge n aza gun aba ko ngun ata nku ɓenukwoyi gye tilas atako , ( to emi gnakni bwa tahi nu nyin . ) mi ɓei la gnaknin aza n ɓa zhin laifi nyi , esa n mi ɓei ɓe fye aba cei nyi , nsayi mi gna kni ɓa njesun , shi mi ɓei shin gnaknin ɓa nyi , du n na azajeyi ɓe n ge n ma ɓe , miye ma ta ɓanu mi ta gye ɓa sun-sun m .
mi ɓa wu fye enya n fye ye vinya fya kpe n ge kristi daɓo n fyei dna nmi , kristi to gba kala lo n wo aɓo zhin n fye yin , ama wo zhin iko yakwo nu dna n fye .
ewo nayi kala gbayi ɓei lafi tu n zundu , ama nsayi ye wo n wye-wyeyi lo dna n shekwoyi iko .
eyi n yi cenyi yi gba kala gba-gbayi lo dna n nayi , shi wo ɓei gbakala , ama nsayiye yi sase n kalayi shi wo ncei nyi , n shekwoyi ikoyi vinya n wo aɓo zhin nfye yi .
fye dna fyehin wye , fye zhin a yesu viyi nu ?
fye gyi nasara lo ?
fye wo kristi aese lo nwo ikoyi n fye a bugbami ?
ko fye dna fyehin kwoce nu ge fye zhin a yesu viyi to fye yi zhin ma ?
mi zhin nubo nge fye ɓa ye , fya zhin saida nge miku nasara ho gyi , mi zhin kristi nyanu .
mi zhin aduwa nge fya se ase manayi , to ge ya bwa enya n yi ɓa gma n cei n , koi wu nge enya n yi wunyi ko zhin gaiciya nu .
awo , gama yi n cei pmalo fya zhin ɓemana kwo ai ci yi wyegba .
eyi tnu-tnu nu ya ga ɓemana zhin bugba kala , to ge ya zhin nubo n ɓenukwoyin .
adayi lo shi yi to n kalayi lon ai ciyi wyegba , ama fye n kalayi lo .
eyi ɓemwi n yi aduwa zhin yi , okwo nu zhin fya ku ze a yesu vi yi kalada .
mi ka deye ga fye n na awyetuyi , mi ta shanɓe ma ta fye esa n ma ɓe n cei n , gama mi cei pma lo ma zhin a pma n dagayi ikoyi n wa gami nyi , to ge ma ta fyen , ama ma zhin fye fya ze a kalada .
mi zo emi wasika n na ɓe da ye yi .
fye da gma fye mwa fi n kristi fye kna aɓo tunbua n mi ku da nyi , fye sase n bugba-doloyi , n bugba fuyi .
shekwoyi ye-ye nya , n bugbafu nyayi wo kunsun n fyei .
fye ɓi aje gna dna n dagayi .
a yesu viyi n ya ɓa ɓi fye gna lo .
alheri eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya ko kunsun nfyei vinya .
shekwoyi ye-ye n zafun jedoɓe yi ko kunsun nfyei .
wasika ye gmi n mi aba nu , omi bulus waʼazi zhin yi , n na yesu viyi ajeyi , n ɓa nyi n ya nyi .
kwoi lo a ikklisiya aba n ɓa nyi n galatiya nyi .
aza nu to ɓei yi mi nge mi ɓe ma zhin waʼazi yen , yesu kristi nu ɓei yi mi n wohin , n shekwoyi dadayi n wo ɓei lawo kala n efi nyi .
fa bugba fu , n anabarkai , n ɓa kun n shekwoyi dada aba nyi n dagayi yesu kristi yi ɓa ze efye nya .
wa fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo shi shekwoyi dada ɓei zhin shiri , wa gni yi n anyi nukwoyi ye n yi fi n ɓa nyi .
mwa-mwa vinya kwo zhin shekwoyi nya nu nyalo-nyalo .
nabari manayi do to lom ce womi lo , shi fye pmi awye ya n shekwoyi n pye , dna n wo yeye nu n sun-sun gyei , n wa yi fye fya vi , fya bwa wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo , n wo ga dna n kristi nyi .
fye ce fyei vi zokwo do nkwo ta si fyei n she n .
gama zokwo do to lo n du odo n ya wu fye nyi m , aza n ɓa shando ɓai pmi kristi gaiciya bma , ɓanu dna fye kwo ce .
fa shekwoyi knitu kwa tu n zaho-zahoi , n mihin ɓe , n wo zhin gni-gni zokwodo waʼazi n du do n yi ɓei wu fye nyi , e , ko malaikai gmi n she wa zhin waʼazi do gbo n yi nya yi , fa shekwoyi knitu kwa tu n wo .
miɓa je ce da .
n za zhin nabari manayi do waʼazi gbo n doyi n fya gwo nyi , fa shekwoyi knitu kwa tu n wo tukwo .
fye gye lo nfyehin , mita ye ma fu fye bugba nu n na ɓeda manayi yin .
miye ma zhin ɓonu n kwo da shekwoyi .
ndei mi zhin atna ma fu aza bugba nu , ha gye mi to zhin kristi fyenu nu m .
omi anugundo ye-yei , mi si nyasi ɓehin-hin nya , nge zokwo n kwo lo ʼshe nyi , n mi ɓei zhin fye kwo waʼazi nyi , ko ta gmi n zaho aba nu , ndu yesu kristi n wohin tukwo , n wa wumi nya n mi ɓa da .
zaho nu to shan mi wun .
fye kpe lo shi mi ɓei wu sanu n mi ɓei ye vi a yahudiyi kunnu nyi , shi mi ɓei zan a yesu viyi zanyi n tna sun-sun , ma wu ɓa to a shan ɓa ye won .
omi nu ɓei zhin a yahudiyi kunnu viyi hin-hin n yi kni n sahi yi , ma zhin atna shi mi ɓa mi ma vi akunnu n na ɓe kniyi eyi adini nya .
ama nya ho a zhin .
gama tunyi to ai mamin shekwoyi ɓo la mi kni ma ze wo nya , wa yimi , n ye-ye dnagmayi n alheri yi .
wa wu owo ɓi n mi mi , n na bai ma lo a byedo aba , mi wu ɓa nabari manayi yesu nya .
sanu n ɓeye ɓei zhin lo nu n mi-i , mi to ɓei lo zaho-zahoi aba ma wu won .
mito ɓei lo urushelima ma wu aza lafiya , nɓa ɓei zhin abara n mi abye nyin .
mi to ɓei lo urushelima n , sai n aye ngun ata avun , ma gye bitrus , ma dna nɓo n woi anyipyei n gun awo-cei-atnu .
bara gmanyi n mi ɓei jegye n sahi , owo nu zhin yakubu , yesu mado .
( fye wo oɓo n mi gna fye nyi gama mi gna fye ɓeye n shekwoyi awyeba nu .
nyanyi n kwo ɓei zhin , mi ta ce akata nu fi fye n . ) n ziyaraye avun ma lo suriya n kilikiyayi .
har nsayi a yahudiya yi a yesu viyi to ɓei kpe shi mi wun .
nya nɓa ɓei bwa kpe gmanyi , kwonu ge ɓa ɓei wo aza ɓai cige , oza n wo ɓei zhin yi nuwun yi nyi .
wo zhin gaiciya ga hi nu waʼazi n sayi , n wo bei ye wa wunkwo ya nyi . ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa ntu mi ɓo .
wasika ye gmi n mi aba nu , omi bulus waʼazi zhin yi , n na yesu viyi ajeyi , n ɓa nyi n ya nyi .
kwoi lo a ikklisiya aba n ɓa nyi n galatiya nyi .
aza nu to ɓei yi mi nge mi ɓe ma zhin waʼazi yen , yesu kristi nu ɓei yi mi n wohin , n shekwoyi dadayi n wo ɓei lawo kala n efi nyi .
fa bugba fu , n anabarkai , n ɓa kun n shekwoyi dada aba nyi n dagayi yesu kristi yi ɓa ze efye nya .
wa fi ntu yi alaifi ɓo shi shekwoyi dada ɓei zhin shiri , wa gni yi n anyi nukwoyi ye n yi fi n ɓa nyi .
mwa-mwa vinya kwo zhin shekwoyi nya nu nyalo-nyalo .
ce womi lo , shi fye pmi awye ya n shekwoyi n pye , dna n wo yeye nu n sun-sun gyei , n wa yi fye fya vi , fya bwa wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo , n wo ga dna n kristi nyi .
fye ce fyei vi zokwo do nkwo ta si fyei n she n .
gama zokwo do to lo n du odo n ya wu fye nyi m , aza n ɓa shando ɓai pmi kristi gaiciya bma , ɓanu dna fye kwo ce .
fa shekwoyi knitu kwa tu n zaho-zahoi , n mihin ɓe , n wo zhin gni-gni zokwodo waʼazi n du do n yi ɓei wu fye nyi , e , ko malaikai gmi n she wa zhin waʼazi do gbo n yi nya yi , fa shekwoyi knitu kwa tu n wo .
miɓa je ce da .

ndei mi zhin atna ma fu aza bugba nu , ha gye mi to zhin kristi fyenu nu m .

ama nya ho a zhin .
gama tunyi to ai mamin shekwoyi ɓo la mi kni ma ze wo nya , wa yimi , n ye-ye dnagmayi n alheri yi .
wa wu owo ɓi n mi mi , n na bai ma lo a byedo aba , mi wu ɓa nabari manayi yesu nya .
sanu n ɓeye ɓei zhin lo nu n mi-i , mi to ɓei lo zaho-zahoi aba ma wu won .
mito ɓei lo urushelima ma wu aza lafiya , nɓa ɓei zhin abara n mi abye nyin .

bara gmanyi n mi ɓei jegye n sahi , owo nu zhin yakubu , yesu mado .
( fye wo oɓo n mi gna fye nyi gama mi gna fye ɓeye n shekwoyi awyeba nu .
nyanyi n kwo ɓei zhin , mi ta ce akata nu fi fye n . ) n ziyaraye avun ma lo suriya n kilikiyayi .
har nsayi a yahudiya yi a yesu viyi to ɓei kpe shi mi wun .
nya nɓa ɓei bwa kpe gmanyi , kwonu ge ɓa ɓei wo aza ɓai cige , oza n wo ɓei zhin yi nuwun yi nyi .
wo zhin gaiciya ga hi nu waʼazi n sayi , n wo bei ye wa wunkwo ya nyi . ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa ntu mi ɓo .
n aye awo-cei-anyi avun , ma , jeze lo urushelima n gnisun n barnabas yi n titus yi .
mi ɓei lo nɓo n tnu-tnuyi nu n shekwoyi ɓo tun mi , mi-i gna ema zaje nya n shekwoyi zhin lo n abyedo aba .
mi ɓei ku ɓoda n na tukwoda yi n nya tukwo n mi zhin kwo waʼazi , mi zhin nubo ɓa ɓei ku kpe ɓeye n mi da ɓa .
ɓa ku ye , ɓa to ɓei damu ko ɓa cige , tutus emi tnu-tnu kun-zhin yi , a zhin wo kaciyan , ko da yake wo zhin ebyedo nu .
aɓona tu owa tukwo ko ma , ɓenya deye pya to ɓei ɓa ɓen , sai dai aza n ɓa yi ɓahin ge a yesu viyi , a yesu viyi a katai n ɓa ɓe , ɓa pmi ɓe gye n yi zhin , ɓa gye a gmada pya n yi n cei dna n yesu , ko yi shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa lo .
ɓa zhin atna ɓa payi gyi n ɓa wyidna n gye a fyenu pa zhi na gmayi .
ama , yi to ɓei kna ɓa tnubuan kwo fyewyi , gama yi to ɓei n cei pma fya gye ge a bwa gni-gni dna n kaciya zhin mi nun , kwo a yahudiyi awyidna bwa shin .
a ikklisiya tukwoda dnagmayi ɓei zhi ɓo , ama ɓa to ɓei bwa enya n ɓa ɓaɓe n mi waʼazin ( ko-dayake ɓa zhin a tukwoda dnagmayi nu ɓa to zhin nya ho nu n mi aban , gama eyi vinya yi zhin gmanyi-gmanyi nu n shekwoyi aba ) .
ɓehin-hin , sanu bitrus , yakubu n yohanna yi n na kpeɓaye n ge ɓa zhin aza dnagmayi nu fi n ikklisiya , ɓei gye shi shekwoyi wa zhin apma n miyi n na abyedo gni-gni , shi wo ɓei zhin apma n bitrus yi wa zhin a yahudiyi waʼazi nyi , ntuge shekwoyi gmanyi nu ɓei gayi nyaga ye pya , ɓa ga yi bugba kala ge yi gyi abye n waʼazi zhin yi n na byedo aba .
ɓahin ce , ɓa gyi abye n cei n na yahudiyi aba .
enya gmanyi n ɓa ɓei gayi shaula tu kwo tukwo okonuge , yi pa awyekwoyi ɓo , emihin ce ai wo mi pwa lo nu .
ama sa n bitrus ɓei ɓe antakiya , ma lanu n woi pei-pei , ntu nya ɓo n wo ɓei zhin ntuge kwo to ɓei bmiyan .
ntuge sanu n wo ɓei kmi ɓe , wo ɓei gyi nyagyi n na abyedo yi a yesu viyi nɓata zhin kaciya zhinyin ko na yahudiyi awyidna m .
ama n navun sanu n a yahudiyi yakubu a nugundo ɓei ɓe , to wa shan nyagyi gyi n na abyedo yin , ntuge wo ɓei wo eɓo dna n na yahudiyi aɓe kniyi ye ɓa da , n ɓa gna ge dole nu a zhin kaciya oza kpe gni-gni bwa .
nnavun , a yahudiyi a yesu viyi ɓaku ze a munafici da har n barnaba yi ɓe , ɓa zhin ɓo n bitrus ɓei zhin nyi ko da yake ɓa kpe ɓeye lo n kwo bmiya .
sanu n mi ɓei gye ɓo n ɓa zhin , maku gye ɓata zhin ɓelo n kwo kuncen , ko ɓa vi gaiciya nabari manayi nyan , ma gna bitrus n na aza bye , kwo da yake yahudiyi nu na maho , sala mwa shi ho ɓei ya a yahudiyi kunnu , ho zhin wuna na hoi zhin abyedo a yesu viyi ɓai vi abeye njesun a ?
a yahudiyi nu na maho n miyi , yito zhin abyedo aɓo nukwoyi zhin yi nun .
yi kpelo ge eyi a yahudiyi a yesu viyi , yi ta bwa gni-gni n shekwoyi aba ntu n ɓa kni ɓon .
ama gaiciya ga gmanyi n yesu kristi , kwa zhan yi alaifi ya .
ntu cenu yi kpema yesu kristi n na bai shekwoyi wa gwo yi ntu gaiciya ɓo , to ge ya shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwan .
ntuge zaho to lo n wo ɓa pwo n tu ɓa bwa shi ɓon .
ama kni nu ɓa zhin eyi gaiciyaga , n kristi to gni yin ma , sai a zhin yi kaciya ya shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa ?
yi ta cige gaiciya ga n yesu kuyi zhin agman ?
shekwoyi to ye oza zhin nubo lonu , tu n yi dagayi tukwon .
ai , yi zhin a laifi da nu , yi ya je anya kwo-kwo yi mi n yi la ɓa laya nyi , ko ya zhin atna ge ya shan gni-gni bwa , ntu n na yahudiyi awyidna bwashi ɓo .
gama dna n shekwoyi ɓeda ba nu , n ma kpe ge mita bwa shekwoyi gni-gni dna n mi kukari zhin , n mi kalagbayi ge ma shi awyidna bwan .
ma kpe ge shekwoyi go oza nu n wo ga kristi gaiciya .
alami zundu n gnisun n yesu yi , emi n mihin mito ye lon , ama kristi nu dnalo n sayi ye n mi-mi .
wye-wyeyi hin-hin n mi ncei lo-lo dna n nayi ye n saiye nyi , kwa ɓe ntuge ma ga shekwoyi nugun gaiciya nu , n wa yemi wa gawo wyewyeyi ntu n mi ɓo nyi .
mito dna lo , n na aza nɓa ta gye kristi efi ngye nyaho nu nyin .
gama n gye yi ɓei ɓa pwo ntu n na awyidna bwa shi ɓo .
kristi to ɓei ɓa shan fin . n aye awo-cei-anyi avun , ma , jeze lo urushelima n gnisun n barnabas yi n titus yi .

kristi to ɓei ɓa shan fin .
a wyidna ta mi nza gnim o , a galatiyayi , aza tna cei .
nyikadonu na dna fye kwoce ye , woi zhin fye ɓo n sun layiʼa ?
gama fye ɓei zhin fyei gye yesu kristi efi pei-pei , n gye ma wufe hoto n yesu yi tu woi fi tu n zundu .
miye ma nya fye ɓo gmanyi , fye ɓei gwo zafun gyi-gyi-yi ntu n na awyidna bwashi ɓo nu ? awo , gama zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓei ɓe fye mi , fyei ku kristi ɓo wo , fyei ku wo ga gaiciya ntu ge wa gni fye .
fye ku je a cinu ?
gama dnan na a tnazhin ge fya shi a yuhudiyi awyidna bwa , fye to bwa wye-wyeyi zafun nyan n kmisunyi n , fye zhin nubo n wuna nu ge oɓa bwashi nsaiye nu ɓa zhin fya ze a yesu viyi a kalada ?
fye ku wahala sin n mwa ntu n nabari manayi ɓo .
fye ye fya ya kwo nu nsayi ?
kwo dnami ɓelo ma gace gaiciya .
ma nya fye ɓo njesun , shekwoyi wa ga fye zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko wa zhin aɓo a wo-woyi n fya ba ntuge fye shi a yahudiyi awyidna nu bwa ?
awo , ceto wolo nun , kwo nyi nsa nu fya ga kristi gaiciya fya kpema wo .
ibrahim ɓei bwa zhin n lonu .
shekwoyi ɓei gna ge wo kunce lo wa lo she ntuge wo ɓei ga shekwoyi alkawali gaiciyanu .
fye gye deye , nge ibrahim aɓi a hin-hin vinya ɓa nu zhin aza nɓa ga shekwoyi gaiciya ɓai kpema wo cewo .
knido nu shan sun a ?
littafi ɓei shi esa ye nu awye n shekwoyi ɓa gni abyedo ntu ɓa gaiciya ga ɓo .
shekwoyi ɓei ku ce gna ibrahim tunyi n sapai ge , miɓa tu aza anabarka nɓa fi n kni doho-doho n ɓa gami gaiciya , shi fye gami nyi . kwo wulonu , aza n ɓa ga kristi gaiciya ɓa bwa anabarka shi ibrahim ɓei bwa nyi .
e , aza n ɓa kpema a yahudiyi awyidna ɓa gni ɓa , ɓa filo n shekwoyi knitu sinta gama litafi a ku da pei-pei , ekni n za tukwo n wa bma owa ye ya , n kwo kafi n shekwoyi littafi owa nya nyi . a ku wuyi pei-pei ge , za to lo n wo ɓa bwa shekwoyi alheri ntuge wo shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwan , ntuge shekwoyi ku luda ge zokwo n yi ɓa bwa gni-gni , konu zhin gaiciya ga .
shi anabi habaku ɓei da nge , oza n wa bwa wye-wyei , wo ɓa bwa ko dna n gaiciya ga nu n shekwoyi . gaiciya ga zokwo wulo gbo n na wyidna zokwoyi , n kwo gna nge a gni za n wa shi shekwoyi awyidna bwa vinya , to woi bma ko gmanyi yan .
ama kristi n la yi si , woi layi kunya n zokwo ɓednayi ye , woi la yi knitu ɓenukwoyi zhinya tu n wohin tukwo .
gama a cei kafi n littafi .
knitu n za ba n na zun wo du tu n shinwa . shi a ɓei zun yesu du tu n zundu shinwa nya nyi .
shekwoyi alkawali nu gyi nabye nsaiye , shekwoyi ɓa tu abyedo anabarka , n anabarka yi n wo ɓei zhin ibrahim alkawali nyi , eyi vinya n yi zhin a kristi viyi , yi ɓa bwa zafun gyi-gyi-yi n na zhin yi wo alkawali nyi , ntu gaiciya ga ye ɓo .
emi azaje ye-yei kwo dna n yi asese mi , esa oza ku alkawali zhin zado aku kwo ka , a bwatu , wota shan kwo don , wota shan nubo zhin n na vun wa shan kwo don .
nsaiye , shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim alkawali o wo ɓiyi , waku kpe nge ato cige owo aɓin ngye a daɓo n wo aɓiyi vinyan a yahudiyi ama aɓei daɓo ga wo ɓi wato kristi .
nya nyi n mi da .
shekwoyi ɓei zhin alkawali nge wo ɓa gni aza n ɓa ga gaiciya , waku kwo kakpe , wa bwa tu , ato ɓei ɓa mi a shan kwo do kwo a wun kwo ya n aye tagyi ngun anyi-cei-kpe shita avun , n shekwoyi ɓei ga awyidna ngun awo nyin .
ngye awyidna yi bwashi ɓei ɓa gni yi , kwa wunu ge zokwo do nu gbo n za ɓa bwa shekwoyi alheri n ibrahim nyayi .
ntuge wo ɓei gwo shekwoyi alkawali nu kawai .
to , knihi ɓo zhin a ga awyidna yeʼa ?
a ɓei ɓe ɓa n na alkawali avun nu , kwa wu aza shi ɓa bma shekwoyi awyidna ya .
ama zokwo ye ɓei ɓe har esanu n kristi ɓa ɓe n cei , eɓi n shekwoyi ɓei zhin kwo alkawali ( ko kaka yi lo fyewyi , shekwoyi ɓei ga wo amalaika nu owo awyidna ɓa ga musa wa ka za ga . ) ama esa n shekwoyi ɓei ga ibrahim owo alkawali wo ɓei ga wo n wo gmanyi nu , a malaika ko musa to ɓei zhi ɓon .
zaho to ɓei dna n ɓa tasin .
to , shekwoyi awyidna nwo alkawaliyi ɓa zhin gaba lo n na ajei nu ?
awo , kwo to wolo nun .
yi ɓei gna yi ɓa bwa gni-gni n na awyidna bwashi ɓo , shekwoyi to ɓei ɓa shan zokwo do ga n kwo ɓa gni yi n laifi akun .
ntuge littafi ku da ge , yi zhin laifi afyenu nu vinya .
zokwo gmanyi n yi ɓa kun nkwo , okwonu zhin gaiciya ga n yesu kristi .
zokwo pwo-pwo nya guya gni lo ntu oza ɓo n wo ɓa ga gaiciya .
sai esa n kristi ɓei ɓe , owa nu ɓei zhin yi guyi , kwoi kai wye har sa n yi ɓa ga anyi gniyi gaiciya .
mi ɓa dakwo lai , a yahudiyi owa nu ɓei zhin yi nyawuyi kwoi wuyi zokwo sai sa n kristi wa ɓe wa gayi agni-gni manayi n shekwoyi abye dna n yi gaiciya ga .
ama shi kristi la ɓe nyi , yito n na pma yi lo n owa yin , kwa wu yi zokwo lo wo abam .
gama nsaiye yi zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu , dna n gaiciya ga n yesu kristi .
eyi n na kuyi zhin baptisma fi n kristi nyi , akuyi sofi n kristi mi .
yi to shan a yahudiyi nu zhin , kwo a heleniyi , kwo a fyenu , kwo a puwa dan , kwo a zanugbayi kwo anyikwozan , ama a yesu viyi , yi zhin gmanyi nu dna n kristi yesu .
nsaiye she yi ku zhin kristi nya nyi , yi ku ze ibrahim ayawyi .
shekwoyi alkawali n wo ɓei zhin wo nyi ɓa zhin yi nya nu n sayi .
o , a galatiyayi , aza tna cei .
nyikadonu na dna fye kwoce ye , woi zhin fye ɓo n sun layiʼa ?
gama fye ɓei zhin fyei gye yesu kristi efi pei-pei , n gye ma wufe hoto n yesu yi tu woi fi tu n zundu .
miye ma nya fye ɓo gmanyi , fye ɓei gwo zafun gyi-gyi-yi ntu n na awyidna bwashi ɓo nu ? awo , gama zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓei ɓe fye mi , fyei ku kristi ɓo wo , fyei ku wo ga gaiciya ntu ge wa gni fye .
fye ku je a cinu ?
gama dnan na a tnazhin ge fya shi a yuhudiyi awyidna bwa , fye to bwa wye-wyeyi zafun nyan n kmisunyi n , fye zhin nubo n wuna nu ge oɓa bwashi nsaiye nu ɓa zhin fya ze a yesu viyi a kalada ?
fye ku wahala sin n mwa ntu n nabari manayi ɓo .
fye ye fya ya kwo nu nsayi ?
kwo dnami ɓelo ma gace gaiciya .
ma nya fye ɓo njesun , shekwoyi wa ga fye zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko wa zhin aɓo a wo-woyi n fya ba ntuge fye shi a yahudiyi awyidna nu bwa ?
awo , ceto wolo nun , kwo nyi nsa nu fya ga kristi gaiciya fya kpema wo .
ibrahim ɓei bwa zhin n lonu .
shekwoyi ɓei gna ge wo kunce lo wa lo she ntuge wo ɓei ga shekwoyi alkawali gaiciyanu .
fye gye deye , nge ibrahim aɓi a hin-hin vinya ɓa nu zhin aza nɓa ga shekwoyi gaiciya ɓai kpema wo cewo .
knido nu shan sun a ?

ama fye pa ge n za dada fi , wafa nyabwa dnagmayi ya zhi wo ɓi , n woto mwan , ɓihi to du fyenu lon , sai wola mwa koda-yake , anya vinya n wo dada ɓei fa nyi ɓa zhin wa nyanu .
tile wa zhin ɓo n wa guyi a gna wo ge wo zhin , sai wo la si ʼye n wo dada ɓei da .
shekwoyi nu na lo yi ya kwo ɓei wu lonu n yi-i kafin kristi wo ɓe , yi ɓei zhin a yahudiyi awyidna , n na ɓo kni yi afyenu nu , ntuge yi ɓei gye ge ɓa ɓa mi ɓa gni yi nu .
ama sa n sa manayi ɓo la si , sa n shekwoyi ɓei kni , wa tnu n wo nugun yi n nyikwoza ba , n na yahudiyi mi .
wa si lo-loya gayi n yi ɓei zhin kwo afyenu nyi , n nabai wa zeyi wa ʼɓi .
ntuge yi zhin wa ʼɓi nu , shekwoyi la tnu n wo nugun zafun yi n yi abugba mi , ntu cenu yi ɓa mi ya yi shekwoyi ge eyi dada ye-ye yi .
yito ye shan a bara nu zhin , ama shekwoyi aɓi .
shi yi zhin wa ʼɓi nu nyi , nya wo cei vinya kwo zhin yi nya nu , gama nya nu shekwoyi wa zhin shiri .
kafin ofye abyedo fye kpe shekwoyi ye , fye ɓei zhin ashan afyenu nu n ɓa to n wye-wyei nyin .
ama nsaiye shi fyela shekwoyi bwa nyi ( ko miɓa cige shekwoyi nku fye bwa ) ko ɓa zhin wuna nu fya jeze n na vunyi , fya ze afyenu n jesun nya aba n kwo to n kalayin , wyekwoyi , adini n kwo to na pmayi n , fyei zhin a tna fya lo she ntu owa bwashi ɓo ?
fye zhin atna fya bwa shekwoyi agmada n nya yi n fye zhin , kwo nfye ta zhin m , n na anyipyeyi hoyi , ko apya ho , ko ayeho yi m .
edna wo mi lo ntu fye ɓo .
edna wo mi lo , kwo emi tnu-tnu vinya n fya ba ɓa ze gbeloyi .
bulus bugba zhi-zhiyi omi azaje ye-yeyi , a wo mi lo ngye fye ku ze ngye mi , fya wo shi a wo mi lo tu aɓeye tukwo , gama mi kni-kniyi lo n na agma ye shi fye ɓei kni-kniyi nyi .
fye to ɓei ci mi wyegba esa n mi ɓei kmi fye waʼazi zhin nyi m .
ko dayake , nyasan ɓei san mi esa n mi ɓei kmi fye ɓe n nabari manayi kristi nya yi nyi .
ko da shike emi nyasan ɓei dami n fyei fye to ɓei nami aɓo fya nya mi yan .
awo , fye ɓei lami fya zhin mi ɓo ngye shekwoyi malaika ko ngye yesu kristi n wohin .
zafun agmada nya gni na n yi i ɓei gni bwa nyi a ?
gama mi kpe lo n na anyipyei hi fye ɓei ɓa kun fya wye n na agmadai fya ga mi fye ɓei gna fya gye kwo n bmazhinyi n ma ba .
nsaiye , mila ze fye nunɓayi nu , shi ma gna fye gaiciya .
a malami a katai n ɓa ye fye n tu n fye nyabwa ɓo nu nyi , ɓata zhin ce ntu fye bmazhin ɓo nun .
nya n ɓa zhin atna ɓa zhin nyi , ɓa ye ɓa ka fye ya n minu , n na bai fya wo ɓanu .
kwo zhin ɓemana nu aza ye fye , n ɓa ye fye n na bugba manayi n bugbayi gmanyi , ngye ɓata ye fye ntuge mi kunsun lo nfyei nun .
o , emi aɓi , fye knimi cilo , mi gni miyi gye azhin shi gye n ɓiya zhi wa gye , woi pmi wa ma ɓi nyi .
mi-i pmi sa n na ɓei nu fye n kristi yi nyi .
awo mi lo ngye miye gnilo n fyei to ma shan ɓeda layin , ama ntu na ba kpa mwa ɓo layi , mita kpe ɓeye lo n mi ɓa zhin .
fye wo mi ɓeda , efye a nugundo n fye zhin nubo ge , sai za shi awyidna bwanu za pwo nyi , knido nu zhin to fyei ɓa nya awyidna ye awyega ɓon ma ?
gama a cei kafi , ibrahim ɓei n na ɓiyi ngun aba , gmanyi owo nyiko bara ɓi , gmanyi owo nyikwo la-layi ʼɓi .
nyaho to lo n kwo zhin nukwoyi lo n owo nyikwo bara ɓiyin .
ama aɓo ma nyikwo la-layi ɓi n shekwoyi alkawali avun nu ge wo ɓa tnu n woi .
nsaiye , nabari gaiciya nya ye zhin yi misali nu n shekwoyi a zokwoyi n gun aba n wo bma za zhin .
wo ɓei zhin ce n sinai pe sanu n wo ɓei ga musa awyidna ngun awo .
a larabawa yi sinai pe nge hajaratu pe ; dna n mi misali , ibrahim nyikwo bara ɓi zhin urushelima nu , a yahudiyi yi nɓa vi zokwoyi nyi ɓanu zhin bara ɓi .
amaeyi zhimi zhin urushelima eshe nya nu , kwoi to zhin a yahudiyi aɓo kni fyenu nun .
nyanu n ishaya ɓei da sanu n wo ɓei zhin anabci ncei ge , nsaiye fye ɓa mi fya dagma .
lama , ho ɓa fi aku n na agmadai koda yake hoto shin ʼɓi man .
ntuge miye ma ga ho aɓi nu n mwa begye , ndu do n ho nyikwo-fyenu ɓei n cei . efye n miyi , emi azaje , eyi nu zhin aɓi n shekwoyi ɓei zhin alkawali , shi wo ɓei zhin ishaku nya nyi .
ntu cenu , eyi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi la yi ma nyi , yi sin wahala n aza kun n ɓa ye ya shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa nyi .
she ishaku oɓi alkawali nya bei sin wahala n smailu akun n wo nu ɓo zhin fyenu nyikwo-ɓi nyi .
ama littafi a da ge , shekwoyi ɓei gna ibrahim ge , wo la fyenu-nyikwo n wo eɓi yi nyaya , ntu ge fyenu-nyikwo ɓi ta gyi ibrahim puwa gado n kni gado yi n gnisun n nyikwo la-layi ʼɓi yin .
emi azaje , yito zhin afyenu aɓinun , n yi ɓa vi a yahudiyi awyidnan , ama nyikwo la-layi aɓi nu , aza a gwo-gwoi n shekwoyi aba ntu gaiciyaga ɓo .
ama fye pa ge n za dada fi , wafa nyabwa dnagmayi ya zhi wo ɓi , n woto mwan , ɓihi to du fyenu lon , sai wola mwa koda-yake , anya vinya n wo dada ɓei fa nyi ɓa zhin wa nyanu .
tile wa zhin ɓo n wa guyi a gna wo ge wo zhin , sai wo la si ʼye n wo dada ɓei da .
kwo ɓei wu lonu n yi-i kafin kristi wo ɓe , yi ɓei zhin a yahudiyi awyidna , n na ɓo kni yi afyenu nu , ntuge yi ɓei gye ge ɓa ɓa mi ɓa gni yi nu .

o , emi aɓi , fye knimi cilo , mi gni miyi gye azhin shi gye n ɓiya zhi wa gye , woi pmi wa ma ɓi nyi .
mi-i pmi sa n na ɓei nu fye n kristi yi nyi .
awo mi lo ngye miye gnilo n fyei to ma shan ɓeda layin , ama ntu na ba kpa mwa ɓo layi , mita kpe ɓeye lo n mi ɓa zhin .
fye wo mi ɓeda , efye a nugundo n fye zhin nubo ge , sai za shi awyidna bwanu za pwo nyi , knido nu zhin to fyei ɓa nya awyidna ye awyega ɓon ma ?
gama a cei kafi , ibrahim ɓei n na ɓiyi ngun aba , gmanyi owo nyiko bara ɓi , gmanyi owo nyikwo la-layi ʼɓi .
nyaho to lo n kwo zhin nukwoyi lo n owo nyikwo bara ɓiyin .
ama aɓo ma nyikwo la-layi ɓi n shekwoyi alkawali avun nu ge wo ɓa tnu n woi .
nsaiye , nabari gaiciya nya ye zhin yi misali nu n shekwoyi a zokwoyi n gun aba n wo bma za zhin .
wo ɓei zhin ce n sinai pe sanu n wo ɓei ga musa awyidna ngun awo .
a larabawa yi sinai pe nge hajaratu pe ; dna n mi misali , ibrahim nyikwo bara ɓi zhin urushelima nu , a yahudiyi yi nɓa vi zokwoyi nyi ɓanu zhin bara ɓi .
amaeyi zhimi zhin urushelima eshe nya nu , kwoi to zhin a yahudiyi aɓo kni fyenu nun .
nyanu n ishaya ɓei da sanu n wo ɓei zhin anabci ncei ge , nsaiye fye ɓa mi fya dagma .
lama , ho ɓa fi aku n na agmadai koda yake hoto shin ʼɓi man .
ntuge miye ma ga ho aɓi nu n mwa begye , ndu do n ho nyikwo-fyenu ɓei n cei . efye n miyi , emi azaje , eyi nu zhin aɓi n shekwoyi ɓei zhin alkawali , shi wo ɓei zhin ishaku nya nyi .
ntu cenu , eyi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi la yi ma nyi , yi sin wahala n aza kun n ɓa ye ya shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa nyi .
she ishaku oɓi alkawali nya bei sin wahala n smailu akun n wo nu ɓo zhin fyenu nyikwo-ɓi nyi .
ama littafi a da ge , shekwoyi ɓei gna ibrahim ge , wo la fyenu-nyikwo n wo eɓi yi nyaya , ntu ge fyenu-nyikwo ɓi ta gyi ibrahim puwa gado n kni gado yi n gnisun n nyikwo la-layi ʼɓi yin .
emi azaje , yito zhin afyenu aɓinun , n yi ɓa vi a yahudiyi awyidnan , ama nyikwo la-layi aɓi nu , aza a gwo-gwoi n shekwoyi aba ntu gaiciyaga ɓo .
kristi ku yi ze aza lo-loiya ntu cenu , kristi la yi loya .
fye ku kpe ɓehin-hin , ge fye filo n yanci ye to fya je fyehin pa fi n na yahudiyi aɓokni n na knunu yin .
fye kna tnubua , ntuge ɓeye zhin ɓo dnagmai nu , ngye fye ye kpe lo n kaciya zhin nu n na yahudiyi awyidna bwa shi yi nu ɓa ze fya aza manayi n shekwoyi abye , agye kristi ta mi wa gni fyen .
mi ɓa je ce da , oza n wa zhin atna wa bwa shekwoyi bugba da ntu n kaciya ɓo n na yahudiyi awyidna bwashi yi tile wa vi ɓa ɓo kni vinya kwo kuwa wa bwi .
kristi to n na pmayi lo nfye aba n , ndei fye gye ge fye ɓa ku ta zo shekwoyi gbanu kpa n na wyidna bwa-shi yin ; fye ku bwi n shekwoyi alheri aba .
ama , dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi bma-zhin yi kpe ma kristi ʼfi nu , wa kuyi alaifi ya , wa ze yi aza manayi n shekwoyi aba .
eyi , n kristi la wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya gayi nyi , yi to n na apmai lo ya damu kwo yi kaciya yi zhin lon , ko yi shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa lon , ntuge nya n yi ye kwonu zhin gaiciya ga tnu-tnu dna n ye-ye .
fye ɓei zan-zan cewo , nykado nu la ɓo dna fye do , to fyei ɓa shan gaiciya vi ma ?
shekwoyi nu to wu fye lonun , ntuge owo nu na yi fye woi lo fye ya dna kristi .
ama zanukwoyi gmanyi nu , n fye mi n wa wun fye ya . mi kpe ma dagayi nu wa je fye ze ɓe cei , fya vi a ɓeye shi mi vnyi .
shekwoyi ɓa zhin n zahi yi , kwo nyikadona n wo dami n fyei woi dna fye kwoce nyi .
azaho gnalo ge , mi zhin kaciya , n na yahudiyi awyidna yi waʼazi lo , nge ɓa zhin ɓe shi-shi-yi nu n gni-gni zokwo .
to , ngye mi zhin cenu waʼazi , ata shan mi wahala gan , ntuge waʼazi ye ta kni zaho-zahoi bugban .
wahala n na ga mi nyi kwa wu nu ge , mi zhin gni-gni dna n gaiciya ga n kristi zundu gmanyi nu waʼazi .
mi cei pma lo , a malami nɓa dami n fyei nge fye sa fye nayi ya n kaciya yi , ɓa ɓa ka n fye to ɓaye zhin dmi n fyei m .
emazaje , ala loloya ga fye , to ge loloya fya zhin ɓenukwo yin , ama loloya fya ye na jei fya bma je zhin .
gama owa vinya dna n wyidna gmanyi ye , fye ye na zajei , shi fye ye n fyehin tukwoyi , ama ndei maimakon fye wu ye-ye , fye ce fyei wu anya n na jei , fyei wun aje nu , fye zhin peceiye .
fye zhin peceiye n na jebwi yi .
vi zafun ɓo mi ga fye shaula , fye vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓowu nu , wo ɓa gna fye aba nfye ɓa lo n nyai n fye ɓa zhin , n lonu fye ta zhin ɓenukwoyi zhin nfye nayi nukwoyi ye fya zhin .
gama yi gna ye ya zhin ɓo n yi nayi a gnayi ge yi zhin , gbo n nyai n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ye ya zhin .
anya manayi n zafun ye ya zhin ɓa wu gbo n nyai n nayi ye ya zhin .
anya deye ngun aba n ɓafi n yi nayi nyi , ɓa sunkun na jei n na bai ɓa gyi nasara n yi tukwo , ɓai gna ya ɓomwi gna-gna .
sanu zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa wu fye zokwo fye to n apmai lo fyavi a yahudiyi aɓeknin .
ama nfya vi fyehin ɓeye , fye ɓa zhin aɓenukwoyi ye , aɓonubozhin nukwoyi , shakpe nukwoyi aɓo awyeda nya .
shangba , alijanu bauta zhin , aza wyegbaci n ɓa to zhin honyan , nuwun n gusun yi , eshe n minagyi yi , n atnazhin yi .
eshe anya pwawo nya , zawu , jesin , n na wyefan kasa yi , n na ɓe deye pyai vinya .
ma gna fye njesun shi mi ɓei shin fye gna , oza n wo zhin aɓeye vinya wo ta lo shekwoyi bemin .
ama , n zafun gyi-gyi-yi nu gyi be tu n yi tukwo wo ɓa ɓe n na aɓeye pyai n yi mi .
yeye , bugba-buyi , bugba fu , hakuri azaye n cei ɓemana zhin .
ɓefyece , zawanshi , peceiye .
aɓeye vinya ta zhin gaba lo na yahudiyi aɓeknin yin .
aza nɓa zhin kristi nya ɓa ku nayi zundu n kwa shakpei vinyan kpe nwo zundu .
n yi sase lo nsaiyei n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko yi , yi vi zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓowun n yi asese vinya .
nnavun yi ta shan mwa-mwa zanshin akpeyiye na za ba nkwo ɓe nshewo yi nyim .
ntu cenu , kristi la yi loya .
fye ku kpe ɓehin-hin , ge fye filo n yanci ye to fya je fyehin pa fi n na yahudiyi aɓokni n na knunu yin .

zaho-zahoi la tabata ge wo zihn hakuri lo n ɓemana zhin , n na bai nu n wo ɓa bwa bugba da , to wa zhin atna wa mwi wohin do n zado yin .

aza n na wuɓa shekwoyi ɓeda kow bimya ɓa bma ʼɓa malami zhin ɓa gba wo .
fye to gmi bugba yam fye to ye a dna fye kwocen , fye pa , hota ya shekwoyi na vun yi fya bwa lafiya n .
oza ɓa bwa nyanu do nwa bye .
nwa bye ge wa fu wohin aɓo pwawo nukwoyi bugba nu , wo ɓo bye nyabye nukwoyi nu , woi ɓo do nya ɓwodo zafun nya n ʼfiyi .
ama nwa bye nyabye manayi zafun nya wo ɓa do wye-wyei nyalo-nyalo nya .
n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓa gawo .
ato ɓeyi n ɓemana zhin yin , gma safyewyi yi ɓa do anabarka n yi to bma bugbaya ya fan .
cenu zhin esa vinya n yi ɓami ya bma aza zhin , tun ba ga eyi a yesu viyi aje .
miɓa kma ɓedaye ka n mi abwayi fye gye shi mi kanya nsun-sun .
ofye amalami hi nɓa zhin atna ɓa zhin fye fya zhin kaciya nyi , ɓa zhin lonu ntu n nya gmanyi ɓo nu : n na bai n na ɓa kpeɓa ye , to ɓa sin wahala ɓai ya ye ge kristi zundu gmanyi nu gni azan .

ntu ge n zundu aba nu emi shakpe anyi da nya ɓei la duya tunyi n sapa , anyi ɓoda n kwo dna-mi nyi ɓola fi .
kwo to shan do lo m , kwo ai ya zhin yi kaciya ko to ai zhin yin , oɓo dnagmayi gmanyi kwonu ge , kwo alai shan ma , yi ku ze aza woi-woi .
shekwoyi sun-sungye n bugba fuyi ɓa kunsun n fyei , nfye wan zokwoye na zayi nɓa zhin shekwoyi a nya na baho-bahoi vinya .

omi azaje ye-yei , eyi dagayi yesu kristi alheri ɓa kunsun n fyei vinya .

omi azaje ye-yei , eyi dagayi yesu kristi alheri ɓa kunsun n fyei vinya .
eyi anugundo a yesu viyi n fye fi n afisusu , fyei vi dagayi ɓo cici nyi , miɓi fye gna lo .
bulus nu ka ga fye , n shekwoyi wa kniwo wa ze yesu kristi tnu-tnuyi nyi .
fa owo anabarka n bugba fuyi ɓa ze fye nya , n shekwoyi eyi dada tnu n cei n yesu kristi eyi dagayi nyi .
yi ci shekwoyi lo , eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada n wa tuyi anabarka n anabarka doho-dohoi n shemi , ntuge yi zhin kristi a nya nu .
shekwoyi shiri dnagmayi tunyi n sapa , to ai zhin anyi n , shekwoyi wa kni yi n na bai ya ze wo nya , ntuge wa zeyi aza agyi-gyiyi n wo awyeba , ntna laifi , eyi n yi gni-agni zhi n wo abye n wo ye-yei pwi .
owo shiri , tna do shanyi nu nyi wa ze yi owo aɓi , cenu a zhin wa tnu yesu kristi yi wafi ntu yi ɓo .
wa zhin ce ntuge wo ɓei n cei pma nu .
mwa-mwa n shekwoyi aba ntu n wo alheri ɓo n wo ye-yei nwa zeya puyi , ntuge yi zhin owo nugun ye-ye yi aɓi nu .
owo alheri mwa lo n yi aba har wa eyi alaifi kuya n wo nugun ami yi , oza n wa gni yi nyi .
woi la owo alheri mwa-mwayi ze kpeyi .
gama wo kpeyi ye lo sarai n nya yi n kwo gna bmiya ntu yi ɓo n sayi vinya .
shekwoyi ku owo asiri wu yi nkwo ɓei so shi , dalili n wa tnu n kristi yi , enya n wa zhin shiri dna n sun-sun gye tunyi n sapa .
owo nufi nu nyi , nge sanu nsa lasi wo ɓa yei zhi n gnisun , aba n yi nyi vinya n eshe kwo n anyi , ya gnisun n woi dna kristi nyalo-nyalo .
ntu nya ɓo n kristi n ku zhin , yi ku ze a cauta n shekwoyi aba n ɓa da wo agma , gama dna n shekwoyi shiri wo ɓei kni yi tunyi n sapa , aɓo vinya ɓei zhin shiwo ɓo zhin shiri nu .
shekwoyi ɓeye vinya kwonu ge ya la shekwoyi tu , ya gawo mwa-mwa ntu n na aɓo a yakwo ye nwa zhin yi nyi , n yi zhin aza kmisunyi n ɓa ga kristi gaiciya nyi .
ntu nya ɓo n kristi wa zhin nyi , ofye vinya ce n fya wo nabari manayi shi oza ɓa pwo , fya ga kristi gaiciya nyi , a tufye eze n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ge fye zhin kristi nya nu , oza n na ɓei zhin wo alkawali ga a yesu viyi nyi .
owo ase-se n yi mi zhin shekwoyi tuze nu ge , wo ɓa gayi anya vinya n wa zhin yi alkawali , zafun ase-se n yi mi wuyi ge shekwoyi la yi lu si , wa ɓe yi n wohin tukwo aba , dalili nyi n jesun n kwo ɓa zhin ya ci yi shekwoyi .
cenu zhin , tunyi esa n mi ɓei wo fye gaiciya ga ɓo dna n dagayi yesu , n ye-yei nfye wu a yesu viyi n nna aba vinya nyi .
mito fa shekwoyi godiya zhinɓo ntu fye ɓon .
mi zhin fye aduwa n esai vinya mi-i nya shekwoyi , dagayi yesu kristi dada , wa ga fye ɓeyekpe , fya gye dei-dei , fya bwa awyega kwo nyikado nu zhin kristi a , n na aɓei vinya n wo ku zhin fye nyi .
mi zhin aduwa , n na bai of ye abugba ɓa bwa buzangna , n na bai nfye ɓa gye nya wye n na bye , n wo yi fye fya gni nya bwa n wo yi nyi .
miye fya kpe ge shekwoyi la ze nyabwai , ntu ge eyi n yi zhin kristi a nya nyi aku yi gawo .
mi zhin aduwa ge fye ɓa ya awyega bwa , shi owo iko nyi ge kwa bma aza zhin nu nɓa gawo gaiciya .
iko dnagmayi ye nu bwa jesun n kwo ɓei la kristi kala n efi , kwa se wo ase tu n shekwoyi bwai-zhe-bwa n eshe .
ndu esu doho-dohoi , kwo abegyiyi doho-dohoi .
e , owo mwamwa du zaho-zahoi nya lo , n na anyi ye kwo anyi do n ɓaye ɓeɓelo nyi .
shekwoyi ku anya fi n wo apita sinta woi lawo ze tukwoda ikklisiya nya vinya .
nkwo zhin wo nayi nyi n nu-nuyi n wohin tukwoyi tukwoda n nyagayi doho-dohoi nya , abaho-bahoi .
eyi anugundo a yesu viyi n fye fi n afisusu , fyei vi dagayi ɓo cici nyi , miɓi fye gna lo .
bulus nu ka ga fye , n shekwoyi wa kniwo wa ze yesu kristi tnu-tnuyi nyi .
fa owo anabarka n bugba fuyi ɓa ze fye nya , n shekwoyi eyi dada tnu n cei n yesu kristi eyi dagayi nyi .
yi ci shekwoyi lo , eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada n wa tuyi anabarka n anabarka doho-dohoi n shemi , ntuge yi zhin kristi a nya nu .
tunyi n sapa , to ai zhin anyi n , shekwoyi wa kni yi n na bai ya ze wo nya , ntuge wa zeyi aza agyi-gyiyi n wo awyeba , ntna laifi , eyi n yi gni-agni zhi n wo abye n wo ye-yei pwi .
owo shiri , tna do shanyi nu nyi wa ze yi owo aɓi , cenu a zhin wa tnu yesu kristi yi wafi ntu yi ɓo .
wa zhin ce ntuge wo ɓei n cei pma nu .
mwa-mwa n shekwoyi aba ntu n wo alheri ɓo n wo ye-yei nwa zeya puyi , ntuge yi zhin owo nugun ye-ye yi aɓi nu .
owo alheri mwa lo n yi aba har wa eyi alaifi kuya n wo nugun ami yi , oza n wa gni yi nyi .
woi la owo alheri mwa-mwayi ze kpeyi .
gama wo kpeyi ye lo sarai n nya yi n kwo gna bmiya ntu yi ɓo n sayi vinya .
shekwoyi ku owo asiri wu yi nkwo ɓei so shi , dalili n wa tnu n kristi yi , enya n wa zhin shiri dna n sun-sun gye tunyi n sapa .
owo nufi nu nyi , nge sanu nsa lasi wo ɓa yei zhi n gnisun , aba n yi nyi vinya n eshe kwo n anyi , ya gnisun n woi dna kristi nyalo-nyalo .
ntu nya ɓo n kristi n ku zhin , yi ku ze a cauta n shekwoyi aba n ɓa da wo agma , gama dna n shekwoyi shiri wo ɓei kni yi tunyi n sapa , aɓo vinya ɓei zhin shiwo ɓo zhin shiri nu .
shekwoyi ɓeye vinya kwonu ge ya la shekwoyi tu , ya gawo mwa-mwa ntu n na aɓo a yakwo ye nwa zhin yi nyi , n yi zhin aza kmisunyi n ɓa ga kristi gaiciya nyi .
ntu nya ɓo n kristi wa zhin nyi , ofye vinya ce n fya wo nabari manayi shi oza ɓa pwo , fya ga kristi gaiciya nyi , a tufye eze n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ge fye zhin kristi nya nu , oza n na ɓei zhin wo alkawali ga a yesu viyi nyi .
owo ase-se n yi mi zhin shekwoyi tuze nu ge , wo ɓa gayi anya vinya n wa zhin yi alkawali , zafun ase-se n yi mi wuyi ge shekwoyi la yi lu si , wa ɓe yi n wohin tukwo aba , dalili nyi n jesun n kwo ɓa zhin ya ci yi shekwoyi .
cenu zhin , tunyi esa n mi ɓei wo fye gaiciya ga ɓo dna n dagayi yesu , n ye-yei nfye wu a yesu viyi n nna aba vinya nyi .
mito fa shekwoyi godiya zhinɓo ntu fye ɓon .
mi zhin fye aduwa n esai vinya mi-i nya shekwoyi , dagayi yesu kristi dada , wa ga fye ɓeyekpe , fya gye dei-dei , fya bwa awyega kwo nyikado nu zhin kristi a , n na aɓei vinya n wo ku zhin fye nyi .
mi zhin aduwa , n na bai of ye abugba ɓa bwa buzangna , n na bai nfye ɓa gye nya wye n na bye , n wo yi fye fya gni nya bwa n wo yi nyi .
miye fya kpe ge shekwoyi la ze nyabwai , ntu ge eyi n yi zhin kristi a nya nyi aku yi gawo .
mi zhin aduwa ge fye ɓa ya awyega bwa , shi owo iko nyi ge kwa bma aza zhin nu nɓa gawo gaiciya .
iko dnagmayi ye nu bwa jesun n kwo ɓei la kristi kala n efi , kwa se wo ase tu n shekwoyi bwai-zhe-bwa n eshe .
ndu esu doho-dohoi , kwo abegyiyi doho-dohoi .
e , owo mwamwa du zaho-zahoi nya lo , n na anyi ye kwo anyi do n ɓaye ɓeɓelo nyi .
shekwoyi ku anya fi n wo apita sinta woi lawo ze tukwoda ikklisiya nya vinya .
nkwo zhin wo nayi nyi n nu-nuyi n wohin tukwoyi tukwoda n nyagayi doho-dohoi nya , abaho-bahoi .
sapai nsayiye-yi nsa dohoi fye ɓei fi n shekwoyi knitu sinta , n zunkni zhi nyalonyalo ntu n fye alaifi ɓo .
fye ɓei gni zan-zan n begye yi , n gye azaje , n nu-nuyi n na laifiyi , fyei zhin satan ɓeye , esu dnagmayi anyi bmana nya , n wo zhin tnu-tnu lo n saiye n na aza bugba , n ɓa zhin gaba n dagayi nyi .
yi ɓei wu lo nu n sapai , eyi ase-se yi wu enya n kwo dna n yi mi , yi zhin aɓo nukwoyi doho-hohoyi shi eyi a shakpe , kwo eyi a nubo zhin nukwoyi gnayi .
yi ɓei ya n tna bmiya yi shi a ɓei mayi n nayi nukwoyi , nfi n shekwoyi minagyi sinta ngye zaho-zahoi .
ama shekwoyi n sun-sun gye mwa , wa yeyi n mwa .
kwo da yake , yi ɓei fi-fiyi n zafun , akni zun yi ntu eyi alaifi ɓo , wa ga yi eyi a wye-wyei n jesun esanu n wo ɓei la kristi kala n efi , ntu n wo ye-ye ɓo nu yi ku gni-gni bwa .
wa kuyi kala n vingwo fi n mwa-mwa n gnisun n kristi yi .
aba n yi sase n gnisun n woi n eshe mi , ntu nya ɓo n yesu kristi ɓei zhin nyi .
nsaiye shekwoyi ɓa mi wa wuyi misali shi wo alheri mwa , n gye shi wa wuyi dna n nya n wa zhin gayi , dna n yesu kristi nyi .
ntu n wo alheri ɓo ala fye gni , n tu gefya ga kristi gaiciya , gaiciya ga n kwo nyi kwo to zhin efye nya nu n , kwo zhin shekwoyi cauta nu n wa ga fye .
gni-gni to zhin lada , ntu ɓemana zhin ɓo nun , n ya zhin n ntu cenu , zaho-zahoi to kunce lo a sawo ami da cen .
shekwoyi nu na zhin yi , yi ze anya n yi ku ze n saiye nyi , woi gayi wye-wyeyi dna n kristi yesu .
tunyi n sapa nu n wa zhin shiri ye , ntu ge ya bma azaje zhin dna n wye-wyeyi ye , n yi la bwa nyi .
fye to ze amwi n ge nsapai fye ɓei zhin aza nu n tna kaciya , a yahudiyi ɓai yi fye ge aza nɓa ta wo shekwoyi dnan , aza tna gyi-gyi ( ama oɓa bugba ce , ɓei ye tu cegye koda yake ɓa ɓei zhin ɓai zhin aɓo ngye a shekwoyi dnawo yi , gama ɓa ɓei zhin ɓai zhin kaciya , tuze nu nge ɓa zhin shekwoyi anya . ) fye pa ge nsapai fye ɓei nyi n tna yesu , fye ɓei zhin shekwoyi aɓi nuwunyin nu , woi to ɓei zhin fye alkawalin n wo ɓa bma fye zhin ma , fye ɓei ku bwi n tna shekwoyi , n tna awyetu .
ama nsaiye , fye zhin yesu kristi anya nu , kwo shi kwo nyi fye ɓei mwa kpa n shekwoyi , n saiye aku ɓe n fyei vi-viyi n woi , ntu n nya ɓo n yesu kristi wa zhin ga yi n wo amiyi nyi .
yesu la yi tagyi do gama kristi nu zhin zokwo eyi bugba fu nya .
wo la yi ga jedoɓe na yahudiyi yi n fyei abyedo , woi zeyi zaknayi aɓi , ngye shi wa ɓa nyakunpa ya n kwo ɓei n yi gna aje nyi .
owo fi la nuwun gmiya , n kwo ɓei dna n yi atasin nyi , n na yahudiyi awyidna ɓei ɓe n cei n na byedo bwayi gmi-gmi ya nyi , gama wa fi n na bai wa zo zokwo yi nu , wa ku aza n gun abaye n ɓa ɓei zhin ɓai zhin gaba n na ajeyi nyi , wa zeɓa owohin nya .
wato wo la yi ye ɓedo ya ze oza woi-woi gmanyi , n sayi bugbafu yi la ɓe .
shi yi ku ze aga nayi gmanyi nya nyi , minagyi n kwo ɓei dna n na tasin nyi kwo ku zo , wo la yi ga jedoɓe n shekwoyi , ngye shi wa fi tu n zundu ntu yi ɓo .
woi la ɓe fye n nabari manayi bugbafu nya yi efye abyedo , nfye ɓei mwa kpa n woi nyi , eyi a yahudiyi yi ɓei wo viviyi n woi .
nsaiye eyi vinya , ko yahudiyi kwo abyedo , ɓami wa ɓe shekwoyi dada aba , n zafun gyi-gyi-yi bmazhin yi , ntu n nya ɓo n kristi ku zhin ga yi nyi .
nsaiye fye to zhin a zhiɓei nu n shekwoyi aban , kwo a zhiɓei n ; eshen , ama fye zhin shekwoyi apuwa da nu , shekwoyi-kni aɓi , fye zhin shekwoyi puwa azanu , n gnisun n a yesu viyi ajei .
fye gni agni kpe n sayi n nyakun goro manayi nu , atnu-tnuyi n na nabiyi .
nyakun bwakwonu kuta ho , yesu kristi nu n wohin tukwo yi .
eyi n ya ga gaiciya nyi akuyi ɓedo peceiye n kristi yi , n gye nyakun manayi n kwo mwa cici ntu shekwoyi ɓo .
akuyi ɓedo n woi n yi azajei dna n zafun , yi-i ku ze shekwoyi ase-se ba .
nsa dohoi fye ɓei fi n shekwoyi knitu sinta , n zunkni zhi nyalonyalo ntu n fye alaifi ɓo .

mi gyi fye wye , emi nmi dna n kurkuku ntu dagayi bauta ɓo nyi , fye zan-zan fya zhin aɓo n kunce n na zayi n na la ɓa kni , ntu n anabarka wo-wo yi ye pya ɓo .
fye gba fyehin tukwo fya zhin peceiye , fye zhin hakuri n na ajeyi , ntu ye-ye ɓo to fya gye aje laifin ngye nya ho nun .
fye zhin atna fya fa zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa dna fye n zokwo nlonu fya sa-se n najei n bugbafu yi .
aɓo zaho-zahoi ɓa mi wa zhin yi zhin aga nanyi gmanyi nyanu , yi n zafun gmanyi nu , ai la yi yi ntu n na aɓo a manayi ɓo .
n yi aba , yi n dagayi gmanyi nu , gaiciya ga gmanyi , baptisma gmanyi .
yi n shekwoyi gmanyi nu , oda nwo tu n na aza sin vinya , woi sase dna n yi vinya woi lo tnu-tnu n yi .
kristi n la ɓe-kpezhin ga zaho-zahoi enya nwo n cei pma ya bwa dna n wo nyabwa gna .
zabura kayi ɓei kuci ge sanu n kristi ɓei jeze lo eshe dna n nasara n wo kalala avun n vingwo , n nasarayi n shetan tukwo , wa ga aza acauta n mwa begye .
woi cige wo ɓei jeze lo eshe mi , kwa wu nuge wo ɓei gmi n eshe mi wa kashi ɓe anyi har anyi sinta .
oza n wa kashi ɓenyi , owo nu na jeze lo , n na bai n wo ɓa nu anya vinya n wohin , n anyimi har n she yi ɓe .
azaho n yimi a ku ɓe-kpezhin gaɓa , ngye atnu-tnuyi , aza ho wa gaba waʼazi kpe-zhin , azaho ɓami ɓa gni aza ɓe cei n kristi aba , ɓai bma ɓa zhin ɓa kpema wo ngye oɓa gniyi .
azaho ɓa shi shekwoyi aza bwa , ngye a knikna yi ɓai wuɓa , ɓai dnaɓa n shekwoyi zokwo .
kni nu zhin woi gayi ɓe-kpezhin n nabai ya kpe aɓo zhin n bmiya ?
n na abai shekwoyi aza ɓami ɓa zhin tnu-tnu manayi gawo , ɓa mi ikklisiya , kristi nayi kwa mwa kwa bwa kala .
har ya ga gaiciya gmanyi ntu n yi gni-gni ɓo , n yi gniyi , shekwoyi nugun , ya mwa fi n dagayi , e , har ya si aba n kristi ɓa dna n yi mi dei-dei .
nnavun yita shan ze ngye aɓin , yi shan abugba do na anya ɓo n yi ga gaiciya n , ntuge aza ɓe yi n wuwu akata nya yi , yi gye ngye gaiciya nu .
nkwo apita yivi gaiciya dna n ye-ye nsai vinya , yida gaiciya , yi zhin aɓo dna n gaiciya , yi sase dna n gaiciya , n na bai ya ze ngye kristi n wo zhin owo nayi tukwo danyi , wato ikklisiya , dna n wo ɓewu nayi vinya nku aje dei-dei , oga dohodohoi n kwo zokwoyi , kwoi bma do zhin , n na bai n nayi vinya ɓa bwa lafiya , kwa mwa n nu-nuyi n yeyi .
zan-zan dna wye- wyeyi woiwoyi mi daɓo n fyei dna n dagayi , fyeto shan ase-se ngye a tna viyin , ntuge awye nku ɓa bua , aɓo ku ɓa gmi aje .
oɓa bugba gu-guyi lo n nunuyi n wyegmayi , ɓa mwa kpalo n wye-wyeyi shekwoyi nya yi , ntuge ɓaku ɓa bugba gu , to ɓa wowon , ɓa ta kpewo a zokwo ye lon .
ɓata damu lo n ɓe nukoyi kwo ɓemanayin , ɓa ku ɓahin ga a ɓenukwoyi zhin .
ɓata fa ɓeho zhin ɓo , nɓa bugba nukwoyi , nɓa shakpe yi gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin m .
ama kristi to ɓei wufye n lo nun .
ngye fye ku owo begye wo , fyei ku owo fyei ku owo gaiciya tumwi , to , fyeku a nayi kwo-kwoi ya , n kwo ɓei zhin aɓe a nukwoyi nyi , n kwo la bo vinya n nu-nuyi n shakpei .
nsaiye efye hali n fye a nubo zhin yi , tilas ɓa shando cici ɓa ze amanayi .
e , tilas fya ze aza woi-woi , n gyi-gyi-yi n bmiya .
fye ku nayi woi-woi ye kpe .
fye to zhin akata cefi ajen , fye da gaiciya , ntuge yi zhin aje aga nu , idan ya ce a kata fi aje yi kni aje bugba nu .
n ha gyi minagyi to zhin laifi ha fa minagyi yi fi n ho min , to fa nyipyeyi kwa shin hoi gyi minagyin , ku kwo ze amwi npye .
gama n ha gyi minagyi , ho ga shetan apita tu ba nu .
ndei oza wyivi lo , tilas wa fa evi wyiɓo , wa ya tnu-tnu zhin n wo abwayi , n nabai wa bma azaje zhin n ɓa gyi san lo .
to da ɓeda nukwoyin , bwa ɓedanu da n kwo ɓa bma aza zhin n ho daɓo n ɓai , enya n kwo ɓa gaba anabarka .
fye to wun zafun gyi-gyi-yi bugba yan , ntu n fye zan-zan ɓon , fye pa ge owonu na tufye ze har nyipyeyi n gni-gni n laifi ɓei nu ncei .
fye kufa napye ɓo n minagyi yi , anyawu , ɓeda nukwoyi , fye to fa a tna ajeye kwa lo dna n fya tasin m .
fye bwa bugba manayi n na jeyi , fyei ye n na jeyi , fyei zhin aje gafara shi shekwoyi wa zhin fye gafara ntuge fye zhin kristi nya nu nyi .
mi gyi fye wye , emi nmi dna n kurkuku ntu dagayi bauta ɓo nyi , fye zan-zan fya zhin aɓo n kunce n na zayi n na la ɓa kni , ntu n anabarka wo-wo yi ye pya ɓo .
fye gba fyehin tukwo fya zhin peceiye , fye zhin hakuri n na ajeyi , ntu ye-ye ɓo to fya gye aje laifin ngye nya ho nun .
fye zhin atna fya fa zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa dna fye n zokwo nlonu fya sa-se n najei n bugbafu yi .
yi zhin aga nanyi gmanyi nyanu , yi n zafun gmanyi nu , ai la yi yi ntu n na aɓo a manayi ɓo .
n yi aba , yi n dagayi gmanyi nu , gaiciya ga gmanyi , baptisma gmanyi .
yi n shekwoyi gmanyi nu , oda nwo tu n na aza sin vinya , woi sase dna n yi vinya woi lo tnu-tnu n yi .
kristi n la ɓe-kpezhin ga zaho-zahoi enya nwo n cei pma ya bwa dna n wo nyabwa gna .
zabura kayi ɓei kuci ge sanu n kristi ɓei jeze lo eshe dna n nasara n wo kalala avun n vingwo , n nasarayi n shetan tukwo , wa ga aza acauta n mwa begye .
woi cige wo ɓei jeze lo eshe mi , kwa wu nuge wo ɓei gmi n eshe mi wa kashi ɓe anyi har anyi sinta .
oza n wa kashi ɓenyi , owo nu na jeze lo , n na bai n wo ɓa nu anya vinya n wohin , n anyimi har n she yi ɓe .
azaho n yimi a ku ɓe-kpezhin gaɓa , ngye atnu-tnuyi , aza ho wa gaba waʼazi kpe-zhin , azaho ɓami ɓa gni aza ɓe cei n kristi aba , ɓai bma ɓa zhin ɓa kpema wo ngye oɓa gniyi .
azaho ɓa shi shekwoyi aza bwa , ngye a knikna yi ɓai wuɓa , ɓai dnaɓa n shekwoyi zokwo .
kni nu zhin woi gayi ɓe-kpezhin n nabai ya kpe aɓo zhin n bmiya ?
n na abai shekwoyi aza ɓami ɓa zhin tnu-tnu manayi gawo , ɓa mi ikklisiya , kristi nayi kwa mwa kwa bwa kala .
har ya ga gaiciya gmanyi ntu n yi gni-gni ɓo , n yi gniyi , shekwoyi nugun , ya mwa fi n dagayi , e , har ya si aba n kristi ɓa dna n yi mi dei-dei .
nnavun yita shan ze ngye aɓin , yi shan abugba do na anya ɓo n yi ga gaiciya n , ntuge aza ɓe yi n wuwu akata nya yi , yi gye ngye gaiciya nu .
nkwo apita yivi gaiciya dna n ye-ye nsai vinya , yida gaiciya , yi zhin aɓo dna n gaiciya , yi sase dna n gaiciya , n na bai ya ze ngye kristi n wo zhin owo nayi tukwo danyi , wato ikklisiya , dna n wo ɓewu nayi vinya nku aje dei-dei , oga dohodohoi n kwo zokwoyi , kwoi bma do zhin , n na bai n nayi vinya ɓa bwa lafiya , kwa mwa n nu-nuyi n yeyi .
mi daɓo n fyei dna n dagayi , fyeto shan ase-se ngye a tna viyin , ntuge awye nku ɓa bua , aɓo ku ɓa gmi aje .
oɓa bugba gu-guyi lo n nunuyi n wyegmayi , ɓa mwa kpalo n wye-wyeyi shekwoyi nya yi , ntuge ɓaku ɓa bugba gu , to ɓa wowon , ɓa ta kpewo a zokwo ye lon .
ɓata damu lo n ɓe nukoyi kwo ɓemanayin , ɓa ku ɓahin ga a ɓenukwoyi zhin .
ɓata fa ɓeho zhin ɓo , nɓa bugba nukwoyi , nɓa shakpe yi gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin m .
ama kristi to ɓei wufye n lo nun .
ngye fye ku owo begye wo , fyei ku owo fyei ku owo gaiciya tumwi , to , fyeku a nayi kwo-kwoi ya , n kwo ɓei zhin aɓe a nukwoyi nyi , n kwo la bo vinya n nu-nuyi n shakpei .
nsaiye efye hali n fye a nubo zhin yi , tilas ɓa shando cici ɓa ze amanayi .
e , tilas fya ze aza woi-woi , n gyi-gyi-yi n bmiya .
fye ku nayi woi-woi ye kpe .
fye to zhin akata cefi ajen , fye da gaiciya , ntuge yi zhin aje aga nu , idan ya ce a kata fi aje yi kni aje bugba nu .
n ha gyi minagyi to zhin laifi ha fa minagyi yi fi n ho min , to fa nyipyeyi kwa shin hoi gyi minagyin , ku kwo ze amwi npye .
gama n ha gyi minagyi , ho ga shetan apita tu ba nu .
ndei oza wyivi lo , tilas wa fa evi wyiɓo , wa ya tnu-tnu zhin n wo abwayi , n nabai wa bma azaje zhin n ɓa gyi san lo .
to da ɓeda nukwoyin , bwa ɓedanu da n kwo ɓa bma aza zhin n ho daɓo n ɓai , enya n kwo ɓa gaba anabarka .
fye to wun zafun gyi-gyi-yi bugba yan , ntu n fye zan-zan ɓon , fye pa ge owonu na tufye ze har nyipyeyi n gni-gni n laifi ɓei nu ncei .
fye kufa napye ɓo n minagyi yi , anyawu , ɓeda nukwoyi , fye to fa a tna ajeye kwa lo dna n fya tasin m .
fye bwa bugba manayi n na jeyi , fyei ye n na jeyi , fyei zhin aje gafara shi shekwoyi wa zhin fye gafara ntuge fye zhin kristi nya nu nyi .
zhin ɓo nkwo ɓa da shekwoyi fye vi shekwoyi aɓozhin n na aɓo vinya n fye ɓa zhin , shi oɓi ye-yeyi zhin wa shan owo dada nyi .
fye ku nu n ye-yei ga aje , fya shan kristi nwa ye n fyei nyi , wa ga wohin n shekwoyi akun ngye hadaya , wa ku fye alaifi ya nyi .
ce a da shekwoyi , ntuge kristi ye-ye nfve aba , kwo zhin ngye tulare sunda yi nu nwo aba .
a to sun anagbayin , kwo cegye kwo shakpe n fye min , fye to ye zaho wa sa fye ye n na ɓei pyan .
a nabari nukwoyi , ɓeda nukwoyi n na awyefan kasayi , ɓato zhin fye nyanun , fye pa aje shekwoyi alheri ɓo , n wo zhin ga fye nyi fyei zhin godiya .
mi ye fya kpe ge , kristi ebemi , n shekwoyi ebemiyi kwo to zhin oza nyanu nwo tu cegyen , kwo shakpe woyi gama shakpe woyi zhin eshan gbayi nu .
woi ye anyi nya woi ga ɓa mwa-mwa ndu shekwoyi .
fye to ku vi akwocednayin n ɓa fan ye n laifi nyin , ntuge shekwoyi minagyi nukwoyi tulo n na aza tukwo nɓa zhin abeye .
to gyi anugundo n na azai pya yin .
gama koda yake n sapai efya bugba ɓei nu-nuyi n wyegmai , n saiye kwonu-nuvi lo n dagayi buzangna yi , efya ɓe zhin kunce lo ɓa wu lonu .
ntu n buzagna ye ɓo n kwo dna n fye nyi fye bwa enya nu zhin n kwo bmiva , n nya yi n kwo zhin gaiciya .
fye tumwi fya zhin ɓo n kwo da dagayi .
fye to dnabwa n anyi gmada nukwoyi n wyegmayin , ama fye gnakni ɓa , fya kpeɓa asiri ya .
kwo zhin avinyikwo ɓo nu fya sa aɓei pya ye n ya , anyi gmada nukwoyi , n na a tna-ɓefyece zhin yi .
ama esa n fya kpe ɓa asiri nya ya , buzagna kwa wu ɓa laifi bmi , sanu n ɓagye oɓa ababwi , azaho nɓa mi , kpekni ɓa ze buzangna aɓi .
cenu zhin shekwoyi woi daɓo , n wo ɓeda wa cige , fye kun agyewyi , o , gye-wanyi , fye kukala n efi , kristi ɓa ga fye buzangna . fye zhin peceiye shi fye zhin aɓo ntu ge anyipyei aɓodnai nu , fyeto ku ze aza ma-man , fye la ce , fye zhin apma n sai n fye n cei lo , ntu ɓemana zhin ɓo .
fye to zhin ɓo n tna nubo zhin , ama fye zhin atna fya kpe enya n dagayi ye fya zhin .
to sin eje n , ntuge aɓo nukwoyi lo n mwa n kwo ɓe n cei , ama fye nu-nu n zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa dna fye n zokwo .
fye ta aza n na ajeyi n dagayi tukwo , fyei da zabura , fyei kwo anyi agyi-gyi-yi .
fyei kwo anyi ga dagayi nfye abugbami .
fye zhin godiya ntu anya ɓo vinya ga shekwoyi eyi dada , dna n eyi dagayi yesu kristi eye mi .
puwa asese n lafiya yi fye ga kristi mwa-mwa , fyei gba fyehin tukwo n na aje aba .
efye anyikwoza fye ga fyehin n fye aɓa akun , shi fye ga fyehin n dagayi akun nyi .
gama nyi kwoza dna n wo ɓa akun nu , shi ikklisiya dna n kristi akun nyi .
( wa gawo wye-wyeyi , wa shi kwo bwa , wa ze okwo gniyi . ) ntu cenu efye anyikwoza tile fya vi efye aɓa ɓeda , shi ikklisiya zhin kwa vi kristi ɓeda nyi .
efye aɓa , fye ye nfye anyikwo yi , shi kristi ɓei ye ikklisiya yi , wa fi ntu n kwo ɓo nyi .
wa zekwo gyi-gyi yi ntna cegye , n zhan-zhan yi ya n batisma yi n shekwoyi ɓeda yi .
nna abai wa ga wohin tukwo kwo , ngye ikklisiya mwa-mwai ntna ɓenukwoi , kwo laifi ci gusa , n gyigyi yi n tna cegye .
nlonu nu aɓa ɓaye nɓa anyikwoyi , ɓei ye n ɓai n gye ɓahin .
shi oza n wo nyikwoi ɓa ku ze gmanyi , ɓai oza ye nwohin nu woi zhin wohin ɓe mana , n wa ye n wo nyikwoyi .
oza to lo n wo taye n wohin nayi n .
ama wo ye nkwoi woi zhin kwo ɓo n kwo bmiya .
shi kristi lura n wo nayi , wato , ikklisiya n yi zhin kwo aganu nyi .
shekwoyi ɓeda n la wu pei-pei nge zanugbayi nwo nyikwoyi ɓa zhin nayi gmanyi nu , sanu nkwa ci ncei ge , tilas zanugbai wa fa owo dada n owo ʼyai , sanu wa pa mula , n na bai wa nyima owo nyikwo , oɓa ngun aba ɓa ze gmanyi . mi kpe lo ge kwo dnaɓolo n na awyega bwa ba , ama mi si ɓesi nu ngye shi yi zhin aga nu dna n kristi nayi nyi .
ngye shin ma cige , tile oza ye n wo nyikwoyi ngye wohin tukwo nyikwoza ce tilas wa zhin atna wa ga owo oɓa mwa-mwa n mwa , woi vi wo ɓeda , woi ciwo , woi gawo mwamwa .
fye vi shekwoyi aɓozhin n na aɓo vinya n fye ɓa zhin , shi oɓi ye-yeyi zhin wa shan owo dada nyi .

aɓi fye vi efye a dada ɓeda , nya nu n kwo kunce fya zhin , gama shekwoyi nku ɓa kpe n efye eshe .
gaho dada mwa-mwa n ho yai , deye kwo nu zhin wyi-dna kmisunyi n shekwoyi awyidna n gun awo , nkwo zo n alkawali yi nyi .
alkawali yi nu nyi , nge nha gaho dada mwa-mwa n ho yai , oho wyewyei ɓa mwakpa n nu-nu yi n anabarka yi .
efye aɓida ce fye wo , fye to zhin efye aɓi ɓa gyi minagyin , fyeto wan ɓa sun .
ama fye wuɓa zokwo ɓa mwa fi n dagayi zokwo , dna n tata manayi fyei ga ɓa shawara manayi .
a fyenu fye vi fye a dagayi ɓeda , fye zhin ɓa tnu-tnu n pwawoyi dna , fye zhinɓa tnu-tnu shi fye ɓa zhin kristi nya nyi .
fye to zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi n fye dagayi awyeba nu kawai n , ama fye zhin tnu-tnu cewo n sai vinya a gye fye zhin kristi nya , fya zhin kristi nya , fye zhin shekwoyi ɓeye n bugbayi gmanyi .
fye pa ge dagayi ɓa gba fye ta ntu fye a tnu-tnu amanayi ɓo , kwo hoi zhin fyenu nu , kwo to hoi zhin fyenu nun .
efyehin ce a dagayi fye zhin efya fyenu ɓo n bmiya , shima gnaɓa ge ɓa zhin fye ɓo nyi , fye to fi ɓa edna n , fye pa nge fye zhin kristi a fyenu nu , efye dagayi gmanyi nu n ɓai , woi ta zhin taran .
eyi akala kun n shekwoyi aba nu nkmasun miye ma gnafye ge , efye akala ɓakun n dagayi aba nu n ikwoyi dna n fye mi .
fye kpe shekwoyi akun kaya vinya , n na bai nfye ɓami fya gni-agni n shetan yi , n wa dabara yi .
gama yita sunkun n na azai nu , n ɓa zhin nayi n na amiyin , ama n na azai nɓato n nayi n , esu a nukwoyi n awyegma nya , n ɓa gyibe n anyi deye n na aljanuyi n ɓa fi n na anyi bmana nyi .
ntu cenu fye zhin apma n shekwoyi a kun kaya doho-dohoi , fya sunkun n na anuwunyi n zokwo doho-dohoi nɓa kun da fye , sanu n na ku zo fyami zhi n na agni .
ama ntuge fya mi fya zhin n lonu , tile fya pa shinpanya wao gaiciya n fye eshin , fya ku kpata wato ɓefyece kpe n na agu n shekwoyi ɓoye nya .
fye fi abuada n ɓa ɓa da fye zan-zan fyei lo nabari manayi da bugbafu nya n shekwoyi .
nkun doho-dohoi fye ɓa pma gaiciya ge , kwa ze fye kpata , kwa gwo fye aknawyi ya n shetan shefye nyi .
fye ɓa kun kata gnigni-nya , n zafun ebe yakwoyi , wato shekwoyi ɓeda .
fye zhin aduwa cici , fye nya shekwoyi ɓeho-ɓehoi n kwo dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓeye .
fye zhin atna n woi , fye pawo efya bukata ɓo , fye zhin aduwa ntu n na a yesu viyi aje ɓo n na aba do .
fye zhin mi aduwa fya nya shekwoyi , wa gami aɓeda n ɓa kunce , shi mi gna aza dagayi ɓeda n tna edna , mi-i wuɓa ge gni-gni zhin abyedo nyanu ce .
mi dna n na awun nsaiye , ntu ge mi zhin shekwoyi ɓeda ye waʼazi nu , ama fye zhin aduwa n na bai n mi ɓa gyi abye n ɓeda yi , n tna edna n kurkuku aba n mi dnanyi .
tikikus , emi zado ye-yei gaiciya da , nwo bmami zhin dna n dagayi tnu-tnu nyi , wo ɓa gna fye shi mi lo n ya .
mi tnu n woi ntu n cenu wa gna fye eyi nabari , n na bai fya bwa bugba kala n ɓei n wa gna fye .
shekwoyi wo ga fye bugbafu , emi a yesu viyi aje , n ye-yei , n gaiciya gayi , n shekwoyi dada aba n dagayi yesu kristi yi .
shekwoyi alheri n anabarkayi , ɓa kunsun n na azai nɓa ye eyi dagayi yesu kristi n bugbai gmanyi .
aɓi fye vi efye a dada ɓeda , nya nu n kwo kunce fya zhin , gama shekwoyi nku ɓa kpe n efye eshe .
gaho dada mwa-mwa n ho yai , deye kwo nu zhin wyi-dna kmisunyi n shekwoyi awyidna n gun awo , nkwo zo n alkawali yi nyi .
alkawali yi nu nyi , nge nha gaho dada mwa-mwa n ho yai , oho wyewyei ɓa mwakpa n nu-nu yi n anabarka yi .
efye aɓida ce fye wo , fye to zhin efye aɓi ɓa gyi minagyin , fyeto wan ɓa sun .
ama fye wuɓa zokwo ɓa mwa fi n dagayi zokwo , dna n tata manayi fyei ga ɓa shawara manayi .

fye to zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi n fye dagayi awyeba nu kawai n , ama fye zhin tnu-tnu cewo n sai vinya a gye fye zhin kristi nya , fya zhin kristi nya , fye zhin shekwoyi ɓeye n bugbayi gmanyi .
fye pa ge dagayi ɓa gba fye ta ntu fye a tnu-tnu amanayi ɓo , kwo hoi zhin fyenu nu , kwo to hoi zhin fyenu nun .
efyehin ce a dagayi fye zhin efya fyenu ɓo n bmiya , shima gnaɓa ge ɓa zhin fye ɓo nyi , fye to fi ɓa edna n , fye pa nge fye zhin kristi a fyenu nu , efye dagayi gmanyi nu n ɓai , woi ta zhin taran .
nkmasun miye ma gnafye ge , efye akala ɓakun n dagayi aba nu n ikwoyi dna n fye mi .
fye kpe shekwoyi akun kaya vinya , n na bai nfye ɓami fya gni-agni n shetan yi , n wa dabara yi .
gama yita sunkun n na azai nu , n ɓa zhin nayi n na amiyin , ama n na azai nɓato n nayi n , esu a nukwoyi n awyegma nya , n ɓa gyibe n anyi deye n na aljanuyi n ɓa fi n na anyi bmana nyi .
ntu cenu fye zhin apma n shekwoyi a kun kaya doho-dohoi , fya sunkun n na anuwunyi n zokwo doho-dohoi nɓa kun da fye , sanu n na ku zo fyami zhi n na agni .
ama ntuge fya mi fya zhin n lonu , tile fya pa shinpanya wao gaiciya n fye eshin , fya ku kpata wato ɓefyece kpe n na agu n shekwoyi ɓoye nya .
fye fi abuada n ɓa ɓa da fye zan-zan fyei lo nabari manayi da bugbafu nya n shekwoyi .
nkun doho-dohoi fye ɓa pma gaiciya ge , kwa ze fye kpata , kwa gwo fye aknawyi ya n shetan shefye nyi .
fye ɓa kun kata gnigni-nya , n zafun ebe yakwoyi , wato shekwoyi ɓeda .
fye zhin aduwa cici , fye nya shekwoyi ɓeho-ɓehoi n kwo dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓeye .
fye zhin atna n woi , fye pawo efya bukata ɓo , fye zhin aduwa ntu n na a yesu viyi aje ɓo n na aba do .
fye zhin mi aduwa fya nya shekwoyi , wa gami aɓeda n ɓa kunce , shi mi gna aza dagayi ɓeda n tna edna , mi-i wuɓa ge gni-gni zhin abyedo nyanu ce .
mi dna n na awun nsaiye , ntu ge mi zhin shekwoyi ɓeda ye waʼazi nu , ama fye zhin aduwa n na bai n mi ɓa gyi abye n ɓeda yi , n tna edna n kurkuku aba n mi dnanyi .
tikikus , emi zado ye-yei gaiciya da , nwo bmami zhin dna n dagayi tnu-tnu nyi , wo ɓa gna fye shi mi lo n ya .
mi tnu n woi ntu n cenu wa gna fye eyi nabari , n na bai fya bwa bugba kala n ɓei n wa gna fye .
shekwoyi wo ga fye bugbafu , emi a yesu viyi aje , n ye-yei , n gaiciya gayi , n shekwoyi dada aba n dagayi yesu kristi yi .
shekwoyi alheri n anabarkayi , ɓa kunsun n na azai nɓa ye eyi dagayi yesu kristi n bugbai gmanyi .
bulus n timatawus yi , yesu kristi a fyenu , eyi nu ka ga fye a pasto n na abyedo yi n na yesu viyi vinya n fye fi n filibi zhi mi nyi .
shekwoyi anabarka ɓa kunsun n fyei vinya .
e , mi zhin aduwa ge shekwoyi eyi dada , n dagayi yesu kristi yi ɓa ga zaho-zahoi n fye mi owo anabarka nu-nuyi , n wo bugba fuyi nfye abugbami , n fye awye wyei n jesun .
omi aduwa vinya ɓa nu-riuyi lo n shekwoyi latuyi .
sanu n ma zhin aduwa ga fye , emi bugba nu-nuyi n na agmadai .
ntu fye bmazhin ɓo , fyei zhin aza ɓai kpe nabari manayi , kristi nya ɓeye , tunyi esa n fye ɓei wo har nsai ye .
mi tabata lo shekwoyi n wa ya tnutnu manayi n fye mi nyi , wo ɓa gyi abye n fye bmazhin yi , fya mwa fi n wo alheri , sai esa n owo tnu-tnu n fye mi nku zo zhin , ewyi n yesu kristi ɓei jeze ɓe cei .
bulus yeye nɓa ba kwo wulo cewo ma wo n mi mi ntu fye ɓo ngye shi mi wo nyi , ntuge , fye dnalo n mi bugba mwa .
yila gni bwa ngnisun shekwoyi anabarka esa n mi ɓei dna n kurkuku nyi , n esayi n mi ɓei la gmi nyi .
mi-i sunkun ntu gaiciya ɓo mi-i gna aza kristi nabari .
shekwoyi gmanyi nu kpe lo shi mi ye fye lo n sun , n yesu kristi bugba ye-ye nya pyai .
emi aduwa zhin ga fye ekwo nu fya nu n shekwoyi ye-yei na za aba , fya gyi abye n mwa-mwa yi dna n zafun , n awyega yi .
gama mi ye ifya kpe ɓe nukwoyi ye n ɓemanayi cewo .
fye ku ze a gyi-gyi-yi n fye mi , to oza mi wa gye fye laifin har esa n dagayi ɓa jeze ɓe n cei .
fye zhin ɓemana nu ci-ci , aɓo n ɓa ɓa wu ge fye zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu .
ntuge de ye ɓa ɓe n latu yi , n mwa-mwa yi n shekwoyi aba .
mi cei pma lo fya kpe , omi azaje , aɓo vinya n ɓa bwa mi ya , kwo la ze apma nya kwoi zhin aza ɓai wo nabari manayi kristi nya .
ntuge aza vinya n ya , n na soja yi ɓe n ɓa kpe n ɓa abarki nyi , ɓa kpe lo ge mi dna n na awun , ntuge mr zhin yesu viyi nu .
ntu n mi dna-dna ɓo n kurkuku n ya a yesu viyi n mwa ɓa ku agmada nya .
omi atna zhin , n ku bugba kala ga ɓa , har ɓai gna aza kristi nabari ntna edna .
azaho zhin waʼazi ntuge ɓa wo she , shi shekwoyi zhin apma n miyi .
ɓaye a ciɓa nge ɓa zhin waʼazi n tna dna .
ama azaho zhin n bugba yi gmanyi .
ɓai zhin waʼazi ntuge ɓa yemi , gama ɓa kpe lo ge dagayi wa ɓe miyi n ya wa zhin apma n miyi ma kna gaiciya .
azaho zhin waʼazi ɓa zhin mi ma wo she , ɓai gye ge oɓa abye gyi ɓa ɓemi bugba zhizhiyi dna n kurkuku ya .
ama kwo ɓai zhin waʼazi n kni nufi yi nuʼa , nya gmanyi n mi kpelo , a zhin nabari manayi kristi nya waʼazi lo , ai da mi lo .
nya kwo zhin to mi-i fim mi ɓa dagma , gama mi kpe lo shi fye zhin mi aduwa zafun gyi-gyi-yi bmami zhin , deye vinya ɓa ze ɓemana n mi aba .
gama mi zhin nubo n na awyetuyi , mi ta zhin ɓeho n kwo ɓa zhin mi ma wo mihin vinyikwon , ama ma gni n shiri yi zhin n saho-sahoi , ma da kristi nabari n bugba kalayi , sa n mi dna n na a zhin gye n ya , shi mi shin gye n sapa n na abai ma ga kristi mwa-mwa , kwo mi-i n wye-wyeyi kwo mi ya fi .
gama n mi aba wye-wyeyi zhin esa bwa nu ntu n kristi ɓo , efi kuwa , n gna bmiya lo .
ama ngye n mi wye-wyei ɓa ga mi esa ma gni aza ga kristi , to a gye mita kpe edo ye lo n kwo gna bmiya lon , wye-wyeyi ko efi m .
nsahoi mi n cei pmalo ma gni wye-wyeyi sahoi mi to n cei pmalo n .
gama mi n cei pma lo ma lo mi kunsun n yesu yi , kwo ɓa gna ma gmada n mwa ma ndu n mi wye-wyeyi lo ya .
ama mi ɓa gnasun n na apmayi n fye aba mi-i ya gni n wye-wyeyi n ya .
e , aye n mi ɓo yi pmalo n ya n na anyi ye , mi kpelo mi ɓeye dna n na anyi ye n sa fyewyi kpa , ama ma bma fye zhin , fya mwa , fya bwa bugba buyi dna fye gaiciya ga .
omi gni-gni n na anyi ɓa ga fye bugba buyi , kwoi ga fye dalili n fye ɓa la kristi yesu tu , n wo shi mi bwanyi , sanu n ma jeze ɓe efye aba n cei , ma zhin fye ziyara .
ama kwo kni ɓe nu yi bwa miʼa , fye pa , fya zan-zan ngye a yesu viyi n na bai kwo to mi-i shan fye gye n shasun , mi ɓa wo nabari manayi nge fye mi zhin lo n bugbai gmanyi , fyei da nabari manayi .
ntna edna , kwo ofye anuwunyi zhin fye n wuna na .
kwo ɓa wu ɓa nge ɓala kaya , ama n fye aba kwo ɓa wufye nge shekwoyi kunsun lo n fyei .
woi la wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya ga fye n gnisun n woi .
gama n fye aba ala esa ga fye , to ge fya kpema wo kawai m , ama fya gye azhin ntu wo ɓo .
yi filo n okun ye n gnisun , fye ku gye mi-i sin wahala intu wo ɓo n sapai , har sayi mi ye dna lo n wahala atan-tasin , ngye shi fye kpe lo .
bulus n timatawus yi , yesu kristi a fyenu , eyi nu ka ga fye a pasto n na abyedo yi n na yesu viyi vinya n fye fi n filibi zhi mi nyi .

yi zhin ngye yesu enya lo n na a yesu viyi ai yi ge atna-zhin ?
fye ye mi lo har fyei ye fya bmami zhin ?
kwo zhin nyaho nu n fye aba nge yi zhin a zaje nu dna n dagayi , yi n zafun gmanyi lo ?
ofye abugba n na atnazhin yi lo n bugba bwa yi ?
to fye zhin mi ma dagma ɓehin-hin nya , fya ye n na jeyi n bugbai gmanyi , fyei zhin tnu-tnu n gnisun n bugbai ɓedo n ɓemwi gmanyi .
to ye hohin tukwon , to zhin ɓo n na bai aza ci hon , gba hohin tukwo , ha gye azaje ndu hohin .
to zhin hohin tukwo aɓonu nubo gmanyi n , ama zhin nubo n na zaje nyai ɓe , n ɓei n ɓa zhin .
kwo bmiya efye hali kwa wu ngye odo n yesu kristi ɓei wu yi nyi .
oza nu , kwo da yake wo ɓei zhin shekwoyi nu , wo to ɓei gyima nge wo zhin shekwoyi nu n .
ama wa kma owo mwa-mwa ya zhi n ikoyi , wa gba wohin tukwo wa ze zanyikwoci ngye fyenu .
wa gba wohin tukwo n du-du , wa fi ngye evi fi tu n zundu .
ntu cenu shekwoyi ɓei la wo kala tu n eshe wa ga wo eye ndu aye aje vinya .
nnabai n yesu ye nyikutukwo doho-doho n she mi , n anyi mi yi , n anyi sintai ɓei ca kwokwo .
nyitala doho-dohoi ɓei cige , yesu kristi nu zhin dagayi dna shekwoyi dada mwa-mwa .
omi a nugundo yeye yi , sanu n mi ɓei gnisun n fyei , fye ɓei vi mi ɓo-wu peceiye .
shi mi to gni lo n saiye nyi n , fye zhin peceiye fya vi aɓo vinya n ɓa ɓe n gni-gni , avun shekwoyi mwa-mwa ga , n dna yi , fyei ta na avun yi n nya n kwo ɓa wun wo bugba ya .
ntuge shekwoyi nu zhin tnu-tnu n fye mi , woi bma fye zhin n nabai fya wowo ɓeda , fya zhin ɓo n wo cei pma fya zhin .
nyaho-nyahoi n fye ɓa zhin , fye bui gunu-gunu da si na ɓena yi , na jeyi .
nna bai n zaho ta bwa fye laifin .
fye sase n gyi-gyi-yi .
ntna cegye , shekwoyi aɓi nfi n wyegma anyi ye nya n na za nukwoyi n ɓa ta wo ɓon .
fye bmiya na n ɓa mi ngye a fitila .
fya ku ze a buzangna .
fyei wuɓa nabari wye-wyeyi nya .
sanu n kristi bei jeze ɓe ncei , aɓei da mi n mwa , nge emi tnu-tnu n fya ba to ze gbeloyin .
ngye aɓa emi ami zeya nu ntu n fye gaiciya ga ɓo n mi ga shekwoyi kwo ngye hadaya nyi , wato ngye mi ba fi ntu fye ɓo nu , aɓa dami n mwa , mabwa agmada ngnisun nfyei .
gama kwo kunce lo fya bwa bugba bui-bui ntu n ce , fya dagma n mi yi ntu n esa ɓo n mi la bwa ma fi ntu fye ɓo nyi .
bulus a wyekwo n dagayi wa ye , mi ɓa tnu n timatawus yi esa fyewyi wa gye fye wye .
n wa jeze ɓe wo ɓa fu mi bugba wa wu mi efye lafiya , shi fye zhin lo .
oza to lo woi ye mi ngye timatawus n .
zaho-zahoi ce woi wo wohin nu ɓo , to woi shan yesu kristi ɓo won .
ama fye kpe timatawus ye lo .
wo la ze n gye mi ɓinu , woi bma mi nabari manayi waʼazi zhin .
mi ɓatnu n woi sa fyewyi , n ma ku kpe nya ye n kwo ɓa bwa mi ya .
mi ga shekwoyi gaiciya lo ge , esa fyewyi mi ɓa ɓe ma gye fye wye .
nsaiye mi gye kwo bmiya lo matnu n abafraditus yi nfya ba .
fye ɓei tnu woi wa bma mi zhin dna n mi bukata , to , owo n miyi , yi ku ze aya ɓi , yi ku ze yi zhin tnu-tnu , yi sunkun n gnisun .
nsaiye mi tnu woi lo n na api n jesun , ntu ge api awye n lawo kwo , woi la damu shi fye ɓei ku wo ge nyasan ɓei ku san wo .
nyasan ɓei ku san wo n mwa , har wo ɓei la wo viwyi n fiyi .
ama shekwoyi ɓei ku gye wo sun-sun , n mi yi ɓe , to wa ye ge ma bwa bugba zhiyi tu n deye tukwo n .
ntu cenu a gnami wolo n gye mi tnu n woi n fya ba njesun , gama mi kpelo shi aɓei da fye nsun fyei yagye wo .
ce ɓa da mi kwa cemi bugba wum bma .
fye zhin wo amabe dna n dagayi n bugba buyi , fya wu fye agmada .
gama wo ɓeye wa fi ntu n kristi tnu-tnu ɓo , sanu n wo ɓei zhin atna , wa zhin mi ɓo n fye to mi zhin ntu ge fye lo n kpai .
enya lo n na a yesu viyi ai yi ge atna-zhin ?
