ngye aɓa emi ami zeya nu ntu n fye gaiciya ga ɓo n mi ga shekwoyi kwo ngye hadaya nyi , wato ngye mi ba fi ntu fye ɓo nu , aɓa dami n mwa , mabwa agmada ngnisun nfyei .
gama kwo kunce lo fya bwa bugba bui-bui ntu n ce , fya dagma n mi yi ntu n esa ɓo n mi la bwa ma fi ntu fye ɓo nyi .
n dagayi wa ye , mi ɓa tnu n timatawus yi esa fyewyi wa gye fye wye .
n wa jeze ɓe wo ɓa fu mi bugba wa wu mi efye lafiya , shi fye zhin lo .
oza to lo woi ye mi ngye timatawus n .
zaho-zahoi ce woi wo wohin nu ɓo , to woi shan yesu kristi ɓo won .
ama fye kpe timatawus ye lo .
wo la ze n gye mi ɓinu , woi bma mi nabari manayi waʼazi zhin .
mi ɓatnu n woi sa fyewyi , n ma ku kpe nya ye n kwo ɓa bwa mi ya .
mi ga shekwoyi gaiciya lo ge , esa fyewyi mi ɓa ɓe ma gye fye wye .
nsaiye mi gye kwo bmiya lo matnu n abafraditus yi nfya ba .
fye ɓei tnu woi wa bma mi zhin dna n mi bukata , to , owo n miyi , yi ku ze aya ɓi , yi ku ze yi zhin tnu-tnu , yi sunkun n gnisun .
nsaiye mi tnu woi lo n na api n jesun , ntu ge api awye n lawo kwo , woi la damu shi fye ɓei ku wo ge nyasan ɓei ku san wo .
nyasan ɓei ku san wo n mwa , har wo ɓei la wo viwyi n fiyi .
ama shekwoyi ɓei ku gye wo sun-sun , n mi yi ɓe , to wa ye ge ma bwa bugba zhiyi tu n deye tukwo n .
ntu cenu a gnami wolo n gye mi tnu n woi n fya ba njesun , gama mi kpelo shi aɓei da fye nsun fyei yagye wo .
ce ɓa da mi kwa cemi bugba wum bma .
fye zhin wo amabe dna n dagayi n bugba buyi , fya wu fye agmada .
gama wo ɓeye wa fi ntu n kristi tnu-tnu ɓo , sanu n wo ɓei zhin atna , wa zhin mi ɓo n fye to mi zhin ntu ge fye lo n kpai .
ɓeho-ɓehoi n kwa zhin , emi anugundo fye dagma fi n dagayi , ata ɓe mi n fye ce gna yi n .
kwo bmiya lo n fya ba fya wo ce ci .
peceye nna malami nukwoyi fye zhin peceiye n na za nukwoyi , amwi , nɓa gna ge sai oza zhin kaciya nu a kpe wo gni nyi .
gama eyi nayi zunya nu ta ze yi shekwoyi aɓin , mwa-mwa ga nu n yi zafun yi , kaciya hin-hin nu , eyi a yesu viyi , yi dagma fi n nya n kristi yesu ku zhin gayi , yi kpe ge yita mi n yihin bma-zhin ya gni yihin tukwon .
ndei oza lo n wo gye ge wo ɓei ɓa mi wa gni wohin , emi nu , ngye aza ɓei ɓa pwo ntu n nya ɓo n wo n cei , mi ɓei ɓa mi ma pwo .
gama nyipyei nyimwa-nyimwai nu n na ɓei zhin mi kaciya , a mami dna yahudiyi hin-hin puwa , banyami bye .
ntu cenu mi zhin yahudiyi za hin-hin nu .
knido nu shasun , mi ɓei dna n na a farisiyi fye nu , n ɓa vi a yahudiyi awyidna n na akunu yi n kala yi nyi .
n wyenyi ?
e , har ma ma ga ikklisiya wahala ma zhin atna ma shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa vinya .
ama anya deye vinya n mi ɓei gye ɓa n na pmai , nsaiye mi ku ɓa ya vinya n na bai ma kpema , ma tu awye n kristi nu gmanyi .
e , anya vinya zhin gbeloyi nu , n na mwi ɓa do n gyibai nza ɓa bwa woi ya kpema kristi yesu emi dagayi .
miku anya ya vinya , mito ze ɓa n gye nyahon n na abai ma bwa kristi .
maze gmanyi n woi , to a shan gna ge ma bwa gni-gni ntu n mi ɓe manayi zhin ɓo nu m , ko shekwoyi awyidna bwa shin , ama ma ga kristi gaiciya wa gni mi nu , gama shekwoyi zokwo n wo zeyi aza ɓefyece da , ko nu zhin gaiciya ga dna n kristi gmanyi .
nsaiye mi ku anya vinya ya , miku gye okwonu zhin zokwo gmanyi n za ɓa kpe kristi ye , oza kpe iko ye n kwo ɓo je wo wye-wyeyi ga nyi , ma bwa awyega wahala sin nya , n fi yi ngnisun n woi .
nya n kwa zhin , emi nu ɓa zhin oza n wo bwa wyewyeyi woi-woyi dna na za n ɓa ku fi ɓa je wye-wyeyi bwa .
mita ye ma ci ge mi la ze oza tna-laifi da nu n , mito tu aɓo mwi n kwo kunce ma tu mwi n .
ama mi zhin tnu-tnu lo abye har ewyi n mi ɓei ze enya n kristi wa gni mi ntu ce , woi yemi ma ze nyi .
omi azaje , har sayi mi to ze enya n mi ye ma zen , awo , ama mi zhin atna n mi akala yi vinya ma zhin ɓeye gmanyi .
mi-i ze aɓo amwi n ko la diya , mi-i shi oɓo awye n kwo lo na bye .
mi zhin atna masi asibui cezhi ba , ma gwo lada n shekwoyi wa yi-yi ya lo she , ntu nya ɓo n kristi yesu wa zhin gayi nyi .
mi n na wyetu yi lo efye n fye ku mwa fi n yesu vi nyi , fye ɓa gye aɓeye n gnisun m miyi pei-pei .
n fye to bwa awyega n na dohon , mi kpelo shekwoyi ɓa ga fye awyegan n ɓa , n fya vi gaiciya n fye n cei nyi .
emi azaje , fye se ase n gye emi , n na ajeyi .
gama miku gna fye n kmisunyi , ma je fye ce gna n saiye n na awye nyi yi , aza lo n ɓa zan-zan fi n a yesu viyi zokwo , ama ɓa zhin kristi zundu a nuɓayi nu .
oɓa kpegni ba abwi nu , gama oɓa shekwoyi kwo nu zhin ɓa shakpe , ɓai mwa ɓahin tukwo n ɓa kunce ɓa wo vinyikwo , enya nɓa zhin nubo vinya , okwo nu , zhin anyi ye n ɓa nyai vinya .
ama eyi a-yi lo n ʼshemi , aba n yi gniyi , dagayi yesu kristi nyi .
yiye zlii yi pmi wo nu , wa jeze zhi .
sanu n wa jeze ɓe , wo ɓa la anayi fi-fi ye waga yi anayi mwamwa nya , ngye owo nya , woi zhin apma n iko dnagmayi , n wo ɓei zhin apma n cei wa gyi nasara n na ba vinya nyi .

fye pa-ge dagayi ɓelo esa fyewyi .

to ge mi ɓei dna n esan gyi n , gama mila tumwi ma sa se n bugba buyi kwo mi n nyai mwa ko to mi-i n cei n .
mi kpe lo shi mi ɓa sa se n tnanya ho kwo mi-i n nyahoi .
mi la tumwi shi mi ɓa sase n nyahonyahoi , kwo nubo fu , ko mikun , kwo nyabwa ko sangyi .
gama mi ɓa mi ma zhin nyaho-nyahoi n shekwoyi a gnami dna n kristi bmazhin n wo gami kala n iko yi nyi .
ama dudu lo nu , fye ku zhin n bmiya n fya bma mi zhin dna n mi wahala n saiye nyi .
shi fye kpe lo nyi , sanu n mi ɓei kmi fye ɓe n nabari manayi nyi , ma godiya ma fa makidoniya , ofye a filibiyi nu ɓei bwami a nugundo zhin n nyaga ngwo-gwo yi .
ikklisiya ho to ɓei shan deye pya zhin .
har esa n mi ɓei dna n tasaluniki fye ɓei tnu mi n bmazhin yi abwa ba .
ama ko da yake adami lo n fye acautayi , enya n kwo gnami agmada lo okwonu zhin lada yakwo , n fye ɓei bwa n she ntu n fye alheri ɓo nyi .
nsaiye , mi n na anya yi lo-lo n mi ye n mwa , anya n fye ɓei ga abafraditus wa ɓemi n cei nyi , ɓa zhin nyaga sundayi nu n kwo da shekwoyi agma n mwa .
owo nu ɓa ga fye anya vinya dna n wo nyabwa n mwa-mwa , ntu n nyaɓo n kristi yesu ku zhin gayi nyi .
nsaiye mwa-mwa vinya kwo kunsun n shekwoyi eyi dadayi , nyalo-nyalo .
fye ɓi a yesu viyi gna vinya n ɓa nyi n ɓo nyi .

wasika ye gmi n bulus akun nu n ti-matawus yi , aza n shekwoyi wa kni ɓa , ɓa ze yesu kristi a tnutnuyi .
kwoi lo eyi azaje aba a yesu viyi , shekwoyi aza n ɓa fi n kolosi zhimi nyi .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada wa tu fye anabarka wa nu fye n wo bugba fu dnagmayi .
esa vinya n ya zhin aduwa ntu fye ɓo , yi zhin ya zhin shekwoyi eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada godiya .
gama yi ku wo , shi fye kpema dagayi n jesun shi fye ye owo aza n sun .
fye pmi agmada eshe nya nu , tunyi esa n na ɓei kmi fye waʼazi nabari manayi nya zhin nyi .
nabari manayi n kwo ɓei ɓe fye abanyi , kwo laɓa lo n na anyi kwoi shan aza wye-wyeyi do .
she ko ɓei shan fye nya do nyi , tunyi ewyi n fye ɓei wo , fya gane n shekwoyi alheriyi n na alaifida aba .
abafras , eyi za yeyei , tnu-tnu kunzhin yi , owo nu ɓei ɓe fye n nabari manayi yei .
wo zhin yesu kristi fyenu gbenuyinu .
wo lo woi bma yi zhin n ya nfye maimako .
owo nu na gnayi ye-ye dnagmayi ɓo , nfye cei lolo n na azaje aba nyi , n zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa ga fye nyi .
ntucenu , tunyi ewyi n yi ɓei wo of ye ɓo nyi , yi zhin aduwa ga fye lo , yi nya shekwoyi nge wo bma fye zhin , fya kpe enya ye nwoln cei pma fya zhin , yi nyawo wa ga fye ce-ce dna n zafun zokwo .
yi nya wo n na abai efye asese ɓa da dagayi agma kwa la wo tu , n na bai nfye ɓa bwa ɓe manayi zhin , fyei zhin aza ɓe manayi , fya tumwi fya kpe shekwoyi ye lo abye-abye .
yi zhin aduwa n jesun , wa nu fye n wo kala yi n mwa-mwa n na bai fya gyi abye ko knidonu yi na zhiʼa .
fya ze nu-nu yi n dagayi agmada yi cici .
yi sa dada ami n tu ge wa zhin yi , yi ku kunce ya bwa anya awo-woyi , n ɓa zhin aza nya n ɓa fi n buzangna ebemi nyi .
gama wo la yi kun n wyegma n shetan ebemi , woi fiyi n wo nugun ye-yeyi ebemi .
nwa siyi n wo amiyi , wa zhin yi alaifi gafara vinya .
latu ntu nya ɓo n kristi ku zhin kristi nu zhin dogbe shekwoyi nya , n na ata gyewye nyin .
wo ɓei nyi tun to shekwoyi zhin nyahonyaho yin .
ɓehin-hin , kristi nu na zhin anya vinya n ɓa fi n ʼshe mi n anyi miyi , anya n yi gye n na anya yi n yi ta gyen .
anya , a zafun nya n kwo asuyi , n na abemi yi n kwa iko dayi .
vinya kristi nu na zhin ɓa n tu wohin latu ɓo .
wo nyi kafin nyaho-nyahoi ya , owo iko nu n na i nya vinya yi shi .
owo nu zhin tukwo , owo nayi nya , wato ikklisiya-nwo ɓei ya , owo nu zhin shugaba aza nya nɓa kukala n efi , n na abai wa zhin kmisunyi n na anya vinya .
gama shekwoyi ɓei ye owohin tukwo wa dna nwo nugun .
ntu n nya ɓo nu n wo nugun a zhin , shekwoyi wo fin zokwo ya nyaho-nyahoi kwa ɓeda wo .
anya vinya n esbe n ekni yi , gama kristi efi tu zundu kwo na ɓe n jedoɓe yi n shekwoyi .
fye filo n ɓo n fye ɓei mwakpa n shekwoyi nyi .
fye ɓei zhin owo anuɓayi nu to fyei ye won .
fye ɓei gnajegna-gna yi ya n wo .
ntu fye aɓo anubo zhin nukwoyi ɓo , n na aɓe zhin nukwoyi , ama nsaiye wo la fye jezeɓe n cei ngye owo anugundo .
wa zhin ce dna n owo efi mi n wa fi dna n nayi tu n zundu nyi ntu n ce nu kristi ku ɓe n fyei n shekwoyi abye , fyei gni agni zhin wo abye n sayi ye n tna laifi , n kwo ɓa zhin n wo ɓa nya fye ya .
nya gmanyi , okwo nu fye ku gaiciya ga , fya ku mi zhin kwo , n kalayi dna n dagayi fya ku tabata nabari manayi nge yesu ɓela fi ntu n fye ɓo , to fya shan-shan , n wo gaiciya ga wa gni fyen , nabari wowoyi n kwo ɓei ɓe fye aba , kwoi laɓa lo nsaiye n na anyi , emi bulus , mi na agmadai lo ma gna azaje .
ama emi tnu-tnu nu ma sin wahala ntu fye ɓo , ai dami lo , gama mi bmazhin lo ma nu kristi azhingye n tu wo nayi ɓo , wato ikklisiya .
asiri la kpe anya ya shekwoyi , la tnu n mi yi ma bma ikklisiya zhin , ma wu abyedo owo asiri .
wo ɓei nwo asiriyi soshi tunyi n sapa , ama kwa dawo wa gna aza n ɓa yewo ɓai se-ase ntu n owo ɓo , n mwa-mwa yi anabarkayi owo shiri nya ɓa zhin fye nya nu .
asiriyi nu nyi , nge , kristi n efyemi , owo nu zhin efye awyetu , n mwa-mwa yi .
ntucenu aba vinya n ya lo ya gna aza kristi nabari n ɓa ɓa wo , yi zhin ɓa gargadi , yi wu ɓa shiyi kpeye lo nsun , yi n cei pma yami ya ɓe n zaho-zahoi n shekwoyi abye n gyi-gyi-yi ntu n nya ɓo n kristi ku zhin ga zaho-zahoi nyi .
omi tnu-tnu nyi mami ma zhin kwo , ntuge kristi iko dnagmayi gami kala lo nu n mi mi .
wasika ye gmi n bulus akun nu n ti-matawus yi , aza n shekwoyi wa kni ɓa , ɓa ze yesu kristi a tnutnuyi .
kwoi lo eyi azaje aba a yesu viyi , shekwoyi aza n ɓa fi n kolosi zhimi nyi .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada wa tu fye anabarka wa nu fye n wo bugba fu dnagmayi .
esa vinya n ya zhin aduwa ntu fye ɓo , yi zhin ya zhin shekwoyi eyi dagayi yesu kristi dada godiya .
gama yi ku wo , shi fye kpema dagayi n jesun shi fye ye owo aza n sun .
fye pmi agmada eshe nya nu , tunyi esa n na ɓei kmi fye waʼazi nabari manayi nya zhin nyi .
nabari manayi n kwo ɓei ɓe fye abanyi , kwo laɓa lo n na anyi kwoi shan aza wye-wyeyi do .
she ko ɓei shan fye nya do nyi , tunyi ewyi n fye ɓei wo , fya gane n shekwoyi alheriyi n na alaifida aba .
abafras , eyi za yeyei , tnu-tnu kunzhin yi , owo nu ɓei ɓe fye n nabari manayi yei .
wo zhin yesu kristi fyenu gbenuyinu .
wo lo woi bma yi zhin n ya nfye maimako .
owo nu na gnayi ye-ye dnagmayi ɓo , nfye cei lolo n na azaje aba nyi , n zafun gyi-gyi-yi wa ga fye nyi .
ntucenu , tunyi ewyi n yi ɓei wo of ye ɓo nyi , yi zhin aduwa ga fye lo , yi nya shekwoyi nge wo bma fye zhin , fya kpe enya ye nwoln cei pma fya zhin , yi nyawo wa ga fye ce-ce dna n zafun zokwo .
yi nya wo n na abai efye asese ɓa da dagayi agma kwa la wo tu , n na bai nfye ɓa bwa ɓe manayi zhin , fyei zhin aza ɓe manayi , fya tumwi fya kpe shekwoyi ye lo abye-abye .
yi zhin aduwa n jesun , wa nu fye n wo kala yi n mwa-mwa n na bai fya gyi abye ko knidonu yi na zhiʼa .
fya ze nu-nu yi n dagayi agmada yi cici .
yi sa dada ami n tu ge wa zhin yi , yi ku kunce ya bwa anya awo-woyi , n ɓa zhin aza nya n ɓa fi n buzangna ebemi nyi .
gama wo la yi kun n wyegma n shetan ebemi , woi fiyi n wo nugun ye-yeyi ebemi .
nwa siyi n wo amiyi , wa zhin yi alaifi gafara vinya .
kristi nu zhin dogbe shekwoyi nya , n na ata gyewye nyin .
wo ɓei nyi tun to shekwoyi zhin nyahonyaho yin .
ɓehin-hin , kristi nu na zhin anya vinya n ɓa fi n ʼshe mi n anyi miyi , anya n yi gye n na anya yi n yi ta gyen .
anya , a zafun nya n kwo asuyi , n na abemi yi n kwa iko dayi .

awomilo ngye fye kpe shi mi sunkun lo , mi-i zhin aduwa ga fye ɓedo ikklisiya yi n kwo nyi n lawudikiya nyi , n mi anugundo yi n ɓa ta shin mi ye kpe lon .
nya nyi n mi nya shekwoyi ntu fye ɓo , fya bwa kala fya nyimaje dna n ye-ye , fya kpe kristi ye dei-dei , n tna wyegma .
gama shekwoyi shiri asiri , n na ala guya wuyi nyi , okwo nu zhin kristi n wohin tukwo yi .
dna n wo nu a ɓeyekpe n cece yakwo yi sofi .
mi da deye ntu ge mi wo dna kada zaho wa ɓe fye aba n ɓeda dadayi , wa dna fye kwoce .
fye to ye a wun fye gaiciya yam gama ko mi lo n kpai n fyei , omi bugba kunsun lo n fyei , ai dami ntu fye gaiciya ga kalada ɓo dna n kristi .
nsaiye shi fya kpema kristi wa gnifye nyi , fye kpema wo lonu fyegyi-fyegyi , fyei nyima wo cici .
fye fa efye agbegye ɓa mifi n wo , fya bwa nyagyi zafunya nwo .
fye gyi abye n mwa-mwa yi dna n dagayi , fya ku dna kala n mizhi n gaiciya , n na ɓei wu fye nyi .
ofye awye-wyeyi ɓa nu na gmadayi n godiyayi ntu n nya ɓo n wo ku zhin .
fyeto fa aza ɓa wunfye gaiciya ga ya n ye-ye yin , n na anyi ɓeyekpe yin , oɓa amsa nukwoyi , akpe-kpe gyei n na mi ɓa kpe n aza ɓeyekpe na ɓo mwi yi , mai-makon nya n kristi wa da .
gama dna kristi shekwoyi wa wu wohin tukwo dna n nayi .
ntu cenu fye n na anya yi lo vinya n dei fye n kristi yi lo , ai ku fye nu n shekwoyi ntu n fye gmanyi ze ɓo n kristiyi .
o wo nu zhin begyi yi dnagmayi ndu zaho-zahoi n wo n ikoyi .
sanu n fya ɓe kristi aba wa lo fyeya n fye ashakpe nukwoyi to ge n kaciya zhin ɓon , ama dna n zafun baptisma ofya wye-wyeyi nya .
gama dna n baptisma fye gye shi efya anayi akwo-kwoyi , anukwoyi ɓo ku fi n gnisun woi , aku fye bi n gnisun n woi , fya kun n ʼfi n woi , dna n wye-wyeyi woi-woyi ntu ge fye ɓei ga shekwoyi ikoda ɓeda gaiciya n wo ɓei la kristi kala n ʼfi nyi .
fye ɓei ku fi fi n fye alaifi , ato ɓei zun fye a shakpe a laifi nya yan .
wa ga fye aba dna n kristi wye wyeyi gama wo ɓei ku fye zhin gafara .
wa zo of ye knizun vinya , owo awyidna vinya nfye to ɓei shi ɓa bwa nyin .
wa ku alaifi ye vinya wa zunɓadu tu n kristi zundu .
dna n zokwoye nu n shekwoyi ɓei wun shetan ikoya , n wo zan fye laifi zanyi nyi , shekwoyi wa wu anyi vinya pei-pei kristi nasara tu n zundu , aba n na aɓei lo n fye alaifi yi nyi .
ntucenu fye to fa oza wa zan-fye laifi zanyi ntu n na anya ɓo n fye gyi ko nfye sin .
ko ntu ge fye ta shi a yahudiyi anyipyei agyi-gyi yi bwa lon , ko epya woi ko asabar woyi m .
gama adeye ɓei zhin awyidna ntu n esa fyewyi ɓonu , n ɓa ɓei zo esa n kristi ɓei ɓe n cei nyi .
ɓa ɓei zhin ofun ɓehin-hin nyanu .
n kwo ɓe lo , wato , kristi n wohin tukwo .
fye to ye zaho-zahoi wa ci fye ge fye ku bwi , ntu ge fye ta zhin a malaika sujada lon .
shi ɓa gna fye ge tilas fya zhin nyin , ɓai gna ge ɓaku gye ruya ɓai kpela nge ko kuncelo fya gye .
aza tukwo mwayi ( koda yake ɓa gna nge ɓata mwa ɓahin tukwon . ) ɓa ce-ceyi lo dna n ɓa aɓemwi .
ama ɓato ɓedolo n kristi yin , tukwo n yi zhin okwo nayi nyin , gama yifi n wo nayi nu yi mwa , yi bwa nyagyi n kalayi n shekwoyi aba .
shi fye ku fi , n kristiyi , deye la fye loya n anyi ɓemwi ngye shi oza ɓo pwo nwu , dna n ɓemana zhin n na wyidna bwashi-kninu zhin fye ye viɓa n pa payi n na awyidna yi ge , to gyin , to towon , harma nge ato to anya gyiho pya bwan ma ?
aɓo kni ye pya ɓa zhin aza ɓowu nu kawai , ntuge aɓei zhin nya gyi agyi nu a zhin apma n cei .
aɓo kni ye wulo ngye ɓa bmiya , gama aɓokni ye pya ye n na aɓo bwashi n kala yinu , ndna ɓo , ɓai ga ɓa nayi wahala .
ama ɓato n kalai ɓa gyi nasara tu n oza a nubo zhin n na shakpe nukwoyin .
ɓa bwa oza zhin wa zhin aɓokwo nu .

fye la eshe bo shi nabye shi fye ɓei bwa wye-wyei n jesun , esa n kristi ɓei laka n efi nyi , fye la awyetu , nwo nyabwa yakwo , n na gmadayi eshe nya , aba n wo sase tu lo n shekwoyi bwaizhebwa , n she n mwa-mwai n ikoyi nyi .
fye zhin aɓo nubo nu n ɓa lo eshe , fyeto la esa n mwa n na anyiɓonubo zhin yin .
anyiɓo to fi fye pwan , ngye oza n wo lafi .
ofye wyewyeyi hin-hin lo n eshe n kristi yi ɓedo n shekwoyi .
esa n kristi nwo zhin eyi wye-wyeyi hin-hin , wa jezeɓe fye ɓei bmiya na fyei bwa owo mwa-mwa .
fyeku aɓo anukwoyi anyi nya ya , fye ku aɓo anukwoyi wu n ɓa fi n fyemi nyi , fye la abwa kun n na anagbai zhi , cegye , shakpe n na aɓo pwawo vinyikwo nya yi , fyeto gyi anya manayi anyi nya wyen , gama deye kwo zhin shangba nu .
shekwoyi minagyi tulo n na aza , n ɓa zhin aɓeye pya nyi .
fye ɓei zhin fyei zhin ɓa esa n fye ɓei zhin anyi nya nu nyi .
ama nsaiye , esa la si n fye ɓa kma anya gye ya , fya kma jekpe kwo-kwoyi minagyi nya ya , nbmi-bmiyi , akmi , na ɓeda kasayi .
fye to ce akata fi ajen , ofye wyewyeyi kwo-kwoyi nu ɓei zhin kwoi zhin lonu , nsaiye kwo la fi .
nsaiye fye se ase woi-woi nu , kwoi tu ɓemana mwi ci-ci , kwoi zhin atna kwa wu ngye kristi , n wa zhin wyewyeyi woi-woi n efye mi nyi .
dna n wye-wyeyi woi-woi ye , oza ekni , ko ilimi , ko oza masei kwo to zhin nyaho nun , anya gye vinya to zhin nyaho nun , ndei oza n kristi yi lo okwo nu zhin nyaho , woi gni n na aza ɓonu vinya .
tunda shekwoyi la fye kni , n wa ga fye wye-wyeyi woi-woi nyi , ntu n wo ye-ye lolo yi ɓo n fye aba , fye tu sun-sun-gye mwi , n bugbafuyi n na azaye n cei .
fye to damu n ɓei n ɓa ɓa dan , ama fye sin wahala dna n na atnazhin n hakuri yi .
fye zhin peceye fyei zhin shiri fya zhin aza gafara .
fye to shi za n fye min , fye pa ge dagayi n ku gafara zhin fye , ntucenu tilas fya zhin azaje gafara .
nkwo sin vinya , fye fa ye-ye kwa gyi be n ofye awye-wyeyi nlonu ikklisiya vinya ɓa sase nbugbai gmanyi .
fye fa bugbafu n kwo gmi n kristi aba nyi , kwa dna n fye abugbami cici , gama efye tnu-tnu nyi n fye sai n fye zhin owo nayi aganyi .
fyei zhin godiya cici .
fye pa enya ɓo n kristi ɓei wu nyi , fye fa owo aɓeda kwa dna n fye abugba mi , kwa ce fye .
fye wu fye azaje , fyei kwo ɓa n zabura yi , n anyi zafun nyayi , fyei kwo anyi ga dagayi n bugba dayi .
enya vinya n fya zhin kwo fya da , fye fa kwa ze wakili dagayi yesu nya , fya ɓe n gnisun n woi n shekwoyi dada abye fya zhin wo godiya .
jedoɓe manayi ofye anyikwoza , fye vi efye aɓa ɓo gama nyanu n shekwoyi wa zhin shiri ga fye .
ofye azanugbayi tila fya ye n fye anyikwozayi , fyei wuɓa alheri , to fya gyi minagyi nɓai , ko fya wun bugba n ɓa yin .
ofye aɓi tilas fya vi ofye azakwoyi ɓo efye adada n efye ayai gama deye kwo da shekwoyi agma .
adada , fye to wun efye aɓi bugba , har bugba bma ɓa ya m , ɓa fa kukari zhi ɓon .
efye afyenu tilas fya vi efye adagayi anyi nya ɓo to fya zhin atna fya zhin oɓo n kwo daɓa ɓai zhi nu gmanyin , ama fye vi ɓa ɓo cici , ntu n fye dagayi ye-ye ɓo n fye n cei pma fya dawo bugba nyi .
fye zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi n bugba bui-buyi n esa yi vinya , n gye fye zhin dagayi tnu-tnu nu to ge ngye efye adagayi nyan .
fyei pa ge , dagayi kristi nu ɓa gba fye ta , woi ga fye anya vinya n wo cei .
owo nu nfye zhin wo tnutnu .
nfye to la fyehin yin , wo ɓei gbafye n nya yi n fye to n cei pman , gama wo ta kni oza kni-kni n na awa daban , n oza ɓa laka ai dawon .
shi fye ɓei bwa wye-wyei n jesun , esa n kristi ɓei laka n efi nyi , fye la awyetu , nwo nyabwa yakwo , n na gmadayi eshe nya , aba n wo sase tu lo n shekwoyi bwaizhebwa , n she n mwa-mwai n ikoyi nyi .
fye zhin aɓo nubo nu n ɓa lo eshe , fyeto la esa n mwa n na anyiɓonubo zhin yin .
anyiɓo to fi fye pwan , ngye oza n wo lafi .
ofye wyewyeyi hin-hin lo n eshe n kristi yi ɓedo n shekwoyi .
esa n kristi nwo zhin eyi wye-wyeyi hin-hin , wa jezeɓe fye ɓei bmiya na fyei bwa owo mwa-mwa .
fyeku aɓo anukwoyi anyi nya ya , fye ku aɓo anukwoyi wu n ɓa fi n fyemi nyi , fye la abwa kun n na anagbai zhi , cegye , shakpe n na aɓo pwawo vinyikwo nya yi , fyeto gyi anya manayi anyi nya wyen , gama deye kwo zhin shangba nu .
shekwoyi minagyi tulo n na aza , n ɓa zhin aɓeye pya nyi .
fye ɓei zhin fyei zhin ɓa esa n fye ɓei zhin anyi nya nu nyi .
ama nsaiye , esa la si n fye ɓa kma anya gye ya , fya kma jekpe kwo-kwoyi minagyi nya ya , nbmi-bmiyi , akmi , na ɓeda kasayi .
fye to ce akata fi ajen , ofye wyewyeyi kwo-kwoyi nu ɓei zhin kwoi zhin lonu , nsaiye kwo la fi .
nsaiye fye se ase woi-woi nu , kwoi tu ɓemana mwi ci-ci , kwoi zhin atna kwa wu ngye kristi , n wa zhin wyewyeyi woi-woi n efye mi nyi .
dna n wye-wyeyi woi-woi ye , oza ekni , ko ilimi , ko oza masei kwo to zhin nyaho nun , anya gye vinya to zhin nyaho nun , ndei oza n kristi yi lo okwo nu zhin nyaho , woi gni n na aza ɓonu vinya .
tunda shekwoyi la fye kni , n wa ga fye wye-wyeyi woi-woi nyi , ntu n wo ye-ye lolo yi ɓo n fye aba , fye tu sun-sun-gye mwi , n bugbafuyi n na azaye n cei .
fye to damu n ɓei n ɓa ɓa dan , ama fye sin wahala dna n na atnazhin n hakuri yi .
fye zhin peceye fyei zhin shiri fya zhin aza gafara .
fye to shi za n fye min , fye pa ge dagayi n ku gafara zhin fye , ntucenu tilas fya zhin azaje gafara .
nkwo sin vinya , fye fa ye-ye kwa gyi be n ofye awye-wyeyi nlonu ikklisiya vinya ɓa sase nbugbai gmanyi .
fye fa bugbafu n kwo gmi n kristi aba nyi , kwa dna n fye abugbami cici , gama efye tnu-tnu nyi n fye sai n fye zhin owo nayi aganyi .
fyei zhin godiya cici .
fye pa enya ɓo n kristi ɓei wu nyi , fye fa owo aɓeda kwa dna n fye abugba mi , kwa ce fye .
fye wu fye azaje , fyei kwo ɓa n zabura yi , n anyi zafun nyayi , fyei kwo anyi ga dagayi n bugba dayi .
enya vinya n fya zhin kwo fya da , fye fa kwa ze wakili dagayi yesu nya , fya ɓe n gnisun n woi n shekwoyi dada abye fya zhin wo godiya .
ofye anyikwoza , fye vi efye aɓa ɓo gama nyanu n shekwoyi wa zhin shiri ga fye .
ofye azanugbayi tila fya ye n fye anyikwozayi , fyei wuɓa alheri , to fya gyi minagyi nɓai , ko fya wun bugba n ɓa yin .
ofye aɓi tilas fya vi ofye azakwoyi ɓo efye adada n efye ayai gama deye kwo da shekwoyi agma .
adada , fye to wun efye aɓi bugba , har bugba bma ɓa ya m , ɓa fa kukari zhi ɓon .

ofye afyenu adagayi , fye zhin ofye afyenu ɓo cewo , fye pa n fyehin ge fye n dagayi lolo n eshemi n wo kafye wyelo .
ato ɓe fye n na aduwa zhin yin , fye pmi shekwoyi amsa , fya pa fya zhin wo godiya esa n ɓa ɓe n cei .
fye to ze amwi , fye zhin yi aduwa ntu yi ɓo n na ɓai shekwoyi wa gayi aba n yi ɓa zhin nabari manayi kristi nya waʼazin n mi dna n kurkuku n tu kwo ɓo nyi .
fye zhin aduwa , n mi ɓa zhin waʼazi n bugba kalayi , n nu-nuyi n jesun , ma wu kwo pei-pei shi kwo kunce ma zhin .
fye zhin apma n esa yi n fya bwa vinya , fya gna aza nabari manayi , fye la ce , shi fye daɓo n ɓai n wu .
fye fa efye azata ɓa ze a manayi n tukwoyi gyi , n na ɓai fya bwa amsa manayi n fye ɓa ga aza .
gnaɓi tikikus eyi zado ye-yei , wo ɓa gnafye shi mi wulo , wo zhin oza nu n wo zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi , woi zhin dagayi tnu-tnu n gnisun n mi yi .
mi tnu n woi n na bai wa gye she fye wu , wa fumi bugba wa gami bugba kala njesun .
mi tnu n onisimus yi , eyi za ye-yei ɓemanayi zhinyi , oza nfye mi , owo n tikikus yi ɓa ga fye nabari vinya .
aristarkus , n wo gnisun n miyi n ya nyi wo dnalo n kurkuku , wo tnu fye n wo gnaɓiyi n markus yi barnaba , zhalu shi ma gnafye nyi fye gwo markus n na agmadayi n wa ɓe fye aba .
yesu yustus wo tnu fye lo nwo gna ɓiyi a deye zhin a yahudiyi a yesu-viyi nu , n ɓa kunsun lo n miyi , ɓai fumi bugba .
abafras , n wo gmi n fye ayi nyi , yesu kristi fyenu , wo tnu fye n wo gnaɓiyi , wo zhin aduwa cici ntu fye ɓo , woi nya shekwoyi wa ga fye kala , wa bma fye zhin fya kpe wo nufi ye n sai vinya n na aɓo vinya n fye ɓa zhin .
mi gnafye ɓehin-hin , woku tnu-tnu zhin fye n mwa n wo aduwa yi , n na a yesuviyi n ɓafi n lawudikiya n hiyarabokis nyi .
likita luka wo tnu fye n wo gnaɓi yi , n dimas yi .
fye ɓi a yesu-viyi gna n ɓa fi n lawudikiya nyi , n nimfas yi n na azai n ɓa ye zhi n wo puwa nyi .
sanu n fya wasikaye ɓa , fya tnu n kwoi n lawudikiya .
efyehin fya ba wasika n ma ka gaɓa nyi .
fya gna arkibbus , la tabata lalle ho zhin oɓo lo n dagayi wa gnaho ge ho zhin . emi gnaɓi nyi n mi rubutu yi n ma ka .
fye pami ɓo dna ya n kurkuku , shekwoyi anabarka ɓa shekna fye , amin .
ofye afyenu adagayi , fye zhin ofye afyenu ɓo cewo , fye pa n fyehin ge fye n dagayi lolo n eshemi n wo kafye wyelo .

yi sa shekwoyi ami lo cici ntu fye ɓo , yi zhin aduwa ga fye nsayi vinya .
yi ta ze ofye atnu-tnu ye-ye nya amwi , esa n yi daɓo n shekwoyi dadayi , ntu fye ɓom , nfye gaiciya ga kalada yi , nfye awyetu yi nfye cei ntu dagayi yesu kristi jezeɓe ɓo nna anyi nyin .
gaiciya-ga kpakalayi yi kpelo ge shekwoyi la fye kni , eyi azaje ye-yeyi n shekwoyi ye fye n mwa nyi .
gama esa n yi ɓei ɓe fye n nabari manayi nyi , kwo to ɓei ze oɓo gbeloyi nu n fye aban , ama fye ɓei kna tnubua n na gmadayi .
enya n yi ɓei gna fye , kwo ɓei ku tnu-tnu yakwo lo nfye mi , ntu ge zafun gyi-gyi-yi ɓei ku buzangna ga fye , fya kpe lalei ge ɓeda n yi gna fye nyi kwo zhin gaiciya nu .
fyei kpe lo shi eyi ase-se ɓei ku wu fye nge eyi ɓeda zhin gaiciya nu .
ntu ce nu fye ku ze eyi aviyi n shekwoyi anya yi , ntu ge fye ɓei la eyi ɓeda gwo n bugba buibuyi n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aba , to fyei gye efye anuwan n wahala yi nbugbawun yi n kwo ɓei ɓe fye n ce yin .
ofye nfyehin fye ku ze ɓesisi n a yesu-viyi aba , nɓa fi n helleni kni nyi .
nsaiye dagayi ɓeda nla kun nfye aba , kwoi gnami lo azaje aba vinya , kwoi lo aknido , ntu ge abaho-bahoyi n ya lo ya wo aza ɓai gna yi efye gaiciya ga ɓo .
ntu ge ɓa gnayi shi fye ɓei gwo yi nwu , shi fye ɓei pmi avun wu efye ashan-gba , fya vi shekwoyi , n nabai nsayi ye shekwoyi wye-wyeyi da n gaiciya da yi , wo nu gmanyi ɓa ze fye tukwoda .
ɓai da lo ngye shi fye nawyetuyi lo ntu shekwoyi nugun jezeɓe n ʼshe , wato yesu , n shekwoyi ɓei la wo kala n vingwo nyi , wo nu zhin eyi gniyi n shekwoyi minagyi n kwo ɓe lo nyi .

yi kpelo ge shekwoyi la fye kni , eyi azaje ye-yeyi n shekwoyi ye fye n mwa nyi .

ɓai da lo ngye shi fye nawyetuyi lo ntu shekwoyi nugun jezeɓe n ʼshe , wato yesu , n shekwoyi ɓei la wo kala n vingwo nyi , wo nu zhin eyi gniyi n shekwoyi minagyi n kwo ɓe lo nyi .
fye kpelo nfyehin , omi azaje , shi eyi ziyara ɓei ku zhin ampanyi .
fye kpelo shi a ɓei zhin yi ɓo n tna bmiya yi n filibi , kafin yi ɓe ofya ba , shi yi ɓei sin wahala n sun .
ama shekwoyi wa gayi kala ya je fye waʼazi zhin , koda yake anuwun-yi ɓei sheyi gun .
ntu cenu fye ku gye , yi to ɓei zhin waʼazi n nufi nukwoyi nu kwo shakpen , yi ɓei zhin fye n gaiciya yi nu ɓehinhin .
atnu-tnuyi n shekwoyi wa tnu gama yi daɓo n gye shekwoyi a tnu-tnuyi nu , n wa ye n ɓai , woi gaɓa tnu-tnu nge ɓa da gaiciya , yi to shan ɓeda ye do ko fyewyin , n nabai kwa da aza n ɓa won , gama yi zhin shekwoyi nu tnu-tnu gmanyi , n wo dna eyi abugba wyenyi , n ɓa aɓo nubo zhin yi .
yi to zhin a tna kwo fyewyi ya wan fye hankali n ɓeda dadayin , shi fye kpelo , shekwoyi kpelo , yi to ɓei dna fye kwoce nu n na bai fya ga yi agyiwye n .
yi to shin ye n ge zaho ciyin , koda yake yi n iziniyi lo fya ga yi mwa-mwa ntu ge yi zhin atnu-tnuyi nu .
ama yi ɓei zhin peceiye n efye aba , shi oɓi ya zhin wa gawo ɓi nyagyi peceiye nyi .
yi ɓei ye fye n mwa har ya ga fye shekwoyi ɓeda , n yi awye-wye yi ɓe .
fye to ye palon , omi azaje , shi yi ɓei zhin tnu-tnu n fye aba n sun , nsukwoyi n nyi-pyei , ye zhin tnu-tnu , ya bwa nyagyi n na abai to ya tu azaho akayan , yi zhin shekwoyi nabari manayi waʼazi nfye aban .
fye zhin yi asaidada nu n fyehin , n shekwoyi yi , nge yi to n laifiyi lo n zaho aba n fye min .
yi ɓei daɓo n fyei ngye shi oɓidada zhin wa daɓo n wo aɓiyi .
fye to palon , shi yi ɓei tna fye abwa , yi gyifye wyen ?
nge , fye to ye , efye ase-se , kwa wun shekwoyi bugban , ama fye gawo bugbabuiyi n wa yi fye fi n wo ebemi nyi , fya gwo wo mwa-mwa nyi .
yi ta fa shekwoyi ami sa ɓo n tu ce n , ngye esa n yi ɓei zhin fye waʼazi , fye to ɓei zhin nubwo nge eyi ɓeda nun , ama fye ɓei gwo eyi ɓeda ngye shekwoyi ɓedanu , okwoi nu ɓehinhin .
kwa shan fyedo esa n fye ɓei gakwo gaiciya cei nyi .
njesun emi azaje fye ku wahala sin shi ikklisiya n yahudiya ɓei sin nyi .
wahala nfye aza akun , shi ɓa ɓei sin wahala n na a yahudiyi akun nyi .
sanu n ɓa ɓei ku anabi wu , n na avun ɓa wu dagayi yesu , n saiye ɓa kuyi ga wahala n tna sun-sun gye , ɓa la yi nya ya .
ɓa zhin gaba n shekwoyi n na azayi .
ɓai zhin atna to ɓa ye ge yi zhin abyedo waʼazin , ɓai wo dna ge azaho ɓa pwo .
ntu cenu oɓa laifi ce kwoi mwa .
ama shekwoyi minagyi n la ɓa wan .
omi azaje , n na avun , yi ku fye fa yi to ye zhi lo n fye aban esa fyewyin ( eyi abugba to fa fyem ) ya zhin atna n mwa ya jezeɓe ya gye fye .
yi ɓei n cei pma ya ɓe , emi , bulus , mi zhin atna ci-ci ma ɓe , ama shetan to wa yen .
gama yi sase , n kniɓei nua kwoi gayi awyetua , bugba bui , n yi lada yi n yi ɓa gma ?
ofyenu , eʼe fye ɓei ɓe yi n bugba buyi n mwa , yi gni-a-gni zhin n gnisun n dagayi yesu kristi abye esa n wa jeze ɓe n jesun .
gama efyenu zhin eyi arawani n bugba buyi .
fye kpelo nfyehin , omi azaje , shi eyi ziyara ɓei ku zhin ampanyi .
fye kpelo shi a ɓei zhin yi ɓo n tna bmiya yi n filibi , kafin yi ɓe ofya ba , shi yi ɓei sin wahala n sun .

yi to zhin a tna kwo fyewyi ya wan fye hankali n ɓeda dadayin , shi fye kpelo , shekwoyi kpelo , yi to ɓei dna fye kwoce nu n na bai fya ga yi agyiwye n .
yi to shin ye n ge zaho ciyin , koda yake yi n iziniyi lo fya ga yi mwa-mwa ntu ge yi zhin atnu-tnuyi nu .
ama yi ɓei zhin peceiye n efye aba , shi oɓi ya zhin wa gawo ɓi nyagyi peceiye nyi .
yi ɓei ye fye n mwa har ya ga fye shekwoyi ɓeda , n yi awye-wye yi ɓe .
fye to ye palon , omi azaje , shi yi ɓei zhin tnu-tnu n fye aba n sun , nsukwoyi n nyi-pyei , ye zhin tnu-tnu , ya bwa nyagyi n na abai to ya tu azaho akayan , yi zhin shekwoyi nabari manayi waʼazi nfye aban .
fye zhin yi asaidada nu n fyehin , n shekwoyi yi , nge yi to n laifiyi lo n zaho aba n fye min .
yi ɓei daɓo n fyei ngye shi oɓidada zhin wa daɓo n wo aɓiyi .
fye to palon , shi yi ɓei tna fye abwa , yi gyifye wyen ?
nge , fye to ye , efye ase-se , kwa wun shekwoyi bugban , ama fye gawo bugbabuiyi n wa yi fye fi n wo ebemi nyi , fya gwo wo mwa-mwa nyi .
yi ta fa shekwoyi ami sa ɓo n tu ce n , ngye esa n yi ɓei zhin fye waʼazi , fye to ɓei zhin nubwo nge eyi ɓeda nun , ama fye ɓei gwo eyi ɓeda ngye shekwoyi ɓedanu , okwoi nu ɓehinhin .
kwa shan fyedo esa n fye ɓei gakwo gaiciya cei nyi .
njesun emi azaje fye ku wahala sin shi ikklisiya n yahudiya ɓei sin nyi .
wahala nfye aza akun , shi ɓa ɓei sin wahala n na a yahudiyi akun nyi .
sanu n ɓa ɓei ku anabi wu , n na avun ɓa wu dagayi yesu , n saiye ɓa kuyi ga wahala n tna sun-sun gye , ɓa la yi nya ya .
ɓa zhin gaba n shekwoyi n na azayi .
ɓai zhin atna to ɓa ye ge yi zhin abyedo waʼazin , ɓai wo dna ge azaho ɓa pwo .
ntu cenu oɓa laifi ce kwoi mwa .
ama shekwoyi minagyi n la ɓa wan .
omi azaje , n na avun , yi ku fye fa yi to ye zhi lo n fye aban esa fyewyin ( eyi abugba to fa fyem ) ya zhin atna n mwa ya jezeɓe ya gye fye .
yi ɓei n cei pma ya ɓe , emi , bulus , mi zhin atna ci-ci ma ɓe , ama shetan to wa yen .
gama yi sase , n kniɓei nua kwoi gayi awyetua , bugba bui , n yi lada yi n yi ɓa gma ?
ofyenu , eʼe fye ɓei ɓe yi n bugba buyi n mwa , yi gni-a-gni zhin n gnisun n dagayi yesu kristi abye esa n wa jeze ɓe n jesun .
gama efyenu zhin eyi arawani n bugba buyi .
nabari manayi n timatawus aba esa n yi to ɓei shan min , ya pmin ya zun shaula ya ge kwo bmiya lo ya ku cefi n atina .
ya tnu n timatawus yi , eyi zado n tnutnu kunzhin-yi , shekwoyi tnu-tnu yi wa ɓe efye aba , wa ɓe fye gaiciya ga kala n bugba kalai , n nabai to fya zun fi ko fya bma bugba ya ntu wahala ɓo n fye sin nyin .
( ama fye kpelo wahala ye pya dna n shekwoyi shiri ntu n yi ɓo . ) ko esa n yi ɓei kunsun n fyeyi nyi , yi ɓei ku gna fye ge safyewyi wahala ɓa ɓe , kwoi la ku ɓe .
shimi ɓei danyi , esa n mi to ɓei shan mi to mi yi gye fye wyen , ma tnu n timatawus yi wa kpe kwo efye gaiciya ga ye n kalayi lo , mi ɓo wodna kwo shetan ku nasara gyi tu n ofye tukwo , eyi tnu-tnu kwoi la ze gbeloyi .
nsaiye timatawus la jeze ɓe , woi gna mi ge , of ye gaiciya ga , n ye-ye yi ɓa gyi abye lo .
fyei pa eyi ziyara ɓo n bugba bui buyi shi fye n cei pma fya gye yi wye , shi yihin cei pma ya gye fye wye nyi .
ntu cenu omi azaje bugba kuyi fu , dna n yi wahala n yi sin n ya nyi , tunda yi kpelo ge fye mi zhi lo n dagayi nyi .
yi ɓa mizhi dna nyaho-nyahoyi ndei yi kpelo ge fye kpema dagayi lo .
yi ta mi ya sa shekwoyi ami n kunce , ntu fye ɓon !
ntu bugba buibui ɓo n fye gayi ngye shi shekwoyi wo yi aduwa ntu fye ɓo nyin .
nsukwoyi n nyipyei yi zhin aduwa ntu nfye ɓo , yi gyi shekwoyi wye , ya gye fye njesun ya nu enya n kwo ce yalo n fye gaiciya ga .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada nwohin tukwo , n yi dagayi yesu yi , wa tnu n yi , nfye aba njesun .
fa dagayi wa zhin ofye yeye kwa mwa lo abye-abye , kwa nu , kwoi gyiya ga efye azaje n na azayi vinya , shi eyi ye-ye ɓe fye aba nyi .
deye ɓa zhin ofye abugba ɓa bwa kala , n tna laifi , n gyi-gyi-yi n shekwoyi eyi dada yi .
n na bai fya gni-gni zhi n wa abye n tna laifi , ewyi n eyi dagayi yesu kristi ɓei jezeɓe n gnisun n na azayi n ɓa zhin owo anya nyi .
esa n yi to ɓei shan min , ya pmin ya zun shaula ya ge kwo bmiya lo ya ku cefi n atina .
ya tnu n timatawus yi , eyi zado n tnutnu kunzhin-yi , shekwoyi tnu-tnu yi wa ɓe efye aba , wa ɓe fye gaiciya ga kala n bugba kalai , n nabai to fya zun fi ko fya bma bugba ya ntu wahala ɓo n fye sin nyin .
( ama fye kpelo wahala ye pya dna n shekwoyi shiri ntu n yi ɓo . ) ko esa n yi ɓei kunsun n fyeyi nyi , yi ɓei ku gna fye ge safyewyi wahala ɓa ɓe , kwoi la ku ɓe .
shimi ɓei danyi , esa n mi to ɓei shan mi to mi yi gye fye wyen , ma tnu n timatawus yi wa kpe kwo efye gaiciya ga ye n kalayi lo , mi ɓo wodna kwo shetan ku nasara gyi tu n ofye tukwo , eyi tnu-tnu kwoi la ze gbeloyi .
nsaiye timatawus la jeze ɓe , woi gna mi ge , of ye gaiciya ga , n ye-ye yi ɓa gyi abye lo .
fyei pa eyi ziyara ɓo n bugba bui buyi shi fye n cei pma fya gye yi wye , shi yihin cei pma ya gye fye wye nyi .
ntu cenu omi azaje bugba kuyi fu , dna n yi wahala n yi sin n ya nyi , tunda yi kpelo ge fye mi zhi lo n dagayi nyi .
yi ɓa mizhi dna nyaho-nyahoyi ndei yi kpelo ge fye kpema dagayi lo .
yi ta mi ya sa shekwoyi ami n kunce , ntu fye ɓon !
ntu bugba buibui ɓo n fye gayi ngye shi shekwoyi wo yi aduwa ntu fye ɓo nyin .
nsukwoyi n nyipyei yi zhin aduwa ntu nfye ɓo , yi gyi shekwoyi wye , ya gye fye njesun ya nu enya n kwo ce yalo n fye gaiciya ga .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada nwohin tukwo , n yi dagayi yesu yi , wa tnu n yi , nfye aba njesun .
fa dagayi wa zhin ofye yeye kwa mwa lo abye-abye , kwa nu , kwoi gyiya ga efye azaje n na azayi vinya , shi eyi ye-ye ɓe fye aba nyi .
deye ɓa zhin ofye abugba ɓa bwa kala , n tna laifi , n gyi-gyi-yi n shekwoyi eyi dada yi .
n na bai fya gni-gni zhi n wa abye n tna laifi , ewyi n eyi dagayi yesu kristi ɓei jezeɓe n gnisun n na azayi n ɓa zhin owo anya nyi .
fye ku ze aza gyi-gyi-yi omi azaje fye kpelo , shi fye ɓa da shekwoyi bugba , dna n fye asese fyegyi-fyegyi , gama fye kpe wyidna ye lo n yi ɓei ga fye dna n dagayi yesu , nsaiye yi gyi fye wye dna n dagayi yesu , nge fye zan-zan shi ya wu fye .
cama shekwoyi n cei pmalo fya ze aza gyi-gyi-yi , ntna cegye , fya bui anagbayi si n na abai zaho-zahoi wa pa mula n gyi-gyi-yi .
to ge n shakpe yin , shi abyedo zhin nyin , ntu n tna shekwoyi yekpe ɓo n wo azokwoyi nyin .
deye kwonu zhin shekwoyi ɓeye , nge fye to gyi efye zado fi fya a ezado nyikwon , ntuge dagayi ɓa ta fye n mwa , shi yi ɓei shin fye gna nyi .
gama shekwoyi to yi yi , ya ze aza nu nɓa bugbayi nu-nuyi n cegye yi nun , n nu-nuyi n shakpe yin , ama ya ze aza agyi-gyi-yi .
oza n wo to vi wyidna yen , wo ta zun aza ɓeda nu gnan , ama shekwoyi nya n wo ga fye owo zafun gyi-gyi-yi nyi .
ama ntu n na azaye n cei ɓo , n kwo kunce a bwa kwo n na shekwoyi aza ba nyi , mi to n na apma yi lo ma da ɓeho tu n kwo tukwon , gama shekwoyi n wohin wo wu fye lo , shi fye ɓa ye najeyi .
ɓehin-hin ofye ye-ye n kalai lo nfye a yesu-viyi aba , n fye kni vinya .
har nsaiye yi gyi fye wye fye ye ɓa lo na bye .
fye fa deye kwa ze fye ɓemwi , fya sase n lafiyai , fyei zhin fyehin tnu-tnu , shi yi ɓei shin fye gna nyi .
nnabai aza nɓata vi yesun ɓa ga fye gaiciya ɓa ga fye mwa-mwa , n fye ta zhin akma fya kpema aza ntu fye bukata ɓom .
yesu-viyi fi nsaiye , omi azaje , mi n cei pmalo fya kpe oɓo n kwo bwa yesu viyi , esa n wa fi n cei .
n na abai n kwa bwa fye , fyeta wun bugba n duwyin , ngye aza n ɓato n na awyetu yin .
shi yi ku gaiciya ga nge yesu la fi , wa lakala n vingwo n jesun nyi , yi ga gaiciya n jesun n ge esa n yesu ɓa jezeɓe , shekwoyi ɓei jezeɓe n na a yesu-viyi , n ɓaku fi n gnisun n woi nyi .
nɓa gna fye deye dagayi wu-wu nu , nge eyi n yi n wye-wyeyi , esa n dagayi ɓei jezeɓe nyi , yi to ɓei kukala ya gyi aza apye-apye n ɓa fi n vingwo nyin .
gama dagayi nu ɓei kashi ɓe n eshe , n wyisa kalai , wyisa a malayika esu ɓegye nya , n shekwoyi mwayi yi .
a yesu-viyi n ɓa ku fi , ɓanu ɓei kukala n na abye ɓa sun n dagayi .
n na avun , eyi n yi cezhi n wye-wyeyi n fi n na anyi nyi , a ɓei ku yi ya shegun dagayi n ʼshe bmana , elonu yi ɓei kunsun n woi nyalo-nyalo .
ntucenu fye fu aje bugba , fya ga aje kala n ɓeda ye yi .
omi azaje fye kpelo , shi fye ɓa da shekwoyi bugba , dna n fye asese fyegyi-fyegyi , gama fye kpe wyidna ye lo n yi ɓei ga fye dna n dagayi yesu , nsaiye yi gyi fye wye dna n dagayi yesu , nge fye zan-zan shi ya wu fye .

aɓeye vinya ɓei zhin n knisayi a ?
kwo to zhin tilas nu ma da ɓeho tu n kwo tukwon , omi-zaje .
gama fye kpelo sarai , nge zaho-zahoi ta kpeye lon , dagayi nyipyei ɓei ɓe n tna esa dnai nu , ngye evi n sukwoyi .
sanu n aza ɓei ci nge , lafiya lo sarai nyaho to wunya lon bugba fulo . nsa gmanyi yi wahala ɓa ɓeɓa tukwo , shi kagna zhin kwa ɓe nyikwoza aba to woi dna ce nyin .
aza deye to ɓei bwa asibui ban , gama abwi-ba to lo n .
ama emi aza je , fye to filo n wyegma n na aɓeye tukwon , dagayi nyipyeyi to ɓei ɓe efye aba ngye evin .
gama fye zhin abuzangna ɓinu anyipyeyi aɓi njesun fye to zhin wyegma nyanu kwo sukwo nyan .
ntucenu fye ku zhi fya pmi , fyeto wangye n gye azajen .

a wyidna n na ɓo pa yi omi azaje , fye ga efye ikklisiya tukwoda mwa-mwa , nɓa zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi n fye aba nyi , ɓai daɓo n fyei tu na aɓo tukwo n ɓato bmiya lo nyin .
fye gaɓa mwa-mwa fya ye ɓa nfye abugbai vinya ntuge ɓa bmafyenu zhin .
fye pa to fya wu anya n na jeyin .
omi azaje , fye gnakni aza n ɓa wo bwato , fye fu aza bugba n ɓa bugba la wunya , fya zhin aza atna nɓa to n kalai lon , fya zhin hakuri n na azai vinya .
fye to ye nge oza wo gba ɓenukwoyi ta n ɓenukwoyi yin , ama fye zhin atna fya zhin aje ɓemana , n na azaje vinya .
fye dagma cici .
fye zhin aduwa cici .

anabarka dnagmayi n ɓa kun n eyi dagayi yesu kristi aba nyi , ɓa kusun n zaho-zahoi n fye mi .
wasika ye gmi n bulus akun , n silwanus yi , n timatawus yi , kwoi lo ikklisiya aba n tasalunika , nfye zhin shekwoyi eyi dada n dagayi yesu kristi nya nyi .
shekwoyi dada n dagayi yesu kristi yi wo tu fye anabarka n mwa , n bugba fuyi nu nfye a bugba .
omi azaje , shekwoyi godiya zhin ntu fye ɓo kwo to zhin ɓe mana nu kawain , eyi tnu-tnu nu n shekwoyi aba , ntu fye gaiciya ga mwa-mwa yi ɓo , ntu ofye ye-ye ɓo n kwo mwalo n na aje aba nyi .
dalili wahala nya adayi lo n mwa har yi gna a ikklisiya aje ofye hakuri ɓo n gaiciya ga yi n shekwoyi , dna n fye wahala n fye sin nyi .
zokwo gmanyi nu nyi n shekwoyi zhin tnu-tnu , gama wo zhin a pma n wahala yi , woi zhin fye shiri ntu wo bemi ɓo .
njesun woi zhin owa shiri ɓedo n tatai , ntu n na aza ɓo nɓa ga fye wahala nyi .
ntuce nu nɓa gnafye , nfye sin wahala nyi shekwoyi ɓa gafye sunlsun n gnisun n yi , esa dagayi yesu ɓa ɓe , esa n yesu ɓa kashi ɓe n eshe , to yi dna cem , ɓedo n wo amalaika iko nya yi .
woi ɓe n owai , tu na aza tukwo n ɓata ye ɓa kpe shekwoyi yen , ɓai to ye ɓa gwo wo shiri wa gni ɓa dna n eyi dagayi yesu kristi n .
aɓei taɓa fi n anapr nyalo-nyalo nya , n gnajegna-gnayi ya n dagayi , ɓa ta gye owo iko mwa-mwa wyen , har abada .
sanu n wo ɓei ɓe , wa gwo latu n mwa mwayi n wo aza gyi-gyi-yi aba .
fyehin ɓo la wo tu ce , ntu ge fye ku gaiciya ga , n ɓeda n ya gnafye tu nwo tukwo nyi .
ntu cenu yi zhin aduwa ntu fye ɓo cici , nna bai eyi shekwoyi , dna nwo iko , wo ɓa zhin fye fya ze aɓi manayi , ngye shi wo ye fya ze , wa zhin fye fya nu ofye aɓomwi manayi , ntu fye gaici-ya ga ɓo .
n lonu aza vinya ɓa ci dagayi yesu kristi eye , ntu n na aɓo ɓbo gye n nfye .
ofye mwa-mwa dnagmayi nunyi vinya , nge fye zhin kristi nyanu .
sun-sun gye dnagmayi eyi shekwoyi nya , n dagayi yesu kristi yi nu na zhin deve kwoi si fye .

yesu jeze be lo .
nsaiye , eyi dagayi yesu kristi ɓeɓe njesun , n yi yezhi yi n wo aba ma ?
mi gyifye wye , agu to vin fyen , omi azaje , shi fye wo ai ce akata nge dagayi nyipyei la lu ɓen .
nfya wo aza ɓai gna ge , ɓa gye ruya , kwo ge shekwoyiwa tnu ɓa tnu-tnu , kwo wasika n fye zhin nubwo ge kwo gmi n mi aba , fye to ga gaiciyan .
fye to ye zaho-zahoi wa dna fye kwoce kwo fyewyin .
gama nyipyei ta ɓen sai anya ngun aba nku zhin , kmisunyi esa n aza ɓei na shekwoyi aɓo , n sayi oza kala kpeyi anapi ɓi wo ɓei ɓe .
wo ɓei tu shekwoyi cegye n nya doho-dohoi n na gakwo mwa-mwa , wo ɓei lo wo sase tu n shekwoyi nyakun ngye shekwoyi , woi cige wo zhin shekwoyi nu .
fye to ye palo nge mi ɓei ku ce gna fye , esa n mi ɓei kunsun n fyei nyin ?
fye kpe enya ye lo n kwo ye n woi shi , to woi ɓe yan , wo ɓa bwa ɓe owo sai lasi nu .
tnu-tnu n oza kala kpei n anapi nyayi ɓei zhin , esa n wa ɓe , kwo gyi abye lo n saiye , ama owo nwohin tukwo ta ɓen , sai oza n wo hana n woi nyi wola laka .
nsai oza nukwoyi ye ɓei ɓe , oza n dagayi yesu ɓei bmiwo na n wo gbe osun yi , woi wu wo , esa n wa jeze ɓe n cei .
benukwoyi zhin-hi ye , wo ɓei ɓe ngye shetan a tnu-tnu kaya , n nunuyi n shetan ikoyi , woi dna aza kwoce n na aɓe wo-woyi n wo ɓei zhin .
wo ɓei dna aza kwoce kpekpe n ɓa lo anapi nyi gama ɓala gaiciya aɓo na , ɓato ye kwo , ɓa gakwo gaiciya , n na bai kwa gni ɓam .
ntucenu shekwoyi ɓei fa ɓa , ɓa ga akata gaiciya n ɓa bugbayi vinya .
aɓei da ɓa owa dei-dei shi ɓa ga akata gaiciya , ɓai na gaiciya aɓo , ɓai gyi abye fi n ɓa a laifi .
ama tilas ya zhin shekwoyi godiya cici ntu fye ɓo , eyi aza je n dagayi ye fye nyi , gama shekwoyi a ɓei kni fye tunyi n sapa , wa ga fye gni-gni , woi zhan fye ya n zafun gyi-gyi-yi ntu fye kpema ɓo n gaiciya .
wo ɓei zhin apma n yi , wa gna fye nabari manayi .
wa yi fye fya ɓe fya bwa mwa-mwa eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya .
nna aɓeye vinyai fi n bugba , omi azaje , fye ku mi zhi fya ku gaiciya shi dei-dei , n yi ɓei wu fye nyi n doyi n yi ɓei ka fi fye n wasika nyi .
eyi dagayi yesu kristi n wohin tukwo n shekwoyi eyi dada , n wa ye yi wa gayi atnazhin nyalo-nyalo nya n na awyetu yi n yi to kunce ya bwan .
wo zhin fye bugba a tna , n na atnazhinyi vinya , wa bma fye zhin n ɓo manayi vinya , n fye ɓa zhin fyei da .
nsaiye , eyi dagayi yesu kristi ɓeɓe njesun , n yi yezhi yi n wo aba ma ?

ama dagayi zhin egbe-nuyi nu , wo ɓa ga fye kala wa gu fye n shetan agam .
yi n gaiciya ga yi lo ge , fye zhin aɓolo n yi ɓei wu fye nyi , fya zhin ɓa cici .
dagayi ɓa ga fye awyega fya gane n shekwoyi ye-ye yi , n hakuri yi n kwo gmi n kristi aba nyi .
wyidna nyi n yi ga fye , omi azaje , dna n eyi dagayi yesu kristi eye n wo ikoyi .
fye to gyi nugundo n yesu-viyi doho-doho yi n wo wo bwato , to woi ye wa vi tnu-tnu zhin zbo n kalai , ngye shi yi ɓei gna fye nyin .
gama fye kpelo tilas fya vi eyi fye , n fye ɓei gye to yi ka nkwo nyin .
yi to gwo nyagyi n zaho aba to yi-i gba won , ya zhin tnu-tnu mwa , n sukwoyi n nyipyei n na abai ya bwa agyiwye , n yi ɓei cei pma ya zhin apma n cei nyi , ntuge yi to ɓei cei pma ya tu fy akayan .
kwo to wu ge yi to ɓei n izini yi nu ya nyafye fya gayi nyagyin , ama yi ɓei cei pma ya wu fye , shi fye ɓa zhin tnu-tnu n tu fye asese ɓo .
esa n yi ɓei nyi n fye aba nyi , yi ɓei ga fye wyidna ye ge , oza n wo ta zhin tnu-tnun wo to gyi nyagyin . ama yi wo lo ge , aza ho n fye mi ɓa wo bwato lo , to ɓai ye ba zhin tnu-tnun , ɓai wun esaya dna n na agnagba zhin nu .
dna n dagayi yesu kristi eye , yi gna aza ye pya , yi gaɓa wyidna , ɓaku zhi pi , ɓa zhin tnu-tnu ɓa bwa nyagyi .
ofye nfye ce nyi , omi azaje , ato ɓe fye n ɓemanayi zhin yin .
oza n wo to vi ɓeda n yi cei kafi n a wasika ye nyin , fya kawo wye , fya pmiya nwo aba , n na bai n vinyikwo ɓa wowo .
fye to shi wo awye ngye efye nuɓaim , ama fye daɓo n woi ngye ozado n wo ye a wuwo zokwo n galgadiyi .
dagayi bugba fu nya , wo ga fye owo bugbafu , kwo knidoi nu bwa fya , dagayi wo kunsun n fyei vinya .
nsaiye omi gnaɓi nyi nmi ka n mi abwayi , shi mi shin zhin n mi wasika , kwa wu nge emi nu na ka , emi abwa nu kakpe n ya .

wasika ye kwo gmi n bulus akun nu , waʼazi zhin yi yesu kristi nya , n shekwoyi eyi gniyi n yesu kristi eyi dagayi eyi awyetu .
kwoi lo timatawus aba , timatawus ɓei zhin ngye omi-ɓi nu dna n dagayi .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada , n yesu kristi eyi dagayi wa wu ho owo alheri n sun-sun gyei , wa ga ho bugba fu yakwo n ho bugba mi n ho nubo zhin yi .
fye na abayi ( amalam ) katayi ɓo shi mi ɓei da esa n mi ɓei lo makidoniya nyi , la dna n afisus ha zhin atna ha kma aza n ɓa wu nya akata nya nyi .
ku oɓa asita n ɓa abyetnuyi ce n ɓa nubo-zhinyi n ge a ɓa gni aza dna n na aɓe a desi n na malaikai ɓei sido n shekwoyi abye n ɓato n na akpegnin bayin .
anubozhin n na aɓe mwi deye pya zhin ɓa la aɓena kala .
maimakon ɓa bma aza zhin ɓa gwo shekwoyi shiri gaiciya ga nya .
enya n kwo womi pwa lo kwonu ge a yesu-viyi n ɓo vinya ɓa ku nu n ye-yei n kwo gmi n na bugba gyi-gyi-yi oɓa bemwi n gyi-gyi-yi , oɓa gaiciya ga kwa bwa kala .
ama a malami deye ɓa ku bwi zokwo , ɓai gyi ɓahin esa , ɓai na aɓo , ɓai daɓo n tna ce-ce .
ɓa ye a kpe ɓaye nge musa a wyidnayi wuyi , ama ɓa ta kpe ye lo kwo fyewyi enya n na awyidna ye wuyi n .
awyidna ye bmiya lo , yi ya zhin apma n ɓai shi shekwoyi ɓemwi nyi .
ama ato zhin ɓa n yi ɓonu m , n shekwoyi gni-gni yi n , ntu n na laifi da ɓonu n ɓata ye shekwoyi nyi n , ɓa n na abugba kala kpenya yi , ɓai tu ekni , ɓai si nyasi , ɓai zhin gaba n ɓa dadayi , n ɓa ayai , aza wuyi .
e , awyidna ye a zhin ɓa ntuge ɓa wu a alaifi da nu , a cegye da aza tna gyi-gyi-yi , n azai n ɓa wangye n na azanugbayi , aɓi wanyi , akata ceyi n na azayi n ɓa zhin oɓo n kwo gni apapa n shekwoyi anabarkada nabari manayi , n mi zhin wo tnutnu yi nyi .
mi zhin kristi yesu eyi dagayi godiya n mwa , shi wa kni mi ma zhin wo tnu-tnu yi , woi gami kala ma zhin wo ɓefyece .
koda-yake mi ɓei zhin mi-i kpe kristi eye agye , mi-i zan ɓa fazan , mi-i zhin ɓa ɓo n mi ɓa mi .
ama shekwoyi wa gyemi sun-sun , gama mito ɓei kpe ɓe ye n mi zhin ntuge mito ɓei kpe kristi ye n sayin .
o , eyi dagayi , zhin alheri danu gama wa wumi shimi ɓa kpema wo , ma nu n kristi yesu yeyeyi .
kwo zhin gaiciya nu , mi n cei pma lo aza vinya ɓa kpe ce ye , n ge kristi yesu wa ɓe anyi mi wa gni alaifi da , omi yi nu zhin oɓa esu .
ama shekwoyi wa gye mi sun-sun , n na bai kristi yesu wa zhin apma n miyi , wa wu shi wo zhin hakuri n na alaifi dayi , har n ɓa dnagmayi yi , n na abai , n ɓa ɓa kpe nge ɓa ɓa mi ɓabwa wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya .
latu n mwamwayi ɓa zhin shekwoyi nya nu nyalo-nyalo amin .
wo nu zhin esu esa vinya nya , n na ta gye won , woi ta shan fin , owonu zhin shekwoyi gmanyi , n nunuyi n ɓeyekpeyi .
nsaiye , timatawus , omi-ɓi , omi gbe ga nyi n ho aba .
sun okun n kalai dagayi okun , shi dagayi gna n na annabi egbe nge ho ɓa zhin nyi .
la gaiciya ga shi n kalai dna n kristi ha anubo-zhin ze agyi-gyi-yi , ha zhin oɓo n kpe ge kwo zhin ɓemana nu .
gama azaho n la oɓa anubozhin zungna ɓai zhin oɓo n ɓa kpelo ge kwo to bmiya lon , kwo to zhin ɓe wo-woyi nu shi ɓa ya ɓa gaiciya ga dna n kristi , ɓai la shekwoyi eye aɓo na lo nun .
himinayus n iskandari yi ɓa zhin misali nu n kwo ɓei lami ze tilas ma gaɓa n shetan akun wa ta ɓa , har esa n ɓa ɓa tumwi to ɓa zhin kristi eye vinyikwo dna m .
wasika ye kwo gmi n bulus akun nu , waʼazi zhin yi yesu kristi nya , n shekwoyi eyi gniyi n yesu kristi eyi dagayi eyi awyetu .
kwoi lo timatawus aba , timatawus ɓei zhin ngye omi-ɓi nu dna n dagayi .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada , n yesu kristi eyi dagayi wa wu ho owo alheri n sun-sun gyei , wa ga ho bugba fu yakwo n ho bugba mi n ho nubo zhin yi .
shi mi ɓei da esa n mi ɓei lo makidoniya nyi , la dna n afisus ha zhin atna ha kma aza n ɓa wu nya akata nya nyi .
ku oɓa asita n ɓa abyetnuyi ce n ɓa nubo-zhinyi n ge a ɓa gni aza dna n na aɓe a desi n na malaikai ɓei sido n shekwoyi abye n ɓato n na akpegnin bayin .
anubozhin n na aɓe mwi deye pya zhin ɓa la aɓena kala .
maimakon ɓa bma aza zhin ɓa gwo shekwoyi shiri gaiciya ga nya .
enya n kwo womi pwa lo kwonu ge a yesu-viyi n ɓo vinya ɓa ku nu n ye-yei n kwo gmi n na bugba gyi-gyi-yi oɓa bemwi n gyi-gyi-yi , oɓa gaiciya ga kwa bwa kala .
ama a malami deye ɓa ku bwi zokwo , ɓai gyi ɓahin esa , ɓai na aɓo , ɓai daɓo n tna ce-ce .
ɓa ye a kpe ɓaye nge musa a wyidnayi wuyi , ama ɓa ta kpe ye lo kwo fyewyi enya n na awyidna ye wuyi n .
awyidna ye bmiya lo , yi ya zhin apma n ɓai shi shekwoyi ɓemwi nyi .
ama ato zhin ɓa n yi ɓonu m , n shekwoyi gni-gni yi n , ntu n na laifi da ɓonu n ɓata ye shekwoyi nyi n , ɓa n na abugba kala kpenya yi , ɓai tu ekni , ɓai si nyasi , ɓai zhin gaba n ɓa dadayi , n ɓa ayai , aza wuyi .
e , awyidna ye a zhin ɓa ntuge ɓa wu a alaifi da nu , a cegye da aza tna gyi-gyi-yi , n azai n ɓa wangye n na azanugbayi , aɓi wanyi , akata ceyi n na azayi n ɓa zhin oɓo n kwo gni apapa n shekwoyi anabarkada nabari manayi , n mi zhin wo tnutnu yi nyi .
mi zhin kristi yesu eyi dagayi godiya n mwa , shi wa kni mi ma zhin wo tnu-tnu yi , woi gami kala ma zhin wo ɓefyece .
koda-yake mi ɓei zhin mi-i kpe kristi eye agye , mi-i zan ɓa fazan , mi-i zhin ɓa ɓo n mi ɓa mi .
ama shekwoyi wa gyemi sun-sun , gama mito ɓei kpe ɓe ye n mi zhin ntuge mito ɓei kpe kristi ye n sayin .
o , eyi dagayi , zhin alheri danu gama wa wumi shimi ɓa kpema wo , ma nu n kristi yesu yeyeyi .
kwo zhin gaiciya nu , mi n cei pma lo aza vinya ɓa kpe ce ye , n ge kristi yesu wa ɓe anyi mi wa gni alaifi da , omi yi nu zhin oɓa esu .
ama shekwoyi wa gye mi sun-sun , n na bai kristi yesu wa zhin apma n miyi , wa wu shi wo zhin hakuri n na alaifi dayi , har n ɓa dnagmayi yi , n na abai , n ɓa ɓa kpe nge ɓa ɓa mi ɓabwa wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya .
latu n mwamwayi ɓa zhin shekwoyi nya nu nyalo-nyalo amin .
wo nu zhin esu esa vinya nya , n na ta gye won , woi ta shan fin , owonu zhin shekwoyi gmanyi , n nunuyi n ɓeyekpeyi .
nsaiye , timatawus , omi-ɓi , omi gbe ga nyi n ho aba .
sun okun n kalai dagayi okun , shi dagayi gna n na annabi egbe nge ho ɓa zhin nyi .
la gaiciya ga shi n kalai dna n kristi ha anubo-zhin ze agyi-gyi-yi , ha zhin oɓo n kpe ge kwo zhin ɓemana nu .
gama azaho n la oɓa anubozhin zungna ɓai zhin oɓo n ɓa kpelo ge kwo to bmiya lon , kwo to zhin ɓe wo-woyi nu shi ɓa ya ɓa gaiciya ga dna n kristi , ɓai la shekwoyi eye aɓo na lo nun .
himinayus n iskandari yi ɓa zhin misali nu n kwo ɓei lami ze tilas ma gaɓa n shetan akun wa ta ɓa , har esa n ɓa ɓa tumwi to ɓa zhin kristi eye vinyikwo dna m .
shi yi ɓa zhin aduwa nwu omi ɓeda nyi n ho aba , zhin aduwa n mwa ntu azaje ɓo , gyi shekwoyi wye wa gye ɓa sun-sun .
zhin shekwoyi godiya ntu nya ɓo nwo ɓa zhin ɓa nyi .
zhin aduwa ntu asu ɓo , na za yi n ɓa zhin a iko da vinya tu n yi eshe , kwo n ɓa n na tnu-tnu yakwoi shi , n na abai n yi ɓa sase n lafiyai , n bugba-fuyi , ya se ase manayi yi zhin nubo n dagayi ɓo .
deye bmiya lo , kwoi da eyi dagayi bugba .
gama wo ye aza vinya ɓa pwo , ɓa bwa gaiciya ye awyega .
nge shekwoyi gni n sepa gmanyi , aza vinya zhin n sepa gmanyi , n kristi yesu n wohin tukwo zanyikwoci n dna n ɓa tasin wa ɓe n bai n na aba gmanyi .
wa gawo wye-wyeyi ntu n na aza ɓo vinya .
ɓeda nyi n shekwoyi wa tnu n cei dna n esa manayi n na lanyi .
ai la mi kni gaiciya nu n mi da-ma zhin tnu-tnuyi n nabari da yi , shekwoyi nya , ma wu gaiciya ye n na abyedo aba , ma wuɓa shekwoyi shiri gni-gni nya dna n gaiciya ga .
ntu cenu miye aza vinya ɓa zhin aduwa ɓai ku abwa a gyi-gyi-yi wu shekwoyi n tna laifi , ntna minagyi , ntna nuwun .
anyikwoza ce ɓaku ze lo nu , ɓaku ce pi ɓa zhin ɓo kwo bmiya , ɓai pa aje cewo .
a yesu-viyi anyikwo a kpeɓaye ntu n ɓa ɓemana zhin ɓo , to n zokwo shiɓa zhin ɓahin aba , kwo tukwo knin , kwo anya shi-shi , kwo aje anakwoyin .
anyikwoza , ɓa kna tnubua ɓa tumwi peceiye n tukwo gbayi .
mita ye anyikwoza ɓa wunya kwo ɓa ze a tukwoda n na azanugbai tukwon .
ɓaku cepi n na aduwa nyakun n yezhi sa .
ntu kniɓei ya ?
ntuge shekwoyi ɓei zhin adamu nu nabye wa kma hawawu zhin .
shetan to ɓei dna adamu nu kwocen , ama hawawu nu , laifi kwa ɓe .
ntu cenu shekwoyi wa tnu anyikwoza n na azhinyi , esa n ɓa ma aɓi n cei , ama woɓa gniɓa wyewyeyi ɓai ya kpema wo , ɓai se ase pi-pi-pi , n bmiya ɓai ye n na azai .
omi ɓeda nyi n ho aba , zhin aduwa n mwa ntu azaje ɓo , gyi shekwoyi wye wa gye ɓa sun-sun .
zhin shekwoyi godiya ntu nya ɓo nwo ɓa zhin ɓa nyi .

ɓaku cepi n na aduwa nyakun n yezhi sa .

ntuge shekwoyi ɓei zhin adamu nu nabye wa kma hawawu zhin .

ntu cenu shekwoyi wa tnu anyikwoza n na azhinyi , esa n ɓa ma aɓi n cei , ama woɓa gniɓa wyewyeyi ɓai ya kpema wo , ɓai se ase pi-pi-pi , n bmiya ɓai ye n na azai .
hali tukwoda nya ɓeda ye kwo zhin gaiciya nu nge ndei oza ye wa zhin pasto , wo ɓemwi manayi dnalo n bugba .
gama tilas pasto wa zhin oza manayi n na ta dawo ɓeda nukwoyi n , n nyikwoyi gmanyi .
woi zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi , woi zhin nubo , cewo n nu-nuyi n na aɓemana zhinyi .
wa bwa bugba bui a zhiɓeyi ɓai ya ɓe wo puwa , wa zhin malami manayi dna n shekwoyi ɓeda .
wo to zhin eje sin yin , kwo anya wu yin , amma wola ze hankali da , mi bwayi , to wa ze oza nu n wo ye agyiwyen .
owo apuwa da ɓaku ze aza manayi , hankali da n na aɓiyi n ɓa vi ɓo n pye , n tna gnunu-gnunu dayi .
gama ndei oza to mi n wo iyali bwashin , wo ɓa mi n wuna wa shi ikklisiya bwa vinya ?
pasto tola ze yesu viyi woi-woi n , kada wo zhin aɓekwo nge alawo kni n pye aɓekwo gyi n kakaya abye .
( shetan ɓei kaya lonu ) .
a tna viyi ɓa zhin wo seida manayi , n na bai shetan ta piwo a gam n na ɓeda nukwoyi n wo tukwon , wa fa wo n tna gbebwa n wo ɓa wu owo akni zokwon .
abyeda , ɓaku ze aza manayi n gye a pasto .
ɓato ku ze aje sin yi yakwon , n na gyiwye ye yin .
ɓaku ze aza gaiciya da , ɓai vi kristi n bugbai gmanyi , n wo zhin yi gaiciya ga tukwo nyi .
kafin a gaɓa abye , aku tnu-tnu gaɓa n ikklisiya amwiɓa gye n ɓa haliyi , n kpe zhinyi , n ɓa ɓa zhin bmiya , ami a kniɓa ɓa ze abyeda .
oɓa anyikwo ɓaku ɓahin wan shi to ge a jesin yakwo yin , to ge a ɓo shanyi n , ama a gaiciya da dna na aɓo vinya n ɓa zhin .
byeda wa bwasun n nyikwoyi gmanyi , n na aɓi aɓo viyi ɓai dagma n na ajei .
a byeda n ɓa zhin tnu-tnu n bmiya aza ɓa gaɓa mwa-mwa , njesun ɓa ɓa bwa bugba kala n dagayi abye dna n gaiciya ga .
mika aɓo deye gaho , koda-yake mi n na awyetu yi lo miɓa be ho aba esa fyewyi .
n na bai n mi to ɓe n pyen ha kpe a za pya ye n ho ɓa kni , ɓa zhin a tukwoda fi n ikklisiya , shekwoyi wye-wyeyi da nya , n ɓa fi ɓai shi shekwoyi gaiciya ɓai la kwo tu nyi .
kwo zhin gaiciya nu asese manayi dna n shekwoyi , kwo to zhin oɓo fafayi nun , amma amsa lo n kristi , n wa ze zanyikwoci wa ɓe anyi , a gye wo n gyi-gyi n tna laifi dna n wo zafun , amalaika ɓa zhin wo bauta , a zhin wo waʼazi n anyi vinya , aza gwowo n na aba vinya laɓa , a gwo wo njesun wo lo eshemi .
ɓeda ye kwo zhin gaiciya nu nge ndei oza ye wa zhin pasto , wo ɓemwi manayi dnalo n bugba .
gama tilas pasto wa zhin oza manayi n na ta dawo ɓeda nukwoyi n , n nyikwoyi gmanyi .
woi zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi , woi zhin nubo , cewo n nu-nuyi n na aɓemana zhinyi .

byeda wa bwasun n nyikwoyi gmanyi , n na aɓi aɓo viyi ɓai dagma n na ajei .

kwo zhin gaiciya nu asese manayi dna n shekwoyi , kwo to zhin oɓo fafayi nun , amma amsa lo n kristi , n wa ze zanyikwoci wa ɓe anyi , a gye wo n gyi-gyi n tna laifi dna n wo zafun , amalaika ɓa zhin wo bauta , a zhin wo waʼazi n anyi vinya , aza gwowo n na aba vinya laɓa , a gwo wo njesun wo lo eshemi .
wu-wu nukwoyi a zafun gyi-gyi-yi gnayi pei-pei n ge dna n sa pmaknayi azaho n ɓafi n ikklisiya ɓa ɓei na kristi aɓo , ɓai vi a malami n ɓa lo tnu-tnu n shetan ɓeye yi .
a malami ye ɓa ce akata n bugbai gmanyi , har oɓa zafun nubo zhin nya to kwoi ceɓa ɓepan .
ɓa ɓei ci ge kwo to bmiya a pa mulan , kwo to bmiya a gyi abun , koda-yake shekwoyi wa ga anya gye vinya , n na yesu viyi abanu ɓa gyi ɓa n bugba bui-bui ɓai zhin godiya .
gama anya vinya n shekwoyi wa zhin ɓa bmiya , yi ɓa mi ya gyi ɓa n bugbai gmanyi yi zhin godiya .
ndei ya nya shekwoyi wa tu kwo anabarka , gama aze kwo manayi n shekwoyi ɓeda yi n aduwa yi nu .
nha zhin azaje bayani ye pya , ho nu ho tnu-tnu nu n gye pasto , n wo n nuboi fu n gaiciya gai n nyawu gaiciya nya yi n ho vi nyi .
to wun esaya hoi naɓo tu n aɓo nɓa to tukwoi n , kwo aɓeda a tna cei , gyi esa n ho kalayi tu aɓo nu nɓa ɓa zhin ho ha mwa dna n zafun .
nayi tnu-tnu n bmiya , amma zafun tnu-tnu n du , kwoi bmaho zhin n nya n ho zhin .
ntu cenu tumwi ha ze yesu viyi manayi , kwo ta bmaho zhin dna anyi ye nu gmanyin , ama har n doi n kwo ye ɓe-ɓelo .
gaiciya nu nyi kwo bmiya lo ozahozahoi wa gwo kwo .
yi zhin tnu-tnu n mwa , yi sin wahala n mwa , ntuge aza ɓa ga kwo gaiciya .
gama eyi awyetu lo n shekwoyi wye-wyeyi da nu , n wa fi ntu na za ɓo vinya nyi tun baga aza nɓa la wo gni-gni gwo .
wu anya ye vinya ha tabata aza tu ɓa mwi lo dei-dei .
to ye zaho wa ci ho wyegba ntu ge hoye zhin ɓinuyin .
la ze ɓa ɓemwi-tu nya .
fa ɓa vi ho nya wu n ho ase-sei , la ze ɓa efye dna n yeye , nho gaiciya gayi , nho aɓonubazhin manayi .
sai mila ɓe , ba shekwoyi ɓeda hoi zhin kwo bayani ga ikklisiya , zhin shekwoyi ɓeda waʼazi .
zhin apma nho nyaga yi zhin apma n ho kpezhinyi , n shekwoyi wa gaho dna n wo anabi esa n na ikklisiya tukwo da ɓei kpe ho abwa n tukwonyi .
zhin apma n ho nyaga yi , la hohin ga n tnu-tnu ye , n na abai aza gye ho abye gyi .
zhin peceiye n na aɓei n ho zhin , n ho anubo zhin yi n jesun .
la kpema n ɓo n kwo zhin gaiciya , shekwoyi ɓa tuho anabarka , wa zhin apma n hoi ha bma azaje zhin .
a zafun gyi-gyi-yi gnayi pei-pei n ge dna n sa pmaknayi azaho n ɓafi n ikklisiya ɓa ɓei na kristi aɓo , ɓai vi a malami n ɓa lo tnu-tnu n shetan ɓeye yi .
a malami ye ɓa ce akata n bugbai gmanyi , har oɓa zafun nubo zhin nya to kwoi ceɓa ɓepan .

zhin peceiye n na aɓei n ho zhin , n ho anubo zhin yi n jesun .
la kpema n ɓo n kwo zhin gaiciya , shekwoyi ɓa tuho anabarka , wa zhin apma n hoi ha bma azaje zhin .
to daɓo n minagyi yi n zayi n wo kwo hon , ama daɓo n woi peceiye ngye oho dada , da ɓo n na za nawyi yi ngye oho azaje ye-ye yi .
zhin anyikwoza anyigbakwoyi ɓo ngye oho aya , aɓi anyikwoyi n gye oho amapui , hoi zhin nubo manayi n ɓa tukwo .
ikklisiya kwo shi anyikwoza bwa n oɓa aɓa n kufi , ndei ɓato n zayi lo n wo ɓa zhin .
ama ngye ɓa n na ɓiyi lo kwo ayawyi , oɓanu ɓa bma ɓa zhin , gama kwo bmiya ɓemana zhin kwa ya na api nu .
hoi bma a zakwoyi awyekwoyi zhin .
ɓo nu n kwo da shekwoyi n mwa .
ikklisiya kwo bma a nyigbai zhin n ɓato n nyahoi n , ɓai to na zayi lon , ndei ɓa kmi awye shi shekwoyi ɓai zhin aduwa n esai vinya .
ama to ge ɓai gyi esa , ɓai zan laɓa , ɓai zhin agnagbain , kwo ɓai da aza ɓon , ɓai zan anyi gmada shin ga ɓahin , n lonu ɓai wu ɓahin wyewyeyi n .
deye kwo la ze ofye ikklisiya wyidna n na bai aviyi ɓa kpe , ɓa zhin oɓo n kwo bmiya .
ama oza n wo to kula n wo azai esa n ɓa gyi san , tun baga aza n ɓa fi n oza puwan , woto n iko yi lo wa ci ge wo zhin yesu viyi nun .
oza deye pya wo du tna viyi lo n nukwoyi .
nyigbayi n wo cei pma pma wa ze ikklisiya tnu-tnu-yi , wo to kasa n na aye shitnayi n , woi bwa mula pa bwa zun gmanyi .
azai dawo ɓeda manayi ntu n wo atnu-tnu manayi ɓo n wo ku zhin , woku owo aɓi shi n bmiya ?
woku ɓemana zhin a zhiɓei n na a yesu viyi ajeyi ?
wo ku bma a nyasan yi zhin n na bugba wunyi ?
wo n cei pma n sai vinya wa zhin ɓemana ?
anyigbai n ɓa to kon , ɓato filo n ɓon , gama esa fyewyi sai ɓa pa mula n jesun ɓa na ɓa alkawali ɓo n ɓa zhin kristi nyi .
ntuce nu ɓaku zunkni ntuge ɓato shi ɓa alkawali kmisunyi bwan .
nko avun , kwoi wulo ɓa wo bwato , ɓa gyi esa ɓai laɓa ɓai vi apuwa , ɓai zhin agnagbai , ɓai fi aza aɓo abwa .
ntu cenu mi gye kwo bmiya lo anyigbayi a nawyi ɓa senu njesun , ɓa ma aɓi ɓa shi ɓahin puwa , n lonu ata da ɓeda nukwoyi tu ɓa tukwon .
gama edna wo milo azaho n ɓami ɓala awye pmiya n ikklisiya , shetan n la ɓa dna kwoce .
ma paho n jesun nge , nyigbai azanu ɓa shiwo bwa , ɓato fa deye n ikklisiya akun .
ikklisiya ɓa wu agyiwye kpe anyigbai tukwo nu nɓa to na zahoyi lon , kwo aɓa yi n ɓa ɓa kpe awye shi ɓan .
fye shi a tnu-tnu yi bwa nbmiya a pasto nɓa zhin tnu-tnu cewo n bugbai gmanyi , a gbaɓa dei-dei , a ciɓa dei-dei , tun baga aza n ɓa nyi-wye da waʼazi zhin n nyawu yi .
gama shekwoyi ɓeda gna ge , to pa jaki egbe esa n kwo gni kwoi dna awyi n cein , fakwo kwa gyi kwoi gwo tnu-tnu lo . nna abado njesun kwa ci ge , tnu-tnu yi gwo lo n wo ladayi . to wo gnunu-gnunu tu pasto tukwon , sai dei n aseida da lo ngun aba kwo ngun ata ɓa zun wo kni .
ndei wo ku laifi zhin , a gnakni wo n eklisiya abye vinya , n na abai n zaho ta viwo zokwon .
mi ga ho wyidna ye n shekwoyi abye n dagayi yesu kristi yi , n wo a amalaika a gyi-gyi-yi , fya zhin lonu kwo pasto yi zhin ho nungundo nu kwo to woi zhin ho nungundon .
fye zhin aza ɓo gmanyi .
awyeto ya fye n pasto kniyin , sakun fya ze owo alaifi pita , kwa ze ngye fya pui ɓa nya nu .
( deye to ci ge ho to ye zhin eje to won nun , kwo bmiya lo ha towo nsahoi gama kwo zhin , shigbe nu n ho aba , shi nyasan ta faho nyin . ) pa ge aza ho , har n na a pastoyi ɓa se-ase fi n laifi azai kpe .
nna aɓeye pya ho ɓa mi ha zhin ɓoho .
ama n na a ɓoho , nyipyei wada nya nu ɓei kpe gaiciya anya ya .
elonu zaho-zahoi kpe lo ngye shi a pasto ho zhin ɓemana , ama ata kpe oɓa ɓemanayi ɓo n saho yim , sai esa la mwa .
to daɓo n minagyi yi n zayi n wo kwo hon , ama daɓo n woi peceiye ngye oho dada , da ɓo n na za nawyi yi ngye oho azaje ye-ye yi .
zhin anyikwoza anyigbakwoyi ɓo ngye oho aya , aɓi anyikwoyi n gye oho amapui , hoi zhin nubo manayi n ɓa tukwo .

a pasto nɓa zhin tnu-tnu cewo n bugbai gmanyi , a gbaɓa dei-dei , a ciɓa dei-dei , tun baga aza n ɓa nyi-wye da waʼazi zhin n nyawu yi .

elonu zaho-zahoi kpe lo ngye shi a pasto ho zhin ɓemana , ama ata kpe oɓa ɓemanayi ɓo n saho yim , sai esa la mwa .
tnu-tnu-n agyiwye yi afyenu a yesu viyi ɓa zhin oɓa dagayi tnu-tnu ɓai gaɓa mwamwa , fye to fa a ci ge a kristi aza zhin a bwatoyi nun , fyeto ye a ma shekwoyi eye san kwo owo ɓeda ntu n deye ɓo m .
ndei oɓa dagayi zhin yesu viyi nu , kwo to wunu ge ɓa ɓa fa tnu-tnu zhin ɓon , kwo bmiya ɓa ɓahin yi nu ntuge zado dna gaiciya ga ɓa bwa bmazhin dna n ɓa tnu- tnu .
timatawus aɓeye nɓa zhin gaiciya nyi ha gna aza , ɓa vi ɓa .
azaho ɓa na aɓeye ɓo , ama ɓanu zhin wuwu hin-hin dagayi yesu kristi nya .
oɓa nu zhin tushi asese manayi nya .
oza n wa da ɓedo gvo wo zhin aɓekwo nu , n za gbeloi , wo la pmiya n kristi ɓeda , woi ze kwo aɓona n kwo ɓa zo fi n shewo , n minagyi yi n kwo ɓe n na agyekpei laifi zanshi n na aɓemwi nukwoyi .
aɓenaiye n ɓa bugbai nunu yi n ɓenukwoyi , ɓa ta kpe gaiciya da m , n ɓa aba nabari manayi zhin agyiwye bwa zokwo nu fye la bui ɓa si .
ho cei pma ha zhin nyabwayi hin-hin ?
ho la ze nyabwayi n gye ho zhin ɓemana lo hoi dagma .
nshiinsun , yi to ɓei ɓe n na agyiwyei shin , esa n yi ɓei ɓe anyi n cei nyin .
yin to ɓei gmi n nyahoi shin esa n yi ɓa fin .
ntu ce yiku eyi abugba zhin pi kwo to yi n na agyiwyei n , ndei yi n nyagyi yilo n na jekpeyi .
ama aza nɓa ye ɓa bwa nya , sa fyewyi sai ɓa ya ɓenukwoyi zhin ntuge ɓa bwa agiwye , enya nkwo tuɓa eci , kwaze ɓa abugba nukwoyi zhin yi , kwa wu ɓa har ana pi .
gama agyiwye ye nu zhin oza zhin a ɓenukwoyi aje .
azaho la avun pmi wu shekwoyi ntu n na gyiwye ɓo , ntuce ɓaku ɓe ɓahin n bugba wun yi n mwa .
o , timatawus , ho zhin shekwoyi zanu , bu aɓo nukwoyi ye si vinya , ha zhin oɓo n kwo wu cewo n bmiya , hoi tumwi ha kpema wu , hoi ye azaje , ha zhin hankuri n mi bwai .
shunkun ga shekwoyi , la nyima wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya n shekwoyi la gaho nyi .
n ho ku kwo seida zhin n na za abye n mwa begye nyi .
mi ga ho wyidna n shekwoyi abye , n wo ga aza wye-wyeyi vinya nyi .
n yesu kristi abye n wo ɓei ga seida manayi n tna dna n bunti bilatus abye nyi nge ho nu aɓo vinya n wa gnaho ge ho zhin , n na abai to a bwa laifi n ho aban , har eyi dagayi yesu kristi wa jeze ɓe .
gama esa fyewyi shekwoyi anabarkada n ikoda yi gmanyi , woɓa wu kristi nʼshe bmana asu aje esu dagayi a dagayi aje nya .
owo nu gmanyi n wo ta shan fin , n wo dna n buzangna yakwo n zanyi-kwoci ta mi wa wu viyi n woyi m .
zanyikwoci to shin wo gyen , woi ta shan wo gyen .
nwo aba , mwa-mwa n iko nyalo-nyalo amin .
gna aza n ɓa n nyabwai nyi nge ɓato mwa ɓahin tukwon , to ɓa kpema oɓa nyabwan .
n kwo ɓa zo esa fyewyi nyin , ama ɓa gma ɓai kpema shekwoyi wye-wyeyi da , n wo gayi anya vinya n yi n cei pma ntu n yi agmada ɓo nyi .
gna ɓa ɓa zhin apma n ɓa agyiwyei dna n ɓemana zhin .
ɓa ku ze anyabwai dna n ɓemana zhin , ɓai ga aza n ɓa gyisan lo n bugba bui-buyi , n shiri yi zhin ɓa gni n na azai enya n shekwoyi wa ga ɓa .
nɓa zhin nlai ɓa so nya bwa hin-hin shi nu nshemi , nyaso shi manayi nu nyalo-nyalo nya .
ɓa se ase manayi n kwo kunce n na a yesu viyi n na anyi deye .
o , timatawus , to gba a kala na ɓeye zhin yi , n shekwoyi wa fi ho n na akun nyin .
to vi aɓenai , a cije nya n ɓa gma n ɓa ɓeyekpe yi nyin .
ɓai wu nu nge ɓa to n ɓeyekpe yi lon .
aza deye pya n ku gyi nya manayi san n ɓa asese , ɓata kpe shekwoyi yen .
shekwoyi sun-sun gye kwo kunsun n hoi .

shekwoyi sun-sun gye kwo kunsun n hoi .
wasika ye kwo gmi n bulus akun nu , yesu kristi waʼazi zhin yi , n shekwoyi wa tnu n woi wa gna azanugbai n na anyikwozai n na aba vinya wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya ɓeda , nwa zhin kwo alkawali dna n gaiciya ga n yesu kristi nyi .
kwoi lo timatawus aba omi ɓi ye-ye yi .
shekwoyi dada , kristi yesu eyi dagayi wo gaho owo alheri , sun-sungye n bugba fuyi .
bulus ye ye n timatawus aba mi zhin shekwoyi godiya ntu ho ɓo , timatawus nsukwoyi mi gyi emi shekwoyi wye , nge wo tu ho anabarka n mwa , wonu zhin emi adada shekwoyi , omi shekwoyi nu n woi ce .
omi ɓomwi n mi asese vinya okwonu ma zhin ɓo n kwo dawo .
awo mi pwa ma gye ho njesun , aɓei dami n mwa , gama mi paho awyenyi ɓe lo , esa n yi ɓei fa aje nyi .
mi kpe lo shi ho kpema dagayi n sun , shi oho ya afniki n oho nyikwo-wyi yi lois ɓei zhin , mi tabata lo ho ye kpemawo lo , shi ho ɓei kpema wo nsapai .
miye ma paho ha hohin yi , dna n ho wyepa n na akalai n ho n cei lo , tunyi ewyi n mi ɓei tuho bwa n tukwo , ma tuho anabarka nyi .
gama zafun gyi-gyi-yi , shekwoyi cauta , to ncei pma lo ha wo aza dnan , ama ha ce , ha bwa kala , ha ye ɓa , ha dagma n ho asese n ɓai .
ndei ha zhin apma n ikoyei n kwo dna n ho nyi , hota wo aza dnan , n dagayi ɓeda gnayi n , kwo ɓai kpe ge mi zhin ho nugundo nu , koda-yake mi dnalo n kurkuku ntu n kristi eye ɓo .
ho ɓa gni n shiri yi zhin-ha sin wahala n miyi ntu n dagayi-ɓo , gama woɓa gaho kala dna n na azhingye .
owonu na gni yi , wa kni yi , n tu n wo tnu-tnu gyi-gyi-yi ɓo , to ge yi kunce lo nun , ama ntuge owo shiri nu tunyi kafin asa anyi , n na bai wa wuyi owo alheri n ye-yeyi dna n kristi .
nsaiye wo ku wuyi pei-pei , sanu eyi gniyi yesu kristi wa ɓe n cei , n wa bma efi iko ya wa wuyi wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya zokwo , dna n gaiciya ga nyi .
shekwoyi la mi kni ma zhin wo waʼazi zhin yi , ma zhin abyedo waʼazi mi-i wu ɓa .
cenu zhin mi-i sin wahala dna n ya n kurkuku vinyikwoi ta wo mi lo n tu cen .
gama mi kpe ezaye lo n mi kpema wo , mi-i kpe lo nge wo ɓa mi wa gu enya n mi la gawo har ewyi n wo ɓa jeze ɓe n cei .
la gaiciya zokwo shi cewo , n mi ɓei wu ho nyi , tun baga gaiciya ga n ye-yei n kristi bei ga ho nyi .
mi ye ha gu kpezhin , cauta dnagmayi n shekwoyi wa gaho nyi , n ho ɓei gwo n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aba n wo dna n ho mi nyi .
shi ho kpelo , a yesu-viyi vinya n ɓa kun n asiya , ɓala busi ɓa ku mi ya , har fimallus n harmojanis yi .
dagayi wo tu onisifurus anabarka nwo puwa yi vinya , gama wo zhin mi ziyara woi gami bugba kala .
owo ziyara gami kala n gye ese manayi , to wa wo vinyikwo ge mi dna n kurkuku n .
ɓehin-hin esa n wo ɓei ɓe roma wa zan mi shin la ɓa , wa kpe aba n mi dna , wa gye mi wye .
dagayi wo tuwo anabarka ewyi n kristi ɓei jeze ɓe n cei .
ho gna kpelo shi wo ɓei bmami zhin n afisus .
wasika ye kwo gmi n bulus akun nu , yesu kristi waʼazi zhin yi , n shekwoyi wa tnu n woi wa gna azanugbai n na anyikwozai n na aba vinya wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya ɓeda , nwa zhin kwo alkawali dna n gaiciya ga n yesu kristi nyi .
kwoi lo timatawus aba omi ɓi ye-ye yi .
shekwoyi dada , kristi yesu eyi dagayi wo gaho owo alheri , sun-sungye n bugba fuyi .
mi zhin shekwoyi godiya ntu ho ɓo , timatawus nsukwoyi mi gyi emi shekwoyi wye , nge wo tu ho anabarka n mwa , wonu zhin emi adada shekwoyi , omi shekwoyi nu n woi ce .
omi ɓomwi n mi asese vinya okwonu ma zhin ɓo n kwo dawo .
awo mi pwa ma gye ho njesun , aɓei dami n mwa , gama mi paho awyenyi ɓe lo , esa n yi ɓei fa aje nyi .
mi kpe lo shi ho kpema dagayi n sun , shi oho ya afniki n oho nyikwo-wyi yi lois ɓei zhin , mi tabata lo ho ye kpemawo lo , shi ho ɓei kpema wo nsapai .
miye ma paho ha hohin yi , dna n ho wyepa n na akalai n ho n cei lo , tunyi ewyi n mi ɓei tuho bwa n tukwo , ma tuho anabarka nyi .
gama zafun gyi-gyi-yi , shekwoyi cauta , to ncei pma lo ha wo aza dnan , ama ha ce , ha bwa kala , ha ye ɓa , ha dagma n ho asese n ɓai .
ndei ha zhin apma n ikoyei n kwo dna n ho nyi , hota wo aza dnan , n dagayi ɓeda gnayi n , kwo ɓai kpe ge mi zhin ho nugundo nu , koda-yake mi dnalo n kurkuku ntu n kristi eye ɓo .
ho ɓa gni n shiri yi zhin-ha sin wahala n miyi ntu n dagayi-ɓo , gama woɓa gaho kala dna n na azhingye .
owonu na gni yi , wa kni yi , n tu n wo tnu-tnu gyi-gyi-yi ɓo , to ge yi kunce lo nun , ama ntuge owo shiri nu tunyi kafin asa anyi , n na bai wa wuyi owo alheri n ye-yeyi dna n kristi .
nsaiye wo ku wuyi pei-pei , sanu eyi gniyi yesu kristi wa ɓe n cei , n wa bma efi iko ya wa wuyi wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya zokwo , dna n gaiciya ga nyi .
shekwoyi la mi kni ma zhin wo waʼazi zhin yi , ma zhin abyedo waʼazi mi-i wu ɓa .
cenu zhin mi-i sin wahala dna n ya n kurkuku vinyikwoi ta wo mi lo n tu cen .
gama mi kpe ezaye lo n mi kpema wo , mi-i kpe lo nge wo ɓa mi wa gu enya n mi la gawo har ewyi n wo ɓa jeze ɓe n cei .
la gaiciya zokwo shi cewo , n mi ɓei wu ho nyi , tun baga gaiciya ga n ye-yei n kristi bei ga ho nyi .
mi ye ha gu kpezhin , cauta dnagmayi n shekwoyi wa gaho nyi , n ho ɓei gwo n zafun gyi-gyi-yi aba n wo dna n ho mi nyi .
shi ho kpelo , a yesu-viyi vinya n ɓa kun n asiya , ɓala busi ɓa ku mi ya , har fimallus n harmojanis yi .
dagayi wo tu onisifurus anabarka nwo puwa yi vinya , gama wo zhin mi ziyara woi gami bugba kala .
owo ziyara gami kala n gye ese manayi , to wa wo vinyikwo ge mi dna n kurkuku n .
ɓehin-hin esa n wo ɓei ɓe roma wa zan mi shin la ɓa , wa kpe aba n mi dna , wa gye mi wye .
dagayi wo tuwo anabarka ewyi n kristi ɓei jeze ɓe n cei .
ho gna kpelo shi wo ɓei bmami zhin n afisus .
la gni-agni n yesu akala yi o , timatawus emi nugun , la dna kala dna n kala n kristi yesu wa gaho nyi .
gama dole ha wu aza aɓo n hohin ɓedo na azajei ɓei wo mi-i da .
wu aza agaiciya da nɓa ɓami ɓa ka azaje wu .
la oho robo dna n wahala sin ngye soja manayi yesu kristi nya .
shi mi zhin nyi .
ngye krist soja to da hohin dna n anyi gmadan , gama ho ta mi ha zhin oɓo n kwo da oza n wa kni ho nyin .
vi dagayi awyidna owo tnu-tnu zhin nya , shi asibui zhin agbetu sibui nya kwo bai bwa lada kwo to ɓai bwa ladan nyin .
zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi n gye fwaiza n wo bwa lada n mwa woi ya nufwa n mwa nyi .
zhin nubo n na amisali yei n gun ata n mi gaho nyi , dagayi wo wu ho shi ɓa n na apmai lo n ho aba .
to ze gaiciya amwi n ge yesu kristi ɓei zhin zanyikwocinun , a mawo dna n esu dawuda efyen , woi zhin shekwoyi nu , shi owo kala la n efi kwo wu yi .
ntuge ma zhin waʼazi gaiciya yakwo ye nya nu , cenu zhin mi-i dna gni n wahala n ya , ai lami dna n kurkuku ngye ɓenukwoyi zhin yi .
ama ato pa shekwoyi ɓedan , kwo ai la mi pan .
mi shiri lo ma sin wahala , ndei okwo nu ɓa ɓe n gni-gni yi , n mwamwa nyalo-nyalo nya yi , dna n kristi yesu ga aza n shekwoyi n la ɓa kni nyi .
gaiciya deye zhin kwa fu mi bugba , nge esa n ya sin wahala ya fi ntu n kristi ɓo , kwo wunu ge yi ɓa ya asese n woi n eshemi .
n ya zʼhin nubo nge owo tnu-tnu n yi zhin nyi kwo dna ɓelo , pa ge n wyi-hoi yi ɓei se ase n woi ya gyi ebe n woi .
ama n ya fa wahala sin ɓo ya pmi avun wu kristi , wo ɓei pmi avun wu yi ce .
kwo esa n yi gaiciya ga gba kala , wo zhin gaiciya da nu , woi bmayi zhin gama wo ta nayi aɓon , yi zhin wo aga nu , wo ɓa nuwo alkawali .
bui aɓena gboloyi si pa oho aza a gaiciya ye ɓo , ha gaɓa wyidna dna n kristi eye ɓa to na aɓo tu n aɓo nba to na apma yin , aɓenaye pya to n na apmayin , ɓai dna aɓo wyegma har ɓai ɓe n wahalai .
zhin tnu-tnu n kalai , n na bai shekwoyi ɓa cihoge , sanu n tnu-tnu yi . ha ze tnu-gnu zhin yi manayi n vinyikwo ta wo won , esa n .
shekwoyi a dna wo a tnu-tnu wye n cei .
kpe nya n wo ɓeda da kwoi wu njesun .
la bui aɓeda kasa si n ɓa zhin aza ɓai gyi minagyi n na ajei nyi .
aɓa da aɓo n ɓa ɓa san za har nsai mwa .
himinayus n filitus yi zhin aza nu n ɓa ye n na ɓeye pya yi .
ɓa ku gaiciya zokwo fa , ɓai zhin waʼazi akata nya nge kala ku n efi la diya , ɓai la azaho gaiciya ga shan-shan n ɓa gwo ɓa ɓeda nyi .
ama shekwoyi gaiciya gni agni lo ngye apma , nyaho ta shan kwo ashan .
fandashen kuta nyanu , n na aɓedaye yi ka kpe n kwo , dagayi kpe aza yi lo n ɓa zhin owo anya . njesun , oza n wo yi wohin nge yesu viyi wo to zhin aɓo nukwoyi zhin . nna anyabwayi puwa akwanu zinariya nya nyi n azurfa nya yi , adoho n shinwayi nzun yi , anakwoi a zhin azhiɓei dnagmai ɓo nu cei , a tna nakwoi azhin apma n cei n gace kwo a ya anya nukwoyi fi .
ndei ha bui laifi si , hoɓa ze ngye kwanu n na zhin a zinariya manayi , kwanu manayi du-duyi vinya n puwa , n nabai kristi n wohin wo ɓa zhin apma n hoi n wo ɓeye manayi ɓo .
bui enya si nkwo ɓa ɓe ho n na nubo zhin nukwoyi , n kwo ɓe samari aba , ama la nyima enya vinya n kwo zhin ho ha wo ɓemana zhin pwa .
bwa gaiciya ga n ye-yei , ha gyi nugundo n na azayi n ɓa ye dagayi , n na bugba manayi .
njesun ma ci ge to lo dna n na aɓena n ɓa lo n azayi n minagyi n .
shekwoyi aza ta ku ze anya wuyin , tilas ɓaku ze amishiyi , hakuri da , ɓai wu aza nɓa ku bwi aba .
gba hohin tukwo esa n ho wu aza , n gaiciya nku ɓa gmi aje .
gama n ha daɓo n ɓai peceiye n na atnazhin yi , kpekni , dna n shekwoyi bmazhin ɓa ɓa pmi ɓe ɓa vi gaiciya .
nsayi ɓa kpe genyi , ɓa pwo shetan agam , fyenu laifi nya n wo zhin apma n cei woi wan ɓa nyi , nsayi ɓa ya shekwoyi ɓeye zhin .
o , timatawus emi nugun , la dna kala dna n kala n kristi yesu wa gaho nyi .

wahala nabye kwo bmiya lo ha kpe deye n jesun , timatawus nge dna n na anyipyei kmaknayi , yesu vi ɓei la dna ɓo .
gama aza ɓei ye ɓahin tukwo n ɓa agyiwyei , ɓa ɓei zhin aɓokwo ɓai gma , ɓai ci shekwoyi wyegba , to ɓai wo oɓa zakwoyi ɓedan , to ɓai zhin godiyan , aɓi a nukwoyi .
ɓa ɓei kwo atukwo agnana to ɓai wo aza ɓedan , ɓa ɓei ze aza kata , ɓai la wahala kala , ɓai zhin ɓenukwoyi doho-dohoi n tna nubo zhin .
ɓa to ɓei wo ɓon , n tna sun-sun gye , ɓai kpe aza agye n ɓa zhin ɓemana nyi .
ɓa ɓei kun oɓa anugundo , a tukwo gnana-kwoyi n nu-nuyi n na aɓokwoyi , ɓai gna agmada ye ndu shekwoyi mwa-mwa ga .
ɓa ɓei lo aduwa nyakun , ama ɓato ɓei ga nya ho gaiciya n ɓa wo n ɓon .
to ye ɓa dna ho kwocen .
azayi pya nu lo aza puwa ɓai gyi nugundo n na anyikwo tna ceceyi , alaifi yi nu bugba , ɓa wu anyikwozaye oɓa zokwo woi-woyi .
anyikwozaye pya vi a malami a woi-woi , ama ɓata ye ɓa kpe gaiciya ye m .
a malami ye pya gni apa-pa n gaiciya yi , shi yinisu n yambrisu yi ɓei gni apa-pa n musa yi nyi .
ɓa n na abugbayi tu cegye , n pmi-pmi yi ya n yesu viyi gaiciya .
ama ɓa ta si n kpa yin , nwyihoi oɓa kwoce dna ɓei kpe anya ya aza gye vinya , shi yinusi n yanbrisu alaifi ɓei kpe anya ya nyi .
ama ho kpelo shi ho kamiwye mito zhin aza yi pya nu m .
ho kpe nya yelo n mi ga gaiciya , n jesun shi mi sase n wu , n nyai n mi ye , ho kpe mi gaiciya ga ye lo dna n kristi , shi mi sin wahala n sun .
ho kpelo shi mi sin wahala n sun n tuge mi zhin nabari manayi waʼazi .
ho kpe ɓe ye lo n na ɓei zhin mi esa n mi ɓei lo antakiya nyi , n ikoniya yi , n listra yi , ama dagayi ɓei lami gni .
e , aza n ɓaye ɓa zhin oɓo n kwo da kristi yesu , ɓa ɓa sin wahala n aza kun n ɓa wun wo nu nyi .
ɓehinhin , a malami akatayi , n na aza nukwoyi ɓa ɓa gyi abye abye n ɓenukwoyi , ɓai dna aza kwoce n mwa , n ɓahin ce shetan n la ɓa dnakwoce .
ama gyi abye n gaiciya gai , dna n na anya n ria wu ho , ho kpe lo ɓazhin gaiciya nu , gama ho kpe lo ho ɓa mi ha kpema yi n ya wu ho nyi .
ho kpelo shi , esa n ho ɓei zhin ɓinayi nyi , aɓo ki shekwoyi ɓeda wu ho , okwonu la ho ce ha gwo shekwoyi gni-gni dna n gaiciya ga n kristi yesu .
rubutu ka vinya littafi gyi-gyi-yi nya shekwoyi nu ɓei da nwoʼgbei , kwo n na apma yi n yi aba ntu n nya wu ɓo , n kwo zhin gaiciya , ya kpe enya ye n kwo to bmiyan , dna n yi asese , kwo gayi kala ya zhin oɓo n kwo bmiya .
shekwoyi zokwo nu n wa zhin yi shiri zokwo doho-dohoi , ya zhin aza vinya ɓemana .
kwo bmiya lo ha kpe deye n jesun , timatawus nge dna n na anyipyei kmaknayi , yesu vi ɓei la dna ɓo .
