shekwoyi zokwo nu n wa zhin yi shiri zokwo doho-dohoi , ya zhin aza vinya ɓemana .
bulus shaula zafun nya a ntuce nu mi zhin ho gargadi n shekwoyi abye , n kristi yesu yi , n wo ɓei da aza wye-wye yi n na azafiyi owa n wyihoi nyin .
esa n wo ɓei ɓe nwo begyi-yi .
zhin shewoyi ɓeda waʼazi n esayi vinya , esa n ha bwa bednu n sayi vinya .
zhin eho aza aba , esa n bednu nyi kwo n tna bednu , ha gnakni ɓa esa vinya n kwo kunce , gaɓa kala ɓa zhin ɓemana n esai vinya , nu ɓa n shekwoyi ɓedayi .
ntu ge esa ɓelo n aza to ɓei shan gaiciya tnubua knan , ama ɓa ɓei zan laɓa ɓai zan a malami zanshi n ɓa ɓa gna ɓa oɓo n ɓaye ɓa wo .
ɓato ɓei kna ɓeda tnubua n shekwoyi ɓeda dan , ama ɓa ɓei vi oɓa anubo zhin zokwo bwi-bwi nya .
la mi gni to wo wahala dna n ho ɓa sin ntu n dagayi ɓo m .
gni aza je ɓe n cei n kristi aba .
to fya ɓeho n tna zhinyi n kwo kunce ha zhin .
mi da ɓeye gama mi to gnilo n mi ɓa bmaho zhin , emisa la gasi , esa fyewyi mi ɓa wan zokwo maloʼshe .
miku okun sun n mwa ntu n emi dagayi ɓo , dna n kwo vinya miku ɓefyece zhin .
nsaiye esa lasi n mi ɓa fa kun sunɓo ma sun .
n eshe mi rawani pmi milo n dagayi alkali gaiciya da ɓei gami ewyi n wo ɓei jezeɓe n cei .
to ge emi n mi gmanyin ama har na zai ɓe n ɓa sase n wyetuyi ge ɓa pmi owo jezeɓe lo n jesun .
zokwodna kmaknayi mi gyi ho wye ɓe npye .
gama dimas nla miya , wa wo anyi nya shakpe wa lo tassalunika , kiristis wo du galatiya , titus wa lo dalmatiya .
luka nu bwa ce gnilo n miyi , gniɓe n markus yi esa n ha ɓe n cei gama mi n wo apmayi lo .
mila tikiku tnu n afisus .
esa n ha ɓe , to ɓo ze amwi ha ɓemi n jekpeyi n mi ɓei ya zhi n taruwasa nyi m n mi ɓei yazhi n karbus emi zado aba nyi , njesun n mi a litafiyi , tun-baga a takarda opa nya .
iskandari epyada sinknabyeyi nya waku mi wu anyi n mwa .
dagayi ɓa tawo .
ama zhin peceiye n woi , gama wo ɓei la gni apa-pa n nya yi n yi ɓei da .
esa kmisunyi n na aɓei ɓe n mi na alkali abye ada mi owa ezaho-zahoi to ɓei gni n , aza vinya ɓola busi , mi n na awyetu yilo ata ba laifi ye n ɓa tukwon .
ama dagayi ɓei gnisun n miyi wa gna mi esa ma zhin waʼazi tna edna anyi vinya ɓa wo .
wa gni mi n na agaba ʼgbe .
e , dagayi ɓa gni mi n na aɓo nukwoyi vinya , wa lo mi dna n wo ebemi eshe nya .
mwa-mwa kwo kunsun n shekwoyi nyalo-nyalo .
ɓi , biskila gna n aikla yi n na aai n ɓa fi n onisifurus puwa nyi .
arastus dnalo n korintus , mafa turufinus dna n militus nyasayi sanwo .
zhin atna ha ɓe n ya kafin vinyikwo , afbulus saho ami lo ɓedo n budis yi n linus yi n kalafidiya yi n na azayi vinya .
dagayi yesu kristi wo kunsun nfye zafun yi .
a ntuce nu mi zhin ho gargadi n shekwoyi abye , n kristi yesu yi , n wo ɓei da aza wye-wye yi n na azafiyi owa n wyihoi nyin .
esa n wo ɓei ɓe nwo begyi-yi .
zhin shewoyi ɓeda waʼazi n esayi vinya , esa n ha bwa bednu n sayi vinya .
zhin eho aza aba , esa n bednu nyi kwo n tna bednu , ha gnakni ɓa esa vinya n kwo kunce , gaɓa kala ɓa zhin ɓemana n esai vinya , nu ɓa n shekwoyi ɓedayi .

dagayi yesu kristi wo kunsun nfye zafun yi .
wasika ye kwo gmi n bulus akun nu , shekwoyi fyenu , yesu kristi tnu-tnuyi .
a tnu mi ma ɓe n gaiciya gai n aza ba nu n shekwoyi la ɓa kni nyi , ma wu ɓa shekwoyi gaiciya gaiciya n kwo shan aza wyewyeyi do nyi .
n na bai ɓa bwa wyewyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya n shekwoyi ɓei zhin ɓa alkawali tunyi kafin a sa anyi , woi ta ce a katan .
dna n owo esa manayi , wa wu yi nabari manayi , wa gami izini ma gna aza vinya .
dna n shekwoyi eyi gniyi egbega , wo la ye ma zhin wo tnu-tnu ye ga wo .
kwoi lo titus aba n wo zhin emi oɓi dna n dagayi zokwo nyi .
shekwoyi dada n kristi yesu eyi gniyi , wo gaho anabarka n bugba fuyi .
a tukwoda kni ma fa ho tu n muse karita n na abai ha zhin ɓo n ho ɓa mi ha bma a ikklisiya zhin nu n ɓa nyi nɓo .
mi ye ha kni a pasto n ezhin doho-dohoyi ha vi ngye shi mi ɓei wu ho nyi .
aza n ha kni a kpe ɓa ye ntu n ɓa asese manayi ɓo , nyikwoza gmanyi da oɓa ɓi ɓai ye dagayi , to ge a tukwo gnana-kwoyin , nɓata vi oɓa azakwoyi ɓedan .
tilas pasto wa ze oza nu n nata ciwo aɓenya n wo asesen , gama ɓa zhin shekwoyi atnu-tnu zhinyi nu , ɓato zhin aɓekwo zhin yi , kwo a tna mi wanshi yi , to ɓa ze ajesin yin , agusun yin , kwo agyiwye shakpe ; woyin .
ɓa ze azhiɓeyi goyi n ɓa puwa , ɓa ye enya n kwo bmiya ɓa ze aza awyega da , ɓai zhin ɓo n kunce , ɓai zhin aɓo manayi nubo to ge a tukwo-gnana kwoyin .
tile oɓa gaiciya ga kwa migni n kala yi , n na bai n ɓa ɓa mi ɓa wu azaje , ɓa wu aza n ɓa ta gwo oɓa ɓedan .
ɓa wu ɓa aba n ɓa bwi aba .
gama aza lo n mwa begye n ɓa ta vi ɓon , deye kwo zhin gaiciya nu tun ba ga na aza aba n ɓa gna nge tilas a shi a yahudiyi awyidna bwa nyin .
ama deye zhin ɓeda gbeloyi nu , kwo bua za wye , to ɓa gye gaiciyan .
tile a hana n kwoi , ala aza pmi awye ya n shekwoyi alheri , amalami ye pya bwa agyiwye nu ye .
zaho n ɓa mi , anabi n wo gmi n karita wa ci ge , a karitayi zhin akataceyi nu , ɓa wu ngye anyafanya abwatoyi nu , n ɓa asese bwasun ɓa fu ɓahin nubo nu . deye zhin gaciyanu , ntucenu daɓo n na yesu-viyi n kala yi , shi kwo kunce kwa mi ɓa gaiciya gagni .
ɓa fa tnubua kna ɓo n na a yahudiyi esi n na aza ɓeyei n ɓa la avun pmin wu gaiciya nyi .
oza n wo bugba gyi-gyi-yi wo gye anya vinya n gyi-gyi yi , ama oza n wo bugba tucegye n tna gaiciya , wo gye nyaho-nyahoi n tna bmiya yi nu , gama owo bugba cegye nya n bugba kala kpei nu zhin woi wo lonu , woi gye lo nu njesun .
azayi pya ci ge ɓa kpe shekwoyi ye , ama nha gye nya n ɓa zhin , ha ku kpe ge ɓata kpe wo ye lon .
ɓa wun-wun yi ya , to ɓai vi ɓom , n tna a pma dna n ɓe manayi zhin .
wasika ye kwo gmi n bulus akun nu , shekwoyi fyenu , yesu kristi tnu-tnuyi .

to ye ozaho wa zhin nubo nge oɓo n ho da nyi kwo to kunce lon .
ɓepa n pmagna yi pa oho aza ɓa vi abegyi yi ɓo n na atukwodayi vinya , ɓa zhin n shiri yi zhin ɓa zhin aɓo manayi .
ɓa to da ɓeda nukwoyi n zaho-zahoi tukwon , kwo ɓa wu anyan ama ɓa zhin peceiye ɓai zhin ɓemana n aza ba vinya .
n sapa yi ɓei zhin aza mama n tna cei , yi kwo tukwo agnana .
aza ɓei dna yi woice ya ku ze afyenu aɓewyeda nya n shakpe nukwoyi nya yi , eyi awye-wyeyi ɓei wun azanu ɓahin ɓai wunyi nu .
ama shi esa ɓe la si n shekwoyi eyi gniyi ɓei wuyi owo alheri n ye-yei .
wa gniyi , tu ntuge n eyi ɓemana zhin ɓo nu wa gni yin , ama ntu n wo alheri ɓo n sun-sungye yi , wa zhan yi alaifiya , wa gayi agmada zafun gyi-gyi-yi nya n yi abugbami .
nwa zeya kpe yi ntu nya ɓo n yesu kristi wa zhin nyi .
nnabai n wo ɓa yi yi aza manayi n wo abye ntu n wo alheri ɓo , nsaiye yi n roboi lo dna n wo anyabwa wye-wyeyi nya n wa gayi nyi , n yi zhi yi pmi ya gwo nyi .
a nyaye n ma gnaho nyi ɓa zhin gaiciya nu , la nyimaɓa n na abai a yesu viyi ɓa zhin peceiye , ɓa zhin ɓemana n sai vinya , gama kwo to bmiya lonu gmanyin , ama kwo zhin kwa ɓe n na ampanyi .
n oza ho ɓelo n ajegnayi nfye mi , fya gnakniwo a bwa aba , ndeye avun fyeto shan efye anuwan gye n woi n .
fye kpe ge oza deye wo la pmiya n gaiciya , wo zhin laifinu , woi kpe .
mi zhin shiri lo ma tnu n artimas yi kwo tikikus , n ho aba .
esanu n zaknayi n ɓa mi waɓe ha zhin atna ɓa ɓe dami n nikobolos n pye , gama mi ku shaula zhin ma izhin vinyikwo dna ɓo .
zhin nya n ho ɓa mi ha bma zinas zhin , owa-yekpei-n apolos yi n ɓa zan , to ɓa gyi nyaho san n zokwon .
gama tilas eyi aza ɓa tumwi ɓa bma aza zhin n ɓa kunce a bma ɓa zhin , nɓa wye-wyeyi ɓa zhin ampanyi .
aza vinya n ya tnu fyelo n ɓa gnaɓiyi .
ɓi a yesu viyi gna gami n ɓo shekwoyi anabarka ɓa kunsun n fyeyi .
pa oho aza ɓa vi abegyi yi ɓo n na atukwodayi vinya , ɓa zhin n shiri yi zhin ɓa zhin aɓo manayi .
ɓa to da ɓeda nukwoyi n zaho-zahoi tukwon , kwo ɓa wu anyan ama ɓa zhin peceiye ɓai zhin ɓemana n aza ba vinya .
n sapa yi ɓei zhin aza mama n tna cei , yi kwo tukwo agnana .
aza ɓei dna yi woice ya ku ze afyenu aɓewyeda nya n shakpe nukwoyi nya yi , eyi awye-wyeyi ɓei wun azanu ɓahin ɓai wunyi nu .
ama shi esa ɓe la si n shekwoyi eyi gniyi ɓei wuyi owo alheri n ye-yei .
wa gniyi , tu ntuge n eyi ɓemana zhin ɓo nu wa gni yin , ama ntu n wo alheri ɓo n sun-sungye yi , wa zhan yi alaifiya , wa gayi agmada zafun gyi-gyi-yi nya n yi abugbami .
nwa zeya kpe yi ntu nya ɓo n yesu kristi wa zhin nyi .
nnabai n wo ɓa yi yi aza manayi n wo abye ntu n wo alheri ɓo , nsaiye yi n roboi lo dna n wo anyabwa wye-wyeyi nya n wa gayi nyi , n yi zhi yi pmi ya gwo nyi .
a nyaye n ma gnaho nyi ɓa zhin gaiciya nu , la nyimaɓa n na abai a yesu viyi ɓa zhin peceiye , ɓa zhin ɓemana n sai vinya , gama kwo to bmiya lonu gmanyin , ama kwo zhin kwa ɓe n na ampanyi .
n oza ho ɓelo n ajegnayi nfye mi , fya gnakniwo a bwa aba , ndeye avun fyeto shan efye anuwan gye n woi n .
fye kpe ge oza deye wo la pmiya n gaiciya , wo zhin laifinu , woi kpe .
mi zhin shiri lo ma tnu n artimas yi kwo tikikus , n ho aba .
esanu n zaknayi n ɓa mi waɓe ha zhin atna ɓa ɓe dami n nikobolos n pye , gama mi ku shaula zhin ma izhin vinyikwo dna ɓo .
zhin nya n ho ɓa mi ha bma zinas zhin , owa-yekpei-n apolos yi n ɓa zan , to ɓa gyi nyaho san n zokwon .
gama tilas eyi aza ɓa tumwi ɓa bma aza zhin n ɓa kunce a bma ɓa zhin , nɓa wye-wyeyi ɓa zhin ampanyi .
aza vinya n ya tnu fyelo n ɓa gnaɓiyi .
ɓi a yesu viyi gna gami n ɓo shekwoyi anabarka ɓa kunsun n fyeyi .
wasika ye gmi n mi aba nu nabari manayi yesu kristi nya ɓo , ɓedo omi zadoyi , timatawus .
kwoi lo filimon aba , eyi tnu-tnu kun-zhinyi , oza ye-yeyi , n ikklisiya yi n kwo zhin kwa yezhi n eho puwa nyi , n abfiya eyi mapui ɓedo n arkibbusa yi n wo zhin yesu soja n gye mi nyi .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada n dagayi yesu kristi yi wa ga fye owo anabarka n bugba-fuyi .
bulus wyegyi mi zhin shekwoyi godiya cici esa n ma zhin aduwa ntu ho ɓo , filimon , omi ʼza ye-yeyi .
gama mi wo oho ye-ye n kpemayi ɓo lo n dagayi yesu n wo aza yi .
mi zhin aduwa mi gna aza oho gaiciya ga ɓo , kwo ɓa shi ɓa wye-wyeyi ce , shi ɓa gye anya a manayi n ho , n ɓa kun n kristi yesu aba nyi .
omi n mihin mila gyiba bwa , bugba buyi nya n emi fuyi n ho ye-yeɓo , emi zado , ntuge oho ɓemana-zhin , bma shekwoyi aza bugba zhin lo .
nsaiye , miye ma nyaho bmazhin gmanyi .
mi ɓa mi ma nya ho ce dna n kristi , gama nya manayi nu , n kwo kunce ha zhin .
ama mi ye ho lo , mi gnaye ma nya ho .
omi , bulus , zakwoyi n saiye dna n kurkuku ntu yesu kristi ɓo .
omi wyegyi , nge , ha wu onisumus alheri , n na gniwo ga yesu dna n ya , mi yi dna n na agmanyi .
onisumus nwo maʼana ge , ( apma ) wo to ɓei n na apma yin n sapain , ama nsaiye wo n na apma hin-hin yi lo , n yi aba vinya .
mi tnu n woi n ho aba njesun , emi bugba gnisun lo n woi .
mi ɓei n cei pma ma wo shi n ya , esa n mi dna n cei n ya n na agma , ntu nabari manayi waʼazi zhin ɓo , owo bmazhin ɓei ɓa ze ngye oho nu bma mi zhin .
ama mi to ɓei n cei pma ma zhin ce n tna ho ayen .
mi to ɓei n cei pma ha zhin ɓemana tilas nun , ama n ho bugba yei .
kpekni ho ɓa zhin kwo nubo n lai , nge wa busi n ha aba esa fyewyi ntuge wa ze oho nya nyalonyalo .
wo to ye zhin fyenu nu , ama nyaho n du ɓo , madoyi ye-yei , tun baga n mi aba ba , nsaiye wo ɓa gna sun n na pmayi n ho aba , ntuge wo to zhin fyenu nun gmanyin , ama oho mado dna n kristi .
nmi zhin ho nugundo hin-hin yi nu , gwo wo n na agmadai , shi ho ɓa gwo mi nyi , emi yi nu a ɓe ho aba .
ngye wo ku ɓenukwoyi nu zhin ho , kwo wa wyi ho vi nu , ɓi mi nu ta , mi ɓa gba ho .
mi ɓa gba ho kwo ta , ( emi bulus mi la ye mi ɓa gaho , cenu zhin mi yi kakwo fi n ya n mi abwayi , ) mita wu ho shi ho n tayi shi mi lon , ɓehin-hin ho n hohin wye-wyeyi tainu shi mi .
e , emi zado ye-yei , gami agmada dna n ye-ye n na bai emi bugba ɓa ci dagayi .
mika wasika ye ntuge mi kpelo ho ɓa zhin oɓo n ma gna ho , har n diya ɓo .
la a zhiɓei nyakun zhin aba gami , gama mi n na wyetuyi lo shekwoyi ɓa wo fye aduwa ma ɓe fye aba esa fyewyi .
abafros emi kurkuku kun zhinyi , n wo dnalo n ya , ntu n kristi yesu waʼazi zhin ɓo nyi , wo tnu fye lo n gnaviyi .
n markus yi , aristakus yi , n dimas yi n luka yi , emi atnu-tnu kun zhin yi .
anabarka eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya ɓa kunsun n ho zafunyi .
wasika ye gmi n mi aba nu nabari manayi yesu kristi nya ɓo , ɓedo omi zadoyi , timatawus .
kwoi lo filimon aba , eyi tnu-tnu kun-zhinyi , oza ye-yeyi , n ikklisiya yi n kwo zhin kwa yezhi n eho puwa nyi , n abfiya eyi mapui ɓedo n arkibbusa yi n wo zhin yesu soja n gye mi nyi .
fa shekwoyi eyi dada n dagayi yesu kristi yi wa ga fye owo anabarka n bugba-fuyi .

n markus yi , aristakus yi , n dimas yi n luka yi , emi atnu-tnu kun zhin yi .
anabarka eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya ɓa kunsun n ho zafunyi .
shekwoyi ɓei daɓo nsapai shekwoyi ɓei daɓo n azokwoi mwabegye nsasai .
wa daɓo n ɓai n ruya yi , n-enayi , njesun wa daɓo ga eyi adada n anabi ʼgbe .
ama nsaiye shekwoyi daɓo yi n wo nugun ʼgbe yesu .
anya vinya wo nu zhin ɓa gado gyiyi .
owo nu na zhin ɓa .
yesu nu wu shekwoyi buzangna ɓehin-hin nya , wonu zhin shekwoyi degbe , owo iko nu shi aɓo bwa vinya .
she wo ɓei pwo ya laifi zhanya ɓo , n wo ami yi wa lo wa sase n shekwoyi shinkpegye bwaizhe-bwa .
aɓei la yesu ze oza ndu a malaika .
aga wo eye ndu oɓa nya .
shekwoyi shin malaika ho gna ge , ho zhin mi nugun nu , mi la ho ma n naiye n jesun ma ze ngye oho dada ? awo .
ama wa ci yesu ge , ho zhin omi ʼɓi nu , amalaika vinya ɓa la hotu . shekwoyi wa gna ge , a malaika wu ngye ese nu nkwo zhin kwa ci barkete nsaho-sahoyi nyi , ntu ge ɓa zhin zafun nu .
owo a bara wu ngye ena yitala nu .
ama wa ci oɓi ge , oho begyi ta shan zon , ko ɓa ze busi kwa wu ɓefyece .
oho busi tnu-tnu nya ɓefyece nu . ho ye atnu-tnu manayi to haye alaifi m .
ntu ce nu oho shekwoyi gmanyi , wa gaho agmada duduyi .
ha zhin eshe , ha zhin ekni n ho ikoyi .
eshe n ekni yi ɓaɓa diya , ama ho ta shan fi m .
ngye aje kokoyi oɓa asa ɓai zeye .
( wato eshe n ʼkni ) .
ho ɓa ya ɓa ngye aje sakun , oɓa asa ɓa zeya , amma ho ta shan don , oho anyipyei ɓa ɓeɓe nu .
shekwoyi shin a malaika gna ge , fye sase nmi bwaizhe-bwa har ma ze fye nuwunyi efya abara ? awo .
ɓa zhin amalaika a tnu-tnu loi nu n na tnu n ɓai ɓa bma a yesu viyi zhin .
njesun nazai n ɓa ɓe shekwoyi aba nyi .

yesu fi ntu aza vinya ɓo ntu gaiciya ɓo n yi ku wo nyi yi zhin peceiye , ntuge wada lo n ya jeze navun yi .
anya amalaika ɓei da nyi , gaiciya nu .
owa gnanazun n tna ɓo vi ko ɓei la ɓe n tatai .
yesu kwa duduyi nu .
( wo du amalaika lo .
owo ɓeda du ɓa nya lo njesun ) .
ntu cenu , yi ɓa po n wuna n ya na gni-gni dnagmayi ye a ɓoʼa ?
gama yesu ɓei da nabari manayi .
owo abara , n ɓa ɓo wo wo nyi , ɓa ka yi ɓe cei .
aɓo wo-woi nwo abara ɓei zhin nyi : acauta zafun nya , gaiciya ga , aza ka gna ɓedo n waʼazi , ɓa ga seida ge shekwoyi ɓo kunsun n ɓai .
ya je kpe ge nabari manayi yesu nya ko du amalaika nya lo ntu ge , shekwoyi to ɓei ga ɓa nu begyi a nyi nya m , wo ɓo ga yesu nu .
ɓehinhin , zabura gna ge , gbaizanyikwoci , wo zhin kni nu ha zhin tunani ntu wo ɓo a ?
owo ɓi zhin kni nu nho ɓa bmawo zhin a ? ho ɓo la woze n gna amalaika gba n sai fyewyi .
avun ha knu wo lowonyi latu nya n mwa-mwa nya yi , njesun ha tu wo n anya she vinya n ha zhin nyi .
behin-hin , ho la iko ga wo , har owo nu shi anya bwa vinya .
shekwoyi to kni nya ho yan .
ama yi ta gye ce kpam sai yesu la ɓe .
ama yi gye yesu lo n wo ɓo la ze ngna amalaika gba .
nsaiye dei shekwoyi la wo latu , woi la wo ga mwa-mwa ntu ge wa fi ntu yi ɓo .
e , ntu shekwoyi yeye ɓo yesu wa fi ntu zaho-zahoi ɓo n nanyi .
deye kwa lo dei-dei n shekwoyi nufiyi nwa zhin anya ntu wohin latu ɓo nyi .
wa zhin bezheyakwo ntu wo wahala ɓo .
ntu lo nu wa mi wa ɓe n nazai n mwabegye n gni-gni zokwo .
yesu n wa zhan yi ya nyi , ɓedo n yi nna lai zhan ya nyi , eyi dada ( wato shekwoyi ) gmanyi nu , cenu zhin yesu to woi wo vinyikwo n , wa yi-yi ge owo azaje m .
zabura gna ge , nɓa ga emazaje oho ye .
nɓa kwo anyi ma la ho tu dna n na aduwa nyakun . n abado wa je da ge , nɓa wo ze omi akpe ma ba .
omi , n mi aɓi yi n shekwoyi wa ga mi nyi , yi zhi nyi . she yi zhin nayi n nami yi nyi , wohin wa ze lo nu .
ntu ge wa wu shetan n wo ikoyi , efi nya yi .
wo ɓo ye ntu ge wa gni aza nɓa wo efi dna tunyi nɓa ma wyi .
( nna bai ɓa po har abada ) .
wo ta bma amalaika nu zhin , ama wo bma ibrahim ayawyi nu zhin .
ntu lo nu wa ze ngye owo azaje , n anya vinya .
deye kwa ga wo iko wa zhin pirist dnagmayi .
wo kpe lo shi wo ɓa gye yi sun-sun wa zhin gaiciya n shekwoyi abye .
ce na zhin wami wala aza laifi .
woi la yi ye ɓedo n shekwoyi yi .
wa sin wahala jaraba nya .
ntu lo nu , wo ɓa mi wa bma aza zhin n na zhin ɓa jaraba nyi .
ntu gaiciya ɓo n yi ku wo nyi yi zhin peceiye , ntuge wada lo n ya jeze navun yi .

fye ku efya bugba ga yesu na tnu nwoi nyi .
eyi pirist dnagmanyi gaiciya ga nya .
yesu ɓei zhin gaiciya n shekwoyi aba ngye shi musa ɓei zhin nyi .
ama yesu ɓo du musa n mwamwa .
ko wu ngye ozanu n wa mi nyakun wo du nyakun n mwa-mwa .
gama yakun doho-dohoi oza nu na mi , ama shekwoyi nu na mi anya vinya .
musa ɓo zhin tnu-tnu n shekwoyi azai sosai .
ama wo ɓei bwa fyenu nu zhin .
deye kwo ɓei zhin dogbe nu n anya yi n ɓa ɓelo n abye nyi .
ama yesu ɓei zhin gaiciya tu shekwoyi puwa ntu ge wo zhin nugun nu .
yi zhin wo azanu n ya mi dna gaiciya , har nyalo-nyalo .
ntu deye ɓo , she zafun gyi-gyi-yi ku da , kna tnubua n mi ɓeda n naiye , to ha kpe bugba akala ngye a israila yi m .
pa a israila yi ɓo dna n jaraba sa n zhabui .
fye to kpe bugba a kala ngye shi fye azakwoyi ɓei zhin fi n zhabui nyi m .
ofya dada ɓei tu mi mwi ɓa mwimi gye , ɓa gye a ɓo wowoi aye shinyi , ama ɓa dudu ɓa kpa kala .
ntu deye ɓo ma gyi minagyi n ɓai .
ma ci ge ɓa zhin abugba nukwoyi danu .
balle ma ɓata kpe mi ʼzokwo ye lon .
ʼntu cenu ma si nya-si ge , ɓata lo emi sun-sun m . ʼ abugba kala kpey i omi-zaje fye zhin peceiye , n na ta bwa bugba nukwoyi da n fye m .
ko ɓa zhin fya ya gaiciya .
fye zhin aje gargadi cici , esa ye nyi , to zaho wa kpe a kala m , woi zhin laifi cici m .
ko ɓa ɓe fye n fiyi n bugba wun yi n jesun .
yi kuze agado gyiyi n kristi yi , yi zhin wo aɓi ɓehin-hin nya nu , n ya mi zhi dna gaiciya ga har nyalo-nyalo .
gama wa gna , n naiye nha wo mi ɓeda , to ha kpe bugba a kala n gye aza n sapayi m . a nyikadonu ɓei wo to ɓa zhin biyaya ma ?
o ɓa nu n musa ɓei kun ɓa n masar kni .
shekwoyi ɓei gyi minagyi na nyikayi nu har aye shinyi a ?
wo ɓei gyi minagyi nazai nu n ɓa ɓei zhin laifi fi n zhabui nyi .
shekwoyi ɓei si nyasi ga nyika nu ge ɓa ta lo wo sun-sun ma ?
ɓanu bwa sun njesun .
ntu lonu ɓato ɓei lo asun-sun ba m , ( wato a israila yi ) ntu n ɓa tna gaiciya ga ɓo .
ntu deye ɓo , ema zaje gyi-gyi-yi , yi zhin shekwoyi aza kni-kni yi nu .
fye ku efya bugba ga yesu na tnu nwoi nyi .
eyi pirist dnagmanyi gaiciya ga nya .
yesu ɓei zhin gaiciya n shekwoyi aba ngye shi musa ɓei zhin nyi .
ama yesu ɓo du musa n mwamwa .

ntu lonu ɓato ɓei lo asun-sun ba m , ( wato a israila yi ) ntu n ɓa tna gaiciya ga ɓo .
a sun-sun ba woiwoyi a yila alkawali gwo pwo-pwo nya , ntu deye ɓo yi zhin peceiye , ko ta bmiya to ya lo shekwoyi ebemi m .
nabari manayi ɓei la ɓe yi aba , ngye ɓa ɓaku wo ce , ama ko to ɓei zhin ampanyi m , ntu ge ɓa to wo n gaiciya gai m .
ama eyi n yi ku gaiciya ga nyi yi ɓa lo wo sun-sun .
ama shekwoyi ɓei gna atna gaiciya gayi .
ma gyi minagyi ma si nyasi ge , ɓa ta lo mi sun-sun , ko da shike owo atnu-tnu ɓo ku zo zhin , tunyi anyi zhin sa . shekwoyi ɓeda gna ge shekwoyi ɓei zhin anya vinya dna anyipyei ngun tnaba .
kwa gna ge , n nyipyeyi tnaba yi shekwoyi wa sun . nlo nu yi gye shekwoyi la lo sun-sun .
njesun , shekwoyi wa da ayahudiyayi ɓo , wa gna ge , ɓa ta lo mi sun-sun m . asun-sun ba lo ntu aza ɓo har nsaye .
yi to ku ze n gye aza tna ɓoviyi da m .
oɓa tna gaiciya ga n laifi yi ɓa zhin ɓa , to ɓa lo shekwoyi sun-sun aban .
njesun n dawuda sa , shekwoyi wapa ɓa shi aza ɓei fi n zhabui nyi .
wa gna ɓa ge , kna emi ɓeda tnubua n saiye .
to ha kpe bugba kala n gye aza n ɓa ɓei zhin ma gyi minagyi nyi m . wato aza n dawuda sa ɓei ku shekwoyi sun-sun ɓo wo nu .
ko shi joshua ɓei lo n ɓai nu alkawali kni , wo to ɓeimi wa lo n ɓai n shekwoyi fun .
wo ɓei gna ge wa lo nɓai nu , to shekwoyi je sun-sun ho ɓo dam .
deye kwa wu ge sun-sun yelo ntu shekwoyi aza ɓo .
zaho-zahoi nwa lo shekwoyi fun wo ɓa bwa sun-sun .
ko ɓa ze ngye shekwoyi sun-sun nwo ɓei sun woi ku anya zo zhin nyi .
ntu cenu , yi zhin atna ya lo ofun deye kada tna gaiciya ga kwa hana n yi .

aza nɓa ɓe shekwoyi aba , ɓa bwa abwi ba n bmazhin yi .
eyi gaiciya ga ta shan-shan , yi ku po sosai ngye nyakun nkwo tu n na pma .
yi ku mi zhi .
yesu la lo eshe n ya bye .
wo zhin eyi pirist dnagmayi nu .
owo begyi pirist nya har nyalo-nyalo nya nu .
ko wu ngye malkizedek nya nu .
malkizedek dnagmayi malkizedek ɓei gyibe dna salima nu .
wo ɓei zhin shekwoyi pirist nu , njesun wa shegun ibrahim woi zhi kun-sun , n asuyi , wa tu ibrahim anabarka .
ibrahim wa ga malkizedek zakka .
malkizedek awyega ge , ɓemanayi zhin yi . wo ɓei gyibe dna n salima nu salima awyega ge bugbafu nu .
( wato esu bugbafu nya ) .
malkizedek to ɓei n eya yi m .
eda ton , oɓi ma to nyin a takpe esa ye n na ɓei ma wo m , ko esa nwo ɓei fi m .
wo ɓei zhin ngye shekwoyi nugun dogbe nu .
wo zhin pirist nu nyalo-nyalo .
wo to ɓei zhin oza dnagmayi nu m ?
ibrahim , shekwoyi za kni-kniyi ɓei ga wo nu zakka .
a levi hi ɓei zhin shekwoyi a pirist nu .
ɓa ɓei zhin levi a yawyi nu .
shekwoyi ɓei gna ɓaɓe ɓa gwo sadaka n naza .
ɓa ɓei gwo n ɓa zaje nu kwa bma ɓa zhin .
shekwoyi nu ɓei gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin lonu .
amma malkizedek , to ɓei zhin ibrahim za nu n amma wo ɓei la sadaka gwo n ibrahim .
wohin kwa wa tu ibrahim anabarka .
ibrahim ɓei zhin ozanu n shekwoyi anabarkai tu .
yi kpe lo ge zadnagmayi nu zhin watu zanawyi anabarka .
a israilayi pirist ɓa to ku fin , amma malkizedek ɓei wu gbo , wo nyi har nyalo-nyalo .
levi , wonu ɓei zhin pirist dnagmayi dada , wohin kwa wa ga malkizedek sadaka dna n ibrahim .
ko a to ɓei ma levi nyin , owo bye ɓei dna n ibrahim mi sanu ibrahim ɓei ga malkizedek zakka nyi .
levi puwa ɓei zhin a pirist puwa nu , kni nu ɓei zhin yesu wa je pirist zhin a ?
malkizedek wa ze degbeyi ama to haruwa nu ma ?
ai a pirist vinya ɓei kun n levi puwa nu .
da shike a pirist tnu-tnu ɓei la shando dole a shan wyidna do , shekwoyi nu ɓei shando ce n wohin .
yesu eyi pirist wo to ɓei gmi n levi puwa nun .
yesu ɓei gmi n yahuda bye nu .
a yahuda yi to ɓei zhin a pirist nu m .
ntu ge musa to ɓei kni ɓa nun .
deye kwa wu yi ge shekwoyi zokwo ɓei la shan do da shike pirist zokwo ɓei la shan do da shike pirist zokwo ɓei la shando .
ko laze ngye malkizedek nya nu .
yesu to ɓei zhin pirist nayi nya num .
amma wo ɓei ze pirist n iko yi n ko ta shan zo m .
shekwoyi wa da n zabura ge , ho zhin mi pirist nu nyalo-nyalo , ho zhin n gye malkizedek nu . deye kwa wu ge aɓei la pirist zokwo kwo-kwoyi zunya .
ko to ɓei n kalayi dei-dei m , kwo to ɓei mi kwa gni za m .
kwo to ɓei ga za n befyece m , kwo to ɓei mi kwo lo n zai n shekwoyi aba m .
amma yesu ɓei la ɓe nu wyetu yi , owonu na ɓe n yi vi-viyi n shekwoyi aba .
shekwoyi ɓei la nyasi si nge yesu zhin pirist nyalo-nyalo nya nu .
shekwoyi to ɓei zhin lonu n pirist a je yi m .
amma n yesu tukwo , wo ɓei si nya si wa gna ge , ho zhin pirist nu nyalo-nyalo nya . ntu deye ɓo kristi ta gba kalam , ntuge shekwoyi la nyasi si , kristi ɓa gyi abye har nyalo-nyalo .
n sapai , a pirist ɓei mwa begye , n nabai n zaho wa fi , sai a dna do .
amma yesu ta shan fi m , ata mi a shan wo do m , ntu cenu ata ye zado lo m .
gni-gni nwo ga nyi , kwo nu-nuyi lo njesun kwo zhin nyalo-nyalo nya nu .
yesu nyi nyalonyalo .
ntu cenu yesu ɓa mi wa gni aza nɓa ɓe wa ba nyi .
wo zhin wa gyi shekwoyi wye ntu yi ɓo .
wo ɓei la ze ngye ʼyi kodashike wo to ɓei zhin laifi m , oza gyi-gyi-yi nu , n tna zamba .
a woi knaya n na alaifi da , a mwa-mwa gawo n eshemi .
yesu to wu ngye a pirist a je nun , wo to ɓei zhin sadaka ntu wa alaifi ɓom ; amma ntu na za ɓo nu .
wo ɓei bwa fi zun gmanyi nu ntu ya laifi ɓo .
wyidna wato musa owa , kwo nu ɓei kni a gbaizanyikwoci dna a pirist tnu-tnu .
ɓa ɓei zhin a laifi da nu .
amma wyidna woi-woyi nu na kni yesu , shekwoyi nugun .
wo to ɓei zhin laifi da shekwoyi nu na kni wo pirist nunuyi nyalo-nyalo .
malkizedek ɓei gyibe dna salima nu .
wo ɓei zhin shekwoyi pirist nu , njesun wa shegun ibrahim woi zhi kun-sun , n asuyi , wa tu ibrahim anabarka .

pirist dnagmayi tnu-tnu nu wa zhin sadaka , ntu aza laifi ɓo .
wo dna n azanyikwoci a tan-tasin n shekwoyi , ntu cenu dole wa ga sadaka .
n na alkawali kwo-kwo yi sa yesu to ɓei ɓa bmiya dna ɓom , ntu ge wo to ɓei gmi n pirist bye nu m .
ntu cenu ato ɓei ɓa ye ge wo zhin tnu-tnu ye pya m .
zokwo kwokwoyi nu ɓei zhin gnabye .
kwo nu ɓei zhin foto eshe nya .
ya gye shi na ɓei zhin lubui n wu .
wo ɓei gna musa ge wo zhin lubui ( tent ) shi wo ɓo wu wo .
amma kristi pirist tnutnu ko du a pirist aje nya n daraja .
owo nu zhin bmazhin yi n shekwoyi abye n saiye .
shekwoyi awyidna kmisunyi ɓei dnaɓo na vi ba .
kwo to ɓo bma zhin .
ntu cenu wa je do ga .
shekwoyi n wohin tukwo , wa cige , dnawye esa ɓelo nɓa zhin alkawali n israila yi ɓodo n yahudiyi yi .
mi ɓei la alkawali kwo-kwo yi wu ntu ge efya dada to ɓei shi kwo bwam-sanu ɓa ɓei kun n masar nyi .
alkawali kwo-kwoyi ɓei wu gbo n woi-woyi . dagayi wa gna ge mi ɓa zhin alkawali ye n na israila yi , wyihoi nɓa dna ɓa emi awyidna nɓa bugba .
nɓa ze oɓa shekwoyi ɓahin ɓa ze ema za .
nsahi , ato ɓei je zaho-zahoi nya wun , ntucenu ato ɓei ye a malami nɓa ɓo wuza dagayi m , zaho-zahoi ɓei kpe mi ye , ɓinayi n na zadnagmayi , vinya aɓei kpe mi ye .
mi ɓei gye ɓa sun-sun dna nɓa aba bwi , mi ɓei ku ɓa laifi zamwi . shiri kwo-kwoyi shekwoyi wa gna ge wola awyidna kwo-kwoyi ga avun , woi la woi-woyi ga .
ɓedakpakalayi nu nyi .

nsaiyi fa ya da alkawali kwo kwoyi ɓo n shekwoyi ɓei ga wa za nyi .
wo ɓei ku awyidna ga shi aɓa la wo tu nwu .
tent ( lubui ) ɓo nyi ntu wo latu ɓo , ko ɓei safi n gun aba , nyakun kmisunyi a yikwo ge aba gyi-gyi-yi .
eje ɓei sa , nkwo avun yakun do ɓonyi , kwo nu ɓei zhin aba gyi-gyi-yi du-duyi .
( shekwoyi zafun ɓei dna ɓo nu . ) n nyakun bayi bagadi ɓei shi n cei zhin n zinariya yi , aɓei zhin a gyi tulale na ɓo nu .
akwati zinariya nya ɓei nyi ko nu ɓei zhin akwati alkawali nya .
nkwo mi musa awyidna ɓo ya dna n nyagyi yafi n ɓa ɓei zhin ɓai gyi n zhabui nyi .
wato mana nu .
haruna busi ɓei dna ɓo , n kwo ɓei kmi nyi .
nkwo she ɓa ɓei n nazai zhin kpe , wato shekwoyi amalaika .
a yi ɓa ge cherubim , ɓa ɓei n nabminayi laya kpe n na kwati yi akwati she , a yi kwo ge shinkpegye sun-sungye nya .
yi ta mi ya da shi kwo ɓei nyi vinya n .
shi ɓa ku anya zo zhin vinya , sai pirist wa lo nyakun gyi-gyi-yi , wa ɓe n sadaka yi ntu n naza ɓo .
amma pirist dnagmayi nu ɓei bwa mi wa lo dna n nyakun bayi .
wo ɓei zhin wa bwa lo zungmanyi nu n eye gmanyi .
wo ɓei zhin wa lo n nami shi wa zoya kpe n shinkpegye sun-sungye nya , n shekwoyi abye .
kwo ɓo zhin kwa bwi ɓa laifi n na babwi yi .
kwo ɓei nyi ntu piristi ɓo na zai vinya .
zafun gyi-gyi-yi cei pma wa wu yi nya nu n kwo mi .
n zokwo kwokwoyi aza ɓei gnaje gna-gnayi n shekwoyi , ɓa to ɓei mi ɓa lo fi n naba gyi-gyi-yi du-duyi ɓa lo da shekwoyi m .
eje ɓo sa n kwo ɓei ɓa gnaje ya .
ntu ge zokwo woi-woyi to ɓei guya ai lo shekwoyi aba m .
deye kwo wu yi nya nu ɓo .
n zokwo kwo-kwoyi , nyaga n sadaka yi ɓo zhin dole nu , amma deye to ɓei mi kwa zhan ɓa bugba ya m , oɓa bugba ɓei zhin laifi nya nu , ɓa ɓei gnaje-gnagnayi n shekwoyi .
shekwoyi ta ye laifi m , wo ta ye ɓa ɓedo n laifi da yi m , aza n na to zhan ɓa laifi ya m .
zokwo kwokwoyi ɓei wu aɓo nu nɓa ɓa zhin a da shekwoyi .
awyidna ɓei nyi ntu nyasin ɓo , n nyagyi , nuwan fu ɓedo n na nyajei mwa begye .
dole owo mwa-mwa gayi ɓa nu aɓoye .
kwo ɓei zhin dole nu ɓa zhin aɓo deye ntu ge ɓa zhin shiri ntu yesu ɓeɓe ɓo .
yesu la zokwo woi-woyi guya kwoi lo shekwoyi aba .
yesu nu zhin eyi pirist woi-woiyi duduyi .
womi woi ɓe n yi n shekwoyi abye , wo du shekwoyi puwa n eshe mi ; abwa nu to mi api ye m , kwo to nyi n na nyi ye nu m , ama n eshe mi .
wo ɓei la wo ami nu wa lo n cei n naba gyi-gyi-yi .
wa ze ɓa kpe n shinkpegye sun-sungye nya , ena ami nu to n , nyakpa dohodohoyi ami nu to n .
owo hin ami nu , owo ami ku yi ta-ta ta gba .
eyi gni-gni la nu , gni-gni tnu-tnu ku zo zhin .
shiri woiwoyi n zokwo kwo-kwoyi , aɓei zhin ampanyi n na nakwoyi , ɓedo n anayi , oɓa mi ɓei zhin ɓa zhan za ya nɓa laifi nayi nya .
amma shekwoyi nugun ami gyi-gyi-yi du oɓa nyalo .
zafun ɓei zhin woi bma wo zhin , owo ami n kala yi lo .
kwo ɓa shan yi do kwapmi ya bugba bma , kwa zhan yi alaifi ya .
kwo la ednawo gmiyi ya ntu na awyindna ɓo , kwo ga yi kala ntu ge ya zhin wo atnu-tnu .
yesu wo la ɓe n alkawali woi-woyi .
kwo nyi ntu naza ɓonu n shekwoyi la ɓa yi nyi , n na byei gbogbo , ɓa gwo shekwoyi anabarka .
yesu fi-fi la yi loya , gama wo ɓei ku ta-ta ta gba ntu ya laifi ɓo .
anabaraka ye cauta nu .
nza fi , wo zhin wa gado ya shi n navun , ama ata mi a gna oza gado , to woi fi num .
ntu cenu aɓa zhin ampanyi n wo ɓeda yi woi la fi nu .
zaho ta gwo nyaho sai wo la fi .
shekwoyi alkawali ɓo ce hatimi n ami .
kwo ɓei wu kwotonci n musa sa , owo fifi nya .
yesu wa fi , ntuge a gayi owo gado nu .
musa ɓei ga aza shekwoyi awyidna .
nsaiyi wa ze ami ya kpe n na wyidna yi ɓedo n na azayi .
wa zhin ampanyi n afintolo hoi ɓedo n lulu byei-byei yi n nabai wa ze ami ya kpe aza ɓedo n nuwan yi .
wo ɓei gna ami ye , ɓa zhin alkawali nya nu , shekwoyi gbega nu , fye shi kwo bwa . wo ɓei lakwo zeye kpe n tent ɓedo n nabayi n ɓa gyi-gyi-yi nyi .
n alkawali kwo-kwoyi ami nu ɓei zhin ɓa zhan nya ya vinya .
deye kwa wu ge , efi , kwo nu zhin laifi tagba nya .
gafara zhin to lo n tna ami zeyan .
tent n musa ɓei zhin n anyai vinya nkwo mi , aɓei laɓa degbe n she nu .
dole musa zeɓa gyi-gyi-yi n anyakpa ami yi .
amma tent nkwo lo n eshe nyi , aɓei zekwo gyi-gyi-yi n enya yi nu n kwo du deye lo n daraja .
yesu ɓei lo eshe nu n kwohin tukwo , to ge aba gyi-gyi-yi nna mi n nabwa yi m , wo lo n she woi wu wohin tukwo n shekwoyi abye ntu yi ɓo .
wo taga sadaka ntu yi ɓo cici m , yesu sadaka zungmanyi nu .
ama pirist dnagmayi ɓei zhin wa ga a sadaka cici n na ba gyi-gyi-yi dudu yi eye doho-dohoyi .
shekwoyi ta ye sadaka ye cici nu m .
dole nu yesu wa ga wohin zun gmanyi .
owo sadaka ɓei la eyi tata goya .
zaho-zahoi ɓa fi zungmanyi .
amma n fi avun shekwoyi ɓei da zaho-zahoyi owa .
ntu cenu yesu ɓei fi ntu yi ɓo zungmanyi , wo ɓei fi eyi a laifi fi nu .
amma wo ɓei la laka n vingwo , wo je ze ɓe lo wa gni aza nɓa vi wo nyi .
nsaiyi fa ya da alkawali kwo kwoyi ɓo n shekwoyi ɓei ga wa za nyi .
wo ɓei ku awyidna ga shi aɓa la wo tu nwu .
tent ( lubui ) ɓo nyi ntu wo latu ɓo , ko ɓei safi n gun aba , nyakun kmisunyi a yikwo ge aba gyi-gyi-yi .
eje ɓei sa , nkwo avun yakun do ɓonyi , kwo nu ɓei zhin aba gyi-gyi-yi du-duyi .
( shekwoyi zafun ɓei dna ɓo nu . ) n nyakun bayi bagadi ɓei shi n cei zhin n zinariya yi , aɓei zhin a gyi tulale na ɓo nu .
akwati zinariya nya ɓei nyi ko nu ɓei zhin akwati alkawali nya .
nkwo mi musa awyidna ɓo ya dna n nyagyi yafi n ɓa ɓei zhin ɓai gyi n zhabui nyi .
wato mana nu .
haruna busi ɓei dna ɓo , n kwo ɓei kmi nyi .
nkwo she ɓa ɓei n nazai zhin kpe , wato shekwoyi amalaika .
a yi ɓa ge cherubim , ɓa ɓei n nabminayi laya kpe n na kwati yi akwati she , a yi kwo ge shinkpegye sun-sungye nya .
yi ta mi ya da shi kwo ɓei nyi vinya n .
shi ɓa ku anya zo zhin vinya , sai pirist wa lo nyakun gyi-gyi-yi , wa ɓe n sadaka yi ntu n naza ɓo .
amma pirist dnagmayi nu ɓei bwa mi wa lo dna n nyakun bayi .
wo ɓei zhin wa bwa lo zungmanyi nu n eye gmanyi .
wo ɓei zhin wa lo n nami shi wa zoya kpe n shinkpegye sun-sungye nya , n shekwoyi abye .
kwo ɓo zhin kwa bwi ɓa laifi n na babwi yi .
kwo ɓei nyi ntu piristi ɓo na zai vinya .
zafun gyi-gyi-yi cei pma wa wu yi nya nu n kwo mi .
n zokwo kwokwoyi aza ɓei gnaje gna-gnayi n shekwoyi , ɓa to ɓei mi ɓa lo fi n naba gyi-gyi-yi du-duyi ɓa lo da shekwoyi m .
eje ɓo sa n kwo ɓei ɓa gnaje ya .
ntu ge zokwo woi-woyi to ɓei guya ai lo shekwoyi aba m .
deye kwo wu yi nya nu ɓo .
n zokwo kwo-kwoyi , nyaga n sadaka yi ɓo zhin dole nu , amma deye to ɓei mi kwa zhan ɓa bugba ya m , oɓa bugba ɓei zhin laifi nya nu , ɓa ɓei gnaje-gnagnayi n shekwoyi .
shekwoyi ta ye laifi m , wo ta ye ɓa ɓedo n laifi da yi m , aza n na to zhan ɓa laifi ya m .
zokwo kwokwoyi ɓei wu aɓo nu nɓa ɓa zhin a da shekwoyi .
awyidna ɓei nyi ntu nyasin ɓo , n nyagyi , nuwan fu ɓedo n na nyajei mwa begye .
dole owo mwa-mwa gayi ɓa nu aɓoye .
kwo ɓei zhin dole nu ɓa zhin aɓo deye ntu ge ɓa zhin shiri ntu yesu ɓeɓe ɓo .
yesu la zokwo woi-woyi guya kwoi lo shekwoyi aba .
yesu nu zhin eyi pirist woi-woiyi duduyi .
womi woi ɓe n yi n shekwoyi abye , wo du shekwoyi puwa n eshe mi ; abwa nu to mi api ye m , kwo to nyi n na nyi ye nu m , ama n eshe mi .
wo ɓei la wo ami nu wa lo n cei n naba gyi-gyi-yi .
wa ze ɓa kpe n shinkpegye sun-sungye nya , ena ami nu to n , nyakpa dohodohoyi ami nu to n .
owo hin ami nu , owo ami ku yi ta-ta ta gba .
eyi gni-gni la nu , gni-gni tnu-tnu ku zo zhin .
n zokwo kwo-kwoyi , aɓei zhin ampanyi n na nakwoyi , ɓedo n anayi , oɓa mi ɓei zhin ɓa zhan za ya nɓa laifi nayi nya .
amma shekwoyi nugun ami gyi-gyi-yi du oɓa nyalo .
zafun ɓei zhin woi bma wo zhin , owo ami n kala yi lo .
kwo ɓa shan yi do kwapmi ya bugba bma , kwa zhan yi alaifi ya .
kwo la ednawo gmiyi ya ntu na awyindna ɓo , kwo ga yi kala ntu ge ya zhin wo atnu-tnu .
yesu wo la ɓe n alkawali woi-woyi .
kwo nyi ntu naza ɓonu n shekwoyi la ɓa yi nyi , n na byei gbogbo , ɓa gwo shekwoyi anabarka .
yesu fi-fi la yi loya , gama wo ɓei ku ta-ta ta gba ntu ya laifi ɓo .
anabaraka ye cauta nu .
nza fi , wo zhin wa gado ya shi n navun , ama ata mi a gna oza gado , to woi fi num .
ntu cenu aɓa zhin ampanyi n wo ɓeda yi woi la fi nu .
zaho ta gwo nyaho sai wo la fi .
shekwoyi alkawali ɓo ce hatimi n ami .
kwo ɓei wu kwotonci n musa sa , owo fifi nya .
yesu wa fi , ntuge a gayi owo gado nu .
musa ɓei ga aza shekwoyi awyidna .
nsaiyi wa ze ami ya kpe n na wyidna yi ɓedo n na azayi .
wa zhin ampanyi n afintolo hoi ɓedo n lulu byei-byei yi n nabai wa ze ami ya kpe aza ɓedo n nuwan yi .
wo ɓei gna ami ye , ɓa zhin alkawali nya nu , shekwoyi gbega nu , fye shi kwo bwa . wo ɓei lakwo zeye kpe n tent ɓedo n nabayi n ɓa gyi-gyi-yi nyi .
n alkawali kwo-kwoyi ami nu ɓei zhin ɓa zhan nya ya vinya .
deye kwa wu ge , efi , kwo nu zhin laifi tagba nya .
gafara zhin to lo n tna ami zeyan .
tent n musa ɓei zhin n anyai vinya nkwo mi , aɓei laɓa degbe n she nu .
dole musa zeɓa gyi-gyi-yi n anyakpa ami yi .
amma tent nkwo lo n eshe nyi , aɓei zekwo gyi-gyi-yi n enya yi nu n kwo du deye lo n daraja .
yesu ɓei lo eshe nu n kwohin tukwo , to ge aba gyi-gyi-yi nna mi n nabwa yi m , wo lo n she woi wu wohin tukwo n shekwoyi abye ntu yi ɓo .
wo taga sadaka ntu yi ɓo cici m , yesu sadaka zungmanyi nu .
ama pirist dnagmayi ɓei zhin wa ga a sadaka cici n na ba gyi-gyi-yi dudu yi eye doho-dohoyi .
shekwoyi ta ye sadaka ye cici nu m .
dole nu yesu wa ga wohin zun gmanyi .
owo sadaka ɓei la eyi tata goya .
zaho-zahoi ɓa fi zungmanyi .
amma n fi avun shekwoyi ɓei da zaho-zahoyi owa .
ntu cenu yesu ɓei fi ntu yi ɓo zungmanyi , wo ɓei fi eyi a laifi fi nu .
amma wo ɓei la laka n vingwo , wo je ze ɓe lo wa gni aza nɓa vi wo nyi .
domwi woiwoyi n kwokwoyi a yahudiyi awyidna ɓei bmiya amma kwo ɓei zhin foto nu , kwo ɓei zhin ofun nu anya manayi n kristi ɓei zhin ntu yi ɓo .
a ɓei zhin a ga sadaka cici , eye dohodohoi .
sadaka yi ɓei gna ge kwo ɓa gni aza nu , to ai ɓei ga cici m .
kwo bmiya mwa-mwa ga yi wa ze gyigyiyi nyalo-nyalo , to wa zhin tunani laifi nya m .
amma sadaka to ɓei mi kwa nya ɓa tunani nukwoyi ya m , kwo ɓei zhin kwa pa ɓa a laifi ɓo nu cici .
kwo to ɓei zhan ɓa a laifi ya m .
anakwo ami , na ana miyi ta mi ɓa zhan za a laifi ya m , sai dai yesu kristi ami gmanyi .
ntu cenu yesu wa ɓe anyi mi , yesu ɓei da ɓo nu anabi ho aba wa ci ge , anyakpa ami ta siho ebemi o shekwoyi , ntu cenu hoi ga mi nayi ye , emi nayi nu n ho ye sadaka .
sakada anyakpa nya to ga ho bugbafu m , kwo sadaka a pirist nya ɓata mi ɓaga ho bugba fu m . n deye avun , fye gye , mi la ɓe ma ga mi wye-wyeyi ntu naza laifi ɓo .
nyanu n littafi ku da ntu mi ɓo . she kristi ɓei ku da ge , anyakpa ami ta mi kwa ga yi enya n shekwoyi ye nyi m , njesun sadaka n na gyina ntu na laifi ɓo nyi ɓa ta fu wo bugbam , a yahudaiyi awyidna ta dawo bugba m .
yesu wa je ɓo da n jesun wa gna , mi la ɓe ma ga mi wye-wyeyi , mi ga kwo ntu n naza laifi ɓo nu .
ala zokwo kwo-kwoyi gaya .
ala ɓe n woi-woyi . shekwoyi wo ku gafara zhin yi n zokwo woi-woi .
wola ya laifi zhanya nyalo-nyalo .
yesu nu na zhin aɓo deye ntu yi ɓo , sanu wo ɓei fi ntu ya laifi ɓo nyi .
nsa kwokwoyi sa , pirist ɓei zhin wa laka gni n nabye fyegyi-fyegyi , wo ɓei zhin wa ga sadaka ntu naza laifi ɓo , ama kwo ta mi kwo gni za m .
ama yesu ɓo ga wohin zun gmanyi ntu sadaka ɓo ga shekwoyi , wa ga wo nayi ntu ya laifi ɓo .
wo tu lo naba duduyi vinya n iko yi n kun-sun shekwoyi n shemi .
wo tu lo naba iko nya n kun-sun shekwoyi yi , owo anuwun yi ɓo fi n wo sunta .
enya nu n wo pmi , wo ɓei gyibe tu ʼɓa tukwo nyalo-nyalo .
wo ku yi ze aza gyi-gyi-yi n shekwoyi aba .
owo ami layi alaifi zhanya har nyalo-nyalo .
zafun nu zhin yi seida n ge yi gyi-gyi-yilo .
zafun shekwoyi nya gna ge , alkawali woi-woyi nyi nɓa zhin na israila yi .
nɓa kami awyidna kpe nɓa bugba , nɓa ku awyidna ya fi ɓa n ɓami , deye ɓa zhin ɓa kpe mi nufi ye ɓa vi ma wyidna . wo ɓei je da ge , mi ku ɓa zhin gafara .
mi ta je ɓa laifi ɓo pa m , kwo kwa oɓa ɓonukwoyi zhin . mi ku fye zhin gafara , mi ku fye alaifi ze , amwi nyalo-nyalo , kwo zhin ɓo gboloyi nu fya ga sadaka ntu fya alaifi ɓo .
yesu ku deye zo zhin n wa mi yi .
emi azaje , yi ɓa mi ya lo shekwoyi aba , yesu ami la zokwo guya gayi .
yesu la zokwo woi-woyi guya gayi .
kwo zhin kwa ga wye-wyeyi , wo la zokwo zhin yi kwoi lo shekwoyi aba .
owo nayi ɓedo n wo ami yi nu ɓei zhin zokwo ye .
she yesu kristi wo nu zhin pirist dnagmayi , woi gyi ɓe tu n shekwoyi puwa nyi .
emi azaje , yi lo shekwoyi aba n bugbayi guguyi ya .
yi ku gaiciya ga n ge wo ɓa gwo yi , ntu ge yesu ami layi zhanya sarai .
zafun kwa woi zhan yi ya cici .
yi zhin aza gniyi nu kuma yi wyewyeyi lo .
yi to zhin shakka , n yi gnigni yi m , gama eyi gni yi zhin za gaiciya da nu wohin kwa wo ɓa nu owo alkawali .
la wye ce n bemanayi zhin yi zhin godiya ntu nya ɓo yesu ku zhin gayi nyi .
yi yenajeyi , yi bma aje zhin yi ce aje bwa .
deye ɓa wu ge yi zhin yesu abara nu hin-hin .
ema zaje yi to ci aduwa ɓo wyegba m , enya nu n na zaho zhin , amma yi ce aje bwa yi dna aje zokwo , yesu jezeɓe ɓo kwo la wu viwyi .
yi to gyi abye fi n na laifi m , ntu ge yi kpe gaiciya ye lo .
amma n ya gyi abye n laifi zhin , shekwoyi ta zhin yi gafara m , ya zhin yi gwo kpe m .
shekwoyi ɓa ta za nwa gyi abye n laifi zhin yi , wo zhin shekwoyi nuwun yi nu .
shekwoyi minagyi ɓo zopui nwo anuwun yi n nyipyeyi kmaknayi .
aɓei tu aza dole ɓa vi musa awyidna , aza n ɓa ɓei zungna nyi ɓaɓei ku fi n tna sun-sungye .
sa n za ɓei zhin laifi , sai a bwa aseda da ngun aba kwo ngun ata laifi kwa tabbata .
aza ho lo ɓai kpe shekwoyi ɓi apita , ɓai zhin aɓo ngye owo ami to ɓai gyi-gyi-yi m .
ɓa la zafun gyi-gyi-yi la minagyi ka .
oza n wo zhin aɓo deye pya , wo ɓa gwo tata dnagmayi , wo to ɓei lo shekwoyi bemi m .
shekwoyi ɓei da ge , tagba kwo zhin mi nya nu .
nɓa ga ɓa amsa . nɓa ka aɓei da ya .
nɓa da aza owa , nɓa ta aɓenukwoyi zhin yi . nkanu ɓa kpe shekwoyi minagyi ɓo ye a ?
kwo zhin ɓo dnawoyi nu oza lo shekwoyi wada .
ho kpe sa lo n ho ɓo ya yesu vi ncei yi ?
emazaje , fye to ze wyihi amwi m .
anyipyeyi gmada nya n naɓo wowoyi : fye ku wahala sin ntu yesu eye ɓo , amma fyehin kwa fye , ku hakuri bwa .
fyeto na wo aɓo m amma fye vi wo cici .
mi pa salo naza ɓei zhin ɓai lu fye , ɓai ma fye san .
fye gye aza sun-sun nɓa ɓei zhin ɓai sin wahala n gye fye nyi , kwo zhin hali manayi nu .
shekwoyi kwa wo dagma lo n fyei .
fye ɓei sin wahala ɓedo n naza yi n ɓafi n kurkuku .
fye to ɓei damu sa n na ɓei ku fye akaya m , fye ɓo ku shekwoyi kpeye har fyei kpema wo .
fye kpe lo ge , gyiba dnagmayi lo kwoi pmi fye nʼshemi .
fye to fa kpema shekwoyi ɓo m , kwo n wuso-wuso , fye to fa m .
shekwoyi n lada yi shi fye lo n ʼshemi .
fye zhin peceiye , fya zhin hankuri .
deye fye zhin shekwoyi ɓeye nu .
n fya zhin shekwoyi ɓeye , fye ɓei gwo lada n mwa .
sa fyewyi , yesu jezeɓe lo , wo ta mwa sam .
fye zhin hankuri fya pmi wo .
a yesu viyi zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu vinya , dole ya zan-zan dna n gaiciya ga .
nna ɓo vinya la kpema wo fyeto fa dagayi vi ɓom , shekwoyi ta wo agmada n nazai n ɓa jeze n navun yi m .
ama yi zhin wo aviyi nu ɓehin-hin nya .
yi to ye ya jeze navun yi m eyi gaiciya ga kwo ci seda lo ge yi wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi lo .
a yahudiyi awyidna ɓei bmiya amma kwo ɓei zhin foto nu , kwo ɓei zhin ofun nu anya manayi n kristi ɓei zhin ntu yi ɓo .
a ɓei zhin a ga sadaka cici , eye dohodohoi .
sadaka yi ɓei gna ge kwo ɓa gni aza nu , to ai ɓei ga cici m .

gaiciyaga aɓo wowoyi kni yi nu zhin gaiciya ga ?
gaiciya ga kwo nu zhin bugba shi ge nya yi ye kwo ɓa zhin .
ko nu zhin gaiciya ga n bugba ge nya lo na bye kwo da shike yi ta mi ya to kwo bwa m , kwo kwa ya gye m .
n sapai aza ɓei nyi n gaiciya ga yi sosai .
aɓei zhin a kpe ɓa ye ntu ɓa gaiciya ga ɓo .
dna gaiciya ga , yi kpe lo ge shekwoyi nu ɓei zhin anyi n nanyai vinya n ɓa fi n ɓa nyi .
owo ɓeda nu ɓei zhin ɓa , nsasayi kwa zhin .
gaiciya ga nu ɓei zhin habila wa vi shekwoyi ɓo .
wo ɓei ɓe n nyagayi n kwo ɓei da shekwoyi ndu kayinu nya .
shekwoyi ɓei la habila gwo ɓedo n wo nyaga yi .
habila gwo ɓedo n wo nyaga yi .
habila lafi amma dole ya dna wo wye ya gye wo ɓei kpe ma shekwoyi .
enoch ɓei zhin zanu n gaiciya gayi .
wo ɓei la kpema shekwoyi .
shekwoyi kwa wa dagma n wo gaiciya gai .
ntu cenu wo to ɓo fi m .
shekwoyi ɓei la wo la lo n cei n ʼshemi .
shekwoyi ta wo ho agmada m ndei ho to n gaiciya ga yi m .
oza n wo ye wa ɓe wa ba dole wa ga wo gaiciya .
wa kpe ge shekwoyi zhin wa ga aza lada n ɓa zan wo shin nyi .
nuhu ɓei zhin ʼzanu n wo ɓei kpema shekwoyi .
shekwoyi ɓo wu wo anya n ɓa ɓa zhin .
nuhu ɓei la gaiciya ga shekwoyi wa zhin eya ntu ge kwa gni wo puwa .
aza je ɓei gyi abye ɓa zhin laifi .
ɓa to ɓo ga shekwoyi gaiciya m .
to ɓa viwo begye m , shekwoyi ɓo gwo nuhu ntu wo gaiciya ga ɓo , n wo ɓo vi yi .
ibrahim kwa wo ɓei kpema shekwoyi sosai .
dna n gaiciya ga wa wo shekwoyi begye .
shekwoyi ɓo gna wo ge wo fa wa yi wa lo ekni do .
shekwoyi ɓo ku gna ge wo ɓa ga ibrahim ekni yi .
wo ɓolo , to woi kpe aba n wo lo m .
wo ɓei zhin zhiɓeyi nu dna ekni alkawali nya .
ama wo ɓei la kpema shekwoyi .
wo ɓei dna n na lubui n wo puwa yi vinya ishaku ɓedo n yakubu yi ɓa ɓo fi n na lubui ce .
shekwoyi ɓei ga ɓa alkawali ngye ibrahim .
ibrahim ɓei pmi shekwoyi wa ɓe n woyi n zhimi .
ezhi n shekwoyi wa mi n wohin yi .
saratu ɓei n gaiciya ga yi , owo gaiciya ga ɓo zhin wo wa ma oɓi woi la kwo .
wa gaiciya ga ge shekwoyi ɓa nuwo alkawali .
ntu cenu , israila yi bye ɓei pa n ibrahim nu oza nwo ɓei la kwo sosai .
wonu zhin ebye dnagmayi ye dada .
owo aɓi n mwa begye n gye amwi kwo akpasu ayiwo ge oɓa dada .
wo ɓei la api mi ɓa n ʼshemi .
aza ye vinya ɓaku kpe ma shekwoyi .
nya wo ɓei zhin ɓa alkawali , ɓa ɓo la kwo ga gaiciya .
amma ɓa to ɓo gwo anya vinya n shekwoyi ɓei zhin ɓa alkawali m .
ɓa ɓei la ye ɓa gwo alkawali , amma ɓa ku ɓa nya fi .
amma ɓa ɓei nagmadayi ntu ge ɓa ɓo kpe ge anyi ye to zhin ɓa nya num .
eyi puwa lo n ʼshemi nu .
oɓa ɓeda kwo wu ɓa wyetu .
aza ɓei zhin ɓai shi awye n ʼshe nu , oɓa puwa nu .
ɓa ɓei n sai nyi ɓa jeze lo anyi gmada .
ama ɓa to ɓe ye lo ɓo m .
maimako ɓa ɓei kni agmada eshe nya nu , ntu cenu a da shekwoyi lo .
sanu shekwoyi ɓeitu ibrahim mwi cei nyi wo ɓo dudu wa kpema wo .
ntu cenu wa ga ishaku owo ɓi .
har wa ku shiri zhin wa zun wo sha ntu sadaka ɓo .
wo ɓei ku shiri zhin wawu ishaku .
koda shike shekwoyi ɓei ku gna wo ge ishaku ɓa zhin obye tukwo da .
wo ɓei ku kpe ge shekwoyi ɓa je ishaku wyewyeyi ga .
enya nu kuwa nkwo ɓo zhin , ama n ibrahim aba ishaku ɓola fi ama wa jeze ɓe anyi .
dna n gaiciya ga ishaku ɓei tu yakubu anabarka ɓedo n isuwa yi ntu na bye ɓo .
yakubu ɓei fi woi la kwo , ama kafin wo fi wo ɓei yi yusufu aɓi vinya wa zhin aduwa kpe ɓa , wa tu ɓa anabarka .
duk dna n gaiciya ga nu n wo ɓo zhin aɓo ye .
yusufu ɓei n gaiciya gayi , wo ɓo fi woi la kwo ce .
wo ɓei da a israila gni-gni ɓo n masar .
wo ɓei ku kpe ge kwo ɓa zhin lo nu .
ntu cenu wa gna ɓa ge ɓa ɓei la wo asunkun ku lo ncei dna n gaiciya ga nu n wo ɓo da ce .
musa dada n woʼya yi ɓei n gaiciya ga ce .
ɓa ɓei la gaiciya ga ge shekwoyi ɓa gni ɓa ɓi n fi .
cenu ɓo zhin ɓa sowo har apya ta .
amma ɓa to ɓei zhin ɓai wo firauna dna m .
musa wohin ɓei gaiciya ga .
wa mwa har wa zhin zayakwo dna masar , to wa ye ayi wo ge firʼauna nyigun nugun m .
wa ye wa sun wahala n shekwoyi azayi , wo to ɓei ye wa dagma dna n laifi m .
wo ɓei gna wo ta ye wa zhin aɓo n gye a masar yi aɓin , ama wo ɓo gye kwo ɓa wo du wa sun wahala ntu shekwoyi alkawali ɓo , wo ɓei la gaiciya ga ge shekwoyi ɓaga wo lada n du masar nya .
dna gaiciya ga wa fa masar , wo to ɓei wo dna ge esu ɓa gyi minagyi m , wo ɓei kpe ge shekwoyi kunsun lo n woi , wa kpe ma shekwoyi iko .
wo ɓei ku kpe ge shekwoyi ɓa gni wo aza , ntu cenu wa gna aza ge ɓa wu kugya ɓa pmiya kwo ami n na bokunmi she , sanu malaika efi nya ɓei duya wo to ɓo wu ɓa ɓi kmisunyi m .
amma puwa doho-dohoi nkwo to ɓei ami yi kpem , wa wu aɓi kmisunyi .
a israila yi ɓei la kpema shekwoyi .
ɓa pi ola dnagmayi ya n gye ɓa piya n kni kawai .
ama sanu na amasar yi ɓei tumwi ge ɓa lo , ɓa ku bwi nuwan .
dna n gaiciya ga jerikwo galu kwa ʼɓaya , a israila yi ɓei she galu gun anyipyei tnaba .
shekwoyi gbega nu ɓei .
ɓavi gbega yi kwa .
rahab ɓei zhin karuwanu .
ama wo ɓei la gaiciya ga shekwoyi iko , wo to ɓei fi n kunsun nwo azaje yi m , ɓa ɓei fi ntu ge ɓa to ɓei vi shekwoyi begye m .
amma rahab ɓei la azhi-pmigye yi gwo .
aza manayi nɓa ɓei du anyi kala to , mi ɓa shada gena ?
esa lami gba , n mi ɓa da aza gaiciya ga ɓo n gye gidion , barak , samson , jepheta , dauda ɓedo n samuila yi .
oɓa vinya ɓa ɓei kpema shekwoyi , ɓa ɓei gyi kun , ai ku asu ya n ɓa gyi nyi , ɓai gyi be , ɓa gwo anabarka .
har ɓa wu agagwo , to agaba mi nɓa nyaho zhin .
ena to ɓei shin ɓa gyin .
abeyakwo to ɓei shin ɓa wu m , azaho ɓei ku kala bwa .
aza ho ɓaku ze abezhe-yakwo dna soja .
ɓa nya a soja je ya har ɓai busi .
azaho ɓai ku aza kala n vingwo , azaho ɓa ye ge ɓa sun wahala ɓa vi shekwoyi .
ɓa ɓei ku kpe ge shekwoyi ɓei je ɓa kala ku ɓa bwa wye-wye yi nyalo-nyalo nya .
aɓei zhin a ma azaho san , azaho a sa ɓa naiya n busi yi , azaho kwa a pa ɓa a ya ɓa fi n kurkuku .
aɓei kni azaho akuta har ɓa fi .
a sa azaho pisa n gun aba nʼbei .
ama aɓei ku ɓa wu n abe-yakwo yi , azahoi vi ana-pa na kugya pai .
mikun yi gun ɓa har nyai san ɓa a zhin ɓa ɓo ntna sun-sun gye .
aza ho ɓei zhin aza manayi nu sosai , ama ɓa ɓei zan fi n zhabui , n na pai .
ɓa fi n nabwo nkni .
ɓa ɓei ikpema shekwoyi a zhin shiri ntu yi ye n ɓai , ama zaho-zahoi nɓa to ɓei gwo anya vinya n shekwoyi ɓo zhin ɓa alkawali m .
lada lo n du ɓa nya n shekwoyi a zhin shiri ntu yi ɓo , ntu cenu shekwoyi yelo ɓa pmi yi ya kun gna .

n nabai ya zan-zan dna n gaiciya n hakuri yi n shekwoyi la shi n ya bye nyi .
yi shi yesu nu awye , wo nu zhin yi gnabye .
vinyikwo to ɓei wo wo wa fi ntu ya laifi ɓon .
wo ɓei kpe ge kwo ɓa ɓe wo n mwa-mwai .
nsaiye kuwa wo tu lo n naba duduyi n kunsun n shekwoyi n ʼshemi .
aza nukwoyi ɓei ga yesu wahala , ama wa zhin hakuri .
yi dna wo wahala wye wa ze eyi gnabye .
deye ɓa bma yi zhin ya bwa kala .
kwo dama yi to shi gusun n laifi yi kwo n jarabai har yi la amisa kpe ɓedo n ami yin .
shekwoyi ta-ta bmiya ntu yi ɓo hola shekwoyi ɓeda zamwi nu ?
wo ɓei gna ge , omi nugun to gyi minagyi ʼsa shekwoyi wa gaho tata .
to bma bugba ya esa n wa wuho oho doknunu gbi m .
shekwoyi zhin wa dna owo aɓi zokwo wa ga ɓa tata .
sanu wo ga yi tata , kwo wu gye yi zhin wa nya nu . shekwoyi zhin yi-fi n zokwo shi aza je zhin oɓa ɓi fi n zokwo nyi .
zaho-zahoi ta mi wa shi n waɓi to wa dna wo zokwo m .
yi zhin wa ɓi nu , ntu cenu woi ga yi tata .
dole ata aɓi , oɓa dada ɓa zhin ba fi n zokwo .
amma n shekwoyi to ga ho tata m , ho to zhin wo nya nu m .
yi zhin ya ga ya dada mwa-mwa .
yi ta nya ɓa ɓo m , ɓai ya ga yi tatam .
ntu cenu yi gwo shekwoyi tata n na gmadayi .
shekwoyi ye yi n du eya dada anyi nya .
wa ga yi tata ntu ge wo ye yi lo .
eya dada anyi nya dna yi zokwo aye fyewyi nu kawai .
amma shekwoyi zokwo dna , gaiciya nu n saho-sahoi .
wo ye ya gwo wo gyi-gyi , wo ta zhin wye m .
a tada oza sanu na ta won , sai dai ko la duya .
kwo zhin ha fa a zokwo nukwoyi ya vi zokwo do na gmada yi ɓedo lafiya yi .
laka la kwo da shike a laho ɓe , ha bwa kala njesun .
zhin ha pita zokwo manayi .
aza tna kala na nyasan yi n ɓa vi kwo ɓa ta miya ɓa wu ɓahin m .
amma ɓaɓa ku ze akala da dna n gaiciya ga .
to je zaho-zahoi m , ha zan-zan gyi-gyi-yi cici , ntu ge aza n ɓa to gyi-gyi-yi m , ɓa ta gye shekwoyi wye m .
fye dna je wye n fye ɓa bwa shekwoyi anabarka n fye to ye ge nuwun kwo lo fye a tasun .
ko zhin kwa ɓe n wahala yi , kwa to aza wye-wyeyi bwa .
to fya zhin anagbayi m , to fya shi shekwoyi lafya-lafya , n gye isuwa m .
wo ɓei kun wo gado ntu mikun ɓo .
kwo ɓei zhin ɓo gboloyi nu n wa ba .
sanu awye ɓei kna wo ya , sai la duya , ko da shike wo ɓo ci bwi ntu wo laifi ɓo , ama duk gboloyi nu .
ato ɓei je woyem .
shekwoyi begyi ho to shin wahala sun n gye a israila nya m .
ɓa ɓei ku lo ena , ɓa ku lo wyegma , ɓa ku lo ogma nukwoyi , aɓo deye ɓa ɓei gye ɓa n sinai pe nu har ɓai wo edna njesun , shekwoyi ɓei ga ɓa owo awyidna n ya nu .
n wyihi , ɓa wo ai bye a kna-knaci , ɓa wo shekwoyi begye n gye ogma har kwoi shan ekni ashan .
har ɓa gna shekwoyi ge wo la fa ɓeda ɓo , ntu dna ɓo kurum .
ɓa to mi ɓa mizhi m , ntu nwa awyidna ɓo .
gama nyakpa doho-dohoi n kwo ɓei to epei , kwo ɓei la fi .
kwo ɓei zhin oɓo dnawo nya nu , musa nwohin wo ɓei ku dna wo , wa gna ge , mi vin lo mi-i wo dna . amma fye ku ɓe sihiyona pe , kwo nu zhin urushelima eshe nya .
fye ku ɓe amalaika yezhi ba , agmada ʼba .
fyehin kwa wato zaho-zaho n wo eye katu lo n shemi , fye ɓe shekwoyi-wada yi aba , fye ɓe azafun aza gni-gni yi nya aba .
ɓa lo n ʼshe , ɓa ku ze n nu-nuyi .
fye ku ɓe yesu aba n wo zhin yi viye yei n alkawali woi-woi aba nyi .
fye ku ɓe yesu ami aba n ɓa zhin za gafara nyi .
owo ami du habila nya lo .
habila ami ɓei zhin nya nu n na ɓa gbata .
kna wo ɓeda tnubua n wo daɓo n hoi nyi .
abei ga a israila yi tata ntu ge ɓa ɓei zun shekwoyi ɓeda gna-na n musa ʼgbe , oza n wo zun wo ɓeda gna-na n yesu gbe wo ɓa gna fifi nu .
shekwoyi begye nu kawai ɓei zhin anyi ɓa shan-shan , sanu wo ɓei da ɓo tu n sinai pe nyi .
sanu wa je ɓo da duk ɓedo n ʼshe yi kwo ɓei shan-shan .
shekwoyi ɓei shi nya ya nkwo to na gbegye yi lon , anya n ɓa mi zhi lo ɓa nu ɓei ce zhi kawai .
shi yi nbegyi lo , n zaho ta mi nkwo gwoya nyin , yi zhin ɓo nkwo ɓa da shekwoyi , yi zhin wo bauta , nbugba godiya nya yi , yi ga wo mwa-mwa ndanwoyi .
ntu ge eyi shekwoyi zhin ona nu , nkwo gyi aba nyi .
she azalo n mwa ɓai shi ya , wye nyi , yi ku akaya shanwoyi ya , yi ku a laifi fa nɓa shi yi nyi to ɓai ye ge ya gyi abye nyin .
n nabai ya zan-zan dna n gaiciya n hakuri yi n shekwoyi la shi n ya bye nyi .
yi shi yesu nu awye , wo nu zhin yi gnabye .
vinyikwo to ɓei wo wo wa fi ntu ya laifi ɓon .
wo ɓei kpe ge kwo ɓa ɓe wo n mwa-mwai .
nsaiye kuwa wo tu lo n naba duduyi n kunsun n shekwoyi n ʼshemi .
aza nukwoyi ɓei ga yesu wahala , ama wa zhin hakuri .
yi dna wo wahala wye wa ze eyi gnabye .
deye ɓa bma yi zhin ya bwa kala .
kwo dama yi to shi gusun n laifi yi kwo n jarabai har yi la amisa kpe ɓedo n ami yin .
hola shekwoyi ɓeda zamwi nu ?
wo ɓei gna ge , omi nugun to gyi minagyi ʼsa shekwoyi wa gaho tata .
to bma bugba ya esa n wa wuho oho doknunu gbi m .
shekwoyi zhin wa dna owo aɓi zokwo wa ga ɓa tata .
sanu wo ga yi tata , kwo wu gye yi zhin wa nya nu . shekwoyi zhin yi-fi n zokwo shi aza je zhin oɓa ɓi fi n zokwo nyi .
zaho-zahoi ta mi wa shi n waɓi to wa dna wo zokwo m .
yi zhin wa ɓi nu , ntu cenu woi ga yi tata .
dole ata aɓi , oɓa dada ɓa zhin ba fi n zokwo .
amma n shekwoyi to ga ho tata m , ho to zhin wo nya nu m .
yi zhin ya ga ya dada mwa-mwa .
yi ta nya ɓa ɓo m , ɓai ya ga yi tatam .
ntu cenu yi gwo shekwoyi tata n na gmadayi .
shekwoyi ye yi n du eya dada anyi nya .
wa ga yi tata ntu ge wo ye yi lo .
eya dada anyi nya dna yi zokwo aye fyewyi nu kawai .
amma shekwoyi zokwo dna , gaiciya nu n saho-sahoi .
wo ye ya gwo wo gyi-gyi , wo ta zhin wye m .
a tada oza sanu na ta won , sai dai ko la duya .
kwo zhin ha fa a zokwo nukwoyi ya vi zokwo do na gmada yi ɓedo lafiya yi .
laka la kwo da shike a laho ɓe , ha bwa kala njesun .
zhin ha pita zokwo manayi .
aza tna kala na nyasan yi n ɓa vi kwo ɓa ta miya ɓa wu ɓahin m .
amma ɓaɓa ku ze akala da dna n gaiciya ga .
to je zaho-zahoi m , ha zan-zan gyi-gyi-yi cici , ntu ge aza n ɓa to gyi-gyi-yi m , ɓa ta gye shekwoyi wye m .
fye dna je wye n fye ɓa bwa shekwoyi anabarka n fye to ye ge nuwun kwo lo fye a tasun .
ko zhin kwa ɓe n wahala yi , kwa to aza wye-wyeyi bwa .
to fya zhin anagbayi m , to fya shi shekwoyi lafya-lafya , n gye isuwa m .
wo ɓei kun wo gado ntu mikun ɓo .
kwo ɓei zhin ɓo gboloyi nu n wa ba .
sanu awye ɓei kna wo ya , sai la duya , ko da shike wo ɓo ci bwi ntu wo laifi ɓo , ama duk gboloyi nu .
ato ɓei je woyem .

ntu ge eyi shekwoyi zhin ona nu , nkwo gyi aba nyi .
zokwadna n gnaɓi-i yi ye najeyi ntu ge yi zhin gmanyi-gmanyi nu .
yi ye na zhiɓeiyi aza ho ɓei ku zhin lo nu na malaikayi amma ɓa to ɓei kpe m .
pa za ɓo nɓa fi n kurkuku nyi , gye she a ga aza wahala .
sun wahala n kun-sun ɓai .
sun wahala yi n gye kwo zhin ho nya nu .
fye la mula ɓo shi dei-dei .
kada a zhin fye agma fya wunya .
n fya wunya shekwoyi ɓei dafye wa .
fye to ku ze agyiwye ye yi m .
zhin godiya n nya yi n ho cei lo .
shekwoyi ɓei gna ge wo ta ya yi m .
mi kun-sun lo n fyei nyalo-nyalo .
nɓa ga fye nyagyi cici .
ntu na alkawali ye ɓo yi ɓa da ɓo ntna edna , shekwoyi nu zhin mi bmazhin yi mi ta wo oza dna m . to fya ze ofye azakowyi amwi dna n yesu ye m , ɓa ɓei kpema shekwoyi ɓa zan-zan n dna woyi .
fye vi ɓa pita bwi .
yesu ta shan do n , nya wo ɓei nyi n su nyi , wo zhin kwo nu n naiye kuma har nyalo-nyalo .
shi shekwoyi ta shan do nyin , to ye a malami doho-doho ɓa dna fye kwoce n nyawu nukwoyi m .
fa shekwoyi alheri kwa ga fye kala .
to ge anyagyi ho pya awyidna ko kwa zhibaje m , ɓa zhin banza nu-nnaza ba nɓa gyi ɓa nyi .
eyi nyagyi gyi zafun nya kwo zhin zundu nu oza n wo dna awyidna kwo-kwoyi sunta wo to deye anabarka yi lo m .
a yahudiyi ɓei zhin apma n na nyakpa yi nu ntu sadaka ɓo , ɓa ɓei zhin ɓa wu nyap-kpa ɓa lo ɓa gyi kona n zhimi avun .
a mi da ɓa ɓe n cei n shekwoyi nyakun .
deye ɓei zhin sadaka ntu alaifi ɓo nu .
cenu ɓei zhin a wu yesu n pifun , wa ga sadaka owo nyai nya ntu yi a laifi ɓo .
yi shegun yesu n zhimi avun .
wato to ge nanyi ye mi m .
yi sun wahala ɓedo n vinyikwo yi n kun-sun woi .
anyi ye to zhin yi nya nun , yi pmi eya ʼpa , nyalo-nyalo nya nu , wato eshe .
yi ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa , kwo nu zhin yi sadaka ga .
yi zhin dna n yesu ye .
yi gna azaje owo eye mwa-mwa ɓo , yi ci wo .
to ze ɓemana zhin amwi m , zhin aɓo manayi .
ce nya ga aza n ɓa to cei lon .
nyaga nu shekwoyi ye n cei .
ga aza mwa-mwa n ɓa du ho , nwyihoi ɓa ɓei wu shekwoyi oɓa tnu-tnu .
ndei fya ga ɓa mwa-mwa tnu-tnu ɓa da ɓa zhin .
ko ɓa bma fyehin zhin ce .
fye zhin aduwa ntu yi ɓo , yi ye ya zhin tnu-tnu ɓehinhin nya nu n ɓefyece yi .
ntu cenu fye zhin aduwa ntu mi ɓo , ko n naiye ma fye ya zhin , mi cei pma ma ɓe fya ba sa fyewyi .
shekwoyi wo tu fye anabarka , wonu ɓei la yesu ka .
yesu kwa wo nu zhin knikna yi , wotu fye anabarka ntu owo ami zeya ɓo , dna n na alkawali woi-woyi .
shekwoyi wo gba fya bukata ntu ge fya zhin wo ɓeye .
wo zhin ɓo n yi-i , nwo cei pma , wo zhin ntu yesu ɓo .
a ga yesu mwa-mwa nyalo-nyalo .
omi-azaje , kna tnubua n ɓo mi ku da dna n wasika ye mi .
ala timatawus loya n kurkuku , yi ɓa kun ɓe n woi .

fye ɓi fya atukwo da gna ga mi , a yesu viyi dna nu italiya , ɓa ɓi fye gna lo .

azhingye mi alu omi azaje ye-yeyi , fye sin wahala lo , fyei gye azhin ?
fye dagma .
ntu ge esa wahala nyi , efye bugba-bwa zhin kwa mwa .
fa efye bugba bwa kwa mwa har fya ze aza hin-hin , nfye ta gyi nyaho san .
nfye n cei pma fya kpe enya n shekwoyi ye fya zhin , fye nya wo , wo ɓa wu fye n ɓugbai gmanyi , gama wo n shiri yi zhin lo wa ga oza ɓeyekpe n bugbai gmanyi , oza nwa nya wo , wo ta na ɓon .
ama n ha nya wo , la awyetu n ge woɓa gaho , gama bugba shaka zhinyi wu ngye anuwan dokwo nu n ese zhin kwa cekwo abwaya nyi .
shaula doho-dohoi nha zhin , hoi to n bugbai shi lo pin , shi ho pmi lo bwaye ha pmilo bwaye .
nhoto nya n gaiciya gayin , to gye ge dagayi ɓaga ho amsan .
yesu-viyi nwo to zhin nyaho nu dna n na nyin , a dawo , gama wo zhin nyaho nu n dagayi abye .
ama nyabwayi dagma n tuge owo nyabwa to zhin nyaho nu n dagayi aban , gama esa fyewyi wo ɓa duya ngye mamawyi n kwo bmiya-bmiya la duya kwoi la bwa , kwo la fi ntu n nyipyei wo-wo ɓo .
anyabwai wulo , nu safyewyi ɓa ɓa fi ɓa fa ɓa nyabwa n ɓa avun .
bugba bui-da nu oza n wo wan wohin shi , to wa kaya dna n jaraban , gama n na avun wo ɓa bwa rawani wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya , n dagayi a zhin aza alkawali nɓa ye wo nyi .
pa esa n oza ye wa zhin ɓenukwoyi , shekwoyi nu ta zhin wo jaraban , gama shekwoyi ta zhin ɓenukwoyin , woi ta zhin aza jaraba n ɓenukwoyin .
jaraba kun n oza bugba nu , oza n wo n shakpei fi n wo mi .
aɓonubo-zhin nukwoyi ye zhin oza wa zhin aɓo nukwoyi , n na avun kwa zhin oza wa gwo tata efi nya n shekwoyi aba .
ntucenu fye to bwi zokwon , emi azaje .
bemana gmi n shekwoyi a ba nu ama enya manayi doho-dohoyi nkwo bmiya kwo gmi n shekwoyi aba nu , owo na zhin buzangna , woi bmiyana nyalo-nyalo , n tna jejelu kwo kuwa wyegma .
njesun nyipyei a gmadanya nu n wo aba ewyi n wo ɓei gayi awye-wyeyi woi-woi n cei nyi , ntu gaiciya owo ɓeda nya ɓo , ya ku ze , aɓo kmisunyi , owo puwa woi-woi nya .
omi azaje ye-yeyi fye to ze amwi ge , kwo gna bmiya oza kna ɓeda tnubuan n mwa , ama oza daɓo cewyi , to oza gyi minagyin .
gama minagyi ta zhin yi ya ze aza manayin , shi shekwoyi ye ya zen .
ntu cenu fye la anya nukwoyi kunya nfye awye-wyeyi nɓa to bmiyan , n na ɓo yi n ɓa she fye kna , fya gba fyehin tukwo fya dagma shi fye la nabari manayi woi-woi gwo , gama kwo ɓami kwa gni yi awyewyeyi , ngye shi kwo shi yi abugba bwa nyi .
fye pa ge ɓeda nu n oza ɓa zhinkwo , to ge oza knatun-bua kawai n , ntu cenu fye to dna fyehin kwocen .
gama n oza wo , to wa zhin , wo wu ngye ozanu n wo shi wohin awye n maganyi .
shi wo la kala wo ta shan wohin awyeshi wa shan pa ngye shi wo wun .
ama n oza shi wohin awye biwu n shekwoyi owa , nkwo zai lo-lo yi ya nyi , wo ta pa kwo ɓonu gmanyin , ama wo ɓa zhin oɓo n kwa da .
shekwoyi ɓa tu wo anabarka dna n ɓeho-ɓehoyi n wo ɓa zhin .
oza nwa ci ge wo zhin yesu-viyi nu , to wa wan wo nyitala shi nkwo gyi-gyi-yi ngye ebe nyin , wo dna wohin kwoce nu , owo knunnu zhin gbeloyi nu .
yesu-viyi nwo gyi-gyi-yi ntna aɓe nya n shekwoyi dada awyeba , ozanu n wo shi a kuwyi bwa , n na anyigbayi , n zayi n wo kpema dagayi n gaiciya yi , to wun-wun yi ya , kwo n tucegye n na anyi nya yin .
wasika ye gmi n yakubu akun nu , shekwoyi bara n dagayi yesu kristi nya yi .
kwoi lo a yahudiyi a yesu-viyi aba , n ɓa busi yafi laɓa nyi , mi tnu fye lo n gnaɓiyi .

nhoto nya n gaiciya gayin , to gye ge dagayi ɓaga ho amsan .
yesu-viyi nwo to zhin nyaho nu dna n na nyin , a dawo , gama wo zhin nyaho nu n dagayi abye .
ama nyabwayi dagma n tuge owo nyabwa to zhin nyaho nu n dagayi aban , gama esa fyewyi wo ɓa duya ngye mamawyi n kwo bmiya-bmiya la duya kwoi la bwa , kwo la fi ntu n nyipyei wo-wo ɓo .
anyabwai wulo , nu safyewyi ɓa ɓa fi ɓa fa ɓa nyabwa n ɓa avun .
bugba bui-da nu oza n wo wan wohin shi , to wa kaya dna n jaraban , gama n na avun wo ɓa bwa rawani wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya , n dagayi a zhin aza alkawali nɓa ye wo nyi .
pa esa n oza ye wa zhin ɓenukwoyi , shekwoyi nu ta zhin wo jaraban , gama shekwoyi ta zhin ɓenukwoyin , woi ta zhin aza jaraba n ɓenukwoyin .
jaraba kun n oza bugba nu , oza n wo n shakpei fi n wo mi .
aɓonubo-zhin nukwoyi ye zhin oza wa zhin aɓo nukwoyi , n na avun kwa zhin oza wa gwo tata efi nya n shekwoyi aba .
ntucenu fye to bwi zokwon , emi azaje .
ama enya manayi doho-dohoyi nkwo bmiya kwo gmi n shekwoyi aba nu , owo na zhin buzangna , woi bmiyana nyalo-nyalo , n tna jejelu kwo kuwa wyegma .
njesun nyipyei a gmadanya nu n wo aba ewyi n wo ɓei gayi awye-wyeyi woi-woi n cei nyi , ntu gaiciya owo ɓeda nya ɓo , ya ku ze , aɓo kmisunyi , owo puwa woi-woi nya .
omi azaje ye-yeyi fye to ze amwi ge , kwo gna bmiya oza kna ɓeda tnubuan n mwa , ama oza daɓo cewyi , to oza gyi minagyin .
gama minagyi ta zhin yi ya ze aza manayin , shi shekwoyi ye ya zen .
ntu cenu fye la anya nukwoyi kunya nfye awye-wyeyi nɓa to bmiyan , n na ɓo yi n ɓa she fye kna , fya gba fyehin tukwo fya dagma shi fye la nabari manayi woi-woi gwo , gama kwo ɓami kwa gni yi awyewyeyi , ngye shi kwo shi yi abugba bwa nyi .
fye pa ge ɓeda nu n oza ɓa zhinkwo , to ge oza knatun-bua kawai n , ntu cenu fye to dna fyehin kwocen .
gama n oza wo , to wa zhin , wo wu ngye ozanu n wo shi wohin awye n maganyi .
shi wo la kala wo ta shan wohin awyeshi wa shan pa ngye shi wo wun .
ama n oza shi wohin awye biwu n shekwoyi owa , nkwo zai lo-lo yi ya nyi , wo ta pa kwo ɓonu gmanyin , ama wo ɓa zhin oɓo n kwa da .
shekwoyi ɓa tu wo anabarka dna n ɓeho-ɓehoyi n wo ɓa zhin .
oza nwa ci ge wo zhin yesu-viyi nu , to wa wan wo nyitala shi nkwo gyi-gyi-yi ngye ebe nyin , wo dna wohin kwoce nu , owo knunnu zhin gbeloyi nu .
yesu-viyi nwo gyi-gyi-yi ntna aɓe nya n shekwoyi dada awyeba , ozanu n wo shi a kuwyi bwa , n na anyigbayi , n zayi n wo kpema dagayi n gaiciya yi , to wun-wun yi ya , kwo n tucegye n na anyi nya yin .
to kni aza awyem omi aza ye-yeyi fye ɓa gna n wuna nu ge fye zhin dagayi yesu kristi nya nu , dagayi latu nya , fye gna ye n na anyabwayi nu fyei zhin awyekwoyi nukwoyia ?
n oza loɓe efye aduwa nyakun , n na aje nakwoyi kpe , n zinariya abwanyayifi , njesun ozado wa loɓe n wo naje sakunyi kpe .
fya gnaye n nyabwayi nu , fya ga wo aseseba manayi fya gna wyekwoyi ge , la gni n bwai kwo ha sase . to , fye ye n zayi n tu n wo nyabwa ɓo kwa wanu ge fye kni aza kni-kni le nu .
fye wo , emi azaje , shekwoyi nla awyekwoyi kni ɓa ze anyabwayi dna n gaiciya ga , eshebemi zhin ɓa nya nu , gama cauta nu n shekwoyi zhin aza alkawali nɓa ye wo .
ama dna n na aza ngun abahi fye la wyekwoyi ci wyegba , fyei dnawo vinyikwo .
fye ta palo ge anyabwayi nu lo n fyei n na awada ban , ai gyi fye tara ai gu fye fi n wyegma nyakun .
nsai mwa begye oɓanu ma yesu kristi esan .
oza n na yi fye n woye manayi nyi .
e , ɓehin-hin , kwo bmiya fya shi dagayi wyidna bwa , tilas ha ye nho kunzhinyi ha bmawo zhin shi ho ye hohin tukwo . ama fye ta shi dagayi owa ye bwa lon , nfya gnaye n na anyabwayi fya laɓatu , kwo zhin ɓenukwoyi nu .
oza n wa shi awyidna bwa vinya wa fa gmanyi wo n iaifiyi lo ngye oza nwo to shiɓa bwan vinya .
gama shekwoyi n wa ci ge hota la nyikwo n wo eɓayilon , wo na ci ge hota wu zan , ntucenu kwo ho to zun mula owa gnanan ha zhin anagbayin , ama ho la oza wu , ho la shekwoyi owa zungna-na vinya , hola ze owa gnazunyi , laifida nu nwa bye .
aɓei da fye owa , kwo fya zhin kwo to fya zhin oɓo n kristi yen .
ntucenu fye zhin peceye n nyayi n ifye zhin n nyayi n fye da .
gama ato ɓei gye aza sun-sun n ɓa to gye aza sun-sun .
ama nha gye oza sun-sun shekwoyi ɓei gye ho sun-sun esa n wo ɓei da ho wa cei .
gaiciyaga nna tnu-tnu-yi emi azaje ye-yeyi , mi gye kwo apma , nfye cige fye n gaiciya gailo , fyei zhin a yesu-viyi nu , ama to fyei bma azaje zhin .
gaiciya-ga yi pya ɓa gni oza ?
ndei ho nugundo yilo n wo to n nyagyi yi lo na jekpeyin .
ha gna wo ge , to , lohonya shekwoyi tu ho anabarka , ha bwa jekpe , ha gyi nyagyi n bugbai gmanyi , to ha gawo ajekpe kwo nyagyin , mi gye kwo ampanyi ?
ntucenu fye gye , gaiciyaga to kunlo n kwo gmanyin , tilas ha zhin bemana ha wu ge ho n gaiciya gailo .
gaiciya ga n kwo to wu kwohin n na tnu-tnu manayin , kwo to zhin gaiciya ga nun , kwo zhin gbeloyi nu , fi-fiyi njesun .
ama zaho ɓa naɓo ge fye gna , zokwo n kwo lo shekwoyi aba gaiciya ga nu gmanyi , to ma cige atnu-tnu n na pmailo n mwa , gama n tna atnu-tnu manayi , ho takpe kwo ho n gaiciya gai lo , kwo ho to n cei lon .
ama zaho-zahoi ɓakpe ge mi n gaiciya gai lo ngye shi mi zhin aɓo n wu . aza lo n fyemi n ɓa ye n cei shilo ge gaiciya ga gmanyi nu kun lo ?
gaiciya ga n shekwoyi gmanyi , to , pa ge aljanu ga gaiciya lo nu ce , n kalayi , har ɓei vin n dnayi .
azacije , fye ɓei tumwi n kniwyiyi nu ge , gaiciya ga to n na pmayi lo ntna aɓe zhin n shekwoyi yen ma ?
gaiciya ga n kwo ta wu kwohin n na tnu-tnu manayin kwo to zhin gaiciya ga nun .
fye to ye palo ge kwo ibrahim eyi dada aɓei yiwo oza manayi ntu n wa tnu-tnu manayi ɓo nu n wo ɓei zhin nyin , n wo ɓei ye wa zhin shekwoyi ɓeye , har wa ga owo nugun ishaku ɓigba gmanyi , wa fi tu n bagadi n ?
ho ku gye , wo ɓei kpema shekwoyi , n mwa har woi cei pma wa zhin oɓo n shekwoyi wa gna wo ge wo zhin , owo gaiciya ga ɓei nunuyi ntu n wo atnu-tnu manayi ɓo n wo ɓei zhin n yi ntucenu kwo ɓei zhin shi shekwoyi ɓeda da n ge ibrahim ɓei kpema shekwoyi .
dagayi wa yiwo oza manayi n shekwoyi abye , har ayiwo nge , shekwoyi nugundo . ntucenu ho ku gye , agni oza ntu n nya bo nu n wa zhin , n nyayi n wo ga gaiciya .
rahab karuwa zhin misali deye nya nu .
aɓei gniwo ntu nyaɓonu n wo ɓei zhinyi , oza n wo ɓei so atnutnuyi fi , wa tnu n ɓai n zokwo do gbo .
shi nayi n kwo to n zafun yi n zhin fi-fiyi nu nyi , elonu gaiciya ga n kwo to n na atnu-tnu manayin , zhin fi-fiyi nu .
omi aza ye-yeyi fye ɓa gna n wuna nu ge fye zhin dagayi yesu kristi nya nu , dagayi latu nya , fye gna ye n na anyabwayi nu fyei zhin awyekwoyi nukwoyia ?

nʼza mi wa wan wo nyitala , kwo wunu wo ɓa mi wa wan wo nayi shi vinya , n zokwo doho-dohoyi .
yi ɓami ya pmi doko awye , shiyi ncei pma ntu na luzami ɓo n yi dna n kwo gbe nyi .
eya busi nawyi kwo zhin kwa pmi eya awye lo , aba vinya n eyada n cei pma kwo lo , kwo esayi dnakala .
nlonu nyitla zhin enya ɓiyinu , ama kwo wun anya ya n mwa , nakna ɓiyi zhin kwa kuci yakwo dnana .
nyitala zhin ena gwo-gwoi nu .

aza ɓami ɓa kpa , kwo ɓa wu anyafanya n na luyi n na awyisala yi .
ama zanyikwoci ho to lon n wo ɓa mi wa wu nyitalan , kwo n shiri yi zhin kwa da ɓeda kasa .
nsahoi kwa ci eyi dada n wo dna n ʼshe nyi , nsahoi kwa tu aza kni nna zhin ɓa dna n shekwoyi dogbe nyi .
nlonu ɓeda nukwoyi n anabarkayi ɓai kun ngbe gmanyi .
omi azaje ye-yei kwo to bmiya lo lonun .
nuwan manayi n nuwan nukwoyi , zhin kwapi n obwo gmanyi ?
ho ɓa ka zaitun n gbayi shinwan ?
awo , ho ta bwa nuwan manayi n snakpegye nuwan .
ngye hoce-ceyi lo , zan-zan cewo n bmiya ntuge ɓe manayi zhin , n hohin tukwo-gbayi nu ɓa zhin akpe ge ho ce-cei lo .
dna n zokwo doho-dohoi to gna ge ho cei-cei lon , ndei ho gyi minagyi lo , hoi woshe , hoi ye hohin tukwom , deye kwo zhin akata nu .
gama shewo n hohin tukwoye yi , ɓa to zhin shekwoyi ce-ce pya nun .
aɓeye pya zhin anyi nyanu n tna zafun , shetan nu ce aɓeye pya bwa .
gama aba n shewo nyi , n tukwoye yi , aɓa bwa ɓenukwoyi doho-dohoi n ɓo .
ama wyemwa n kwo gmi n ʼshe , kwo gyi-gyi-yi , n nasuwayi , kwo ye bugba fu n ɓemanazhin yi , kwo ye n na aza tayi , kwo ga kwohin n na aza ba , kwo nunuyi n sun-sun-gyeyi , n na ɓemana-zhinyi , kwo n bugbayi gmanyi , n lo cewo n tna kata .
aza n ɓa ga bugba-fu , ɓa ɓa bye nyabye bugbafu nya , ɓa do ɓemana .

aza n ɓa ga bugba-fu , ɓa ɓa bye nyabye bugbafu nya , ɓa do ɓemana .
a kni donu ɓe fye n na anyawuyi n guyia ?
aɓo pwawo n na shakpe nukwoyi nu n ɓa fi fyemi ɓai sunkun n fyei nyi ?
fye ye nya n fye to n cei lon , ntu cenu fyei wu aza ntuge fya bwa .
fyei wo anya she nʼza cei lo , to fyei bwan , ntuce fya iya anya n guyi ntuge fya gwo ɓa kwo , duk dalili n kwo zhin fyei to n nyayilo n fye ye nyin ntuge fye ta nya shekwoyi ɓon .
kwo n fya nya fye ta bwan , ntuge fye nya n na bugba nukwoyi nu , fye ye nya nu n kwo ɓa ga fye agmada n fye nayi .
fye wu ngye nyikwoza nu nwo to gaiciya yi nwo ɓa aban , woi ye nwo ɓa anuwuyi .
fye ta kpe lo ge nfya gyi nugundo n anyi yi , kwo ɓa zhin fye fya ze shekwoyi anubayi n ?
ma gna fye ndei fye ye anyig-mada lo , fye ta mi fya zhin shekwoyi anugundon sai owo anuwuyi .
kwo fye gye ge litafi a gna ge na na , esa n kwa ci ncei ge zafun gyi-gyi-yi , n shekwoyi wa dna wo n yi mi nyi , wo dna yi wye n shewo manayiʼa ?
ama wo gayi kala ci-ci n na bai ya gyi nasara , n na ɓo pwawo nukwoyi yi , shi littafi a da , shekwoyi ga za nu kala n wo gba wohin tukwo , ama wo gyi minagyi n ʼzayi n wo zhin aɓokwo , woi gma .
ntucenu fye ga fyehin n shekwoyi a kun ntna tukwo mwa .
esa n ha ɓe viwyi n shekwoyi , shekwoyi ɓa wo viwyi n hoi .
fye la abwana nfye a laifi , fya fa shekwoyi wa nu fye abugba , wa ze ɓa agyi-gyi-yi , agaiciya da n wo aba .
fye ci bwi ntu na ɓonukwoyi ɓo n fye ku zhin , fye wun bugba , fya wunwye , fye wun bugba to fya masan , maimakon a gmada , fye zhin bugba zhi-zhiyi .
nnavun , n ha gye ho akalagba n dagayi aba , wo ɓa la hotu , wa gaho kala , wa bma ho zhin .
fye to ci aje wyegba , fya zan aje laifi zanshin , fya da aje ɓon , emi azaje .
nfya zhin lonu , fye sunkun n shekwoyi wayi nu n kwo gna ge , fye ye n na jeyi nyi , fyei gna kwo to bmiya lon , ama , of ye tnu-tnu nu to fya kni , kwo owa ye bmiya lo kwo kwo to bmiya lon , ama fye vi kwo .
oza n wa zhin owaye nyi wonu ɓa mi wa da owa n yi atasin .
owo nu ɓa mi wa kni kwo wa wuyi kwo wo gniyi .
ntu cenu kni ikoyi nu n ho cei lo ha da owa , kwo ha zan za laifi zanshin a ?
fye gye wye , ofye nfye cige , nna ye kwo n su yi ɓei lo ʼzhi deye , kwo ʼzhi dehi ya fi ɓo eye bwugyi , ya ze abwa ya gyi gyiba . ho kpe ɓeye lo n kwo ɓei zhin n su ?
gama oho wye-wyeyi kpamwa wu ngye bwigye nu , hagye kwo nsaiye esa fyewyi kwo la duya .
nya n kwo kunce ha da okwonu nyi , n dagayi wa ye , yiɓa sase ya zhin deye kwo dehi . nto lonu , fye mwa fyehin tukwo nu , tukwo-mwa ye pya ta da shekwoyi n .
fye pa ge , oza nwo kpe ɓemanayi ye to wa zhin kwon , kwo zhin laifi nu nwa ba .
a kni donu ɓe fye n na anyawuyi n guyia ?
aɓo pwawo n na shakpe nukwoyi nu n ɓa fi fyemi ɓai sunkun n fyei nyi ?
fye ye nya n fye to n cei lon , ntu cenu fyei wu aza ntuge fya bwa .
fyei wo anya she nʼza cei lo , to fyei bwan , ntuce fya iya anya n guyi ntuge fya gwo ɓa kwo , duk dalili n kwo zhin fyei to n nyayilo n fye ye nyin ntuge fye ta nya shekwoyi ɓon .
kwo n fya nya fye ta bwan , ntuge fye nya n na bugba nukwoyi nu , fye ye nya nu n kwo ɓa ga fye agmada n fye nayi .
fye wu ngye nyikwoza nu nwo to gaiciya yi nwo ɓa aban , woi ye nwo ɓa anuwuyi .
fye ta kpe lo ge nfya gyi nugundo n anyi yi , kwo ɓa zhin fye fya ze shekwoyi anubayi n ?
ma gna fye ndei fye ye anyig-mada lo , fye ta mi fya zhin shekwoyi anugundon sai owo anuwuyi .
kwo fye gye ge litafi a gna ge na na , esa n kwa ci ncei ge zafun gyi-gyi-yi , n shekwoyi wa dna wo n yi mi nyi , wo dna yi wye n shewo manayiʼa ?
ama wo gayi kala ci-ci n na bai ya gyi nasara , n na ɓo pwawo nukwoyi yi , shi littafi a da , shekwoyi ga za nu kala n wo gba wohin tukwo , ama wo gyi minagyi n ʼzayi n wo zhin aɓokwo , woi gma .
ntucenu fye ga fyehin n shekwoyi a kun ntna tukwo mwa .
esa n ha ɓe viwyi n shekwoyi , shekwoyi ɓa wo viwyi n hoi .
fye la abwana nfye a laifi , fya fa shekwoyi wa nu fye abugba , wa ze ɓa agyi-gyi-yi , agaiciya da n wo aba .
fye ci bwi ntu na ɓonukwoyi ɓo n fye ku zhin , fye wun bugba , fya wunwye , fye wun bugba to fya masan , maimakon a gmada , fye zhin bugba zhi-zhiyi .
nnavun , n ha gye ho akalagba n dagayi aba , wo ɓa la hotu , wa gaho kala , wa bma ho zhin .
fye to ci aje wyegba , fya zan aje laifi zanshin , fya da aje ɓon , emi azaje .
nfya zhin lonu , fye sunkun n shekwoyi wayi nu n kwo gna ge , fye ye n na jeyi nyi , fyei gna kwo to bmiya lon , ama , of ye tnu-tnu nu to fya kni , kwo owa ye bmiya lo kwo kwo to bmiya lon , ama fye vi kwo .
oza n wa zhin owaye nyi wonu ɓa mi wa da owa n yi atasin .
owo nu ɓa mi wa kni kwo wa wuyi kwo wo gniyi .
ntu cenu kni ikoyi nu n ho cei lo ha da owa , kwo ha zan za laifi zanshin a ?
fye gye wye , ofye nfye cige , nna ye kwo n su yi ɓei lo ʼzhi deye , kwo ʼzhi dehi ya fi ɓo eye bwugyi , ya ze abwa ya gyi gyiba . ho kpe ɓeye lo n kwo ɓei zhin n su ?
gama oho wye-wyeyi kpamwa wu ngye bwigye nu , hagye kwo nsaiye esa fyewyi kwo la duya .
nya n kwo kunce ha da okwonu nyi , n dagayi wa ye , yiɓa sase ya zhin deye kwo dehi . nto lonu , fye mwa fyehin tukwo nu , tukwo-mwa ye pya ta da shekwoyi n .
fye pa ge , oza nwo kpe ɓemanayi ye to wa zhin kwon , kwo zhin laifi nu nwa ba .
pmagna ga anyabwayi dnawye , ofye anyabwayi , esa nyi nfye ɓa cibwi fyei do mi , nbugbawun yi ntu n wahala ɓo n kwo ɓelo nfye abye nyi .
ofye nyabwa nkubo ofye aje manayi anya ku gyi , ɓaku ze aje sakun .
ofye zinariya n azurfayi ampanyi nla kniya , kwo zhin efye ɓenukwoyi saida .
kwa gyifye abu ngye na , nyanu n fye ku sozhi fyehin , fya ɓei gwo n wada nyipyei n kwo ɓelo nyi .
fye kna tnubua fya wo atnu-tnuyi bwici , nfye la ɓa gyifi to fyei gba ɓa nyin .
oɓa bwici kusi dagayi azabegye nya atnubua .
fye ku sun fi n na anyi , dna n anyida , fyei fu fyehin bugba , nsaiye efye abugba awye-wyeyi zhin ɓa pmi shazun nyipyeyi nu .
fye ku aɓo manayi-zhin-yi zun kni , fyei ku aza wu n ɓa to n kalayi lo ɓa gni ɓahin n fye akun .
nsaiye n fye aba omi azaje , nfye zhi fyei pmi dagayi jezeɓe nyi , fye zhin hakuri , ngye shi fwai-za zhin wa pmi har mikegye wa do wo ofwa ampanyi nyi .
e , fye zhin hakuri , fya bwa bugba kala gama dagayi la ga ɓe .
fye to da gunnu-gunnu tu n na je tukwon , omi azaje , ho du laifi akpeya lo nu ?
gama gye , owadayi dnagmayi ɓelo , wo la gaɓe , ( fye fa wa wan wyebwo doho-dohoyi n kwo kunce . ) ntu hakuri ɓo dna n wahala , fye shi dagayi anabi wye kwa ze fye ɓesisi .
yi kpelo shi ɓa dagma lo n saiye , ntu ge ɓa bei la kpema wo nsahi yi , kwo dayake ɓa bei ku wahala sin n mwa .
ayuba zhin misalinu oza n wo ɓei kpema dagayi dna n wo azhin-gye , dna n wo wahala , yi ku gye shi dagayi shiri bei zofi n ɓemana , gama wo nu-nuyi n sun-sungye yi .
ama dna aɓo vinya omi azaje , fye to si nyasi n ʼshe yi kwo anyin , bwaci ge e , kwo aʼa nnabai n ho ta zhin laifi a zun ho kni n .
kagna n bmazhin yi zaholo n fyemi woi sin wahala ?
wo zhin aduwa ntuce , aza n ɓa n ɓei lo n ɓa ɓa sa shekwoyi ami ɓa gyi abye ɓai kwo anyi ga dagayi , bai la wo tu .
nyasan san zaho lo ?
wo yi a ikklisiya atukwoda ɓa zhin aduwa gawo , ɓa shin wo emi , ɓai yi dagayi wa kawo gna .
oɓa aduwa nɓa zhin n gaiciya yli ga , ɓa ɓa kawo gna , gama dagayi ɓa ka wo gna , ndei nyasan n kwo sanwo nyi laifi nu na bewo n kwoi , dagayi ɓa zhin wo gafara .
fye zhin aje gafara fyei zhin aduwa ga je , n na bai fya bwa lafiya ɓefyece zhinyi aduwa ɓa zhin ikoyi mwa , kwa ɓe n amsa manayi .
iliya ɓei zhin oza nu n gye yi , ama wa mi wa zhin aduwa nge ogma to zhin , to kwa zhin har eye ngun ata n na pyai kpe ngun tnanyi .
n navun wa je aduwa zhin ge ogma kwo zhi , agbe-gbe ɓa je ya pa , anya ya pa njesun n na fwa .
omi azaje , ndei zaho la bma n shekwoyi zokwo to woi ye kpema dagayin , oza ho wa bma wo zhin wa gye gaiciya .
ozahi n wa jezeɓe n woi n shekwoyi aba nyi , wo la wyewyeyi bwi-bwiyi gni n efi , kwoi ɓe n owo a laifi gafara zhin yi n mwa .
dnawye , ofye anyabwayi , esa nyi nfye ɓa cibwi fyei do mi , nbugbawun yi ntu n wahala ɓo n kwo ɓelo nfye abye nyi .
ofye nyabwa nkubo ofye aje manayi anya ku gyi , ɓaku ze aje sakun .
ofye zinariya n azurfayi ampanyi nla kniya , kwo zhin efye ɓenukwoyi saida .

nyasan san zaho lo ?
wo yi a ikklisiya atukwoda ɓa zhin aduwa gawo , ɓa shin wo emi , ɓai yi dagayi wa kawo gna .

fye zhin aje gafara fyei zhin aduwa ga je , n na bai fya bwa lafiya ɓefyece zhinyi aduwa ɓa zhin ikoyi mwa , kwa ɓe n amsa manayi .
