omi azaje , ndei zaho la bma n shekwoyi zokwo to woi ye kpema dagayin , oza ho wa bma wo zhin wa gye gaiciya .
ozahi n wa jezeɓe n woi n shekwoyi aba nyi , wo la wyewyeyi bwi-bwiyi gni n efi , kwoi ɓe n owo a laifi gafara zhin yi n mwa .
wasika yi gmi n bitrus akun , yesu kristi tnu-tnuyi , kwoi lo a yahudiyi a yesu viyi aba n na nya ɓa ya n urushelima , ɓai gnami fi laɓa n buntus , galatiya , kapadokiya , asiya , n bitniya yi nyi .
oma nugundo , shekwoyi dada ɓei kni fye tunyi n sapa , wa ku pma kpe ge fye ɓa ze owo aɓi , zafun gyi-gyi-yi lo tnu-tnu lo n fya bugba mi woi zhan fye ya n yesu kristi ami yi , woi zhin fye fyei zhin oɓo kwo dawo , alheri n bugba-fuyi ɓa la lakpe nfya ba .
agmada n mwi-mwi yi mwa-mwa vinya shekwoyi nya nu n dadayi , eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya , ntuge owo sun-sungye tnazoyi nu na gayi esa a shan yi ma .
nsaiye yi sase n na awyetu wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi , ntuge kristi ɓei la laka n efi .
shekwoyi n cauta dnagmayi so shi owo aɓi lo n ʼshe ; kwo gyi-gyi-yi lo , kwoi ta shando aigna kwo bom kwoi ta shan zom .
shekwoyi , dna n wo iko yakwo , wo ɓa shi fye bwa fya si ɓo n lafiyai n nabai fya bwa fya si ɓo n lafiyai n nabai fya bwa kwo , ntuge fye kpema wo lo .
kwo ɓei ze ofye nya dna n nyipyei kmaknayi n kwo ɓelo nyi zaho-zahoi wo gye .
ntu cenu a da fye n mwa , a gmada yakwo lo n fya bye , kwoda shike ezan dna ɓo lo n saiye kpa ntu mu-mugye ɓo nɓa ɓe fya ba nyi .
a wahala ye ɓe da fye ntuge , a mwi fye gaiciya ga gye nu , agye kwo kwo n kalayi lo , n gyi-gyi-yi , a mwi kwo gye shi ena zhin kwo mwi zinariya gye nyi kwa zhan kwo ya , ofye gaiciya ga du zinariya lo n latu n shekwoyi aba , ntu cenu n fye gaiciya ga migni n kalayi n kwo mutu , avun , dna n wahala abednai , kwo ɓa ɓe fye n ci-ci yi , n mwa-mwayi , n latuyi ewyi n yesu kristi ɓei jezeɓe nyi .
fye yewo lo , kwo da yake fye to shin wo gyen .
fye ta gye wo lon , ama fye kpma wo lo , kwo nsaiye a da fye lo n na gmadayi n na ta shin kwo ɓedan , efye lada n na bye deye ntu fye gaiciya ga ɓo , okwonu zhin efya wye-wyeyi gni-gni .
gni-gni ye zhin enya nu n na anabi to ɓei n kwo awyega yin , kwo da yake ɓa ɓei ku ka nkwo tukwo , ɓa ɓei n na ɓenya-nyai mwa n kwo awyega tukwo .
ɓa ɓei ye ɓa kpe esa ye n ʼza yi n kristi zafun , nkwo ɓei dna ɓami nyi , ɓai daɓo tu n ɓa tukwo , esa wo ɓei gna ɓa ge ɓaka nya tu n kristi azhingye tukwo n latu yi nkwo ɓa vi azhingye yi nyi .
aku gna ɓa ge aɓeye ta zhin n ɓa wye-wyeyi sa nun , ama nna aye begye avun nu .
nsaiye aku nabari manayi ye wuyi pei-pei , aɓei zhinyi kwo waʼazi dna n iko zafun gyi-gyi-yi nya n wo gmi n ʼshe , n wo ɓei da ɓo n ɓai nyi kwo zhin oɓo wo-woyi nu , oɓo agmada nya njesun , ntuge har amalaika ma ɓa cei pma lo ɓa kpe ɓeye awyega .
ntucenu fye ku fyehin wan shi , fya pmi n na wye tuyi tu n shekwoyi alheri nkwo ɓe fya ba lo , esa n yesu kristi ɓa jezeɓe cei nyi .
fye vi shekwoyi ɓo , ntu ge fye zhin owo aɓi nu , fye to jezelo fya zokwo kwokwoyi ɓenukwoyi zhin nyam , ntuge fye to ɓei zhin fyei kpe ɓemanai ye num .
ama fye ku ze agyi-gyiyi n ɓeho-ɓehoi nfye zhin , ngye shi dagayi zhin gyi-gyi-yi nu n wa yi fye nyi .
a cei kafi lo n littafi ge , fye ku ze a gyi-gyi-yi , ntuge mi gyi-gyi-yi lo . fye pa ge , ofye dada nfye zhin aduwa ga wo dna n ʼshe nyi , wo ta kni za kni-kni , esa n wa da owa cei n .
wo ɓei daho wa cewo n tna gyifi tu n nyaho-nyahoi tukwo n ha zhin , ntucenu zhin ɓeho-ɓehoi n wo dna woi ɓe kafin ho si eshe .
aku ota gba shekwoyi ɓei gba efye shan-shan agyiwye ntuge wa gni fye n zokwo n kwo to ɓei ɓa lo fyei n ʼshen n fye azakwoi ɓei wan nyi , tagba n wo ɓei gbani zinarya nu ton kwo azurfa shi fye shin fye nya kpelo .
ama wo ɓei gba n kristi ami gyi-gyiyi nu , shekwoyi kugya n tna laifi n tna ecigusa .
shekwoyi ɓei kni wo tunyi n sapa to ai zhin anyin , ama n na anyipyei kmaknayi ye kwa ze anabarka n fya ba .
ntu cenu efye gaiciya ga nyi n shekwoyi nu n wo ɓei la kristi kala n efi , wa gawo mwa-mwa n jesun nyi .
nsaiye efye gaiciya ga n na wyetui ɓa bwa kpema n wo nu gmanyi .
nsaiye fye ɓa mi fya ye n na zai n tuge ala fya bugba zhan ya n tukwo ye yi , n nuwun yi , esa n fye ɓei kpema kristi wa gni fye nyi , ntucenu fye ku kpe lalei ge fye ku yelo n jei , n bugbai gmanyi .
ntuge fye n wye-wyeyi woi-woyi lo , fye to ɓei bwakwo n fya zakwoyi nun , ntuge wye-wyeyi n ɓa ɓei ga fye nyi kwo ɓa zo , woi-woyi deye ta shan zon , ntuge kwo gmi n kristi nu shekwoyi ɓeda wye-wyeyi n na za aba .
e , eya wye-wyeyi anyinya ɓa zo , she a gbe-gbe zhin ɓa bmi ɓa wo akawu nyi .
zanyikwoci latu bwa wu ngye ama-mawyi nu n ɓa bwa ɓa kaya nyi .
ama shekwoyi ɓeda ɓa gni-gni har nyalo-nyalo .
owo ɓeda ye nu zhin nabari manayi n na ɓei zhin fye kwo waʼazi nyi .
wasika yi gmi n bitrus akun , yesu kristi tnu-tnuyi , kwoi lo a yahudiyi a yesu viyi aba n na nya ɓa ya n urushelima , ɓai gnami fi laɓa n buntus , galatiya , kapadokiya , asiya , n bitniya yi nyi .

a cei kafi lo n littafi ge , fye ku ze a gyi-gyi-yi , ntuge mi gyi-gyi-yi lo . fye pa ge , ofye dada nfye zhin aduwa ga wo dna n ʼshe nyi , wo ta kni za kni-kni , esa n wa da owa cei n .
wo ɓei daho wa cewo n tna gyifi tu n nyaho-nyahoi tukwo n ha zhin , ntucenu zhin ɓeho-ɓehoi n wo dna woi ɓe kafin ho si eshe .
shekwoyi ɓei gba efye shan-shan agyiwye ntuge wa gni fye n zokwo n kwo to ɓei ɓa lo fyei n ʼshen n fye azakwoi ɓei wan nyi , tagba n wo ɓei gbani zinarya nu ton kwo azurfa shi fye shin fye nya kpelo .
ama wo ɓei gba n kristi ami gyi-gyiyi nu , shekwoyi kugya n tna laifi n tna ecigusa .
shekwoyi ɓei kni wo tunyi n sapa to ai zhin anyin , ama n na anyipyei kmaknayi ye kwa ze anabarka n fya ba .
ntu cenu efye gaiciya ga nyi n shekwoyi nu n wo ɓei la kristi kala n efi , wa gawo mwa-mwa n jesun nyi .
nsaiye efye gaiciya ga n na wyetui ɓa bwa kpema n wo nu gmanyi .
nsaiye fye ɓa mi fya ye n na zai n tuge ala fya bugba zhan ya n tukwo ye yi , n nuwun yi , esa n fye ɓei kpema kristi wa gni fye nyi , ntucenu fye ku kpe lalei ge fye ku yelo n jei , n bugbai gmanyi .
ntuge fye n wye-wyeyi woi-woyi lo , fye to ɓei bwakwo n fya zakwoyi nun , ntuge wye-wyeyi n ɓa ɓei ga fye nyi kwo ɓa zo , woi-woyi deye ta shan zon , ntuge kwo gmi n kristi nu shekwoyi ɓeda wye-wyeyi n na za aba .
e , eya wye-wyeyi anyinya ɓa zo , she a gbe-gbe zhin ɓa bmi ɓa wo akawu nyi .
zanyikwoci latu bwa wu ngye ama-mawyi nu n ɓa bwa ɓa kaya nyi .
ama shekwoyi ɓeda ɓa gni-gni har nyalo-nyalo .
owo ɓeda ye nu zhin nabari manayi n na ɓei zhin fye kwo waʼazi nyi .
shekwoyi aza ntu cenu fye la nuwun gmiya n bugba .
fye to zhin aɓo n gye fye zhin aza manayi n munaficiyi gwo dna n mim , fye ku tna-gaiciya ya , n eshei , n na za ɓedai n ɓa vun .
nsaiye shi fye kpelo shi dagayi ye fye nsunyi , fye ku ɓenukwoyi ya vinya , kwocedna , eshe , n na katai .
fye zhin atna fya mwa fi n fye gnigni , fyei zan madara zafun nya shi n bwi-ci yi , she oɓi zhin wa cibwi woi zan ɓeɓe shin nyi .
fye ɓe kristi aba , owo nu zhin nyakun shishiyi apma nya n shekwoyi mi nya tu nyi .
koda shike aza la wo ciwyegba wo na pmailo n latui njesun n shekwoyi aba n wa kni wo tu naza she nyi .
nsaiye fye ku ze akuta awyewyeyi , shekwoyi wa zhin apma cei wa mi nyakun , kniyi du lo ɓoʼa ?
fye ɓe wa ba , ( ofye n fye ku zhin anya go-go yi nwa ba ntu yesu kristi ɓo nyi , ) fya ga wo anya n ɓa dawo .
shi littafi ada , shawye , mi tnu n kristi yi wa ze kuta kni-kniyi nyakun-bwakonu nya omi ikklisiya nya , mi ta dna aza vinyikwo n ɓa kpema won . e , wo n latu yi lo n fya ba n fye ku gaiciya ga nyi , n na zaba n ɓa la wa ɓo na nyi , to , kuta ho n na a nyakunmiyi la kwa ɓo nanyi , kwo la ze kuta nyakun-bwakonu nya nkwo du n mwa-mwa n na pmai dna nyakun mi nyi . littafi a je ci ge , wo zhin kuta bonyi-ce nya nu n na zaho aba .
apma n kwo ɓei zhin ɓa miya . ɓa ɓei kni a bonyi ntuge ɓata ye ɓa wo shekwoyi ɓeda , kwo ɓa vi wo ɓeyem , ntu cenu tata ye mimiya nya , ɓei vi ɓa .
ama fye to wulo lonun , ntuge shekwoyi la fye kni n wohin yi , fye zhin esu a pirist nu , fye gyi-gyiyi lo n bmiya , fye zhin shekwoyi anyanu , aɓeye vinya ntu ge fya wu aza shi shekwoyi wa yi fye n wyegmaa mi woi lo fye fi n wo buzangna ɓewowoyi nya .
nsapai fye to ɓei zhin nyaho nun , nsaiye fye zhin shekwoyi anya nu , nsapai fye to ɓei kpe shekwoyi alheri ye n mwan , nsaiye okwo nu la fya wye-wyeyi shando .
oma zaje , fye zhin azhiɓeyi nu ya .
shikwonyi ofya yi hin-hin lo n ʼshe mi nu , mi gyi fye wye fya bui anyi dada nukwoyi ye nya si , ɓa to zhin ofye nun , ntuge ɓa sunkun n ʼfya wye-wyeyi .
fye zhin peceiye shi fye sase n fya knuzhiyi n ɓa zhin atnaviyi nyi , ntuge ɓa gye fye ngye aɓo nukwoyi zhin yi , shi ɓa gye fye ɓemana ɓa ɓei ci shekwoyi ntu fya tnu-tnu manayi ɓo esa n kristi ɓa jezeɓe cei .
ntu dagayi ɓo , fye vi gwannati doka doho-dohoyi ɓo kwo esu anya nu ngye ekni tukwoda .
n esu abmazhinyi yi , ntuge wa tnu n ɓai ɓata abenukwoi zhinyi yi nu , ɓa ci aza n ɓa zhi ɓemanai ce .
shekwoyi nufi nu efya sese manayi ɓa kun aza gbe n ɓa ci nabari manayi aɓenya to ɓai kpe oɓoye n kwo ɓa mi kwa zhin ɓa nyim , ntuge ɓa to shin kwo iko towom .
fye ku pwo owa , ama kwo to wu nu ge fye zhin ɓenukwoyim , fye sase n gye aza nɓa ku pwo , ɓa zhin shekwoyi ɓeye nu gmanyi n saho-sahoi yi .
ga zaho-zahoi mwa-mwa , ye n na yesu-viyi yi nbwaho-bwahoi vinya , wo shekwoyi dna , ha ga gwamnati mwa-mwa .
afyenu , fye ga fya dagayi mwamwa fya zhin oɓo ɓa gna fye vinya to ge sai ɓai nsunsun gyei nu kwo ye-yem , ama kwo ɓai zhin aza nukwoyi nu .
fye zhin shekwoyi godiya n na ga fye wahala ntu ɓemanai zhin ɓo .
gaiciya , gyiba to lon , n na ga fye wahala ntu ɓe nukwoyi zhin ɓom , ama n fya zhin ɓemanayi fya sin wahala ntu ce har fya zhin hakuri dna n na zhin-hi mi , kwo zhin kwa da shekwoyi n mwa .
wahala ye pya dna lo n tnu-tnu mi n shekwoyi wa ga fye .
kristi nwo ɓei sin wahala n fye ɓo nyi , wonu zhin fye e-fye , fye vi wa pita ʼbwi .
wo to ɓei zhin laifim , to wa ca katam .
a kni wo akmi , to wa gba akmi tam , esa na ɓei gawo wahala wo to ɓei kun akalam , ama wa wohin fa dna n shekwoyi akun n wo da owa ntna awyekwo nyi .
wonu ɓei la eyi alaifi kaya n wohin nayi , esa n wo ɓei fi tu n zundu nyi , n na bai ya ze afifiyi n laifi aba , ya se ase gyi-gyi-yi nsayi .
ntuge ntu wo aci ɓonu yi-i bwa kagna .
ngye akni fye ɓei ku bwi shekwoyi zokwo , ama nsaiye fye la jezeɓe da fye ʼkniknayi ofye awye-wyeyi guyi n wo gu fye n nanya kasayi nyi .
ntu cenu fye la nuwun gmiya n bugba .
fye to zhin aɓo n gye fye zhin aza manayi n munaficiyi gwo dna n mim , fye ku tna-gaiciya ya , n eshei , n na za ɓedai n ɓa vun .
nsaiye shi fye kpelo shi dagayi ye fye nsunyi , fye ku ɓenukwoyi ya vinya , kwocedna , eshe , n na katai .

ntuge ntu wo aci ɓonu yi-i bwa kagna .
ngye akni fye ɓei ku bwi shekwoyi zokwo , ama nsaiye fye la jezeɓe da fye ʼkniknayi ofye awye-wyeyi guyi n wo gu fye n nanya kasayi nyi .
awyidna ntu puwa agmada ɓo anyikwoza , fye vi fyaɓa ɓo , n nabai kwo to ɓai kna tnubua n dagayi ɓeda nfye gnaɓa nyin , ɓa ye abui ntu fye ɓovi ɓo n hali manayi .
ofye hali manai ɓa gna ɓeda nɓai afa ɓeda n ʼgbeyi .
fye to gye fya huwan n bmiya-bmiya yi n kwo ɓe ntu nyigun zhin ; ɓo , n na kaya nabmiyai anyi nya yin ko aje manayi , kwo tukwokni manayin .
ama fye ku bmiya n mi nfye abugba mi , n bmiya-bmiya yi n kwo mwasa dna n zafun , konu zhin nya manayi n shekwoyi abye .
ntuge anyikwoza agyi-gyiyi sapa-nya , nɓa ɓei na wyetu yi n shekwoyi aba nyi , ɓei zhin ɓahin nyigun lainu ɓa ku ze oɓa ʼɓa ɓeda-viyi .
fye la dogbe n saratu yi .
wo ɓei vi wo ɓa ibrahim ɓo , wo gawo mwa-mwa ntuge wonu ɓei zhin puwa tukwoda , har woi yiwo ge , omi dagayi . fye vi owo fye , fya zhin oɓo manai ngye wo , ntuge efyenu zhin wa nyigun n saiye ; oɓo edna nya ta shan shi nfya byem ( ko misali ge fye ɓa wun ofyaɓa bugba yam . ) ofye aɓa , fye zhin peceiye nfye anyikwoyi fye zhin nubo n ɓa bukatayi , fyei gaɓa mwa-mwa ngye aza nɓa to n kalayin , pa ge oho nho nyikwoyi , fye kun shekwoyi anabarka gwonu , ntu cenu , n ho to zhin wo shikwo kuncen , ata wo fye aduwam .
nsaiye ɓeda ye kwo ɓe fye abanu vinya .
fyeku ze ngye puwa yakwo ɓai dagma , fyei gye aje sun-sun fyei ye najei n bugba manayi n tukwo-gba yi .
fye to gba ɓenukwoi ta n ɓenukwoyi yin .
to gba aza ta n ɓa da ɓeda nukwoi tu n fye tukwon .
ama zhin aduwa shekwoyi wa bmaɓa zhin , ntuge kwo bmiya ya zhin aza alheri , shekwoyi ɓa tuyi anabarka ntu ce .
nho cei pma ha bwa agmada , ha gye anyipyei manai jesun , to laho nyitala wanshi , ha gu ho gbe n na katace .
la bui ɓenukwoi si ha zhin ɓemanai .
zan bugbafu shin kwo hoi ɓa nyakwo na sipitai nu , ha vi ko dei-dei .
ntuge dagayi shiwo aɓi awyelo , woi wo oɓa aduwa njesun .
ama dagayi awyeba gyi minagyi nnaza yi n ɓa zhin ɓenukwoyi .
nshinsun-sun zaho tolo n wo ɓa zhin fye ɓenukwoyi n tu ge fye zhin ɓemanayim .
ama kwo kola ze ge fye ɓa sin wahala ntu befyece zhin ɓo , anabarkada nu fyei .
fye to wo ɓa dnam , to efya bugba kukalam .
la kristi shi nho bugba mi n gyi-gyi-yi ngye dagayi .
n zaha nyaɓo nko zhin hoi kpema wo lonu , ha gni n shiri yi zhin n saho-sahoi yi ha gna wo dna na tna n mwa-mwa gai ɓe .
fye zhin oɓo kwo bmiya , n naza daɓo tu fye tukwo , ɓai yi fye n naye nukwoi yi she fye vi yesu , vinyikwo a woɓa ntu ɓa ɓeda nukwoi ɓo .
pa , n shekwoyi cei pma fya sin wahala , kwo gna bmiya oza sin wahala ntu ɓemanai zhin ɓo , afa wahala sin ntu ɓenukwoi zhin ɓo .
apma azhigye nya kristi ɓei ku wahala sin , wo ɓei fi bwa zungmanyi ntu eyi vinya alaifi ɓo .
koda-yake owo wohin tukwo wo to ɓei n laifiyi kwo gmanyi n , nnabai wa ɓe yi n shekwoyi aba n tna benukwoi .
koda-yake owo nayi ɓolafi , owo zafun ye n wye-wyeyi lo .
dna n zafun ye nu n wo ɓei lo a zafun aba nɓa fi n kurkuku , wa zhin ɓa waʼazi a zafun aza nya nu tunyi dna n nuhu anyipyei , n ɓa to ɓei wo shekwoyi nyin ko da yake wo ɓela pmi ɓa dna bugbabwa esa n nuhu ɓei ji eya nyi .
ama aza ngun nyimwa-nyimwa nu ɓei bwa pwo , to ɓa bwi nuwan yakwo yim .
( nlonu batisma zhin dogbe , dna n batisma , yi wu ge alayi gni n efi n bwi-bwi yi dna n kristi kalala n vingwo ; to ntuge ala nayi cegye shinya n , ama ntuge dna n batisma zhin , yi pmi awye wu shekwoyi nu , yi ɓa wo wa zhan ya bugba ya n laifi . ) nsaiye kristi dnalo n ʼshe , n sase tu n mwa , mwa aba n shekwoyi bwai-zhe-bwa , amalaika , n na iko yi n ʼshe mi ɓa yazhi lo n wa bye ɓai vi wo ɓeda .
anyikwoza , fye vi fyaɓa ɓo , n nabai kwo to ɓai kna tnubua n dagayi ɓeda nfye gnaɓa nyin , ɓa ye abui ntu fye ɓovi ɓo n hali manayi .

koda-yake owo nayi ɓolafi , owo zafun ye n wye-wyeyi lo .

ama aza ngun nyimwa-nyimwa nu ɓei bwa pwo , to ɓa bwi nuwan yakwo yim .
( nlonu batisma zhin dogbe , dna n batisma , yi wu ge alayi gni n efi n bwi-bwi yi dna n kristi kalala n vingwo ; to ntuge ala nayi cegye shinya n , ama ntuge dna n batisma zhin , yi pmi awye wu shekwoyi nu , yi ɓa wo wa zhan ya bugba ya n laifi . ) nsaiye kristi dnalo n ʼshe , n sase tu n mwa , mwa aba n shekwoyi bwai-zhe-bwa , amalaika , n na iko yi n ʼshe mi ɓa yazhi lo n wa bye ɓai vi wo ɓeda .
shikonyi kristi ɓei ku wahala sin wa dna n na zhin gye , fye ku wo bugba pya fi , fya ku zhi n shiriyi fya sin wahala ce .
ntuge fye pa ge , esa n nayi kwa sin wahala laifi kala kwa gba .
fye ta shan asese fyei vi aɓepwawo nayi nyam , ama aɓa wo fye pwa ngye fye zhin shekwoyi ɓeye nu .
aɓo anukwoyi ye ku fye kun , n fye ɓei zhin fyei zhin n sapa , n na a tna shekwoyi yekpei zhin ɓa dagma fi n ɓa nyi , ajesin ajeshin , shakpe , jesin , awye-fan kasa ngye a nyacei shangba , n na ɓenukwoi aje yi .
ai ceɓa wo of ye nugundo kwokwoi , shi fye to ye-yelo fya zhin aɓo nukwoi n gnisun ɓai , shi fye ɓei zhin fyei shin zhin nyim , ntucenu , ɓa ɓa mafye san ɓai kpe fya gye .
ama fye pa ge tilas ɓa zhi n wadayi vinya abye , awye-wyeyi da n na zafi yi , aɓei taɓa ngye shi ɓa sase wu .
ntucenu a zhin azafi nabari manayi waʼazi n nuwan ɓei wan ɓa nyi , ntuge koda-yake aɓei taɓa nayi n efiyi ɓa mi ɓa sase fi nɓa azafun ngye shekwoyi .
yeye pui alaifi anya nmwa .
anyi zo ɓelo esa fyewyi , ntucenu fye lace , fya zhin aduwa nubo cici .
nya kwo du vinya , fye gyi abye fyei wu aje ye-ye dnagmai ntuge yeye zhin kwa pui alaifi nya mwa begye .
fye ye n najei , fyei gaza nyagyi n na gyewanba yi , nɓa filo n ʼsan ntna awyice .
shekwoyi la aɓozhin-zhinyi ga zaho-zahoi n , fyemi , fye zhin apma ɓai , ntu naza bmazhin ɓo , fye ce shekwoyi anabarka ga azaje nwo ga fye nyi .
ala ho yi ha zhin waʼazi ?
to zhin waʼazi ngye shekwoyi nu daɓo nho ʼgbe yi .
ayiho ha bma aza zhin nu ?
zhin kwo n kalayi vinya n shekwoyi wa gaho , n nabai a la shekwoyi tu dna n yesu kristi , mwa-mwa n ikoyi owo nya nu har nyalonyalo .
oma nugundo , ceto wofye fye ya sin wahala napyei n na bye deyen , ntuge oɓo woyi honu toye kwa bwa fyen .
ama ada fye dada nu ntuge awahalaye ɓa ze fye gmanyi n kristi yi dna n wo wahala , n na vun fye ɓei bwa agmada yakwo dna nwo latu n kwo ɓelo nyi .
fye dagma n na kni fye akmi ai tu fye ʼkni she fye vi yesu , ntuge n kwa bwa fye lonu shekwoyi zafun ɓa ɓe fye aba n mwa-mwa yakwoyi .
fye to ye mawo fye wahala sin ɓo ntuge fya wu oza kwo fya wyi ʼvim , kwo ɓenukwoi zhin , kwo ge fye laɓa fyei fi azaɓo abwam .
ama kwo to zhin vinyiko ɓonu oza sin wahala she wo vi yesun , ci shekwoyi she ho zhin yesu nya nu , har ai yi ho n wo ʼye latu nya yi .
ntuge esalasi wada nya , tilas kwa ya n shekwoyi aɓiyi nu .
tunda aɓa da a yesu viyi owa , aza n ɓa to ga dagayi gaiciya nyi ma , a ɓei ka zozo nɓai wuna ?
n na a-ɓe-fyece-zhin-yi a pwo deca , atna shekwoyi-viyi nna ɓenukwoyi zhin yi ma , aɓei papa agye ɓa da ma ?
ntuce nu fye sin wahal a ntu shekwoyi ɓeye zhin ɓo , gyi abye n ɓe-manai-zhin-yi , fya kpema shekwoyi n wa zhin fye nyi , ntuge wota yafyen .
shikonyi kristi ɓei ku wahala sin wa dna n na zhin gye , fye ku wo bugba pya fi , fya ku zhi n shiriyi fya sin wahala ce .
ntuge fye pa ge , esa n nayi kwa sin wahala laifi kala kwa gba .

n na a-ɓe-fyece-zhin-yi a pwo deca , atna shekwoyi-viyi nna ɓenukwoyi zhin yi ma , aɓei papa agye ɓa da ma ?
ntuce nu fye sin wahal a ntu shekwoyi ɓeye zhin ɓo , gyi abye n ɓe-manai-zhin-yi , fya kpema shekwoyi n wa zhin fye nyi , ntuge wota yafyen .
ɓeda ga abyeda nsaiye ofye a eklisiya tukwoda , omi n mihin mi zhin tukwoda nu , n ma wyei mʼɓei ku gye kristi woi fi tu n zundu , n mihin mʼɓei bwa wo mwa-mwa , n wo latu yi esa n wa jeze ɓe cei , oma tukwodaje , emi wyegyi nfya ba ge : fye ga shekwoyi akni nyagyi , fyei shi ɓa bwa n bugbai gmanyi ntna wyice , to tu enya ɓo nfye ɓa bwa dna ko mim , ama ntuge awo fye pwa lo fya zhin dagayi tnu-tnu .
fye toku ze abegyi yin , ama fye ku ze e-fye n nakni ɓa mi ɓa vi .
esa n kniknayi tukwoda ɓei jeze ɓe fye ɓei gwo lowonyi nkwo bmiya-bmiya ta shando nyin .
ofye aɓi kasa , fye vi aza ɓeda n ɓa gyilo nfya bye .
ofye vinya fye zhin aje bauta dna tukwo gba , ntuge shekwoyi tu aza anabarka nɓa gba ɓahin tukwo , ama wo zhin gaba n nazai n ɓa mwa ɓahin tukwo .
nfya gba fyehin tukwo fi n shekwoyi ikoda akun , wo ɓa ku fye wu n sayi nkwo wu dei-dei .
fye ku efya ɓesasa yakpe wo vinya , ntuge wo pa fye ɓelo woi dna fye wye cici .
fye zhin peceiye fya ku zhigu , ntuge shetan , ofye nuwun-yi yakwo , wo zan laɓa ngye gaba mikunyi nu woi boh , woi ye oza n wo ɓa wan wa saya .
lami-gni esa n wo aɓeda ho , lakpe ma dagayi , ha pa ge a yesu viyi-aje n na nyiye vinya ce , sin wahala lo n ho sin nyi .
esa n fya ku wahala sin esa fyewyi , eyi shekwoyi , n wo nu-nuyi n sun-sun gyei dna n kristi nyi , wo ɓa ga fye mwa-mwa nyalo-nyalo nya .
owo n wohin tukwo wo ɓaɓe wo ku fye , wa mi fye zhi , wa ze fye akala-da ndu sapa .
iko zhin wonya nu har nyalo-nyalo .
mi ka fye wasikaye n sivanus bmazhin yinu , n mi wyegye , wo zhin eyi zado gbenu-yi nu .
mi nna wyetu yi lo mi la bugba kala ga fye dna n wasikaye , ntuge mika seida gaiciya nya ga shi shekwoyi tu anabarka wu .
nya ma gna fye dna ya nyi kwo kunce lo kwa bma fye zhin fya mi zhin dna wo ye-ye .
ikklisiya n kolo ya dna n roma kwo zhin fye mapuinu dna n dagayi , kwo tnu fye lo n kwo gnaɓiyi , n markus yi ɓe emi nugun .
fye dna aje bwa-do n na a yesu viyi ye-ye yi .
bugba fu kwo kun-sun nfyei n fye zhin kristi nya nyi .
nsaiye ofye a eklisiya tukwoda , omi n mihin mi zhin tukwoda nu , n ma wyei mʼɓei ku gye kristi woi fi tu n zundu , n mihin mʼɓei bwa wo mwa-mwa , n wo latu yi esa n wa jeze ɓe cei , oma tukwodaje , emi wyegyi nfya ba ge : fye ga shekwoyi akni nyagyi , fyei shi ɓa bwa n bugbai gmanyi ntna wyice , to tu enya ɓo nfye ɓa bwa dna ko mim , ama ntuge awo fye pwa lo fya zhin dagayi tnu-tnu .

fye dna aje bwa-do n na a yesu viyi ye-ye yi .
bugba fu kwo kun-sun nfyei n fye zhin kristi nya nyi .
wasika nkwo gmi n siman bitrus aba , yesu kristi fyenu n tnu-tnuyi .
kwoi lo aza ba vinya n ɓa ku gaiciya ga latu nya bwa eyi-nya pya nyi , dna n ɓefyece eyi shekwoyi , n eyi gniyi yesu kristi nya yi .
fye kpe wo ye ndudu fye ye shekwoyi alheri lo woye ga fye lo abye ?
to , fye tumwi fya kpe woye lo abye-abye .
ntuge n fye kpewoye labye , wo ɓa ga fye , dna nwo iko yakwo , anya vinya n fye ɓa pmai , ntu na sase manai ɓo : har wo zhin wa gayi owo latu n ɓemanai yi .
dna wo iko yakwo , woku anyabwaje gayi n anabarka manai yi nwa zhin yi alkawali nyi .
wato woku alkawali zhin ge woɓa gniyiya n shakpe , n cegyeyi nkwo sheyigun ɓa nyi , wa pmi wa gayi owo ɓefyece .
ama kafin fye gwo anabarka ye , fye n na pmailo n nyai n kwo du gaiciya ga , tilas fya zhin atna fya ze aza manayi ; har ma kwo to zotu lo ɓon , ntuge fye na pmailo fya kpe shekwoyi ye lo abye-abye , fya kpe enya ye n wo cei pma fya zhin .
nnavun fye tumwi fya ga ofye ɓopwawo nnabai fya ze amizhiyi nna shekwoyi zokwo viyi yi , fyei fa shekwoyi wa wu fye zokwo dna na gmada .
deye nu ɓa zhin fya wo azaje agmada , fya yeɓa ce har n shince n ʼkni yj .
nfya gyabye lonu , fye ɓa gna kala bwa-bwa dna zafun har fya ze aza apmada n yi dagayi yesu kristi aba .
ama oza nwo to vi aɓeye n gaiciya ga avun , wo zhin wyebuai nu , kwo wo ta gye wyeba cewon , woi la zamwi ge wa bwa kala wa sase manai ga dagayi .
ntucenu , oma zaje , fye zhin tnu-tnu fya fyehin yi , fya wu ge fye filo n naza n shekwoyi wa yi , woi kni .
nlonu fye ta ce bwonyin , kwo fya miyan .
shekwoyi ɓa gu fye eshe abwokun-mi ya bmam , ntuge fya lo owo ebemi nyalo-nyalo nya eyi dagayi nya , n ʼyi gniyi yi , yesu kristi .
miye ma ce fye ɓepa cici n na ɓeye tukwo , kwo shikwo nyi fye kpeɓa yelo , fyei viɓa lo cewo .
ama dagayi yesu kristi ku wumi ge ema nyipyei n na nyiye , ɓaku ga nu , miɓa fi esa fyewyi sa n mi ye wye-wyeyi lo kpa , miɓa tnu fye na ɓepayei cici , nna wyetui ge ɓa lo fye mi dei-dei n nabai fye-e paɓa ɓo mi yi la-laka n nanyi .
ntuge yi to ɓei zhin yi ta fye aza cece osi nun , esa yi ɓei wufye iko eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya nwo jeze-ɓei nyin .
oma wye ku gye owo mwamwa n wo latu yi .
mʼɓei tu n epe gyi-gyi-yi sanu wo ɓei bmiyana n mwa n shekwoyi owo dada ɓei gawo nyi .
mʼɓei ku wo , begye yakwo , ikoda , latu nya , kwoi gmi n ʼshe kwoi ci ge , omi nugun ye-yei nu nyi .
owo ɓo dami n mwa . ntu cenu yiku gye yi-i ku kpe ge oɓo na anabi ɓei danyi kwo laze gaiciya .
kwo ɓa bma fye zhin , fya ku bugba ga enya ɓa ɓei kanyi , ntuge she buzangna zhin kwa bmiyana fi n na wyegma ba nyi , oɓa ɓeda bmayi zhin yi kpe aɓo ye n ɓa ɓei ɓa dna yi wyegma n dnaɓo .
ama esa nfya dna gaiciya manai a anabi nya wye , buzangna bmiya fi n fya bugba n sayi kristi-kpasu labmi nya-wa bmiya fi fye n fya bugba mi .
ama fye ku kpe ge a anabi ɓeda doho-dohoi to lo n kwo kadna n litafi n ɓa ɓei zhin ko nubo nɓahin tukwo yim .
zafun gyi-gyi-yi nu ɓei dna n na ɓefyecei-ye mi , woi ga ɓa nabari gaiciya nya n kwo gmi n shekwoyi aba .

zafun gyi-gyi-yi nu ɓei dna n na ɓefyecei-ye mi , woi ga ɓa nabari gaiciya nya n kwo gmi n shekwoyi aba .
amalami akatai nɓa ɓegbednayi ama a anabi akatai ɓei nyi nna nyipyei avun nyace , ngye shi amalami akatai ɓa kun nfye mi nyi .
ɓa ɓei ce akata nʼgbai tu n shekwoyi tukwo , ɓai pmi avun wu ɓa dagayi nwo ɓei si ɓa nyi ; ama wahala bwi-bwi nya ɓelo tu nɓa jtukwo npye-pyei .
aza n mwa begye ɓei vi oɓa kata , nge anagbai zhin to zhin ɓenukwoi nun .
ntu ɓa ɓo , aɓei kpe kristi n wo zokwoi agye .
amalami ye , ntu ɓa shakpe ɓo , ɓa ɓei gna fye ɓeho-ɓehoi ntuge ɓa bwa fye agyiwye .
ama shekwoyi ɓei laɓa zunkni tunyi n sapa , oɓa bwi-bwi tulo n zokwo .
gama shekwoyi to ɓei fa amalaika n ɓa ɓei zhin laifi nyin , ama wa sheɓa yafi n anapi , nfi agma fifiyi fi nabmi awyegmanya ɓa pmi wadawyi .
to wa fa aza a sapa yim akpe nuhu , oza n wo ɓei daɓo ga shekwoyi , n wo puwayi aza ngun tnaba , ama shekwoyi wa wu anyi vinya n nuwan yakwo yi .
nnavun wa ze sodom n gomora azhiyi otnu , wa wun ɓaya nanyi wyeba , wa zeɓa mutu nya na tna ? ? shekwoyi viyi aba n nabye , ɓa pa ɓa wodna .
ama dna n esa gmanyi dagayi wa gni lutu , n sodom ntuge wo ɓei zhin oza manayi nu , aɓo nukwoi n wo ɓei zhin woi gye laɓa fyegyi-fyegyi nyi , ɓa ɓo zhin ɓai san wo nya .
ntu cenu , dagayi ɓami wa gni yi n na jaraba n ɓa shegun yi laɓa nyi , wa gyi abye n na aɓo nukwoi tayi har owa da nyipyei-a ɓe .
wo gna minagyi gyi n na zai n ɓa vi ɓa aɓo nukwoi , aɓo pwawo shakpenya , n na zai n ɓa mwa ɓahin ttukwo , ɓai kpe shekwoyi aza agye ntna edna .
koda-yake amalaika n ɓa zhi n dagayi abye nyi , ɓa iko yi lo n kala yi ndu a malami a katai ye , ɓata da ɓa ɓenukwoyi n shekwoyi abam .
ama a malami a katai ye zhin aza mama nu , ɓa wu gmanyi-gmanyi n na nyakpai nu , ɓai zhin aɓo ɓa cei pma ; ngye anyakpa nna maɓa a wan ai wu nyi .
ɓa zhin ɓa ma iko wyegma nya esan nɓa ta kpe kwo yem ; ai aɓa duɓa ɓoya ɓedo na aljanu yi viyan n iko anapi nyai ɓe .
lada nyi n na malami ye ɓei gwo ntu ɓa laifi ɓo .
ntuge ɓa sase fi nanyi da nukwoi fyegyi-fyegyi , ɓa zhin a vinyikwo nya nu n na aci gusai n fyaba , ɓa dna fye kwoce , ɓai sasefi n na laifi nukwoi n sahoi , har ɓai lofi nfya gmada ye-ye nya ngyeɓa zhin aza manayi .
nyikwoza to lo n ɓa ta shi wo ashakpe wyem , anagbai zhin yi ta kun ɓam , ɓai dna aza kwoce n ɓa to mizhi m , ɓai tu ɓahin mwi ɓa ze ashakpewoyi , aɓi bwi-bwi-yi nu aknituyi .
ɓaku bwi zokwo ɓaku ze ngye balamu basura nugun , nwo ɓei kayadna n ye-ye n na gyiwyei , n wo ɓei ye wa bwa dna n ɓenukwoi zhin nyi .
ama aɓo la wo kun ntu wo laifi ɓo , esa nu zhagawyi ɓei daɓo n woi n zanyi-kwoci begye yi , kwa kma anabi ɓenukwoyi-zhin .
aza deye pya to na pma yin ngye adnabminu nɓaku wo , nwu gye a ɓa bwa nyaho-manai nɓa , ama awo , ɓato mizhim ngye ogma gyesa , n ese ku kwo ya nyi .
aku ɓa zunkni lo cei ʼbwo tna ceyi wyegmaanya .
ɓai gma n ɓa laifi yi n gbegyi yi , ɓai zhin apma n nayi shakpe yi , ɓai je aza gnifi n ɓenukwoi zhin n sato mwa shi ɓa pwo cem .
ɓai ci ge , ata gnifye ntu ɓemanai zhin ɓo nun , ntu cenu fye ɓa mi fya zhin ɓenukwoi ɓedo , fye zhin ɓo kwo dafye , fye la bugba leya . ama a malamiye n ɓa ga fye loloya n owa nyi , n ɓahin tukwo ɓa pa-pai lo n zhin alaifi fyenu , n bwibwi .
ntuge oza zhin enya fyenu nu nkwo woi wan shi .
esanu oza la pwo n aɓenukwoyi anyi nya zokwo , ntu yi dagayi n gniyi yi yesu kristi yekpe ɓo , wa je lodna n laifi wa ze kwo fyenu njesun , wo zhin wa gna sapa wunya .
kwo ɓei ɓa gna bmiya ngye to wo ye kpe kristi zokwo yem , afa odo n wo ku kpeye , wa pmi avun wu owa wyidna gyigyi-yi n na ɓei ku gawo nyi .
anyi ɓesi-si kwo-kwoi lo ai cige , omui zhin kwa jeze ɓe da okwatu , a fu burutu nuwan kwa jezeɓe kwa nya kma-kma dna na denbi nu . kwo wu lonu , n naza ba n ɓa jeze ɓeda ɓa laifi .
ama a anabi akatai ɓei nyi nna nyipyei avun nyace , ngye shi amalami akatai ɓa kun nfye mi nyi .
ɓa ɓei ce akata nʼgbai tu n shekwoyi tukwo , ɓai pmi avun wu ɓa dagayi nwo ɓei si ɓa nyi ; ama wahala bwi-bwi nya ɓelo tu nɓa jtukwo npye-pyei .

yesu ɓa jezeɓe omi wasika bayi nyi nfyaba , oma zaje , n ɓa gun aba mi , mi zhin atna ma cefye ɓe pa n fya yemi , nna nyaɓo n fye shin ye kpelo , aɓo n fye ɓei tumwi n na anabi agyi-gyi-yi aba n ʼyi ɓedo atnutnu-yi , n ʼyi ɓei ɓe fye n ɓeda eyi dagayi , n gniyi nyai nyi .
kmisunyi , miye ma pa fye ge dna n na nyi-pyei kmaknayi , agyekpei ɓei ɓe nɓa ɓei zhin aɓo nukwoi doho-dohoi nɓa kpelo , ɓai ma gaiciya ʼsan .
ɓa ɓei caɓo n layinu ge , ce kristi ɓei ku gna ge wo jeze ɓelo ko ?
woi gnina ?
wota shan ɓem .
tunyi n sapa shi zaho-zahoi pa ɓelo sun , anya to shando shiɓa ɓei wun esa n na ɓei zhin anyi nyim . ɓa yi ɓahin ge ɓa zamwi ɓai gwokpe ge shekwoyi ɓei ku anyi zo n nuwan yakwo yi , n na anyi zhin avun , n wo ɓeda egbe nyai , woi ɓo bwa apma zhin n nuwan yi nu wa gmi anyi shi n nuwan yi shekwo-gun njesun .
shekwoyi la gbetu ga njesun ge ala anyi ye n eshe yi pmi shi n tu ena ɓo , n wada nyipyei wyiyi , wyi yi naza nukwoi ɓei bwi cei nyi .
ama fye to ze deye amwin , oma nugundo yeyeyi , nge aye dubu , kwo nyipyei gmanyi ɓa wu ngye nsu nu n dagayi abam .
wota zhin kalala nu n tu wo alkawali jezeɓenya ɓon , kwo da yake ko wu lonu n saho .
ama wo pminu , n dalili manai-ge woto cei pmalo zaho-zaho ya bwim , wo ye ga a ɓenukwoi zhinyi esa nu ɓa ye abui .
dagayi nyipyei ɓelo ntna kmakma , ntna esa dnayi ngye evi , nsayi eshe ɓei kmi kwoi duya wyeɓo yakwo yi , anya ɓa kpe na nyibmana ena ɓei gyi ɓa , ekni nna nyai ɓa kpe kwo , ena ɓei gyiɓa vinya .
tunda anya vinya n shegunyi laɓa ɓa ɓei wuya , ashe ko to bmiya lo ya se ase gyi-gyi yin ?
fye shi nyipyei yi awye , okwo ɓe-ɓe pwai wo fye , ewyi n shekwoyi ɓei dna eshe cei nyi anya ɓa kpe nanyi bmana vinya ɓa ɓei wuya fi nna nyitala .
ama yi pmi shekwoyi ɓahin ɓeye , ɓai ye ɓeda bmapmi kasa-ɓala wo a wasika pmibwa ɓai da aɓo n wo to ɓei zhin nufin , shi ɓa shin zhin n na littafi ajeyi-oɓa gyiba kuwa bwi-bwinu alkawalinu , eshe woyi nya , n nanyi woyi yi , aba n ɓefyece nu bwa sese .
oma nugundo ye-yeyi , sa fye zhilo fyei pmi nyipyei ye , owo ɓeɓe nya , fye zhin kukari fya sase ntna ɓenukwoi zhin yi , fya sase n gyi-gyi-yi , n bugba fuyi n wa bye .
fye pa nya kwo zhin woyi pmi .
wo ga yi ʼsa nu , yi lo azaje n gni-gni ɓeda yi .
eyi zado ce-cei , n ye-yei da yi bulus , woku aɓeye kafi n wo a wasika homi .
owa ɓeda ho dnaɓo lo a kpeɓa awyeɓa , aza lo kuwa n ɓa ku ze a acijeyi dna n ɓahin ɓeye , ɓai ye ɓeda bmapmi kasa , ɓa la wo wasika pmibwa ɓai da aɓo n wo to ɓei zhin nufin , shi ɓa shin zhin n na littafi ajei oɓa gyiba kuwa bwi-bwi nu .
mila atnubua pmafye gni to esayi ɓem , ema-zaje-ye-yei , n nabai nfye ɓa kawye to aza nukwoi ye pya ɓa dna fye kwoce har fya miya nfye mizhi mim .
ama fye mwa fi n alheri , n yekpe yi eyi dagayi n gniyi yi yesu kristi nya .
mwamwa vinya n latu yakwo yi , ɓa kunsun woi nyalo-nyalo .
sai wyihoi .

sai wyihoi .
shekwoyi zhin buzangna nu kristi ɓei n wye-wyeyi kafin a zhin anyi , har emi n mihin tukwo maku gyewo nmi awyei , maku wo wo woi daɓo , ma wo to bwa nmi abwai , wo zhin shekwoyi ɓeda wye-wyeyi nya nu .
oza deye n wo zhin wye-wyeyi nyi , woi gmi n shekwoyi aba nyi , aku wo wuyi , yi zhin seida ge yiku gye wo .
mi da kristi nu ɓo , n wo zhin wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya nyi , wo ɓei kunsun n dadayi a wuyi wo .
ma gnafye njesun , yi gnafye oɓo nu n yi ku gye yi ku to bwa , nna abai fya bwa jedoɓe n na gmadai n yi cei lo n dadayi n yesu kristi owo nugun .
nfya zhin shi ma kafi n wasika ye , efyehince fya ku nu n bugba buyi , n yihinɓe .
ɓeda nyi n shekwoyi wa da nge yi gnafye , nge shekwoyi zhin buzangna nu wyegma to nyi n wo aban .
ntucenu n ya ci ge yi zhin owo anugundo nu , ama ya gyi abye n zan-zan yi fi n wyegma n laifi yi , yi ce akatanu .
ama n yi zan-zan fi n buzangna shekwoyi nya , shi kristi ɓei zhin nyi , yi n jedoɓe yi lo n bugba buyi n na ajei , yesu owo nugun ami ɓa zhanyi ya na laifi vinya .
nyacige yi to n laifi yi lon , yi dna yihin kwoce nu , yi na gaiciya aɓo .
ama n ya da eyi alaifi nwo aba , yi ɓa mi ya kpema wo wa zhin yi gafara .
wa zhanyi ya n ɓenukwoyi vinya .
kwo wulo cewo n shekwoyi aba , wa zhinyi lonu ntuge kristi ɓei lafi ntuge wa zhanyi alaifiya .
n ya gna yi to zhin laifin , yi ce akata nu yi-yi shekwoyi ge zakata , gama wa ci ge , yi ku laifi zhin .
kristi ɓei n wye-wyeyi kafin a zhin anyi , har emi n mihin tukwo maku gyewo nmi awyei , maku wo wo woi daɓo , ma wo to bwa nmi abwai , wo zhin shekwoyi ɓeda wye-wyeyi nya nu .
oza deye n wo zhin wye-wyeyi nyi , woi gmi n shekwoyi aba nyi , aku wo wuyi , yi zhin seida ge yiku gye wo .
mi da kristi nu ɓo , n wo zhin wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya nyi , wo ɓei kunsun n dadayi a wuyi wo .
ma gnafye njesun , yi gnafye oɓo nu n yi ku gye yi ku to bwa , nna abai fya bwa jedoɓe n na gmadai n yi cei lo n dadayi n yesu kristi owo nugun .
nfya zhin shi ma kafi n wasika ye , efyehince fya ku nu n bugba buyi , n yihinɓe .
ɓeda nyi n shekwoyi wa da nge yi gnafye , nge shekwoyi zhin buzangna nu wyegma to nyi n wo aban .
ntucenu n ya ci ge yi zhin owo anugundo nu , ama ya gyi abye n zan-zan yi fi n wyegma n laifi yi , yi ce akatanu .
ama n yi zan-zan fi n buzangna shekwoyi nya , shi kristi ɓei zhin nyi , yi n jedoɓe yi lo n bugba buyi n na ajei , yesu owo nugun ami ɓa zhanyi ya na laifi vinya .
nyacige yi to n laifi yi lon , yi dna yihin kwoce nu , yi na gaiciya aɓo .
ama n ya da eyi alaifi nwo aba , yi ɓa mi ya kpema wo wa zhin yi gafara .
wa zhanyi ya n ɓenukwoyi vinya .
kwo wulo cewo n shekwoyi aba , wa zhinyi lonu ntuge kristi ɓei lafi ntuge wa zhanyi alaifiya .
n ya gna yi to zhin laifin , yi ce akata nu yi-yi shekwoyi ge zakata , gama wa ci ge , yi ku laifi zhin .
omi aɓi , mi gna fye aɓo deye ntuge fya bui laifi si , ama nfya zhin laifi , oza lo n wo ɓa gyiwye ga fye n dada aba .
ayi woye ge , yesu kristi oza n wo zhin ɓefyece yi , woi da shekwoyi agma .
owo nu ɓei shin shekwoyi minagyi n yi tukwo wa tu wohin , wa ga yi jedoɓe n shekwoyi , owo nu zhinyi alaifi gafara , to ge eyi anya gmanyin ama har anyi nya vinya .
gaiciya ga mwi-mwi yi ɓa kpe nwuna nu ge yi zhin owo anya nua ?
n ya shi yihin awye , yi zhin atna lo ya zhin oɓo n wo ye ?
ozaho ɓaci ge , mi zhin yesu viyi nu , mi tu lo n zokwo mi-i lo eshe , mi zhin kristi nyanu . ama nwo ta zhin oɓo lo n kristi a gna won , wo zhin zakata nu .
ama aza n ɓa zhin oɓo n kristi a gna ɓa ge ɓa zhin , ɓa ɓa tumwi ɓa ye shekwoyi ndudu , nlonu yi kpe kwo yi zhin a yesu-viyi nu .
oza n wo ci ge wo zhin yesu-viyi nu , wo zan-zan shi kristi ɓei zan .
omi azaje , mi ta ka wyidna woiwoi nu ga fye fya shibwan , ama kwo-kwoyi nu nfye ɓei ncei shinsun tunyi n kmisunyi .
fye ku kwo shinwo .
ama kwo zhin woi-woi nu , kwoi zhin fye apma shi kwo ɓei zhin kristi nyi , n yaa shi wyidna ye bwa , fye ye n na ajei , wyegma n yi a wye-wyeyi ɓa busi , kristi buzangna , wye-wyeyi nya ɓa bmiyana fi n yi mi .
oza n wa ci ge wo zan-zan dna lo n kristi buzangna , ama woi wun owo zado nu , woye dna lo n wyegmaa .
ama zaho-zahoyi n wo ye nwo zadoyi , wo zan-zan dna lo n buzangna , woi gyewo zokwo ntna bonyi-ce dna n wyegma ko laifi .
gama oza nwo ta ye nwo zadoyin , woye dnalo n wyegma zafun nya , to woi kpe aba nwo lon , gama wyegma n ku wo bwi awye to woi gye wyebam .
mi ka aɓeye ga fye nu efye vinya , emi aɓi , gama aku fye a laifi zhin gafara dna n yesu eyi gniyi .
mi gna fye aɓeye azakwoyi ntuge fye kpe kristi ye lo .
oza n wo wyewyeyi tunyi n kmisunyi .
efye aɓi anuyi , mi daɓo n fyei , ntuge fye ku nasara gyi n shetan tukwo , mika ga gye aɓi anuyi n abi anyikwoyi , ntuge fye ku tumwi ce , fya kpe shekwoyi eyi dada ye .
fye to ye anyim ntucenu , mi daɓo n fyei a dada n fye kpe shekwoyi nyalo-nyalo nya ye lo nyi , nfyei abi-anuyi nfye na kalayi lo n shekwoyi ɓeda yi nfye abugba nyi , fyei ku nasara gyi n shetan yi .
fye ku fa anyi ye ɓo , na nya yi n anyi ga fye vinya , gama n fye ye anya ye , fye wunu ge fye ta ye shekwoyi lon .
gama anyi nya ye vinya , anyikwo shakpe aɓo awyeda , anya si n ɓa lo ha wye , ntukwo mwayi n kwo ɓe n nyabwa aba nyi , aɓeye vinya to zhin shekwoyi nya nun .
ɓa kun n anyi nukwoyi ye nu .
anyi ye duyalo , nna anya nukwoyi yei vinya ɓa ɓeilo n gnisun nɓai , ama oza n wa gyi abye n shekwoyi ɓeye-zhinyi wo ɓa bwa wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya .
emi aɓi , anyi ye esa kmaknayi nla ɓe , fye ku kristi nuɓayi ɓo wo , oza n wo zhin gaba n kristi nyin-saiye azahi pya n mwa begye nku ɓe , deye wuyi ge anyi zo sa la ga si .
aza n ɓa zhin gaba n kristi yi nyi , ɓei fi n yi aduwa nyakun , ama ɓa to ɓei kunsun n yin to ɓaye kun , esa nɓa ɓei fa yi nyi kwo ku wuyi ɓa to ɓei zhin eyi anya num .
ama fye to wu lo nlonun , gama zafun gyi-gyi-yi la ɓe nfye tukwo , fyei kpe gaiciya yelo .
ntu cenu , mi taka fye ngye aza nu , n ɓa cei pma ɓa kpe gaiciya yen .
ama mi pma fye gna nu , ngye aza n ɓa kpe gaiciya ye , n na akatayi .
nyikadonu zhin akata esua ?
oza n wo ci ge yesu to zhin kristi nun .
ozahi pya zhin kristi nuɓayi nu , ntuge wo to ga shekwoyi gaiciya n wo nugun yin .
gama oza nwo ta ga kristi shekwoyi nugun gaiciyan , wo ta bwa shekwoyi dadan , ama oza nwo n kristi shekwoyi nugun yi lo , wo n shekwoyi dada yi lo .
ntucenu fye gyi abye n gaiciya gai n nya n na ku wu fye , tunyi n sapa .
nfya zhin lonu fye ɓa bwa jedoɓe n shekwoyi n owo nugunyi .
nwohin tukwo wo ku deye alkawali zhin yi wato wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya .
omi ɓeda tu n kristi nuɓai ɓo , mi da aza nu ɓo n ɓa ɓa ye ɓa bwi fye awye , ɓa dna fye n zokwo kasa .
ama fye la zafun gyi-gyi-yi gwo , wo dnalo n fyemi , n fya bugba mi , nna bai n fye ta sun nzaho apmai wa wu fye nyahon n kwo bmiyan .
gama wo wu fye anya vinya , owo nu zhin gaiciya , ntu cenu , shi wo ku da , tilas fye sase fi n kristi , to fya shan ka n won .
nsaiye emi aɓi , fye ku fi n zumunta agmada n dagayi n na bai n wa ɓe fye ku kpe nge ɓeho to lon , vinyikwo to ɓei wo fye , fyei ta n na avun yin esa n wa ɓe n cei n .
shi yi kpelo ge shekwoyi zhin oza manayi nu , woi zhin ɓemana n esai vinya , yi ɓa mi ya ci ge , aza nɓa zhin ɓe mana , ɓa zhin owo aɓinu .
omi aɓi , mi gna fye aɓo deye ntuge fya bui laifi si , ama nfya zhin laifi , oza lo n wo ɓa gyiwye ga fye n dada aba .
ayi woye ge , yesu kristi oza n wo zhin ɓefyece yi , woi da shekwoyi agma .
owo nu ɓei shin shekwoyi minagyi n yi tukwo wa tu wohin , wa ga yi jedoɓe n shekwoyi , owo nu zhinyi alaifi gafara , to ge eyi anya gmanyin ama har anyi nya vinya .
yi ɓa kpe nwuna nu ge yi zhin owo anya nua ?
n ya shi yihin awye , yi zhin atna lo ya zhin oɓo n wo ye ?

fye gye shi eyi dada eshe nya yeyi nsun , har woi ye ge a yi yi ge owo aɓi gaiciyai nu yi zhin wo aɓinu , ama aza n mwa begye nɓa ta kpe shekwoyi yen , ɓata kpe lo ge yi zhin owo aɓi nun , e , omi anugundo , yi zhin shekwoyi aɓinu nsaiye , yi ta mi ya kpe enya ye nkwo ɓe lon , ama yi kpe lo ge , esa , n wa ɓe n cei yi ɓa wu ngye wo , ntuge yi ɓei gyewo shi wo wu .
oza n wo ga ɓeye gaiciya wo ɓa shi wohin n gyi-gyi-yi , shi kristi nwohin gyi-gyi-yi nyi .
ama aza n ɓa gyi abye n laiti zhinyi , ɓa zhin shekwoyi nuwunyi nu , gama ata zhin alaifi doho-dohoyi n shekwoyi ɓeye yi nun .
fyei kpe lo ge wo ɓei la ze zanyikwoci n na bai wa ku yi alaifi ya , woi to n laifi owohin nyan , wo to na shekwoyi ɓeye zhin ɓo nsaho-sahoyi n , n zokwo doho-dohoyin , ntu cenu n yi wo vivi-wyi n woi , yi vi wo ɓo , yi ta gyi abye n laifi zhinyin , ama aza nɓa gyi abye n laifi zhin yi nyi , kwo kunce ɓa kpe ge , ɓa zhin alaifi ntu ge ɓa to shin woye kpe nun , kwo ɓa to ze owo anyan .
o , omi aɓi , fye toye zaha wa dna fye kwoce n , nfya zhin ɓemana n esai vinya , kwo wunu ge fye zhin aza manayi nu ngye wohin .
ama n fya gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhinyi , kwo wunu ge fye zhin shetan nyanu , oza n wo ɓei ya laifi zhin to wa shan ka nkwon , ama shekwoyi nugun ɓei ɓe ntuge wa wun shetan atnu-tnu ya nu .
oza n na la wo ma dna n shekwoyi aɓi wo ta gyi abye n laifi zhin yin , ntuge nsaiye shekwoyi wye-wyeyi dnalo n wo , ntuce wo ta gyi abye n laifi zhin yin , ntuge ala wye-wyeyi woi-woyi ye ma dna nwo , kwoi wanwo shi , alawo shanma .
nlonu yi ɓa mi ya wu oza n wo zhin shekwoyi ɓi , n zayi n wo zhin shetan nya .
oza nwo sase dnalo n laifi to woi ye nwo azaje yin , wa wunu ge woto dnalo n shekwoyi aɓin .
gama nabari n yi ɓei wo tunyi n kmisunyi , okwonu ge yi ye n na ajeyi .
yi to ku ze ngye kayinu , nwo ɓei zhin shetan nya , wa wu owo mado nyin .
kninu ɓei zhin wa wu woa ?
ntuge kayinu ɓei zhin woi zhin ɓenukwoyi , wo ɓei n cei kpe n ge owo mado zan-zan ɓei gna wo nya bmiya .
ntucenu ce to wo fye n , emi anugundo ndei anyi wun yi nun .
n ya ye n na a yesu-viyi ajeyi kwa wunu ge alayi gni n na anapi , ai la wye wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya gayi .
ama oza n wo taye n wo aje yin wo lo efi nyalo-nyalo nya .
oza n wa wun owo yesu-viyi do nu , wo zhin zawuyi nu .
fye kpelo ge oza to lo n wo wu oza nwo wye-wyeyi nyalonyalo nyayi lo-lo nwo min .
yi kpelo ge ye-ye hin-hin kun n kristi aba nu , ngye shi wa fi ntu nyi ɓo nyi , ntu cenu kwo kunce lo ya gayi awye-wyeyi ntu n yi a yesu-viyi aje ɓo .
ama ndei oza n wo zhin yesu-viyi wo n na agyiwyeyi lo nwo ɓa sase n dagma , wa gye zado n na awyekwoyi to wa bmawo zhin , shekwoyi ye-ye dnalo n wuna nu nwo miʼa ?
omi aɓi , yi fa ɓeda ɓo n gbeyi ge yi ye eyi azaje lo , yi ye ɓa cewo ya wu ɓa n yi aɓo zhin-zhin .
nnavun yi ɓe kpe dei-dei n yi aɓezhin , nge yi malo n shekwoyi bwa , nsai eyi abugba ɓe bwa lafiya , kwo esa n ya gni-agni zhin n dagayi abye .
ama n yi n na abugba anukwoyi , kwa gnayi ge yi ku ɓenukwoyi zhin , dagayi ɓa gna kwo wo , gama wo kpe ɓeye lo vinya n yi zhin .
ama emi a nugundo ye-yeyi ndei eyi abugba gyi-gyi-yi lo , yi ɓa mi ya ɓe dagayi aba n bugba kalayi n tna edna .
ya bwa enya n yi nya , ntuge yi vi wo ɓo lo , yi zhin oɓo n wo ye .
enya nyi n shekwoyi wa gna ge yi zhin , yi ga gaiciya n yesu kristi owo nugun eye , ya ye n na jeyi .
aza n ɓa zhin enya n shekwoyi wa da ɓa sease lo fi n shekwoyi owohin nɓa mi , yi kpelo deye kwo zhin gaiciya nu , n tuge zafun gyi-gyi-yi n wa gayi nyi wo gna yi nlonu .

ama n yi n na abugba anukwoyi , kwa gnayi ge yi ku ɓenukwoyi zhin , dagayi ɓa gna kwo wo , gama wo kpe ɓeye lo vinya n yi zhin .
ama emi a nugundo ye-yeyi ndei eyi abugba gyi-gyi-yi lo , yi ɓa mi ya ɓe dagayi aba n bugba kalayi n tna edna .
ya bwa enya n yi nya , ntuge yi vi wo ɓo lo , yi zhin oɓo n wo ye .
enya nyi n shekwoyi wa gna ge yi zhin , yi ga gaiciya n yesu kristi owo nugun eye , ya ye n na jeyi .
aza n ɓa zhin enya n shekwoyi wa da ɓa sease lo fi n shekwoyi owohin nɓa mi , yi kpelo deye kwo zhin gaiciya nu , n tuge zafun gyi-gyi-yi n wa gayi nyi wo gna yi nlonu .
omi a nugundo ye-yeyi fye to ga aɓo vinya gaiciya nfye won , ntuge aza gna fye ge shekwoyi ɓeda nun fye mwi kwo kpa fya gye kwo shekwoyi ɓeda nu .
gama anya wuyi a katayi lo .
zokwo nfye ɓa kpe ge ɓeda ye zhin zafun gyi-gyi-yi nya nu , okwo nu ge fya nyaɓo ge ɓeda ye da lo ge yesu kristi , shekwoyi nugun ɓo la ze zanyikwoci wa ɓe dna na anyi n nayi ku ngye za ?
nkwo wu lonu agye ɓedahi gmi n shekwoyi aba nu .
nkwo to wo lonun , to ɓedahi ta gmi n shekwoyi aba nun , ama n kristi nuɓayi aba , kristi nuɓayi n fye ku owo ɓo shinwo nge wo ɓelo nyi , owo a tnutnu nukwoyi n ɓa zhin gaba kristi nyi , ɓa fi lo anyi .
omi anugundo ye-yeyi fye zhin shekwoyi anyanu , fyei ku nasara gyi n na azayi n ɓa wun kristi nu , ntuge oza dnalo n efye abugbami n wo du amalami akatayi ye lo n kala , n ɓa fi n na anyi nukwoyi ye nyi .
aza deye zhin anyi nya nu , ntu cenu ɓai vi anyi nya , anyi yi kna ɓa tnubua lo .
ama yi zhin shekwoyi aɓinu , ntu cenu aza n ɓa kpe shekwoyi ye ɓa nu knayi ɓeda tunbua .
azado ta won , zokwonu njesun n yi ɓa kpe kwo ɓeda gmi n shekwoyi aba nu , ntuge n kwo gmi nwoabanuanyitawon .
emi anugundo , yi tumwi ya ye n na ajeyi , gama ye-ye gmi n shekwoyi abanu , aza nɓa ye n na zayi , ɓai zhin ɓemana ɓa wunu ge ɓa zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu , ɓai zhin atnalo ɓaye kpewo ye lo na bye .
ama ndei oza to n ye-yei lo woi zhin ɓemanan , kwo wu nu ge wo ta kpe shekwoyi ye lon gama shekwoyi zhin ye-yenu .
shekwoyi ɓei wu shi wo ye yi nsun esa n wo ɓei tnu n wo nugun , ɓigba gmanyi yi dna n na nyi nukwoyi ye , wa ɓe yi n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi , dna n wo fi .
dna n tnu-tnuye yi ku gye shi yeye hin-hin wu , kwo to zhin eyi yeye nu n shekwoyi aban , ama , owo yeye nu n yi aba , esa n wo ɓei tnu n wo nugun yi wa ya shekwoyi minagyi zhi n yi alaifi tukwo .
emi anugundo , shi shekwoyi ye yi lo n sun lonu nyi , kwo kunce lo ya ye n na ajeyi ce .
gama kwo da yake yi to shin shekwoyi gyen , esa n ya ye n na ajeyi , shekwoyi dnalo n yi , owo ye-ye n yi mi kwa dnakala lo abye-bye .
wo la owo zafun gyi-gyi-yi dna n yi abugba mi , seida nu ge yi sase fi lo nwo , owohin n yi mi .
har sahi , yiku gye n yihin awyeyi , yi gna anyi , nge shekwoyi la tnu n wo nugun yi wa ze anyi gniyi .
zaho-zahoyi n wa ga gaiciya wa ci ge yesu nu zhin shekwoyi nugun , shekwoyi dnalo n owo mi , owohin ce dna n shekwoyi mi .
yi kpelo shi shekwoyi ye yi nsun , ntuge yi ku owo ye-ye woshan , ntu ge yi ku gaiciya gawo esa n wa gnayi nge wo ye yi lo n mwa .
shekwoyi zhin ye-ye nu , zahozaho yi nwo dnalo n ye-ye , wo dnalo n shekwoyi , shekwoyi dnalo n wo .
shi yi sase fi n kristi , eyi ye-ye kwa mwa lo abye kwa nu , nlonu vinyikwo n ednayi to ɓei woyin , nwada-wyiyin , ama yi ɓei gye wo n bugba kalayi n na agmadayi , ntuge wo ye yi lo , yihin yewo lo ce .
yi to n dna apma yi lo n za aba nwo ye yi lo cewon , owo ye-ye n yi aba n la aɓo dna nya nyayi ya , n woɓa zhin yi nyi .
n ya wo edna , yiwo oɓo dna nu n wo ɓa zhinyi , kwa wu nu ge yita kpelo shi wo ye yi nsun .
ntu cenu , yi yewo ntuge wona ye yi n na bye .
ndei oza gna ge , mi ye shekwoyi lo ama woi wun owo zado nun , wo zhin za kata nu , woɓa ye shekwoyi n wuna n wo to shin wo gye-nyin , ndei wo ta ye wo zado lo n wo gyewo wye nyin ma ?
shekwoyi , n wohin tukwo wo ku ci ge oza taye shekwoyi nu gmanyin ama wo ye nwo zadoyi .
omi a nugundo ye-yeyi fye to ga aɓo vinya gaiciya nfye won , ntuge aza gna fye ge shekwoyi ɓeda nun fye mwi kwo kpa fya gye kwo shekwoyi ɓeda nu .

ama ndei oza to n ye-yei lo woi zhin ɓemanan , kwo wu nu ge wo ta kpe shekwoyi ye lon gama shekwoyi zhin ye-yenu .

shekwoyi , n wohin tukwo wo ku ci ge oza taye shekwoyi nu gmanyin ama wo ye nwo zadoyi .
nza ga gaiciya ge yesu nu zhin kristi , woi zhin shekwoyi nugun nu n ho gniyi , agye ho zhin shekwoyi ɓinu .
oza n wo ye n dadayi , wo ye lo nu n wo nugun yi .
ntu cenu fye ɓa kpe shi fye ye shekwoyi aɓi n sun wato efye azaje n na amapwi dna n dagayi , shi fye ye shekwoyi fyei vi wo ɓo nsun nyi .
shekwoyi yeye nwu ge ha zhin oɓo nwo ye , ɓehin-hin kwo to dnaɓon .
gama shekwoyi ʼɓi doho-dohoyi ɓami wa vi wo , woi gyi nasara n laifiyi , n na shakpe nukwoyi anyi nya yi , n wa kpema kristi ntu ge wa bma wo zhin .
ama nyikado ɓami wa sunkun wa gyi nasara n okun ye yi , to oza ga gaiciya nu ge , kristi zhin .
shekwoyi nugun nu ma ?
yi kpelo ge wo zhin wo nugun nu , ntuge shekwoyi ɓei ku da lonu n begye yi nkwo ɓei gmi n eshe , esa n na ɓei zhin yesu baptisma , n esai n wo ɓei ye wa fi nyi .
e , to ge esa n na ɓei zhin wo baptisma gmanyim , ama n esayi n wo ɓei ye wafi nyi .
zafun gyi-gyi-yi gaiciyada vinya ɓei ku da lonu ce .
ntu cenu yi n na seidada yi lo ngun ata , zafun gyi-gyi-yi begye n yi abugbami , begye nkwo ɓei gmi n eshe , esa n na ɓei zhin wo baptisma nyi , n begyeyi kafin wofi , ɓa ɓei da ɓo gmanyi nu , nge yesu kristi zhin shekwoyi nugun nu .
yi zhin ya ga aza gaiciya n ɓa gmi seida n na awadaba nyi , ntu cenu yi ɓa mi ya ga oɓo gaiciya n shekwoyiʼa da .
shekwoyi wo gna ge yesu zhin owo nugun nu .
aza vinya n ɓa ga ɓeye gaiciya nɓa bugba , ɓa kpelo ge kwo zhin gaiciya nu .
zaho-zahoyi n wo to ga ɓeye gaiciyan wo yi shekwoyi nu ge za kata .
ntuge wo ta ga gaiciya lo tu oɓo n shekwoyi ku da n wo nugun tukwon .
knido nu n shekwoyi n kuda ?
nge wo la wyewyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya gayi , wyewyeyi ye kwo dna lo n owo nugun nu .
ntu cenu oza n wo n shekwoyi nugun yilo , wo n wye-wyeyi lo , oza n wo to n nugun yi lon woto n wyewyeyi n lon .
mi ka deye ga fye n fye ku gaiciya ga n shekwoyi nugun nyi , n na abai fya kpe ge fye n wyewyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya yi lo .
yi kpelo lallei , nge woɓa wo yi , wa gayi nyaho-nyahoyi n ya nyawo n lodo n wo ɓeye yi .
n yi kpelo ge wo wo yilo , esa n ya daɓo n owoyi , yi gyi wo wye yi kpelo nu nge wo ɓa ga yi amsa .
nha gye yesu-viyi woi zhin laifi n kwo ta ɓe n efiyin , ha gyi shekwoyi wye wa zhin wo gafara , shekwoyi wa gawo wye-wyeyi , saidai woku laifi zhin nkwo kunce n efiyi .
ama laifi lo n kwo ɓe n efi yi nwo ku kwo nu zhin , apma to lo a zhin aduwan .
ɓenukwoyi dohodohoyi zhin laifinu .
mita da alaifi fafayi nu ɓon , mi da laifinu ɓo n kwo ɓe nfi yi .
oza to lo n wo la zhin shekwoyi oɓi n wo ɓa gyi abye n laifi zhin , gama kristi , shekwoyi nugun , wo yi shilo n kalayi , shetan ta mi wa to wo bwan .
yi kpelo ge yi zhin shekwoyi aɓi nu , anyi vinya n ɓa cenyi ɓafi n shetan sinta nu nwo ikoyi .
yi kpelo ge kristi , shekwoyi nugun , nla ɓe wa bmayi zhin , yakpe , ya bwa shekwoyi hinhin ye , nsayiye yi filo n shekwoyi ntuge yi fi lo n yesu kristi owo nugun .
nwonu zhin shekwoyi gaiciyada gmanyi , owonu zhin wyewyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya .
omi aɓi , fye bui enya si n kwo ɓa gwo shekwoyi aba dna nfye abugbami .

shi gaiciya dnalo n yi mi nyalo-nyalo nyi .
shekwoyi dada n wo nugunyi yesu kristi , ɓa tu yi anabarka n sun-sungye dnagmayi n bugba fuyi , n gaiciya yi n ye-yeyi .
fye zhin peceiye nna byeda akata nya yi a damilo n mwa shi ma gye oho aɓiho n ya , ɓai zan-zan shi kwo kunce , ɓai vi gaiciya , ɓai vi shekwoyi gbega .
nsaiye mi cei pma lo ma ce fye ɓepa , emi , anugundo , wyidna kwokwoyi n shekwoyi ɓei ga tunyi n kmisunyi nyi , nge kwo bmiya a yesu-viyi ɓa ye n najei .
n yi ye shekwoyi , ye ɓa zhin oɓo n wo ye ya zhin , wa ku gnayi tunyi nsapa nge yi ye najei .
fye ka atukwoda akatai wye , n ɓa sheyi gun laɓa nyi , n ɓata ga gaiciya nge kristi ɓei la ɓe anyi dna n nayi ngye eyi nya pyan .
aza deye pya gni apapa n gaiciya yi , n kristi yi .
fye zhin peceiye to fya ze ngye ɓan , fya bwi lada nuwan , n fyehin , nmihin zhin tnu-tnu n kalayi ya bwa nyin .
fye la fyehin yi fya bwa lada nu-nuyi n dagayi aba .
gama nfye to kpetu kristi wuwun , fye la shekwoyi fa nu n na avun .
ama n fya vi kristi nyawu , fye ɓa bwa shekwoyi .
fya bwa dada n nugun yi .
n za ɓe wa wu fye , to woi ga gaiciya n nya n kristi ɓei wun , fye to yi wo ma wa ɓe fye puwan , fye to gawo bugba kala n zokwo dohodohoyin .
nfya ye , fya ku ze aza nukwoyi nu ɓedo nwoi , dna n wo aɓe nukwoyi zhin-zhin .
to , mi n cei pmalo maye daɓo ɓe ama mito n cei pmalo ma dakwo fi n wasikayen , gama mi n bugbayi dnalo ma ɓe ma gye fye esa fyewyi , nsahi yi ɓei da aɓeye n gnisun , yi dagma .
oho mapui , shekwoyi oɓi knikniyi , owo aɓi ɓi ho gna lo .
wasika ye gmi n yohanna byeda , zakwoyi ikklisiya nya aba nu , kwoi lo nyikwoza ye-yeyi aba n shekwoyi wa kni nyi , n wo aɓiyi n mi ye n mwa nyi shi azaje ye wo dna ekilisiya nyi .
shi gaiciya dnalo n yi mi nyalo-nyalo nyi .

nfya ye , fya ku ze aza nukwoyi nu ɓedo nwoi , dna n wo aɓe nukwoyi zhin-zhin .
to , mi n cei pmalo maye daɓo ɓe ama mito n cei pmalo ma dakwo fi n wasikayen , gama mi n bugbayi dnalo ma ɓe ma gye fye esa fyewyi , nsahi yi ɓei da aɓeye n gnisun , yi dagma .
oho mapui , shekwoyi oɓi knikniyi , owo aɓi ɓi ho gna lo .
wasika ye gmi yohanna byeda aba nu kwoi lo gayus emi za yeyeyi aba , n mi ye wo n gaiciya nyi .
emi nugundo , mi zhin aduwa lo ge oho nayi n lafiya yi lo shi oho wye-wyeyi n ceilo nyi .
eyi azado-hon ɓa zan-zan ɓai wan zokwo n ya ɓaku bugba bui-bui gami , shi ɓa gnami ge ho zan-zan lo bmiya n gaiciya yi , hoi sase lo shi nabari manayi da .
vi ɓo nkwo bmiya bugba buyi do to lo nkwo ɓa du deye ngye shi mi wo aɓeye pya n mi aɓi aban .
omi nugundo ho zhin shekwoyi tnu-tnu manayi lo , nha bma , a malami zhin n na a waʼazi zhinyi , n ɓa diya n ho aba nyi .
ɓaku oho alheri ɓo gna eklisiya n ya , nho yeye atnu-tnu yi .
a dami lo shi ho ɓei tnu n na a cauta yi n aza kun nɓa diya nyi .
gama a zan dagayi ezan nu to ɓai go , kwo nyagyin , ajekpe , agye wanba kwo agyiwye n na azaba n ɓa ta vi yesun , kwo da yake ɓaku waʼazi zhin ɓa .
ntucenu eyi n yi hin tukwo yi bma ɓa zhin n na bai yaku ze a dagayi tnu-tnu kun-zhin yi n ɓai .
mi tnu ikklisiya n wasika ɓiyi yei ntu ce nu , ama diyoturifus , tu kwomwayi , n wo ye wa duwohin gyi n na abye , ngye a yesu-viyi tukwoda nyi , wo ta gwo mi iko tulo n wo tukwon to woi ye wa womin .
esa n ma ɓe n ɓa gnaho aɓo n wo zhin lo , n na aɓo a nukwoyi n wo dalo n mi tukwo , n ɓeda nukwoyi n wo da .
wo ta na awaʼazi zhinyi gwoɓo nu gmanyin , ama wo ta ye ge azaje ɓa gwon , n ɓa gwo wa kunɓa ya n na aduwa nyakun .
omi nugundo , to gwo zokwo nukwoi yen , vi oɓo n kwo bmiya hapa ge , aza nɓa zhin ɓo mana , ɓa wunu ge ɓa zhin shekwoyi aɓinu , aza n ɓa gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhinyi , ɓa wu nu ge ɓa mwakpalo n shekwoyi .
ozaho-zahoyi ɓedo n gaiciya yi n kwohin tukwo ɓei zhin dimitriyus seida , emi n mihin tukwo mi ɓa da ɓo gmanyi nu , hoi kpelo ge mi da gaiciya nu .
mi n na ɓei lo n mi n cei pma ma gnaho , ama mita kafi n yan .
gama mi na awyetu yilo mi ɓaɓe daho , yi ɓei daɓo n mwa n gnisun .
ntucenu sai esahoi .
anugundo n ya ɓa tnu ho lo nɓa gnaɓiyi , ɓi aza vinya gna gami .
wasika ye gmi yohanna byeda aba nu kwoi lo gayus emi za yeyeyi aba , n mi ye wo n gaiciya nyi .
emi nugundo , mi zhin aduwa lo ge oho nayi n lafiya yi lo shi oho wye-wyeyi n ceilo nyi .

ntucenu eyi n yi hin tukwo yi bma ɓa zhin n na bai yaku ze a dagayi tnu-tnu kun-zhin yi n ɓai .

ozaho-zahoyi ɓedo n gaiciya yi n kwohin tukwo ɓei zhin dimitriyus seida , emi n mihin tukwo mi ɓa da ɓo gmanyi nu , hoi kpelo ge mi da gaiciya nu .

gama mi na awyetu yilo mi ɓaɓe daho , yi ɓei daɓo n mwa n gnisun .
ntucenu sai esahoi .
anugundo n ya ɓa tnu ho lo nɓa gnaɓiyi , ɓi aza vinya gna gami .
omi yahuda yesu kristi bara n yakubu madoyi .
kwoi lo a yesu-viyi n na aba vinya a za ye-yeyi n shekwoyi wa kni .
fa shekwoyi alheri , bugbafu n sun-sungyei , ɓa mwa nfye aba lo abye abye .
agnigni ntu gaiciya ɓo omi anugundo ye-yeyi mi zhin shiri maka ga fye ntu n gni-gni ɓo n shekwoyi la gayi , ama nsaiye kwo la ze dole ma ka fye n nyaho tukwo gbo , ma gna ge fye sunkun n wyei bmi ntu n gaiciya ɓo n shekwoyi ɓei ga owo aza , bwa sun gmanyi , ɓa shikwo ntna doshanyi , aye yi mwa begye .
mi da deye ntu ge amalami ho a tna shekwoyi yekpeyi , ɓaku lofi n fye mi , ɓai ci ge n ya ku vi yesu , na avun , yi ɓami ya zan-zan shi yi n cei pma n tna shekwoyi ta ta dnawo .
aɓei ka oɓa knizun tun-yin sapa , ntu ge ɓala pmi da eyi tukwoda , wato dagayi yesu kristi .
omi amsa n ɓa aba okwonu nyi ge , fye pa gaiciya ye ɓo nfye shin kpeye lo nyi nge , shekwoyi ɓola wo aza gni n masar kni , n na avun wa wu , aza vinya n ɓato ɓei gawo gaiciya ɓa zhin owo ɓe yen .
ma pa fye njesun , amalaikayi ɓo , n ɓa ɓei gyi-gyi-yi n tna cegye nyi , ama ɓa pmi da ɓenukwoyi zhin .
nsaiye shekwoyi nɓai fi agma filo n kurkuku wyegmanya ɓai pmi wada nyipyei .
fyeto ze sodom kni n gomara yi amwi m , n na azhiyi nɓa ɓei shegun ɓa nyin , vinya n nu-nuyi n shakpe doho-dohoyi .
azanugbayi ɓai wo aje shakpe , azhihi aɓei ku ɓa kpe ena , ɓaku ze misali n yi aba nge anapi lo aba n na ta , aɓenukwoyi zhinyi .
ama amalami a katayi ye ɓai gyiabye n na zan-zan nukwoyi , ɓai zhin laifi , ɓa gba ɓahin nayi , ɓai kpe aza agye n ba gyi abe tu n ɓa tukwo nyi , har ɓai kpe a malaika a gye .
ama mikailu , amalaika esu , esa n wo ɓei gni musa nayin n shetan yi , wo to ɓei zhin atna wa gnawo ɓeda kasan , ko wa kpewo agyen , ama wa ciwo ge , dagayi wo gnakniho . ama aza deye , ɓa kpe anya agye , ɓai kni anya akmi n ɓa to nɓa awyegayin , ngye anya fanya ɓai zhin aɓo n ɓa gye dama , ɓai lo n ɓa awye-wyeyi n na abwi .
aiya n ɓa aba , gama ɓaku vi kayinu fye , n wo ɓei wu owo mado nyi , ngye balamu ɓei zhin ɓehoɓehoi ntu agyiwye ɓo , n gye kuraha ɓo la shekwoyi beda zungna , ɓa fifi n owo knitu .
esanu n na aza deye ye ɓedo n nfyei n na abuki aba n na aduwa nyakun yi , ɓa zhin aza nukwoyi fi n fyemi , ɓai masan ɓai gyi abye , ɓai kna ɓahin , to ɓai pa azaje ɓon , ɓawu ngye alkawali to ɓai nun , ɓawu ngye ashinwa a gyi-gyi-yi n ɓa ta gyi nɓa sayin .
ɓato fifi yi nu gmayin ama ɓa fifi yi abwa aba : ntu ge ala ɓa shiya n na agbegyei vinya a kpe ɓa eria .
enya nɓa fa n ɓa avun , okwo nu zhin vinyikwo , ngye alazhenya n nuwan kma kwa yaɓa zhi n edna gbe nyi .
ɓai zan laɓa ngye akpasu , buzangna nya , ama nɓa abye wyegmaa nyalo-nyalo nya n bugba wunyi n shekwoyi nla zhin shiri gaɓa .
inok n wo ɓei zhin oza tnabayi n adamu avun , ɓei kpe aza deye ɓo wa ci ge , gye , dagayi ɓelo n wo azagyi-gyiyin mwa begye .
wo ɓei ɓe n na azanyikwoci yi n owada abye , ɓo gwo tata cewo ai wu aɓo anukwoyi n ɓa ku zhin gaba n shekwoyi , woi wu oɓo n ɓa zhin nwo tukwo . aza deye zhin anya abwa shiyi nu nyaho ta kunɓa , bai zhin ɓenukwoyi doho-dohoi n ɓa gye , ɓai mwa ɓahin n gbeyi , n ɓa ga aza mwa-mwa ɓa ga ntuge ɓa ye nyaho nu .
mi nyakun tu n nyakungoro manayi .
emi a nugundo , fye pa aɓo n eyi dagayi yesu kristi abara ɓei gna fye .
nge n na anyipyei kmazoyi agyekpe yi ɓei ɓe , oɓa nufi vinya ɓa dabahin agma dna n zokwo nukwoyi doho-dohoi .
ɓai ɓe na jegnayi ɓai ye anya nukwoyi anyinya , ɓato n zafun gyi-gyi-yi dna n ɓa emin .
ama efye , emi a nugundo , fye mi fyehin fi n tushi eyi gaiciya ga gyi-gyi nya , fyei tumwi fyei zhin aduwa dna n zafun gyi-gyi-yi iko , n kalayi .
fye ku fi aba n shekwoyi ye-ye nyi , wa tu fye anabarka , fye pmi n hakuri yi , wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nya n eyi dagayi yesu kristi dna n wo sun-sun gye ye wo ga fye nyi .
fye bma aza zhin nɓa naɓo n fye mi nyi , fye gye aza sun-sun nɓa zhin shaka nyi .
gni aza ho ngye ho kun ɓa , n anapi , azaho kuwa , bma ɓa zhin ɓa bwa dagayi , ama fya zhin peceiye n na abai n fye ta bwi fi n ɓa laifin , fye na ɓa alaifi ɓo , ama fya gye ɓa sun-sun n ɓahin tukwo nɓa zhin alaifida nyi .
nsaiye , mwa-mwa vinya n wo aba n wo zhin shekwoyi gmanyi nyi , n wa gni yi ntu yesu kristi ɓonyi , e , mwa-mwa n kalayi vinya , iko vinya n ebe yi owo nya nu tunyi n kmisunyi , ɓa zhin owo nya nu tunyi n kmisunyi , ɓa zhin owo nya nu ɓai ɓo zhin owo nya nyalo-nyalo .
wo n ikoyi lo wa shifye bwa to fya taya fya miya , waɓe n fye yi ntna laifi n gyi-gyi-yi , n wo abye , mwa-mwa n kasun ci agmada nya yi , nyalo-nyalo .

littafi ye kpe anya , anyaya n ɓa ɓa zhin esa fyewyi , n yesu kristi asesemi , shekwoyi ɓei ga wo izini ge wo kpe ɓa nya ya wu yohanna owo bara .
a tnu n malaikayi n eshe wa ɓe wa wu wo oɓa awyega .
yohanna wa kaɓa kpe vinya , shekwoyi ɓeda , n yesu kristi yi n na aɓei vinya n wo ɓei wo , woi ce woi gye .
nha ba anabci ye dna ikklisiya ai wo , ho ɓa gwo anabarka n dagayi .
aza nɓa wo ɓa knatunbua ɓa zhin oɓo n kwa da ɓa bwa anabarka .
gama esa la wo viwyi n na aɓeye vinya ɓa zhin .
daga yohanna , zuwa a ekilisiya n gun tnaba n ɓa fi n asiya nyi , turki .
omi anugundo , alheri , n bugbafuyi , nɓa kun n shekwoyi aba , nwo nyi nyi , n wo ɓei nyi , woi ye wa ɓe , n na zafun ngun tnabayi nɓa zhi n wo abye nyi .
n yesu kristi yi n wa nu egbe woi wuyi gaiciya vinya nyi .
owo nu zhin kmisunyi n wo ɓei lakala n efi , to wa shan fin .
wo du esu dohodohoyilo n esayi vinya , n wa loyiya , n yi alaifi , shi wa ze owo ami ya ntu yi ɓo nyi .
wola yi yezhi fi n owo ebemi , wa zeyi a pirist shekwoyi owo dada anya .
fye gawo mwa-mwa nyalo-nyal-o nya , wo gyi ebe nyalonyalo amin .
gyewye , wo zhilo , n na anyi yi shewo gun , awye vinya ɓa gyewo , e , aza nɓa ɓei fin wo eshanyi , akni vinya ɓei cibwi ɓai wun bugba esa nwa ɓe ncei .
e , amin , ko ze nlonu .
ominu zhin a n z yi , kmisunyi n kmaknayi , anya vinya n ya shekwoyi na dace n wo zhin dagayi nyi , oza nwo ikoyi vinya nyi , n wo nyin , woi ɓei nyi , woi ɓelo njesun .
ominu , efye zado , yohanna , wahala kun-sunyi ntu n yesu ɓo , n wo ka fye wasika ye , emihin ce , mila hakuri bwa n yesu ga , yi ɓei gyi ebe n woyi .
mi ɓei tu n muse n na yi kwo ge batmus , n na ɓei nyami ya ntu ge mi zhin shekwoyi ɓeda waʼazi , mi-i da oɓo n mi kpeyolo n yesu kristi tukwo .
yohanna wa gye mwa-mwa dagayi nyipyeyi nu ɓei , mi-i gawo mwa-mwa , esa fyewyi mawo begye yakwo n mi avun , begye n wo n gye a bye kna-knaci .
kwoi ci ge , ominu zhin a n z yi .
kmisunyi n kmazoyi , nna vun ma wowo woi cige , ka anya vinya n ha gye , ha tnun n ho wasika yi n na ikklisiya ngun tnaba aba , n ɓa fi n turki nyi .
ikklisiya n afisus , n doi n kwo dna n simiruna nyi , n na adoyi n ɓa fi n pargamus , thiatira , sardisu , filadalfiya , n lawudikiya yi nyi . esa n mi ɓei kpe awye ma gye oza n wo daɓo n miyi , nɓo n mi avun ma gye a kandle busi ngun tnaba zinariya nya , n gni agni zhin .
ma gye zaho gni agni dna n ɓa atasin , ngye yesu nwo yi wohin ge , oza nugun , n eje yakwoyi kpe n cei pa n na agu n zinariya belt yi .
owo apita nwu n bui-bui ngye lulu kwo snow , owo awye wu ngye ena gwogwoyi .
owo apita ɓai bmiyana n gye sinkna byei prnia-pmiaiya .
owo begye kwoi sawyi ngye a nuwandokwo n ɓa luya n na akuta .
wo n na a kpasi tnabayi shi n wo bwai-zhe bwa , n ebe yakwoi shi n gyi-gyi-yi asepa aba-ba n owo gbe , owo awyeba ɓai bmiyana ngye nyi-pyei n kwo wo n tna anyi n ɓa ɓa gwo kwo ya .
esa n mi ɓei gyewo ncei .
ma miya shi n wo apita ba ngye zafi , amma wa tomi bwa n wo bwaizhebwai wa cimi ge , to wo ednan , kwoda yake emi nu zhin , kmisunyi n kmaknayi .
wye-wyeyi da n wo ɓei fi , woi wye-wyeyi lo nsai ye nyalonyalo , n wo n na a mabudi anapi nya yi n efi nyai nyi to wo ednan .
ka enya n ho ye bwagye nyi , n na anyai n na ɓa wuho esafyewyi .
akpasu tnaba n ha gye n mi bwai-zhe bwa nyi , n na kandle busiyi ngun tnaba nyi , oɓa awyega nu nyi .
akpasu ngun tnaba oɓanu zhin a ikklisiya tukwoda ngun tnaba , a kandle busi ngun tnaba , oɓa nu zhin a ikklisiya .
littafi ye kpe anya , anyaya n ɓa ɓa zhin esa fyewyi , n yesu kristi asesemi , shekwoyi ɓei ga wo izini ge wo kpe ɓa nya ya wu yohanna owo bara .
a tnu n malaikayi n eshe wa ɓe wa wu wo oɓa awyega .
yohanna wa kaɓa kpe vinya , shekwoyi ɓeda , n yesu kristi yi n na aɓei vinya n wo ɓei wo , woi ce woi gye .
nha ba anabci ye dna ikklisiya ai wo , ho ɓa gwo anabarka n dagayi .
aza nɓa wo ɓa knatunbua ɓa zhin oɓo n kwa da ɓa bwa anabarka .
gama esa la wo viwyi n na aɓeye vinya ɓa zhin .
daga yohanna , zuwa a ekilisiya n gun tnaba n ɓa fi n asiya nyi , turki .
omi anugundo , alheri , n bugbafuyi , nɓa kun n shekwoyi aba , nwo nyi nyi , n wo ɓei nyi , woi ye wa ɓe , n na zafun ngun tnabayi nɓa zhi n wo abye nyi .
n yesu kristi yi n wa nu egbe woi wuyi gaiciya vinya nyi .
owo nu zhin kmisunyi n wo ɓei lakala n efi , to wa shan fin .
wo du esu dohodohoyilo n esayi vinya , n wa loyiya , n yi alaifi , shi wa ze owo ami ya ntu yi ɓo nyi .
wola yi yezhi fi n owo ebemi , wa zeyi a pirist shekwoyi owo dada anya .
fye gawo mwa-mwa nyalo-nyal-o nya , wo gyi ebe nyalonyalo amin .
gyewye , wo zhilo , n na anyi yi shewo gun , awye vinya ɓa gyewo , e , aza nɓa ɓei fin wo eshanyi , akni vinya ɓei cibwi ɓai wun bugba esa nwa ɓe ncei .
e , amin , ko ze nlonu .
ominu zhin a n z yi , kmisunyi n kmaknayi , anya vinya n ya shekwoyi na dace n wo zhin dagayi nyi , oza nwo ikoyi vinya nyi , n wo nyin , woi ɓei nyi , woi ɓelo njesun .
ominu , efye zado , yohanna , wahala kun-sunyi ntu n yesu ɓo , n wo ka fye wasika ye , emihin ce , mila hakuri bwa n yesu ga , yi ɓei gyi ebe n woyi .
mi ɓei tu n muse n na yi kwo ge batmus , n na ɓei nyami ya ntu ge mi zhin shekwoyi ɓeda waʼazi , mi-i da oɓo n mi kpeyolo n yesu kristi tukwo .
dagayi nyipyeyi nu ɓei , mi-i gawo mwa-mwa , esa fyewyi mawo begye yakwo n mi avun , begye n wo n gye a bye kna-knaci .
kwoi ci ge , ominu zhin a n z yi .
kmisunyi n kmazoyi , nna vun ma wowo woi cige , ka anya vinya n ha gye , ha tnun n ho wasika yi n na ikklisiya ngun tnaba aba , n ɓa fi n turki nyi .
ikklisiya n afisus , n doi n kwo dna n simiruna nyi , n na adoyi n ɓa fi n pargamus , thiatira , sardisu , filadalfiya , n lawudikiya yi nyi . esa n mi ɓei kpe awye ma gye oza n wo daɓo n miyi , nɓo n mi avun ma gye a kandle busi ngun tnaba zinariya nya , n gni agni zhin .
ma gye zaho gni agni dna n ɓa atasin , ngye yesu nwo yi wohin ge , oza nugun , n eje yakwoyi kpe n cei pa n na agu n zinariya belt yi .
owo apita nwu n bui-bui ngye lulu kwo snow , owo awye wu ngye ena gwogwoyi .
owo apita ɓai bmiyana n gye sinkna byei prnia-pmiaiya .
owo begye kwoi sawyi ngye a nuwandokwo n ɓa luya n na akuta .
wo n na a kpasi tnabayi shi n wo bwai-zhe bwa , n ebe yakwoi shi n gyi-gyi-yi asepa aba-ba n owo gbe , owo awyeba ɓai bmiyana ngye nyi-pyei n kwo wo n tna anyi n ɓa ɓa gwo kwo ya .
esa n mi ɓei gyewo ncei .
ma miya shi n wo apita ba ngye zafi , amma wa tomi bwa n wo bwaizhebwai wa cimi ge , to wo ednan , kwoda yake emi nu zhin , kmisunyi n kmaknayi .
wye-wyeyi da n wo ɓei fi , woi wye-wyeyi lo nsai ye nyalonyalo , n wo n na a mabudi anapi nya yi n efi nyai nyi to wo ednan .
ka enya n ho ye bwagye nyi , n na anyai n na ɓa wuho esafyewyi .
akpasu tnaba n ha gye n mi bwai-zhe bwa nyi , n na kandle busiyi ngun tnaba nyi , oɓa awyega nu nyi .
akpasu ngun tnaba oɓanu zhin a ikklisiya tukwoda ngun tnaba , a kandle busi ngun tnaba , oɓa nu zhin a ikklisiya .
ka wasika ga ikklisiya tukwoda n afisus ha gnawo ge : mika ma gna ho tnu-tnu n kwo gmi n wo aba n wo zan-zan dna n na ikklisiya nyi , nɓa tukwo-dai shi n wo bwai-zhe bwa nyi .
wo ciho ge , mikpe lo shiho zhin aɓo manayi nsun , miku gye oho kukari n hakuri yi , mi kpelo hota ye n laifiyi n ho aza aban , hoi la aza pmi nɓa ci ge ɓa zhin atnu-tnu-yi ɓai to zhinɓa nun , ho ku kpe n gye shiɓa ce a kata .
hoku wahala sin ntu mi ɓo , to hoi fa min .
amma enya lo gmanyi n kwo wunya lo , ho ye milo ngye kmisunyin .
zhin nubo n esai n ho ɓei kmi mi ye nyi , kwo shandolo nsai ye , ha je zeɓe dami , ha zhin tnu-tnu shi ho ɓei shin zhin , kwo maɓe ma gni ho kandle busiya n na a eklisiya aje .
amma oɓo lo n ho aba n kwo bmiyalo : hota ye n nikolawuya ashakpe yin , shi mi ta ye nyin .
fa ɓedaye kwa lo zaho-zahoi tnubua n wo kna tunbua woi wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya .
oza n wa gyi nasara , miɓa gawo , shinwa wye-wyeyi nya n kwo dna n shekwoyi paradise wagyi . kwo lo ikklisiya tukwoda aba n simiruna : tnu-tnuye gmi n o-wo aba nu nwo zhin kmisunyi n kmazoyi , n wo ɓei la fi wa lakala n wye-wyeyi nyi .
mikpelo shi ho sin wahala ntu dagayi ɓo nsun , mikpe oho awye kwoye lo , ( amma ho n nabwa eshe nyayi lo . ) mi kpe aza kwoce dnai yelo n ɓa gni apa-pa n hoi nyi , nɓa gna ge ɓa zhin a yahudiyi nyi shekwoyi aɓi , ɓai to zhin owo aɓi nun , gama ɓa ce shetan zokwo golo .
to zhin wahala dnawo n ho ye ha sin nyin , gama esa fyewyi shetan ɓa she a zaho yafi n kurkuku wa mwi fye gye .
aɓa ga fye wahala anyi-pyei ngun awo .
la mi gni , ha nu egbe kwo efiyi nu , mihin ce mi ɓa gaho rawani wye-wyeyi nya .
abye , mwa-mwa tna zo yi .
fa zahozahoi n wo wo atnubua ɓo wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya .
oza n wo gyi nasara .
efi bayi ta gye wo wyen . ka wasikaye ga ikklisiya tukwoda n pargamus : tnu-tnuye gmi n oza banu nwo ebeyakwoyi shi ngyi-gyi yi abwa aba-ba nyi .
mi kpelo ge ho dna n ezhi nu n shetan n gyi ebe , shetan mwa-mwa ga aba a tasin , har hoi vimi , to hoi ye ha nami aɓo m , kwo esa n antibas , emi seida zhinyi , gbenuyi ɓei fi n na shetan a viyi akun .
ama mi na ɓei shilo n hoi , ho fa aza ho nɓa wu aza ge ɓa zhin shi bilamu ɓei zhin , wa wu balak shi wo ɓa bwi a israilayi aɓi dna n na anagbayi zokwo , wa ga ɓa bugba kala nge ɓa lo ashangba ba .
e , ho n na azayi filo n ɓa vi balamu efye .
shan oho bugbado n ho aɓezhin yi , kwo kuwa maɓe oho aba ntna esa dnayi , ma sunkun n ɓai n ebeyakwo emi egbe nyai .
fa oza nwo wo atnubua ɓo wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya .
oza nwa gyi nasara , wo ɓa gyi n manna n kwo so shinyi .
asiri lafiya ganya n kwo soshi n eshe mi nyi , ma ga zaho-zahoi kuta buyi , n kuta yi mi ɓei ka eye tu n zahota kpe kwo yen , sai : oza n wa bwa kwo . ka wasikaye ga ikklisiya tukwoda n tiyatara : tnu-tnuye gmi n shekwoyi nugun abanu , n wo awye gye wyeba ngye ena nyintala nyi , nwo apita wu ngye sinkna byei nagyi yi .
mi kpeho atnu-tnu amanayi yelo .
oho bmazhin n na awyekwoi aba .
oho cauta n tnull-tnu yi n ɓa aba , njesun mikpeho , ye-ye yelo , n gaiciya gayi n hankuriyi , mi gye she abye gyilo dna n na aɓeye n ho zhinyi .
amma mi n na aɓeyi shilo game n hoyi , ho fa nyikwozayi jezebe , n wo yi wohin ge anabi woi wu emi abara nge anagbai to zhin ɓenukwoyi nun , woi ye ena fiɓa nge ɓa zhin cegye tnu-tnu , nge ɓagyi enya n na ala zunsha ga ashan .
ma gawo esa nge wo shan owo bugba do n wo aɓe zhin-zhin yi gye ho anuwan n eɓei n mi danyi , mi ɓa wan wo gye tu n gado n nyasan nukwoi , ngnisun n wo aviyi , akpe ɓa pmi ɓe dami njesun , ɓa ye abwi alaifi n ɓaku zhin n woi nyi .
mi ɓa wu wo aɓi eklisiya vinya ɓa kpe ge emi nu dna aza abugba wye n ɓa anubo-zhinya , miɓa ga zaho-zahoi n fye mi nya n kwo kunce .
ofye nfye ce fi n tiyatara nyi , fyei to vi ababwi ye pyanyin , ( a gaiciya loloyi , shiɓa yiɓa nwu , ama shetan aɓo aloloyi nu ) mita shan-fye ɓeho nyan fye ku enya shi n kalai nfye cei , kafin mi ɓe .
oza-n wa gyi nasara , wa zhin oɓo n kwo dami har nyipyei kmaknayi , miɓa ga wo iko tu n na akni tukwo .
wo ɓei gyi ebe tu n ɓa tukwo n sinknanya bwai , shi emi dada gami iko tu n ɓa tukwo , aɓei ɓa ɓaya ngye shakun , n na ɓakwo ya wyiwo-wyiwo nyi .
miɓa gawo kpasu labminya !
fa ozaho-zahoyi nwo wo atnubua ɓo , wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya . ka wasika ga ikklisiya tukwoda n afisus ha gnawo ge : mika ma gna ho tnu-tnu n kwo gmi n wo aba n wo zan-zan dna n na ikklisiya nyi , nɓa tukwo-dai shi n wo bwai-zhe bwa nyi .

miɓa gawo kpasu labminya !
fa ozaho-zahoyi nwo wo atnubua ɓo , wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya .
zuwa ikklisiya tukwoda n sardisu : tnu-tnuye gmi n oza aba nu nwo n na zafun shekwoyi nyai n gun tnabai shi , n na a kpasu yi n gun tnaba .
mi kpe hoye lo n ge ikklisiya wye-wyeyi n tnutnu-zhinyi , amma ho fifi yilo .
nsaiye kun agyewyi la enya n kwo ce gnilo nyi kwo la gafi .
oho atnutnu mwakpalo n ɓemanayi n shekwoyi awyeba .
jeze lo da enya n ho ɓei wo ha ga gaiciya n kmisunyi , la kwo shi deidei ha jeze ɓe da mi n jesun , mi ɓa , ɓe daho n tna esa dnai ngye evi , ma taho .
e , har nsai ye azaho n sardisu ɓato gmi oɓa aje amwi n anyi cegye yi n , ɓa ɓa zan-zan n mi yi n na aje abuyi ntuge ɓa kunce lo .
ozahozahoyi n wa gyi nasara , aɓei kpewo aje abuyi , mi to ɓei wun owo eye ya n littafi wye-wyeyi nyan , amma mi ɓei zhin wo se-ida n emi dada abye n wo a malaikayi nge wo zhin emi nya nu .
fa aza vinya n ɓa wo atnubua ɓo ɓa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya .
ka wasikaye ge tukwoda nwo dna n eklisiya n filadalfiya nyi : ʼtnu-tnu ye nkwo nyi oza n wo gyi-gyi-yi , n gaiciya yi n dawuda makuliyi shi , wa gu enya ya n zaho ta mi n gun , wa gu enya n zaho ta mi n guyan , wonu na tnu . ʼ mikpeho yelo sarai , hoto n kalayi lon , ama hoku kukari zhin ha zhin oɓo n mi da , hoi to na emi eye aɓon , ntucenu mila abokun-mi guho ya n zaho ta gun .
wo ga , miɓa tu azayi tile n ɓa ce shetan zokwo gwolo ɓai gwo gna ge ɓa zhin emi nya nu nyi ( amma ɓato zhin emi anya nun ɓace akatanu , ) ɓa ya zhi n ho a pita ba ɓakpe nge oho nu zhin oza n mi ye .
ntuge hoku ɓo vi n hakuriyi ko da yace ho sin wahala lo ntucenu mi ɓa guho n wahala yakwo esa n jarabai nkwo ɓaɓe n na anyi tukwo a mwi zaho-zahoi gye n wo n wyewyeyi .
shi wye , mi ɓelo esa fyewyi , kushi dei-dei enya nho n cei lo n hakalayi n na bai n zaho ta gwoho oho rawanin .
oza n wa gyi nasara , miɓa ze wo jigo n mi shekwoyi yakun , nyaho ta bwawon wo ta shagmin nyalo-nyalo miɓa ka emi shekwoyi eye tu n wo , wa ze ekni ɓi n emi shekwoyi aba .
woɓei bwa emi eye n katu n wo .
fa oza n wo n na atnubuai wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya . ka wasikaye ga ikklisiya tukwoda n lawudikiya : tnu-tnuye gmi n oza aba nu n wo gni agni n kalayi , seida zhinyi egbe nuyi , gaiciya dayi ( n na anya vinya nɓa nyi , kwo ɓei nyi , kwo n kwoye ɓeɓe lo ) shekwoyi nyazhin yi kmisunyi .
mi kpe hoyelo sarai , hoto pyena lon , hoi to fu-fui lon .
awo mi pwa ngye ho ye gunna lo kwo n fufuyi .
amma shi ho wolo bwala-bwala n u nyi , mi ɓa kunho ya n emi egbe .
ʼha cige , ʼmin nyabwayilo , n na anya , vinya n mi n cei pma . ʼ hota kpelo ge dna n zafun ho zhin wyekwoyi nu , enya sun-sun nyan , wyebuai , bwotoloi n .
omi shaula nho aba okwonu ha si zinariya hin-hin n mi , n na alakwo pmiaya n ena yi , nsayi nu nho ɓa ze nyabwayi , hi-hin , hasi n mi , a je abui n gyi-gyi-yi , n nabai n hota gni n bwotolo yin , n vinyikwo yin , ha bwa shigbe n mi kwa kaho awyesan gna , kwa jeze ɓeho n wyeba gyei .
mi zhin ma ta ozaho-zho yi nmi ye , ntu ce nu nɓa ta ho , akpe ha je ze n ɓenukwoyi zokwo , ha zan aɓo shin nɓa zhin shekwoyi nya .
shiwye esa la mi sun gni n na abokun mi , mi-i lu , oza-ho-zaho-yi n wa wo mi yiwo wa gu abaya , mi ɓa ɓe dawo ya zhin zumunta n woi , owo n miyi .
mi ɓa ye zaho-zahoi n wa gyi nasara wa sasetu n miyi n mi akujara-ebenya shi mi ɓei sase tu n gnisun n mi dada nyi n mi ɓei gyi nasara nyi .
fa zaho-zahoyi n wo wo atnubua ɓo wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a eklisiya . zuwa ikklisiya tukwoda n sardisu : tnu-tnuye gmi n oza aba nu nwo n na zafun shekwoyi nyai n gun tnabai shi , n na a kpasu yi n gun tnaba .
mi kpe hoye lo n ge ikklisiya wye-wyeyi n tnutnu-zhinyi , amma ho fifi yilo .
nsaiye kun agyewyi la enya n kwo ce gnilo nyi kwo la gafi .
oho atnutnu mwakpalo n ɓemanayi n shekwoyi awyeba .
jeze lo da enya n ho ɓei wo ha ga gaiciya n kmisunyi , la kwo shi deidei ha jeze ɓe da mi n jesun , mi ɓa , ɓe daho n tna esa dnai ngye evi , ma taho .
e , har nsai ye azaho n sardisu ɓato gmi oɓa aje amwi n anyi cegye yi n , ɓa ɓa zan-zan n mi yi n na aje abuyi ntuge ɓa kunce lo .
ozahozahoyi n wa gyi nasara , aɓei kpewo aje abuyi , mi to ɓei wun owo eye ya n littafi wye-wyeyi nyan , amma mi ɓei zhin wo se-ida n emi dada abye n wo a malaikayi nge wo zhin emi nya nu .
fa aza vinya n ɓa wo atnubua ɓo ɓa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya .
ka wasikaye ge tukwoda nwo dna n eklisiya n filadalfiya nyi : ʼtnu-tnu ye nkwo nyi oza n wo gyi-gyi-yi , n gaiciya yi n dawuda makuliyi shi , wa gu enya ya n zaho ta mi n gun , wa gu enya n zaho ta mi n guyan , wonu na tnu . ʼ mikpeho yelo sarai , hoto n kalayi lon , ama hoku kukari zhin ha zhin oɓo n mi da , hoi to na emi eye aɓon , ntucenu mila abokun-mi guho ya n zaho ta gun .
wo ga , miɓa tu azayi tile n ɓa ce shetan zokwo gwolo ɓai gwo gna ge ɓa zhin emi nya nu nyi ( amma ɓato zhin emi anya nun ɓace akatanu , ) ɓa ya zhi n ho a pita ba ɓakpe nge oho nu zhin oza n mi ye .
ntuge hoku ɓo vi n hakuriyi ko da yace ho sin wahala lo ntucenu mi ɓa guho n wahala yakwo esa n jarabai nkwo ɓaɓe n na anyi tukwo a mwi zaho-zahoi gye n wo n wyewyeyi .
shi wye , mi ɓelo esa fyewyi , kushi dei-dei enya nho n cei lo n hakalayi n na bai n zaho ta gwoho oho rawanin .
oza n wa gyi nasara , miɓa ze wo jigo n mi shekwoyi yakun , nyaho ta bwawon wo ta shagmin nyalo-nyalo miɓa ka emi shekwoyi eye tu n wo , wa ze ekni ɓi n emi shekwoyi aba .
woɓei bwa emi eye n katu n wo .
fa oza n wo n na atnubuai wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a ikklisiya . ka wasikaye ga ikklisiya tukwoda n lawudikiya : tnu-tnuye gmi n oza aba nu n wo gni agni n kalayi , seida zhinyi egbe nuyi , gaiciya dayi ( n na anya vinya nɓa nyi , kwo ɓei nyi , kwo n kwoye ɓeɓe lo ) shekwoyi nyazhin yi kmisunyi .
mi kpe hoyelo sarai , hoto pyena lon , hoi to fu-fui lon .
awo mi pwa ngye ho ye gunna lo kwo n fufuyi .
amma shi ho wolo bwala-bwala n u nyi , mi ɓa kunho ya n emi egbe .
ʼha cige , ʼmin nyabwayilo , n na anya , vinya n mi n cei pma . ʼ hota kpelo ge dna n zafun ho zhin wyekwoyi nu , enya sun-sun nyan , wyebuai , bwotoloi n .
omi shaula nho aba okwonu ha si zinariya hin-hin n mi , n na alakwo pmiaya n ena yi , nsayi nu nho ɓa ze nyabwayi , hi-hin , hasi n mi , a je abui n gyi-gyi-yi , n nabai n hota gni n bwotolo yin , n vinyikwo yin , ha bwa shigbe n mi kwa kaho awyesan gna , kwa jeze ɓeho n wyeba gyei .
mi zhin ma ta ozaho-zho yi nmi ye , ntu ce nu nɓa ta ho , akpe ha je ze n ɓenukwoyi zokwo , ha zan aɓo shin nɓa zhin shekwoyi nya .
shiwye esa la mi sun gni n na abokun mi , mi-i lu , oza-ho-zaho-yi n wa wo mi yiwo wa gu abaya , mi ɓa ɓe dawo ya zhin zumunta n woi , owo n miyi .
mi ɓa ye zaho-zahoi n wa gyi nasara wa sasetu n miyi n mi akujara-ebenya shi mi ɓei sase tu n gnisun n mi dada nyi n mi ɓei gyi nasara nyi .
fa zaho-zahoyi n wo wo atnubua ɓo wa wo oɓo n zafun gna a eklisiya .
oshe a bokunmi nguyagni a shi mi ɓei shi awye ma gye abokunmi n guya gni n she , mawo begye n mi ɓei shinwo nyi , kwo ɓei wo n gye abye knaknaci yakwo , kwa daɓo n miyi kwa ci ge , ɓe ya ma wu ho aɓo nɓa ɓa zhin n na abye . nsayi-sayi , mi dna n zafun , n ɓo n eshe ma gye , okwo mwa-mwa , esushikpe-gye n zahoi sasetu nkwo .
ena buzangna yakwo ɓei kun n owo n gye ɓa kun n diamond na bmiya yi , n shanyin-pmana yi kwoi bmiyana n shewo shinkpegye gun .
esu ashinkpegye a ɓiyi n gun shiba cei anyi n she esu shinkpegye dnagmayi gun , n na atukwodai ʼshiba-cei-anyi n sase kpe n ɓa , n na ajei kpe n bui-bui n rawani zinariya nya yi wan n ɓa tukwo .
o gma-na bmiya n ogma-wyisai ɓei kun n wo shinkpegye , a begye ɓei fi n ogmawyisai .
nwo shikpegye abye , afitila n gun tnaba n wan enazhi , ɓa zhin misali zafun ngun tnaba shekwoyi anya .
n nuwan yakwoyi n wu ngye cristal kwoyi kun n shinkpegye-esu nya .
anya awye-wyeyi n gun anyi n zhi n wo shinkpegye aba , n na aba ngun anyi , ɓai ɓe n na awyei , avun n abye yi .
nya wye-wyeyi kmisunyi ɓei wu ngye gaba , bayi ɓei wu n gye nakwo ɓiyi , tayi ɓei n na awyebai n gye gbagyiza .
nyiyi n wu n gye zunkwo n na abminai laya ngye kwo gye afu .
doho-dohoi n na anya a wye-wyeyi ye n na abminai gyi ngun tnanyi , oɓa abmina atasinya n fuya n na awyei , sukwo n nyipyei ɓai ci ge gyi-gyi-yi , gyi-gyi-yi , gyi-gyi-yi dagayi shekwoyi ikoda , oza n wo ɓei nyi , n wo lo , owoi nu zhin ɓeɓeyi .
esa n na anya a wye-wyeyi a ga mwa-mwa , latu n godiyai n oza aba nwo tu n esu-shinkpegye , n wo n wye-wyeyi nyalo-nyalo nyi .
a tukwoda shiba cei anyi ye , ɓa miya zhi n wo abye ɓa gawo mwa-mwa , wye-wyeida nyalo-nyalo nya ɓa ya oɓa a rawani zhi n wo abye , ɓai kwo anyi ɓai cige .
o , dagayi ho k uncelo ha gwo mwa-mwa n latuyi n ikoyi , gama ohonu na zhin anya vinya .
aɓei zhin ɓa ɓa bwa wye-wyeyi dna n ho ɓeye nu .
a shi mi ɓei shi awye ma gye abokunmi n guya gni n she , mawo begye n mi ɓei shinwo nyi , kwo ɓei wo n gye abye knaknaci yakwo , kwa daɓo n miyi kwa ci ge , ɓe ya ma wu ho aɓo nɓa ɓa zhin n na abye . nsayi-sayi , mi dna n zafun , n ɓo n eshe ma gye , okwo mwa-mwa , esushikpe-gye n zahoi sasetu nkwo .

kugya n littafi yi ma gye takarda n kmishi n za bwaizhe nwo sase tu n esul shinkpegye nyi , takarda n kmishi nya yi kafi n mi n ebmi yi , n cei gugui n na hatimiyi ngun tnaba .
malaʼika kalada wa sawyi n begye lyakwoyi wa nyaɓo ge , nyikado nu kuncelo wa sa hatumi ye ya n takarda kmi-kmiyi , wa lokwoya ? ama to a bwa zaknayi n eshemi vinya , kwo dna n na anyi n wo kuncen , kwo dna n na a zafi n woɓa gu kwoya wa ba kwon .
ma ci bwi n bugba wunyi , ntuge zaho to lo n bwaho nwo kuncen wa gnayi oɓo n kwo kafin .
ama zaknayi n na a tukwoda shiba cei anyi yi , wa gna mi ge , mila bwi fa gama gyewye !
gaba yahuda ebye nya , dawuda gbegye , nku nasara gyi , woi ku wu ngye wo kun celo wa gu takarda kmi-kmiyi ye ya , wa bma kwo a hatimi tnabaye ya . ma shi awye magye , kugya n gni-agni-gni n a tukwoda shiba cei anyi yi abye , n esu shinkpegye n a nya awye-wyeyi abye , kugya yi n na acigusai kpe n ɓa ɓei wu wo n sadohoi .
wo n na amwai tnaba , n na awyeyi tnaba , n ɓa zhin misali n na zafun ngun tnabai shekwoyi anya , n na tnu n cei n sepa dohodohoyi n na anyi .
wa lakala ɓe abye wa gwo takarda kmi-kmiyi n za akun n wo ɓei sase tu n esu-shinkpegye nyi .
shi wo ɓei gwo takarda kmi-kmiyi a tukwoda shiba cei anyi ho , ɓa yazhi n kugya yi abye , zaho-zahoi n ɓa mi n molo yi shi n zinariya papai n tulare yifi , shekwoyi aza aduwa .
ɓa kwo anyi woi ge , ho kuncelo i hala takarda kmi-kmiyi .
ha lo hatimi ya ha gu kwo ya .
gama aɓei la ho zun sha , oho ami n la aza si gaho n na abye vinya , ngye nyaga ntu n shekwoyi ɓo .
hoi la ɓa yezhi n ebemi , hoi ku ɓa ze a pristi ieyi shekwoyi anya , ɓa ɓei gyi ebe tu n na anyi tukwo . dna n mi ɓewyegye , mawo amalaika n mwa-begye n na wye !
wyeyi dayi n na tukwodayi , ɓai kwo anyi .
kugya n na aɓei zunsha .
wo kuncelo wa gwo iko , n kalai , n latuyi , n mwa-mwai n anabarka yi .
nna vun mawo aza vinya n eshe nanyi yi , n na a zafiyi n ekni mi , n na anuwan yakwoyi ɓai gna , anabarka , n mwa-mwai , n latu yi , n ikoi , zhin oza nya nu n wo sase tu n esu-shinkpegye nyi , n kugyai nyalonyaloi . awye-wyeyi da ɓai ci ge , amin .
