shekwoyi bara gaiciya nya ma gye a malaika ngun anyi n gni agni zhin n anyi abwakwonu n gun anyi , ɓai hana n esei ge kwo to cin n na anyi , n na bai kwo fintolo ta shan-shan , a nuwanyi to ɓei ci aɓon , ɓa ku wo pi-pi-pi .
ma gye malaika do woi gmi n nyipyeyi kpe bwa , n hatimi yakwo shekwoyi wye-wyeyi danya yi shi .
wa sawyi dna a malaika yi ngun anyi n na ɓei gaba iko ɓa ga anyi n na anuwan yakwoi nyasan nyi .

mawo oɓa begye , , n israila abye awo cei aba vinya .

esa n kugya ɓei lo hatimi tnabai ya , aku ce pi fi n eshe mi ngye minti shita .
ma gye amalaika tnaba nɓa zhi shekwoyi abye nyi , a ga ɓa a mwayi ngun tnaba .
nnavun malaika nwo n zinariya shapai shinyi wa ɓe wa gni n bagadi i aba a gawo a tulare ge wa gmi kwo aje n shekwoyi aza aduwa yi , wa ze kpe n bagadi zinariya nya n esushinkpegye abye .
tulare yiho ashin kwo ɓedo n shekwoyi aza wyegyi yi nyi , kwa gunlo shekwoyi aba daga bagadi aba n malaika ɓei zekwoya kpe .
nna vun malaika wa ce ena n bagadi wa fi kwo n shanpa wa zekwoya kpe n anyi ogma bmiya , anyi ɓa shan-shan .
nnavun , amalaika ngun tnaba n ɓa n na a mwayi tnabai shinyi ɓa zhin shiri ɓa bye a mwayi .
malaika kmisunyi wa bye owo mwayi aze agma-kuta ya n enayi , n gmi aje n amiyi fi n anyi .
anyi ajegna ngun ata .
kwa gwo ena shinwan ajegna ngun ata ena gyi ɓa n na agbe-gbe putuyi vinya .
malaika bayi wa bye wo mwayi , a she nyaho ya dna n ela ngye epe yakwo nagyiyi , kwa wun aya nuwan ajegna ngun ata ya , ela ajegna ngun ata kwa wu ngye ami , awyesala ajegna ngun ata ɓafi .
malaika tayi wa bye mwayi kpasu yakwo nagyi yi kwa kaya n eshe tu anuwan n adnayi ajegna ngun ata .
ayi kpasuyi ge , bedobedoyi , ntuge kwo ɓei fi emwi a nuwan ajegna ngun ata , aza n mwa begye ɓafi .
malaika nyiyi wa bye owo mwai , n sai-sai yi , nyipyeyi ajegna ngun ata kwa dnawye-gma n epya yi n na akpasu ajegnayi ngun ata , n na abai nyipyei a dna wyegma sukwo kwa gna wyegma dna-dna .
shi mi ɓei shi awye magye zunkwo , nkwo gmanyi n na anyi bmana , kwoi sa ewyi n begye kalai ge , owyi-owyi , owyi n na aza aba nɓa fi n na anyi nyin , ntu a na aɓo a nukwoyi ɓo n ɓa ɓelo esa fyewyi nyi , esa n na amalaika ngun ata-ka ɓa amwayi bye n ɓa cenyi . esa n kugya ɓei lo hatimi tnabai ya , aku ce pi fi n eshe mi ngye minti shita .

shi mi ɓei shi awye magye zunkwo , nkwo gmanyi n na anyi bmana , kwoi sa ewyi n begye kalai ge , owyi-owyi , owyi n na aza aba nɓa fi n na anyi nyin , ntu a na aɓo a nukwoyi ɓo n ɓa ɓelo esa fyewyi nyi , esa n na amalaika ngun ata-ka ɓa amwayi bye n ɓa cenyi .
obwo tnaceyi n navun malaika tnuyi wa bye owo mwayi , ma gye oza woi kaya n eshe dna n na anyi a gawo makuli obwo dnagmayi tna cei nya .
shiwo ɓei gu kwoya , awu ɓa kun ya ngye apinagyi yakwo ho , nyipyeyi n eseyi ɓa dna wyegma ntu n awui ɓo .
aɓo ɓa kun ɓe n awu yi a ga ɓa iko ɓa kni aza ngye anapisi .
a gna ɓa ge ɓato kni agbe-gben , kwo shinwan doho-dohoyin , amma ɓa kni aza nɓa to n shekwoyi hatimi yi tulo n ɓa nyikunmin .
ato ɓei ye ge ɓa wu ɓan , amma ɓa wuɓa anyi apya ngun atnu shi napisin san n wu nyi .
dna anyipyeyihi mi , aza ɓei zhin atna ɓa wu ɓahin , ama ɓato ɓei min efi to ɓei ɓen .
ɓa ɓei ye ɓa fi , amma efi ɓo la busi .
aɓo hi ɓo wu ngye a dokwo n na zhin-zhinyi n gye ɓa lo kun , n na anya hoi kpe n ɓa tukwo n gye rawani zinariya nya , oɓa awyeba wu ngye aza nyikwoci nya .
oɓa oyi n mwakpa ngye anyi-kwoza nya , oɓa anyikna n wu ngye a gaba nya .
ɓa n na akpata yi shi ngye asunkna , oɓa abmina yi ci aɓo ngye a karusa kunsun nya lo okun .
ɓa n na a zhin-zhin yi gyi ngye anapisi n ɓa sesiyi , oɓa kala ɓa ce oza apya ngun atnu fi n ɓa sesi yi nu .
oɓa esu nu zhin esu obwo tnacei nya n na yiwo ibranaciyi nge , abaddon , n helenanciyi apollyo n , ( n nasara gbei nyawunya yi . ) azhin gmanyi nku zo nu , acelo n gun aba .
azafun nukwoyi ngun anyi malaika tnanyi yi wa bye owo mwayi , ma wo begye kwoi daɓo n na amwayi ngun anyi n ɓa gyi n bagadi zinariya nya n kwo gmi n shekwoyi esu-shinkpegye abye nyin .
woi gna malaika tnayi yi , lo aljanu yakwoya n gun anyi n na ɓai pa kpe n ola yakwo affaratis nyi . aɓei zhin shiri zhi ntu n eye ye ɓo nu , n epya yi n nyipyeyi n esayi .
nsai ye , a loɓaya ɓa wu azanyi kwoci ajegna ngun ata nu anyi .
ɓa ye a soja zhi miliyan tagyi n gun aba , ( , , ) mi ɓei ku wo shi ɓaɓei nyi n sun .
magye oɓa adokwo ɓai gnami , dna n mi begye , oɓa gunyi n na akpata byei shi adoho wu ngye anyi a doho wu ngye bmina-bmina , ena n adokwo tukwo nwu ngye agaba nya , awu n ena yi , n sulfa nagyi ɓai kun n ɓa egbe , ɓa wu aza ajegna gun ata vinya .
oɓa iko efi nya to ɓei nyi n ɓa egbe nu gmanyin , ama n ɓa sesiyi , gama oɓa asesi yi ɓei wu ngye awa tukwo nu kpewu , kwoi sa aza har efi .
amma aza nɓa ɓei ce zhin n wye-wyeyi n nato wuɓa n nɓa anyasan dna-gmai yin , to ɓa ye ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwan .
to ɓa na alijanu bauta zhin ɓon , kwo oɓa ashan n ɓa zhin n zinariya yi n azurfa yin , n sinkna byei , n na akutayi , n na ashinwan yin , n ɓa ta mi n zan-zan kwo ɓa daɓon .
to ɓa shan oɓa bugba do tu nɓa azokwo azawu nya , n aguzhenyi yi , anagbai n aviwyi yin .

aku shekwoyi anabi wu a gami busi nyamwi nya , a gnami ge milo mi mwi aduwa nyakun , wato shekwoyi nyakun .
n nyakun omi nya yi n bagadi dnanyi , ma ba a sujada zhinyi .
ama a gnami ge ato mwi akpeda ebmi nyan .
gama ala kwo ga abye do .
ɓa ɓei dna ezhi gyi-gyi-yi har apya shinyi-cei-aba .
mi ɓei ga emi aseida-da ngun aba ɓa zhin anabci , anyipyei , dubu gmanyi n tagyi yi ngun aba n cei kpe shi tnanyi .
( , ) n na aje sakunyi kpe . anabi ngun aba ye nu zhin a zaitun ashinwan ngun aba , nna kandle busiyi ngun aba nɓa gni agni zhi n shekwoyi anyi vinya nya abye nyi .
oza n wa zhin atna wa wuba , ena ɓa kun n ɓa egbe kwa wu wo .
ɓa n ikoyilo ɓa gu eshe to ogma zhin har aye ngun ata n tokunyi ( . ) shi ɓa ɓei zhin anabci .
a pmi , ara n na anuwan yakwoyi ɓa ze ami , ɓa tnu n na anyasan a dnagmayi cici shi ɓa n cei pma .
esa n ɓa ɓei ku zo n ba seida yi aye ngun ata n tokunyi , oza nukwoyi n wo gmiɓe n obwotnanceyi nyi , wo ɓei ya okun n ɓayi , woi gyi nasara n ɓa tukwo woi wuɓa .
oɓa anayi ɓei yakpe n urushelima azokwo yakwo har anyipyeyi ngun ata n tokunyi ( deidei nu n na yikwo ge sodon kwo masar ) aba n na aɓei zun ɓa dagayi dunyi .
ato ɓei ye ge zaho-zahoi wo bi ɓan , aza n mwa begye n na akni do , n ɓa ɓei ɓe ɓai gye ɓa nayi .
aɓei sun n na anyi vinya , aɓei da aza n na ba vinya ɓai zhin aje cauta , ɓai yi aje ɓa yezhi ɓai dagma n tu n na anabi n gun abaye efi ɓo , gama ɓaku wahala gaɓa n mwa .
ama n anyipyeyi ngun ata n tokunyi avun , zafun wye-wyeyi nya n kwo gmi n shekwoyi aba nyi , kwo ɓei lo ɓa mi , ɓa kuka zhin n na agni aza ɓai wo edna n mwa .
n avun begye yakwo ɓei sawyi n eshe , nge , gunzhi ɓe , ɓai kukala gun eshe oɓa nuwunyi gye .
n esa gmanyi-i , anyi ɓei shan-shan ɓai wu ezhi yi ajegna ngun awo , kwoi wu aza dubu tnaba ( , ) , n na vun aza nɓa ce zhi n wye-wyeyi ɓa ɓei wodna n mwa , ɓa ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa , n wo dna n eshe nyi .
owyi , bayi nla duya , ama tayi to shan zegnin .
gama n sayi nu n malaika tnabayi ɓei bye mwayi abegye yakwo ɓai da ɓo n eshe , nge , ebe anyi nya nsai ye zhin , eyi dagayi nyanu n wo kristi yi wa gyi ebe nyalo-nyalo . a tukwoda shiba cei anyi nɓa sase kpe n ashinkpegye-esu nya n shekwoyi abye nyi , ɓa yazhi ɓa ga wo mwa-mwa ɓai gna .
yi zhin godiya , dagayi shekwoyi ikoda nwo nyi , n wo ɓei nyi , nsaye ho la ya ɓebegyi , n ho iko yakwo yi .
akni vinya ɓa gyi minagyi n hoi , ama oho esa nyi n ho ɓa gyi minagyi nɓai , esa la si n ho ɓa da azafi owa , ha ga oho abara lada anabi n na azajei nɓa wo ho eye dna , dnagmayi n nawyi yi vinya , wa wu aza n ɓa ɓe n bwi-bwi yi n na anyi .
n navum dna n eshe , a gu shekwoyi aduwa nyakun ya , n na ɓa gyewo akwati alkawali nya .
ogma bmiya , kwoi sawyi agmakuta yakwoi ɓe , anyi ɓa shan-shan n asha-sha dnagmayi .
a gami busi nyamwi nya , a gnami ge milo mi mwi aduwa nyakun , wato shekwoyi nyakun .

n wo tukwo .
woi gni n nuboi woi fi aku , nyasan kagna nyai sanwo , woi pmi owo kagna .
esa fyewyei dragon byei-byei kwa gmiɓe n na tukwo yi gyi ngun tnaba , n na amwayi gyi ngun awo , n na a rawani yi kun n kwo atukwo agun tnaba .
owo sesi kwa gni akpasu ajegna ngun ata wa yaɓa fi n anyi , wa gni agni n nyikwozayi abye , woi laga oɓi ma , n shiri yi zhin wa gyi oɓi yi n sahoi-sahoi n na mawo n cei .
wa ma oɓi nugbayi n wo ɓa gyi ebe tu n na aza tukwo vinya , n ebwa kalayi a cewo pa , ga shekwoyi n wo esu-shinkpegye yi .
nyikwoza yi wa busi lo bmana , aba n shekwoyi n cei zhiwo , wa shiwo bwa har anyi-pyeyi dubu gmanyi n tagyi gun aba n cei kpe shi tnanyi ( , ) .
asun okun n eshemi , mikaʼilu n na a malaikayi nɓa fi n owo sinta ɓa sun kun n dragon yi n wo amalaika anukwoyi .
a gyi dragon n okun yi , a nyawo ya n eshemi .
dragon yakwoye , owa kwo-kwoi n na yiwo guzhenyi n satan yi nyi , n wo dna anyi vinya kwoce nyi , a shewo ya dna n anyi ɓedo n wo amalaika yi .
navun , mawo begye kwoi sawyi dna n eshe , kwo-ku kma zhin , shekwoyi gni-gni , n ikoi , n ebei , n fukunci kristi nyayi la ɓe n ya , gama owo n wo zhin ɓa sara n shekwoyi abye n sukwoyi n nyipyeyi , alawo sheya dna n anyi .
ɓa gyi nasara n wo tukwo n kugya ami yi nu , n ɓa seidayi gama ɓato ye ɓa wye-wyeyi m , ɓa gakwo ntu wo ɓo .
fye dagma o , eshemi , ofye n fye zhin eshe aɓinyi .
ama aiya n fye aba aza nfye fi n anyi nyi , gama shetan n la ɓe dafye n minagyi yakwoi , ntuge wo kpelo owo esa to ye kun lon . esa n shetan ɓei gye alawo sheya dna n anyi , wa nya nyikwozayi n wa ma oɓi nyi .
ama a gawo a bwase n gun aba ngye zunkwo , wa gye afu lo bmana , aba n na cei zhin gni wo , aba n na ɓei shiwo bwa , ai guwo n owayi , dragon , aye ngun ata n tokunyi .
nuwan yakwo kwa kun n owa yi egbe , kwa zhe yalo nge kwo wan nyikwozayi , n na abai kwa wu wo .
ama ekni kwa bma wo zhin kwa lo egbeya kwa sin nuwan yakwoyi .
nnavun dragon kwa gyiminagyi kwa nya owo aɓi-aje vinya n ɓa vi shekwoyi owa ɓai gna ɓa zhin yesu anya nu .
wa gni woi pmi n ola gbe .
a gye oɓo wo-woyi n eshe n kwo wu aɓo n ɓa ɓa zhin , magye nyikwoza n nyipyeyi kpe , n epyai zhi n wo apita sinta , n na a kpasu rawani yi kun ngun awo cei aba .
n wo tukwo .
woi gni n nuboi woi fi aku , nyasan kagna nyai sanwo , woi pmi owo kagna .
esa fyewyei dragon byei-byei kwa gmiɓe n na tukwo yi gyi ngun tnaba , n na amwayi gyi ngun awo , n na a rawani yi kun n kwo atukwo agun tnaba .
owo sesi kwa gni akpasu ajegna ngun ata wa yaɓa fi n anyi , wa gni agni n nyikwozayi abye , woi laga oɓi ma , n shiri yi zhin wa gyi oɓi yi n sahoi-sahoi n na mawo n cei .
wa ma oɓi nugbayi n wo ɓa gyi ebe tu n na aza tukwo vinya , n ebwa kalayi a cewo pa , ga shekwoyi n wo esu-shinkpegye yi .
nyikwoza yi wa busi lo bmana , aba n shekwoyi n cei zhiwo , wa shiwo bwa har anyi-pyeyi dubu gmanyi n tagyi gun aba n cei kpe shi tnanyi ( , ) .
asun okun n eshemi , mikaʼilu n na a malaikayi nɓa fi n owo sinta ɓa sun kun n dragon yi n wo amalaika anukwoyi .
a gyi dragon n okun yi , a nyawo ya n eshemi .
dragon yakwoye , owa kwo-kwoi n na yiwo guzhenyi n satan yi nyi , n wo dna anyi vinya kwoce nyi , a shewo ya dna n anyi ɓedo n wo amalaika yi .
navun , mawo begye kwoi sawyi dna n eshe , kwo-ku kma zhin , shekwoyi gni-gni , n ikoi , n ebei , n fukunci kristi nyayi la ɓe n ya , gama owo n wo zhin ɓa sara n shekwoyi abye n sukwoyi n nyipyeyi , alawo sheya dna n anyi .
ɓa gyi nasara n wo tukwo n kugya ami yi nu , n ɓa seidayi gama ɓato ye ɓa wye-wyeyi m , ɓa gakwo ntu wo ɓo .
fye dagma o , eshemi , ofye n fye zhin eshe aɓinyi .

wa gni woi pmi n ola gbe .
nyawan-nyawan aɓo wowo ma gye nyawan-nyawan ho kwoi gmi ɓe n nuwan-yakwo , n ina aye awyebwo nyayi kakpe n amwayi ngun awo n a rawani n gun awoyi kun n kwo amwayi ngun awo , n na bara kugya nya aye yi kakpe n kwo atukwo doho-dohoi n ɓa mi kwoi sa shekwoyi ye n cegyei n na akmiyi .
nyawan-nyawanye wu ngye nakmi , ama n apitai wu ngye bear nya , n gaba , egbe yi gyi , dragon kwa gawo wo iko , n esushinkpegye yi , n begyi dnagmayi .
ma gye owo tukwo gmanyi n ciyitu , nkwo ta shan ɓin , ama , eciyi ho kwa ɓi .
ceʼa wo anyi vinya ntu n wo a tnu-tnu awo-woi ɓo n wo zhin nyi aza ɓa vi nyawan-nyawan yi n dnai .
ɓa ga dragon mwa-mwa , ntuge wa gawo ikoyi pya , ɓai ga nyawan-nyawanyi mwa-mwa , ɓai gna , oza lo n kni bwa yi nu ngye owoʼa ?
nkado ɓa mi wa sunkun n owo yiʼa ? nna vun dragon ho wa ga nyawan-nyawan kala n ge wo sa dagayi eye n wyebwoyi , wa gawo iko wa gyi ebe tu n anyi tukwo apya shinyi cei aba .
n sai vinya wa tu shekwoyi eye cegye n wo aduwa nyakunyi n azayi vinya nɓafi n eshe .
dragon wa gawo iko wa sunkun n shekwoyi azayi , wa gyi nasara nɓa tukwo , wa gyi ebe tu n na anyi tukwo vinya , n na abyei vinya , n na anyi .
a zanyikwoci vinya , na ato n ɓa aye yi kafi n kugya wu-wuyi littafi wye-wyeyi nya kafin anyi zhi san , ɓa ga nyawan-nyawan nukwoyi mwa-mwa .
ozaho-zahoyi n wo n na atnubua yi , wo la tnubua kna peceye .
shekwoyi aza n na ɓai zhi n kurkuku ɓo , aɓei wanɓa , ai lo n ɓai , aza n na n ɓai zhi n efi ɓo aɓei wuɓa , amma fyeto wo ednan , gama efye sa nyi hankuri nya n bugba kalayi .
nnavun magye nyafanya ho , kwoyi gmi n ekni , n na amwayi ɓiyi ngun aba , ngye kugya , n begye yakwoi ngye dragon .
wa lo tnu-tnu n nyawan-nyawan ikoyi n eci n lawo ɓinyi , n wo ye anyi vinya ɓa ga wo mwa-mwa nyi .
wo ɓei zhin aɓo wo-woyi , woi zhin ena kwoi kaya ɓe nshe zaho-zahoi woi gye .
wa zhin aɓo awo-woyi ye wo ɓei mi wa dna aza kwoce n na aba vinya , wo ɓei mi woi zhin aɓo a wowoi ye esa vinya n nyawan-nyawan kmisunyi gni woi gye wo .
waga aza wyidna n na anyi nge ɓa zhin nyawan-nyawan kmisunyi dogbe , n na ɓei la wo wu waje lakala nyi .
a gawo izini nge wo ga zazhi-zhinye esun wa zhinkwo kwa da ɓeda .
nnavun nya zhin-zhinye kwa ga wyidna ge oza n wo to ga kwo mwamwan wafi .
wa ga gbe , dnagmayi n nawyi yi , nyabwayi n sanyi , fyenu n dagayi vinya ge aku eze tu zaho-zahoi n bwaizhe , kwo n nyikunmi .
zahozahoyi ta bwa tnu-tnu , kwo wa si nyaho-nyahoyi n gni kwoho n tna tuze yin , n kwo nu zhin nyawan-nyawan yi eye , kwo owo eye tuze .
oɓo ɓednayi nyi sai oza zhin nubo nu kpa oza kpekwoye .
aza n ɓaɓa mi ɓa zhinkwo awyega okwo nu zhin tnanyi-tnanyi a ku ngun ata ( ) wato tagyi tnanyi n cei kpe shi tnanyi cei tnanyi .

magye malaika doho woi gye afu n na anyi bmana , n nabari manayi shi , wa zhin aza waʼazi ba akni doho-doho , n na abyei , n na anyitalayi .
woi sawyi woi gna , wo shekwoyi dna , ha lawo mwa : mwa tu , gama esa lasi nwo ɓa sase tu ngye alkali , ga wo mwa-mwa nwa zhin eshe n na anyi-i nyi , anuwan yakwo n na anyayi vinya nɓa fi n ɓa nyi . malaika doho wa viwo n na avun , n na anyi bmana woi gna , babila n la miya , kwola miya , ezhinyakwoyi gama kwo dna akni anyi nya kwoce , kwa dnaɓa asisi ɓo zhin n laifi yi n mwa . malaika tayi wa viɓa woi sawyi nge , ozaho-zahoyi n wo ga nyawan-nyawan mwa-mwa nkwo gmi n nuwanyi , n wo nya zhin-zhin yi , wa gwo owo zetu , nwo nyikunmi kwo obwa .
tile wa sin nuwan nukwoyi shekwoyi minagyi nya , azekwo fi n tna buyi shekwoyi kop minagyi nya , a ɓei gyi ɓa ena n sulfa yi , n wo amalaika gyi-gyi-yi abye n kugya yi .
awu oɓa azhinya ɓa gun lo eshe nyalo-nyalo , ɓato ɓei shan sun n sukwoyi n nyipyeyi-gama ɓa ga nyawan-nyawan mwa-mwa n wo nya zhin-zhin yi , ɓai la owo eye tuze gwo . fa deye kwa ga shekwoyi aza kala , ɓa zhin hakuri dna n wahala doho-dohoyi n nazhinyi , gama aza n ɓa mi zhi n kalayi dna n wo awyi-dnai vi , ɓai kpema yesu , ɓa zhin aza gyi-gyi-yi nu .
mawo begye n eshe bmana , n mi eshe kwoi cige , ka aɓeye kpe , esa n la si nsai n awo aza a fifiyi ɓa lo oɓa sun-sun , e , zafun nu na da , ɓazhin anabarkada nu , gama nsaiye ɓaɓa sun n ɓa azhin , ntnu-tnuyi , gama oɓa atnu-tnu manayi viɓa lo har eshemi . aɓo ɓa shando , magye a nyin bui-buyi n zahoi sase tu n ɓa n wu ngye yesu , n na ɓei yiwo ge , oza nugun . n rawa ni zinariya , nya yi kun n wo tukwo , n limizhegye gyi-gyi-yi shi n wo akun .
okni nyabye ku bi nnavun malaika gmiɓe n aduwa nyakun wa yi wo , ya apma zhin n limzhegye yi , gama esa n laho si ha ya do , gama ampanyi anyi nya n la ɓi . nsai oza nwo sase tu n na anyi nyi wa dna limzhegye anyi , wa ye ampanyi zhi .
ndeye avun malaika ho woi gmi n aduwanyakun n eshe n limzhegye gyi-gyi-yi shi ce .
dna n sayi malaika , n wo n ikoi wa zo anyi n enai nyi , wa sawyi dna malaika nwo n limizhegye shi nyi zhin akma n ho limzhegye yi nsaiye , ha do anab shinwa anyi nya gama ɓa ku ɓi ntu n owa daɓo . malaika ya limzhegye dna wa do anab wa yezhi n anab abazhinba , n shekwoyi minagyi aba .
a dna anab n kwo aba zhinba nzhi yakwo avun , ami ɓa zeya ngye edna mile tagyi ngun aba ( ) n lo-loyi n kwo ɓa si dokwo lunzami .

musa anyi ɓedo n kugya ɓi yi ma gye n eshe oɓo wowoyi , ai wu oɓo n kwo ɓelo .
a tnu n na a malaika yi ngun tnaba , ɓa ɓe anyi n anyasan a nukwoyi n kma-sun ngun tnaba .
n na vun shekwoyi minagyi kwa zo .
ma gye nyaho tazhi nmi abye n wu ngye ena n maganyi yi , n na azayi gni agni kpe , nɓa ɓo gyi nasara n nyawan-nyawan nukwoyi n owo nya zhin-zhin yi , n wo tuzei n lambai , oɓa vinya n shekwoyi amuloyi shi .
ɓai kwo musa anyi , shekwoyi fyenu n kugya anyi yi , oho aɓo zhin-zhin shekwoyi ikoda , oho azokwo vinya zhin ɓefyece nu n gaiciya yi , o , esu esa vinya nya , nyikado nu tawo edna n ma , o dagayi , wa la oho eye tun ma ?
gama oho nu zhin gyi-gyiyi n ho gmanyi yi .
akni vinya ɓaɓe ɓa ga ho mwa-mwa , gama aku oho aɓo zhin manayi wu . n na avun mashi awye ma gye aba gyi-gyi-yi vinya , n na aduwanyakun n eshe mi , n guya gni .
a malaika ngun tnaba n na ɓei kniɓa ɓa ze anyasan anukwoi ya fi n na anyi ngun tnaba nyi , ɓa kunɓe n aduwa-nyakun yi , n na aje abuyi kpe lonen n ( fan-fan yi ) n tna cegye , n na a belt zinariya nyai pa n na agu .
zaknayi n na a wye-wyeyi da n gun anyi yi ho , wa ga zaho-zahoi nɓa mi papa zinariya nya n nu-nuyi n shekwoyi wye-wyeyi da minagyi yakwoyi , n wo nyi nyalo-nyalo nyi .
aduwanyakun n nung-ni n na wuyi n wo-ikoyi n mwa-mwayi , to zahozahoi wa mi wa lo ɓon , sai a malaika ngun tnaba yi , nku a nyasan nukwoyi ngun tnaba sheya fi n anyi .
ma gye n eshe oɓo wowoyi , ai wu oɓo n kwo ɓelo .
a tnu n na a malaika yi ngun tnaba , ɓa ɓe anyi n anyasan a nukwoyi n kma-sun ngun tnaba .
n na vun shekwoyi minagyi kwa zo .
ma gye nyaho tazhi nmi abye n wu ngye ena n maganyi yi , n na azayi gni agni kpe , nɓa ɓo gyi nasara n nyawan-nyawan nukwoyi n owo nya zhin-zhin yi , n wo tuzei n lambai , oɓa vinya n shekwoyi amuloyi shi .
ɓai kwo musa anyi , shekwoyi fyenu n kugya anyi yi , oho aɓo zhin-zhin shekwoyi ikoda , oho azokwo vinya zhin ɓefyece nu n gaiciya yi , o , esu esa vinya nya , nyikado nu tawo edna n ma , o dagayi , wa la oho eye tun ma ?
gama oho nu zhin gyi-gyiyi n ho gmanyi yi .
akni vinya ɓaɓe ɓa ga ho mwa-mwa , gama aku oho aɓo zhin manayi wu . n na avun mashi awye ma gye aba gyi-gyi-yi vinya , n na aduwanyakun n eshe mi , n guya gni .
a malaika ngun tnaba n na ɓei kniɓa ɓa ze anyasan anukwoi ya fi n na anyi ngun tnaba nyi , ɓa kunɓe n aduwa-nyakun yi , n na aje abuyi kpe lonen n ( fan-fan yi ) n tna cegye , n na a belt zinariya nyai pa n na agu .
zaknayi n na a wye-wyeyi da n gun anyi yi ho , wa ga zaho-zahoi nɓa mi papa zinariya nya n nu-nuyi n shekwoyi wye-wyeyi da minagyi yakwoyi , n wo nyi nyalo-nyalo nyi .
aduwanyakun n nung-ni n na wuyi n wo-ikoyi n mwa-mwayi , to zahozahoi wa mi wa lo ɓon , sai a malaika ngun tnaba yi , nku a nyasan nukwoyi ngun tnaba sheya fi n anyi .
amalaika ngun tnaba mawo begye yakwo kwoi gmi n aduwa-nyakun kwoi daɓo n na amalaika tnabayi , fyelo n saiye fye ze a papa tnaba shekwoyi minagyi nya ya fi n na anyi . nlonu malaika kmisunyi wafa aduwa-nyakun wa ze papa kmisunyi yafi n anyi , a gbago , a cisa nukwoyi a sansanyi , ɓa kunkpe n na aza vinya , nɓa n nyawan-nyawan lambayi lo ɓai ga wo mwa-mwa nwo nya zhin zhinyi .
malaika bayi wa zewo papa yafi n anuwan yako , ɓaku ze ngye oza fifiyi ami , anya vinya nɓa fi n na nuwan yakwo ɓaku fi .
malaika tayiwa ze owo papa yafi n na ala , n na adna ɓiyi vinya , ɓaku ze ami .
mawo malaika a nuwanya woi gna , kwo wulo cewo shi ho tnu n wadaye pya yi , o , oza gyi-gyi-yi , nwo nyi wo ɓei nyi .
gama aku ho aza gyi-gyi-yi n anabi yi wu ai ze oɓa ami ya fi n anyi , nsaiye , n kasun ho ka aza ami zeya nɓa ɓei wu banyi , oɓa lada nu n kwo kunce n ɓai .
mawo malaika nwo gni n bagadi aba nyi woi gna , e dagayi , shekwoyi ikoda oho tata wulo cewo dei-dei . nnavun malaika nyiyi wa ze owo papa ya kpe n nyipyeyi , kwa gyi aza ena n kwo ena yi .
zaho-zahoi vinya okwo ena aku gyiwo , ɓa tu shekwoyi eye ekni n wa tnu n na anyasan dnagmayi nyi , to ɓa shan oɓa bugba don n ɓa aɓe zhin yin , ɓa gawo mwa-mwan .
nna vun malaika tnuyi wa ze owo papa ya kpe n nyawan-nyawan nkwo gmi n nuwanyi , a yakwo ebemi dna n wyegma , owo aviyi vinya ɓai gyi oɓa anyitala ntu n sansan ɓo .
ɓa tu shekwoyi eshe nya ekni ntu nɓa aci ɓo n nyasanyi , ama to ɓa ye abwi n ɓa aɓe nukwoyi zhin ɓon .
malaika tnanyi wa ze owo papa yakpe n ela dnagmanyi .
affratis kwo wo n na bai asu n ɓa nyin n gabas ɓa bwa zokwo ɓa duya n ɓa asojayi ɓa lo nyipyeyi shin bwa ntna wahala .
ma gye azafun nukwoyi ngun ata n wu ngye adug-ba ɓai kun n dragon egbe , n nyawan-nyawan egbeyi , n owo anabi katayi egbei .
a zafun , aɓo wowoyi zhinyi ye , ɓa si egbe do n asu anyi nyayi vinya , ɓa yeba zhi ɓa sunkun n dagayi n nyipyeyi yakwoyi owadawyi , shekwoyi ikoda nya .
fye wo , mi ɓei ɓe ntna esa ; dnayi ngy evi , anabarkada nu aza vinya n ɓa kmimilo n ɓa nu ajei zhin shiri lo , ɓato n na a pmayi lo ɓai zan-zan n na bwotolo yin n vinyikwoyin . ɓa ye a soja anyi nya zhi vinya n aba n na yi ibrananciyi nge , arma-giddon , magiddo epe .
nnavun malaika tnabayi waze wo papa ya fi n ese , wyisa yakwo kwa gmi n aduwa-nyakun n eshe mi kwoi gna , aku zo zhin . ogma sawyi kwa ci aɓo , kwa bmiyana , eknia shan-shan n nato shin kwo pya zhin dna n zanyi-kwoci asesemi n na anyin .
ezhi yakwo babila kwa gna aje ngun ata , azhi yakwo nɓa shegun ɓa miya laɓa n na anyi , nlo nu shekwoyi wa pa babila alaifi ɓo vinya n wo bugba mi , a tawo to a ce minagyi wan har owo minagyi kwa zo .
a muse vinya ɓa busiya laɓa , ape vinya ɓa ɓaya .
a gma kuta a yakwo ɓakun n eshe , agma kuta n woshan , har laba tagyi ɓa kaya kpe aza n anyi , ɓa tu shekwoyi ekni ntu n na agmakuta a nukwoyi ye ɓo .
mawo begye yakwo kwoi gmi n aduwa-nyakun kwoi daɓo n na amalaika tnabayi , fyelo n saiye fye ze a papa tnaba shekwoyi minagyi nya ya fi n na anyi . nlonu malaika kmisunyi wafa aduwa-nyakun wa ze papa kmisunyi yafi n anyi , a gbago , a cisa nukwoyi a sansanyi , ɓa kunkpe n na aza vinya , nɓa n nyawan-nyawan lambayi lo ɓai ga wo mwa-mwa nwo nya zhin zhinyi .

mawo malaika a nuwanya woi gna , kwo wulo cewo shi ho tnu n wadaye pya yi , o , oza gyi-gyi-yi , nwo nyi wo ɓei nyi .

a gma kuta a yakwo ɓakun n eshe , agma kuta n woshan , har laba tagyi ɓa kaya kpe aza n anyi , ɓa tu shekwoyi ekni ntu n na agmakuta a nukwoyi ye ɓo .
nyikwoza byei-byei zaknayi n na amalaika n ɓa ɓei ze anyasan anukwoyi ya nyi , wa ɓe wa daɓo n mi yi , wa gna , ɓe ngnisum n miyi , ma wuho oɓo n kwo ye kwa bwa karuwa tawoɓo ye , n wo sase tu n na anuwan yakwo anyi nya nyi .
asu anyi nya nku aɓo a nukwoyi zhin n woi .
aza n ɓafi n anyi nyi n ku wo nuwan nukwoyi sin , a ɓenukwoyi nya . malaika wa lami dna n zafun , yalo bmana .
nɓo magye nyikwoza n sasetu n nyawan-nyawan , n wu n byei-byei ciwu , n na atukwoyi ngun tnaba , n na amwayi gyi ngun awo , n nya yi kakpe nɓa , n ɓa tu shekwoyi eye cegye .
nyikwozai n jekpei kpe bmina-bmina ndohoi kpe ciwu , n nyigunyi zhin n zinariya yi , n lu-lu manayi , n na akutabmiya-bmiya yi , n ebwe yi shi zinariya nya , n nunuyi n wye bwo yi , asisi nya , a cegye owo anagbai nya .
a na a sigyi eye yi kakpe n wo nyikunmi , babila dnagmayi , a karuwa ʼya n na ashan yi n na gba vinya n na anyi mi . magye eje kwoi zhin nyikwozayi , eje aza gyi-gyi-yi ami nya , azafi yesu anya n wa wu .
ma shiwo awye , ednayi womi .
malaika wa nyami ge , kninu zhin cei wo hoa ?
miɓa wuho owo , ma wuho nyawan-nyawan n wo gun nyi , nya n wo zhin kwo dogbe .
wo ɓei n wye-wyeyi ama nsaiye woto lon .
ama esafyewyi woɓa gmiɓe n bwokun tna cei , walo bwi-bwi nyalo-nyalo nya .
n azai nɓa fi n anyi n ɓa aye to kafi lo n littafi wye-wyeyi nya nyin , kafin a zhin anyi , ce ɓei woɓa nɓa ɓei gyewo n wo efi avun .
nsaiye , zhin nubo n mwa , owo amwayi ngun tnaba zhin ezhi yakwoho nu , n mitu n ape ngun tnaba , aba n nyikwozaye sase nyi .
ɓa zhin dogbe asu ngun tnabanu , ngun atnu nla miya , tnanyi yi gyi ebelo nsa ye , tnabayi to ɓe kpan , ama woto ɓei gyi ebe n mwasan .
nyawan-nyawan ciwuyi ye n wa finyi , owo nu zhin esu nyimwanymwayi , woku ebe shin gyi ngnisun n na asu tnabai , woɓei gyi ebe n jesun n wo begyi bwabayi ye , avun woi lo a bwi .
owo amwayi ngun awo zhin asu ngun awo nu , n ɓa to gyi ebe kpan , aɓei kni ɓa , ɓai gyi ebe esa fyewyi , ngnisun n woi .
oɓa vinya ɓei tu obwa n takarda ɓoi gawo oɓa kala vinya n ikoi .
ngnisun , ɓa ɓei sun okun n kugyai .
kugya ɓei gyi nasara nɓa tukwo , gama owo nu zhin a dagayi dagayi .
esu aje esu , owo aza nu zhin ayi-yi-i a kni-kniyi , a gbenuyi . anuwan yakwo , ala , n na adnai n nyikwozai sase tu nyi , ɓanu zhin aza vinya n na abyei vinya n na akniyi .
nyawan-nyawan byei-byei n wo amwayi ngun awo , zhin dogbe n na asu yi ngun awo n ɓa ɓei gyi ebe ngnisun n woyi ɓa wun nyikwozai nu , ai cewo okun ai fawo n bwotoloyi ena kwoi gyi wo .
gama shekwoyi ɓei dnaɓa shiri nɓa nubo zhimi , shiri n kwo ɓanu wo beye .
ɓa ɓei gun egbe ɓa ga nyawan-nyawan byei oɓa ebegyi , n na abai shekwoyi ɓeda kwa nu .
nyikwoza yi n ha gye n ho ruya nyi , owonu zhin ezhi dnagmayi n kwo gyi ebe tu n asu anyi nya tukwo nyi .

ezhi yakwo la miya n deye avun vinya , ma gye malaika woi ɓe n she n begyi yakwoi , anyi ɓa bmiyana nwo mwamwayi .
wa sawyi n kalai , babila dnagmayi nla miya , kwola miya , wola ze alijanu fiba , a guzhenyi a fazan zan ba , n zafun nukwoi dohodohoi .
gama abye vinya n ku nuwan nukwoyi efinya owo aɓo nukwoi nya sin .
asu anyi nya n ku ɓahin dagma n woi , anyakunyi n ku ze anyanbwai ntu n wo nayida kala ɓo . mawo begye kwoi gmi n eshe kwoi gna , fye la kun n wo aba emi aza , fyeto ye ɓedo n wo alaifiyin , kada a tafe ɓedo n woi .
gama owo alaifi n la tugbaga n lawu n eshe , shekwoyi nku shiri zhin wa tawo ntu wo aɓe nukwoyi ɓo .
zhin wo shi wa zhin ho , nduɓo , gbawo aɓe zhin-zhin nukwoyi ta zun ɓa .
wa ga aza ebwe bugba wunya , gawo lonu zunɓa .
wola sase dna n nanyi do n agmadai , mwi kwo do n kasu n ibugbawunyi n anyi .
nsayi woi gma nge , ʼmi zhin sarauniya nu tu n mi esu-shinkpegye , mito zhin anyigbai banzanya nun , mi ta kpe bugba wun yen . ʼ ntuce nu bugba wun efi nya n bwiciyi , n mikunyi ɓei ɓefye aba n nyipyeyi gmanyi nu , ena yi gyiwo n sagmanyi yi , gama dagayi zhin iko da nu n wo dawo owa nyi .
anyi tukwoda nɓa dnabwa n wo aɓo nukwoyi a wyebwo nya zhinyi , ɓai dagma n wo alheri nyi , ɓa ɓei ciwo ebwi shi ɓa ɓei gye awu ɓai gmi n wo agusa .
ɓa ɓei zhi n kpayi , ɓai vin n ednai , ɓai cibwi ge , ʼowyi , babila ezhi dnagmai n esa gmanyi nu n kwo kni zun aɓe . ʼ anya siyi anyi nya ɓei cibwi , ɓai wun bugba ntu nwo ɓo , gama zaho to cegni lo wa si oɓa akayan .
owonu ɓei zhinɓa anya siyi dnagmayi n zinariya , azurfa , akuta manayi , luʼu-luʼu yi , linen manayi , siliki , n eje byei-byei yi , n na shinwan sundayi , n na akaya yi n na zhin n dagba nyi-kna yi , n na shinwan nakwoyi , akaya yi n sinkna byei-byei yi , n sunkna zhiyi-zhiyi , n kuta manayi yi .
n yaji yi , ntulare yi , n emi yi , n luban yi , n anab nuwan yi , zaitun emi yi , n wyiluku luku-luku yi , n alkama yi , anakwo , na adoko , karusai n na afyenuyi , har ɓedo n na a zanyikwoci wyewyeyi .
anya amanayi vinya n ɓa ɓo daho ɓa du , anyida n mwa-mwai n ɓa daho nyi ɓa ta jeho aba ɓen , ɓa du nyalo-nyalo .
ntucenu anyakunyi , nɓa ze a nyabwai ntu n na anya deye kun ɓo nyi , ɓa ɓei zhi n kpai , ɓai wo wahala dna n ɓahin tukwo , ɓai cibwi ɓai fi aku .
ʼaiya , ezhi dnagmai , n bmiya ngye nyikwoza , n zhi-zhinyi n linen putu-putu yi , n eje bye-byei ciwu , n zhin-zhin yi n zinariya yi , n na a kuta manayi , n luʼu-lu-uyi .
n esa gmanyi yi ezhi yi nyabwa vinya n la wunya . ʼ ayada vinya n aya tukwodai , n aya dnayi ɓa ɓei zhi n tagni .
ɓai cibwi shi ɓa gye awu ɓai gmiya gun eshe , nge , ʼnknibwayi nu n ezhi dnagmayi lo ngye deye pya ? ʼ ɓa kpe abwitukun n ɓa tukwo , dna nɓa bugba wun , ɓai gna , ʼewyi , ewyi , n ezhi dnagmayi aba , kwa zhinyi yi ze anyabwayi ntu n kwo nyabwa ɓo .
nʼsaiye n esa gmanyi yi ɓa ku bwi vinya .
ʼamma oho , o eshe , dagma n owo bwi-bwi , efye shekwoyi aɓi , n na anabiyi n na amanzaniyi , gama shekwoyi ku owa dawo gafye n sayi . ʼ navun malaika yakwo , wala , kuta n wu n gye ata wyigwonya , wa shekwoya dna n nuwan yakwo , wa sawyi , babila ezhi dnagmai aɓa she kwoya , shi ma she kuta ye ya nyi .
kwa bwi n awyeba nyalo-nyalo .
ata shan anyi begye wo n kwon , kwo amolo kwo amwayin , ata shan abwa ze doho-dohoi ze n ezhi yin , ata shan ewyi gwon .
wyegma , wyegma okwo asukwo vinyal kwo fitila ato ɓei gye n kwo atagan n i jesun ato ɓei je amula a shan won , n na amula ɓa n na amula anyikwoyi begye dadayin .
a kpe owo anyansiyi ye vinya n anyi , n wa dna anyi kwoce n wo aɓeyi-sunyi anabi n aza gyi-gyi-yi vinya n na aɓei wu ɓanyi , oɓa ami tulo n wo tukwo . n deye avun vinya , ma gye malaika woi ɓe n she n begyi yakwoi , anyi ɓa bmiyana nwo mwamwayi .
wa sawyi n kalai , babila dnagmayi nla miya , kwola miya , wola ze alijanu fiba , a guzhenyi a fazan zan ba , n zafun nukwoi dohodohoi .
gama abye vinya n ku nuwan nukwoyi efinya owo aɓo nukwoi nya sin .
asu anyi nya n ku ɓahin dagma n woi , anyakunyi n ku ze anyanbwai ntu n wo nayida kala ɓo . mawo begye kwoi gmi n eshe kwoi gna , fye la kun n wo aba emi aza , fyeto ye ɓedo n wo alaifiyin , kada a tafe ɓedo n woi .
gama owo alaifi n la tugbaga n lawu n eshe , shekwoyi nku shiri zhin wa tawo ntu wo aɓe nukwoyi ɓo .
zhin wo shi wa zhin ho , nduɓo , gbawo aɓe zhin-zhin nukwoyi ta zun ɓa .
wa ga aza ebwe bugba wunya , gawo lonu zunɓa .
wola sase dna n nanyi do n agmadai , mwi kwo do n kasu n ibugbawunyi n anyi .
nsayi woi gma nge , ʼmi zhin sarauniya nu tu n mi esu-shinkpegye , mito zhin anyigbai banzanya nun , mi ta kpe bugba wun yen . ʼ ntuce nu bugba wun efi nya n bwiciyi , n mikunyi ɓei ɓefye aba n nyipyeyi gmanyi nu , ena yi gyiwo n sagmanyi yi , gama dagayi zhin iko da nu n wo dawo owa nyi .
anyi tukwoda nɓa dnabwa n wo aɓo nukwoyi a wyebwo nya zhinyi , ɓai dagma n wo alheri nyi , ɓa ɓei ciwo ebwi shi ɓa ɓei gye awu ɓai gmi n wo agusa .
ɓa ɓei zhi n kpayi , ɓai vin n ednai , ɓai cibwi ge , ʼowyi , babila ezhi dnagmai n esa gmanyi nu n kwo kni zun aɓe . ʼ anya siyi anyi nya ɓei cibwi , ɓai wun bugba ntu nwo ɓo , gama zaho to cegni lo wa si oɓa akayan .
owonu ɓei zhinɓa anya siyi dnagmayi n zinariya , azurfa , akuta manayi , luʼu-luʼu yi , linen manayi , siliki , n eje byei-byei yi , n na shinwan sundayi , n na akaya yi n na zhin n dagba nyi-kna yi , n na shinwan nakwoyi , akaya yi n sinkna byei-byei yi , n sunkna zhiyi-zhiyi , n kuta manayi yi .
n yaji yi , ntulare yi , n emi yi , n luban yi , n anab nuwan yi , zaitun emi yi , n wyiluku luku-luku yi , n alkama yi , anakwo , na adoko , karusai n na afyenuyi , har ɓedo n na a zanyikwoci wyewyeyi .
anya amanayi vinya n ɓa ɓo daho ɓa du , anyida n mwa-mwai n ɓa daho nyi ɓa ta jeho aba ɓen , ɓa du nyalo-nyalo .
ntucenu anyakunyi , nɓa ze a nyabwai ntu n na anya deye kun ɓo nyi , ɓa ɓei zhi n kpai , ɓai wo wahala dna n ɓahin tukwo , ɓai cibwi ɓai fi aku .
ʼaiya , ezhi dnagmai , n bmiya ngye nyikwoza , n zhi-zhinyi n linen putu-putu yi , n eje bye-byei ciwu , n zhin-zhin yi n zinariya yi , n na a kuta manayi , n luʼu-lu-uyi .
n esa gmanyi yi ezhi yi nyabwa vinya n la wunya . ʼ ayada vinya n aya tukwodai , n aya dnayi ɓa ɓei zhi n tagni .
ɓai cibwi shi ɓa gye awu ɓai gmiya gun eshe , nge , ʼnknibwayi nu n ezhi dnagmayi lo ngye deye pya ? ʼ ɓa kpe abwitukun n ɓa tukwo , dna nɓa bugba wun , ɓai gna , ʼewyi , ewyi , n ezhi dnagmayi aba , kwa zhinyi yi ze anyabwayi ntu n kwo nyabwa ɓo .
nʼsaiye n esa gmanyi yi ɓa ku bwi vinya .
ʼamma oho , o eshe , dagma n owo bwi-bwi , efye shekwoyi aɓi , n na anabiyi n na amanzaniyi , gama shekwoyi ku owa dawo gafye n sayi . ʼ navun malaika yakwo , wala , kuta n wu n gye ata wyigwonya , wa shekwoya dna n nuwan yakwo , wa sawyi , babila ezhi dnagmai aɓa she kwoya , shi ma she kuta ye ya nyi .
kwa bwi n awyeba nyalo-nyalo .
ata shan anyi begye wo n kwon , kwo amolo kwo amwayin , ata shan abwa ze doho-dohoi ze n ezhi yin , ata shan ewyi gwon .
wyegma , wyegma okwo asukwo vinyal kwo fitila ato ɓei gye n kwo atagan n i jesun ato ɓei je amula a shan won , n na amula ɓa n na amula anyikwoyi begye dadayin .
a kpe owo anyansiyi ye vinya n anyi , n wa dna anyi kwoce n wo aɓeyi-sunyi anabi n aza gyi-gyi-yi vinya n na aɓei wu ɓanyi , oɓa ami tulo n wo tukwo .
aza yezhi agmada nshe mi ndeye avun mawo deji kwoi ɓewyi n eshe , haliluya , la dagayi tu , gnigni gmi n shekwoyi aba nu .
mwa-mwa n begyi zhin owo nya nu gmanyi .
gama owo wada zhin ɓefyece nu n gaiciya yi .
wola karuwa yakwoi ta n wo ɓei tu anyi cegye n wo alaifi nyi , woi gba ta ga wo afyenu n na ɓei wu nyi . oɓa begye aiwo njesun cici , ɓei kwo anyi ge , la dagayi tu !
awu owo nagyi nya ɓa gunlo eshe nyalo-nyalo . atukwoda shiba cei anyi , n awyewyeyi dayi ngun anyi ɓa yazhi n kni ɓai ga shekwoyi mwa-mwa , n wo sasetu n esu-shinkpegye ɓai gna , amin , haliluya la dagayi tu .
begye a gmi n esu-shinkpegye kwa gna , la eyi shekwoyi tu , ofye owo abara vinya , dnagmayi n nawyi yi , n fye wowo edna nyi . mawo aɓoci n jesun ngye aza begye ɓeda , kwo n gye anuwan yakwo n ɓaluya n na adnagbe , kwo ngye ogma wyisa yakwo , la dagayi tu .
gama dagayi eyi shekwoyi iko da vinya gyi ebe lo . yi dagma ya nya agmada , ya gawo mwa-mwa , gama esa n lasi n na ɓa zhin buki kugya nya , owo mula nyikwo n la wohin zhin shiri .
ala ye wo wa kpe linen n kwo du n gyi-gyi n bui-buyi n bmiya-bmiya yi .
( linen manayi zhin aɓe mana nu n shekwoyi aza zhin ) .
malaika wa ba ɓeda ye gami , an , abarka da nu aza n na la ɓa yi ɓa ɓe kugya a buki aba . wa kma ɓeda ɓe nge , shekwoyi nu na dace . ma yashi nwo apita ma ga wo mwa-mwa , ama wa gna , lafa to zhin .
gama mi zhin shekwoyi fyenu nu n gye ho ce , n ho azajei a yesu viyi , n ɓa zhin seida n ɓa gaiciya gayi n yesu nyi . delili anabci ye nya vinya , n na ɓoi n ma wu ho nyi , ɓa zhin seida nu tu n yesu tukwo .
asu aje su nnavun ma gye eshe n guya gni n dokwo buyi gni agni gni n ɓo , ayi oza n wo ɓei sase tu n dokwo yi nyi ge , gbenuyi n gaiciya yi oza nwo ta aza nyi , woi sun okun .
owo awye wu ngye ena go-goyi n na rawani yi kpe nwo tukwo n mwa , n wo yei katu n nyikunmi n zaho ta kpe kwo yelon sai owo .
wo n na ajei kpe n dafi n ami , ayiwo ge , shekwoyi ɓeda . akun sunyi n eshe vinya n na linen manayi kpe bmiya-bmiya yi vinya , ɓai viwo n kpe n adokwo buyi .
wo n ebe yakwo gyi-gyi-yi shi nwo egbe wa zun abye kni n cei , wa gyi ebe tu nɓa tukwo n sinkna bwayi , wa dna anab nuwan-piba shekwoyi ikoda minagyi nya .
nwo eye yi kakpe n wo jekpe n buzhi-kwo nge , esu aje esu , dagayi a dagayi aje nya . magye malaika gni agni gni n nyipyeyi za-za , woi sawyi ga alu vinya nge , fye ɓe , fya yezhi ntu shekwoyi dnagmayi buki ɓo !
fye ɓe fya gyi asu abu , n na akun atukwoda abuyi n na bezhe yakwo yi , n na adokwo yi , n ɓa gunyi-i , n na azanyi-kwoci yi , adnagmayi n na ɓiyi-i alo-loi ya n na apapayi . nnavun magye , nyawye-wyei nukwoi , woi ye a gwomnati anyi nya zhi nɓa asojayi , ɓa sunkun n zai nwo tu n dokwo buyi nyi n wo akunsun yi .
a wan nyawye-wyei n anabi katayi , n wo zhin aɓo wowoi esa n nyawye wyei nukwoyi gni n cei nyi , aɓo a wo-woi nɓa dna aza kwoce n ɓa ɓei gwo nyawye-wyei nukwoyi zetu , n ɓa ga owo nya zhin-zhin mwa-mwa nyi , oɓa ba nyawye-wyeyi nukwoyi n wo anabi katayi a sheɓa yafi n wye-wyeyi yi n ena zundna n kwo gyina n suffa yi nyi .
a wu ɓa akun sunyi vinya , n ebe yakwoyi n kwo dna n oza egbe n wo tu n dokwo buyi nyi .
alu anyi bmanaya vinya ɓa gyi ɓa abu nuboʼa kuɓa fu har eshakpi .
ndeye avun mawo deji kwoi ɓewyi n eshe , haliluya , la dagayi tu , gnigni gmi n shekwoyi aba nu .

a la shetan pa nnavun magye malaika woi kashi n eshe n mabudi obwo tnacei nyai shi n na agma yakwoyi shi n wo akun .
wa wan dragon , owa kwo-kwoi , oza nukwoyi , shetan , wa pawo n na agma yi har eye tagyi ngun awo , ( , ) .
wa shewo ya dna n obwo tnacei wa gu wa makuli dna , n na bai n wota dna abye kwocen sai aye tagyi ngun awo n la duya .
nnavun ai lowoya esafyewyi .
nnavun magye esushinkpegye n na azai sase kpe n ɓai n na la izini ga ɓa ɓa dawa , ma gye a wye-wyeyi aza nya n na ɓei kmiɓa tukwo ya ntu nɓa seida yesu nya ɓo , ntu n shekwoyi ɓeda waʼazi zhin ɓo , n na azai n ɓato ga nyawye-wyeyi mwa-mwa n owo nya zhin-zhin yin , to ɓa gwo owo zetu nɓa nyikunmi ko abwan .
ɓai ku wye-wyeyi jebwa ɓai gyi ebe ngnisun n kristi yi har aye tagyi ngun awo ( , ) .
kalaku n efi kmisunyi nu nyi , ( azafi nɓa ce nyi ɓa to kukala kpan sai aye tagyi ngun awo n la duya ) .
anabarkada nu n agyi-gyi yi aza nɓa bwa lo-lo dna n kalaku kmisunyi .
gama efi bayi to n ikoyi lo n ɓa tukwon gama ɓaɓa zhin a prist shekwoyi anya n kristi yi ɓai gyi ebe n woi har aye tagyi ngun awo .
shi aye tagyi ngun awo ɓei la duya ai lo shetan ya n wo kurkuku .
wo ; gmilo wo dna abye kwoce n na anyi wa yeɓa zhi gnisun , gog n magog yi , ɓa sun okun , aza begye , to ai shin ban , ngye amwi n ɓa kpe n ela gbe .
ɓa ɓei gunlo ɓa duyalo bmana yakwo anyi nya ɓai she shekwoyi aza gun , n ezhi ye-yei urushelima nya , ama ena ɓei gmi n shekwoyi aba kwoi gyi akunsunyi vinya kwoi wuɓa .
nnavun , shetan nwa dnaɓa kwoce nyi ai shewo yadna n ena zundna n kwo gyi n sulfa yi nyi , aba n nyawan-nyawan n anabi katayi fi nyi , ai wu ɓa anyi n nyipyeyi n sukwoyi nyalo-nyalo .
magye esu-shinkpegye bui-bui , n zayi nwo sase tu n kwo , anyi n eshe bmana yi ɓa busi n wo awyeba , ama to ɓa bwa abwi ban .
ma gye azafi , adnagmayi n aɓiyi n gni a gni zhi n shekwoyi abye , a gu a littafi ya , n littafi wye-wyeyi nyai ɓe .
a da azafi owa n nya yi nkwo kafi n na a littafi yi mi , zaho-zahoi shiwa zhin n wu .

anyi woiwoyi nshe woiwoyi-i n navun magye , anyi woi woyi ( n tna ala ) n eshe woi-woyi , gama anyi nsaiye nya n duya .
omi yohanna , magye , ezhi gyi-gyi-yi , urushelima woi-woyi kwoi gmi n shekwoyi aba n eshe kwoi shin zhi ɓe , nya bmiya-bmiya yi , ngye mula anyikwo n wo mula pa aba .
ma wo begye yakwo , kwoi gmi n esu-shinkpegye kwoi gna , shi awye shekwoyi puwa lo n kunsun n na azai nsayi , wa sase n kunsun nɓai ɓa zhin owo aza , e , shekwoyi nwohin tukwo wa sase dna nɓa atasin .
wa wunɓa awyenyi ya n na awyeba vinya , efi ta shan sun , kwo bugba wun , kwo ebwi cin , kwo nayi , san .
aɓeye vinya nla duya nyalonyalo . oza nwo sase tu n esushinkpegye nyi wa gna , gyewye , mi zhin anya woi-woyi nu , wa gnami nsai ge , ka aɓeye kpe , gama oɓo n mi gnaho nyi kwo zhin oɓo hin-hin nu n gaiciya yi . aku zo zhin , eminu zhin a n z yi , kmisunyi n kmazoyi , mi ɓa ga oza n nuwan mikun wowo a nuwan kpeba , nuwan wye-wyeyi nya , cauta .
ozaho-zahoi n wa gyi nasara , wo ɓa bwa anyi gye vinya gado , ma ze wo shekwoyi wa ze mi oɓi .
ama aɓiɓi n ɓa fa mi viɓo ɓai jeze n na avun yi , n na azayi nɓa ta nu egben , n na cegye dayi , azawuyi , n na aɓenukwoyi-zhinyi , n na aza yi n ɓa daɓo n alijanu yi , n na shangbayi , n na a kataceyi vinya , oɓa abwiba nyi n anapi ena zundna n kwo gyi ena n sulfa yi .
efi bayi nu .
malaika gmanyi n na amalaika tnaba mi nɓa n ɓo ze a papa anyasan dnagmayi nya nyi , wa ɓe wa gna mi ge , gni ɓe n miyi ma wuho mula-nyikwo , kugya nyikwo . ezhi latu nya wa la mi dna n ruya wa lomi yi n epe nshe , ma gye ezhi manayi-i , urushelima gyi-gyi-yi kwoi gmi n na anyi bmana n shekwoyi aba .
kwo ɓei nunuyi n shekwoyi mwa-mwa yi , kwoi bmiyana ngye luʼu-luʼu na bmiyayi n wu pyanyi n gye jasper .
okwo a galu n mwakpa n mwapata n na abwokumiyi fi n gun awocei aba , a malaika ngun awocei-aba ɓai gu abwokunmi yi , n na a israilai bye ngun awo-cei-aba aye yi kakpe n abwokunmi awocei-aba yi .
abwokunmi fi n sepa dohodohoyi , n arewa abwokunmi ngun ata , n kudu abwokunmi ngun ata n yamma , abowkunmi ngun ata , n gabas abwokunmi ngun ata .
a galu yi n na agoro yi awocei-aba n na bara kugya nya aye yi kakpe n kwo agoro awo-cei-aba yi .
malaikayi n zinariya busi nyamwinyai shi n wo akun , wa mwi ezhi yi n kwa abwokunmiyi n kwa agaluyi .
shi wo ɓei mwi kwo wa gye kwo n na abwakwonu yi ngun anyi n mwi awye .
ekpa n pata yi sun dei-dei mile dubu gmanyi ncei kpe tagyi ngun atnun .
( , ) n navun wa mwi galu shin-shin wa gye kwo apita tagyi ngun aba ncei-kpe awocei tnanyi ( ) .
n zunduya malaika yi wa wumi mwi-mwi yi aye n nyamwi ye hin-hinyi .
ezhi n kwohin tukwo , nwu serai n gyi-gyi-yi zinariya nabmiya yi ngye maganyi .
a zhin kwo agalu n jaspa yi nu , amikwo kpe n agoro awo-ceiaba n na akuta a nakwoyi luʼu-luʼu yi goro kmisunyi n jaspa yi bayi n sapphire yi tayi n chalcedonyi yi nyiyi n emaraod yi tunyi n sardonyi yi tnanyi yi n sardus yi tnaba yi n crysolite yi nyimwa-nyimwa yi n beryl yi ciwa-gmanyi yi n topaz yi nwo yi n chrysoprase yi awocei-gmanyi yi n jecinth yi awo-cei-aba yi n amethyst yi .
a zhin abwokunmi awo cei aba yi n luʼu-luʼu yi nu , luʼu-luʼu dohodohoi n kwo bwai .
okwo azokwo n gyi-gyi-yi zinariya na bmiya yi , n gye maganyi .
aduwa-nyakun to ɓei nyi n ezhi yin gama dagayi shekwoyi ikoda n kugya yi a ga ɓa nu mwa-mwa n na aba vinya .
ezhiyi to n nyipyei ɓeyi pman kwo epyan , ɓa gakwo buzagnan , gama shekwoyi n kugya mwa-mwai nu gakwo buzangna .
okwo buzangna ɓei ga abye buzangna n anyi , abegyi yi n anyi vinya ɓei ɓe nɓa mwa-mwayi n kwo .
ata gu okwo abagu-nyan , ɓaguya zhi nylo-nyalo , sukwo to lon ɓom .
aɓei ɓe n abye-mwa-mwai n ɓa latuyi n kwo mi .
ato ɓei ye n nyaho-nyahoi n kwo zhin nukwoyi nɓon , ɓenukwoyi-zhinyi kwo tnagaiciya da to ɓei lo ɓon sai aza nɓa aye kafi n kugya litafi wye-wyeyi nya .
n navun magye , anyi woi woyi ( n tna ala ) n eshe woi-woyi , gama anyi nsaiye nya n duya .
omi yohanna , magye , ezhi gyi-gyi-yi , urushelima woi-woyi kwoi gmi n shekwoyi aba n eshe kwoi shin zhi ɓe , nya bmiya-bmiya yi , ngye mula anyikwo n wo mula pa aba .
ma wo begye yakwo , kwoi gmi n esu-shinkpegye kwoi gna , shi awye shekwoyi puwa lo n kunsun n na azai nsayi , wa sase n kunsun nɓai ɓa zhin owo aza , e , shekwoyi nwohin tukwo wa sase dna nɓa atasin .
wa wunɓa awyenyi ya n na awyeba vinya , efi ta shan sun , kwo bugba wun , kwo ebwi cin , kwo nayi , san .

aɓei ɓe n abye-mwa-mwai n ɓa latuyi n kwo mi .
ato ɓei ye n nyaho-nyahoi n kwo zhin nukwoyi nɓon , ɓenukwoyi-zhinyi kwo tnagaiciya da to ɓei lo ɓon sai aza nɓa aye kafi n kugya litafi wye-wyeyi nya .
ola nuwan wye-wye-yi nya .
wa wu mi ola gyi-gyi-yi nuwan wye-wyeyi nya , n tna cegye dnayi n gye crystal , kwoi zhe n shekwoyi shinkpegye , n kugyayi .
kwoi diya n zokwo yakwo a tasin , n ola kma a sepa aba-aba shinwan wye-wyeyi nya n pazhi kwoi gyi abye awo-cei-aba , kwoi gyi woiwoyi epya doho-dohoi , okwo afintolo ai zhin apma n cei ntu n na abye kagna ɓo .
nya nukwoyi doho-doho yi to ɓei lo ezhi yin , gama shekwoyi shinkpegye n kugya nyai ɓei fi n ɓo , owo abara ɓei ga wo mwa-mwa .
ɓa ɓei gyewo awyeba , ai ka wo eye kpe n ɓa anyikunmi .
sukwo tolo n ɓom , ato n fitila apmayi lo n ɓom , kwo nyipyei m .
gama dagayi shekwoyi nu zhin buzangna nɓo wo ɓei gyi ebe nyalo-nyalo .
malaika wa gnami ge , ɓeda ye zhin gbenu yi nu n gaiciya yi .
mi ɓelo esa fyewyi . shekwoyi n wo gna owo anabi oɓo nkwo ɓelo n na abye nyi , wo na tnu n-wo malaika yi wagnaho ge abyeye ɓelo esafyewyi .
anabarka da nu oza n wa gakwo gaiciya , n na anya yi vinya n ɓa kafi littafi .
omi yohanna , magye ma wo aɓeye vinya , ma yashi ma ga malaika mwa-mwa n wa wumi ɓa nyi .
ama wa gna , awo , to zhin oɓo n wu lo nun , emihin ce , mi zhin yesu bara nu n gye ho , n ho azajei anabi , n na azai n ɓa wo ɓeda n na cei kafi n littafi , ga shekwoyi nu mwa-mwa n wo gmanyi yi . wa gnami , to gu enya n ha kan , gama okwo anusa nla wo viwyi .
nsa si , aɓenukwoyi zhinyi ɓei gyi abye n ɓenukwoyi zhin yi .
cegye da ɓei gna cegye tu-tu nu .
aɓo manayi zhinyi ɓei gyi abye n ɓemana zhinyi aza n ɓa gyi-gyi-yi ɓa ɓei gyi abye n gyi-gyi-yi .
mi ɓe lo esa fyewyi shi awye , miɓelo esa fyewyi , emi lada n kunsun lo n miyi magba ozaho-zahoi shiwa zhin n wu .
ominu zhin a n z yi , ayaba n azo bayi , kmisunyi n kmaknayi .
anabaraka da nu nyalo-nyalo aza nɓa zhan oɓa ajekpe , n na bai ɓa bwa izini , ɓa lo ezhi yi n na abwokunmi , ɓa gyi shinwa wye wyeyi nya nɓo .
aza nɓa bma shekwoyi zokwo ya to ɓai vi won , n na aɓeyi , n na a shan-gbayi , n na azai n ɓa ye akata , ɓai ce ɓa .
omi yesu , mi la tnu n mi malaika yi , wa gna a eklisiya aɓeye , e mi nu zhin dauda abye tukwo n wo yawyi .
ominu zhin kpasu labmi nya . zafun n mulaɓayi ɓa gna ge , be fa azaho-zahoi n wa wo wa gna ɓe , oza ho-zahoi nwo n cei pma wo ɓe wa sin nuwan wyewyeyi nya cauta .
mi gna ozaho-zahoi n wo ba litafiye , ezaho-zahoi n wa ɓe nyado ndu odo nkwo kafi n ya nyi , shekwoyi ɓa ɓewo azhin n ɓa kafi n ya nyi .
ozaho-zahoi n wa ce enya kniya n kwo kafi n anabci ye shekwoyi ɓa gmi wo robo ya n shinwa wye-wyeyi nya , n ezhi gyi-gyi-yi n na dakwo ɓo n ya nyi .
oza n wa da aɓeye vinya nyi wa gna , e , mi ɓelo esa fyewyi ! amin ɓe , dagayi yesu .
alheri eyi dagayi yesu kristi nya ɓa kunsun n fyei vinya .
wa wu mi ola gyi-gyi-yi nuwan wye-wyeyi nya , n tna cegye dnayi n gye crystal , kwoi zhe n shekwoyi shinkpegye , n kugyayi .
